Job Description
Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience
Position Overview: We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
Core Daily Activities
Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.
Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio.
Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery.
Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments.
Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients.
Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials.
Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements.
Key Responsibilities:
Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use.
Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance.
Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios.
Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team.
Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations.
Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio.
Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction.
Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments.
Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience.
Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk.

jobs.description:
Job Description
Job Title: Observability & Monitoring Lead
Location: Pune, India
Love making complex systems feel simple and reliable? We’re looking for an Observability & Monitoring Engineer who is equal parts builder and detective—someone who instruments services end-to-end, shines a light on blind spots, and turns noise into actionable signals. You’ll help us evolve a modern RunOps capability that improves reliability, reduces toil, and elevates the employee experience across Zendesk.
About Zendesk
At Zendesk, we believe outstanding customer and employee experiences start with great service and resilient platforms. We lead with empathy, innovate with purpose, and celebrate diversity and inclusion in everything we do. Join our global team and help us build an observability practice that others want to copy.
The Role: We are seeking a highly experienced Observability & Monitoring Lead with 6+ years of industry experience to spearhead our SRE and observability strategy. You will be responsible for maturing our monitoring ecosystem, driving operational excellence, and reducing system downtime through proactive detection and incident management. You will bridge the gap between engineering and operations, ensuring that observability data directly translates into improved reliability, SLA compliance, and reduced MTTR.You will design and operate the telemetry backbone for our internal platforms and business-critical applications. This role spans metrics, logs, traces, synthetics, RUM, and event correlation—instrumenting services, building dashboards, tuning alerts, and partnering with Incident/Problem/Change to drive measurable reliability outcomes.
What You’ll Do
Design the observability stack: Define and implement standards for metrics, logs, traces, and profiling (e.g., OpenTelemetry collectors, exporters, and context propagation).
Instrument what matters: Establish golden signals, SLIs/SLOs, and health checks for priority services; automate baselining and anomaly detection.
Build actionable visibility: Create executive and on-call views (dashboards, service health, dependency maps) for Apps, Network, Collaboration tools, HRIS, and integrations.
Engineer signal > noise: Develop alerting policy as code; reduce false positives; implement suppression, deduplication, and auto-
Security & compliance: Ensure monitoring data is handled per policy; implement role-based access and guardrails for sensitive logs/metrics
Incident Reduction: Develop and execute strategies to systematically reduce the volume of high-priority incidents through trend analysis and proactive stability improvements.
Incident Automation: Lead the engineering of automated response workflows and self-healing capabilities to minimize manual intervention and accelerate resolution times.
Strategy & Architecture: Design and coordinate with engineering teams for comprehensive observability strategies, including logging, metrics, and tracing across distributed systems.
Tooling Enhancements : End-to-end management of observability stacks (Data Dog) and its integration with ITSM tools (Ticketing Tools) and applications. Seek assistance from product and engineering team for any tool enhancement use cases to build a robust observability platform integrated with the ticketing tools.
Application Onboarding: Responsible and accountable for onboarding relevant observability and monitoring necessities for new applications which are onboarded and handed over to operations.
Incident & SLA Management: Oversee the operational lifecycle of monitoring tickets and Lead the monthly analysis and reporting of performance metrics (Eg - Mean time to detect, Mean time to restore,Mean time to Respond/Accept, First touch resolution) and ensure SLA compliance .
Continual Service Improvement: Liaise with technical and level 2 teams to improve and mature the current monitoring state of applications in scope.
Process Automation: Drive the automation of incident reporting, alert correlation rules, and "alert fatigue" reduction. Transform raw telemetry data into actionable executive insights.
SRE Leadership: Responsible for managing the L1 SRE Engineers who will be handling the automated monitoring incidents in day to day operations.
Governance & Leadership: Manage governance calls, lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reviews, and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB).
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with domain team leads to define SLOs/SLIs, align on capacity planning, and ensure documentation (Runbooks/HLD/LLD) is maintained to "single point of failure" (SPOF) standards.
What You Bring
Experience: 6+ years in Observability/SRE/Platform/Monitoring roles supporting SaaS or enterprise applications.
Telemetry tools: Hands-on with monitoring and logging tools.
Tracing & metrics: Strong grasp of distributed tracing, RED/USE/golden signals, SLI/SLO/SLA, and error budgets.
Automation & code: Proficient in common languages such as Python.
Cloud & platforms: Experience with AWS
ITSM fluency: Comfortable operating within Incident/Problem/Change frameworks; adept at runbooks, RCAs, and post-incident reviews.
Data mindset: SQL or log query languages; can translate telemetry into insights and narratives.
Soft skills: Clear communicator, collaborative partner, bias to action, and calm during outages.
Nice to Have
Service maps/dependency modeling, synthetic/RUM design, APM transaction tuning, log schema governance.
Experience integrating observability with CMDB/service catalog and feature flag systems.
Certifications (e.g., AWS, Datadog).
Working Model
Hybrid role in India collaborating with global teams; core hours aligned to IST with occasional off-hours participation for major incidents or change windows.
Part of an on-call rotation with follow-the-sun support.

In this role, you will bridge engineering, operations, and business systems—driving system stability, proactive detection, and rapid incident mitigation while leading administration, enhancement, and process optimization across our Salesforce and Quote to Cash (Q2C) platform ecosystems.
You will be responsible for hands-on configuration of observability platforms, triaging system alerts and user reports, managing incident response workflows, enforcing end-to-end ITIL lifecycles (Incident, Problem, and Change Management), and configuring Salesforce applications (custom objects, validation rules, flows, profiles/permissions, and Q2C workflows) to support evolving administrative and business requirements.
Primary Platforms: Salesforce Sales Cloud, Core Sales and Salesforce CPQ / Q2C. Zuora Billing knowledge is a plus. Over time, you may also support onboarding of other critical Tier 0 and Tier 1 applications in the Salesforce value stream.
Key Responsibilities
Partner and collaborate with end users to understand administrative needs, resolve issues and meet business requirements.
Handle both end user tickets and monitoring tickets from ITIL perspective with end to end ownership maintaining required response and resolution SLA targets.
Liaise with the problem manager to identify repeated incidents and engage with level 2 or domain teams for permanent fixes.
Able to manage high impact major incidents P1/P2 and able to perform initial level troubleshooting and triaging.
Develop and mentor others around application customization via custom objects, validation rules, workflows, flows, process builder, etc
Implement, own and optimize internal processes to improve efficiency.
Document procedures, policies, and systems in Runbooks, SOPs and KEDBs/KB Articles.
Manage and own system administration and help streamline business functionality including: profiles/permissions, role hierarchy, security models, application customization, reports and dashboards, etc
In future , also support onboarding of other critical Tier 0 and Tier 1 applications relating to Salesforce value streams.
Detailed Roles & Responsibilities
Core Sales & ITCRM Support Responsibilities :-
User & Access Administration: Manage end-to-end user administration, including logins, MFA troubleshooting, password resets, license assignments, profiles, permission sets, roles, and sharing settings across Core Sales and Salesforce environments.
Visibility & UI Administration: Administer and adjust field-level security, custom fields, page layouts, record types, list views, report access, and button/tab visibility to support smooth end-user workflows.
Light Data & Config Operations: Execute routine data fixes, picklist updates, public group management, delegated approver setups, and light operational configuration updates.
Triage & Routing: Actively monitor and triage the ITCRM support queue and incoming requests, accurately categorizing issues, resolving L1/L2 admin queries, and routing non-admin requests (such as CPQ incidents or complex integrations) to appropriate domain teams.
ITIL-Based Incident & Request Handling: Own and drive ITIL-aligned Incident and Service Request lifecycles for Core Sales, meeting defined SLA targets for response and resolution times while maintaining clean documentation and knowledge base updates.
Salesforce & Quote to Cash (Q2C) Administration:-
Partner and collaborate with business stakeholders and end users to understand administrative needs, gather requirements, and resolve system issues.
Design, configure, and customize Salesforce applications using custom objects, validation rules, workflows, Flows, and Process Builder.
Manage system administration and streamline business functionality, including user profiles/permissions, role hierarchies, security models, reports, and dashboards.
Implement, own, and optimize internal Quote to Cash (Q2C) processes to drive operational efficiency across revenue and billing systems.
Triage & Incident Management:-
Actively triage incoming system alerts and user-reported issues, minimizing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore (MTTR).
Participate in incident swarming and real-time operational response utilizing modern collaboration and ITSM tools such as Incident.io, Datadog, Jira, and Slack.
Oversee the lifecycle of monitoring tickets, maintaining strict adherence to SLA compliance and response metrics.
Problem & Change Management:-
Assist problem manager to conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and facilitate Post-Incident Reviews (PIR) to eliminate recurring incidents for Salesforce CPQ & Core Salesforce.
Maintain and expand the Known Error Database (KEDB) and runbook documentation to mitigate Single Point of Failure (SPOF) risks across operational workflows.
Assist change manager in reviewing and governing change requests, verifying risk assessments and rollback plans to maintain operational continuity.
Tooling & Integration Management:-
Monitor, troubleshoot, and support bi-directional SaaS integrations and data pipelines (e.g., Salesforce-to-Zuora, Workato, AWS Lambda, and EHC/Zendesk platforms).
Ensure seamless data flow across ticketing and incident management ecosystems, collaborating with engineering leads to resolve integration breaks.
Required Qualifications
Experience: 4-6 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT Operations, System Engineering, NOC or Global Command Centre environments.
Observability & Systems Analysis: Hands-on experience handling telemetry-triggered incidents (APM, metrics, tracing in Datadog/Dynatrace) combined with strong business systems analysis capability in enterprise SaaS applications.
ITIL Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of ITIL frameworks, specifically Incident, Problem, and Change Management integration.
Cloud & Architecture: Technical experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), API integrations, payload troubleshooting, and database querying via SQL.
Salesforce & Q2C Expertise: Demonstrated experience administering Salesforce platforms, managing Quote to Cash (Q2C) workflows, configuring security models/permissions, and building declarative automations (Flows, validation rules)
Operational Drive: Proven track record in reducing alert fatigue, managing complex system environments, and maintaining composure during high-priority outage events.
Nice to Have
ITIL 4 Foundation certification or specialized certifications in Incident/Problem Management.
Prior experience in service-based or consulting environments with broad, multi-client operational exposure.
Background in a global technology company supporting enterprise-grade, business-critical SaaS systems and distributed topologies.
AWS , Salesforce and Integration/Middleware knowledge will be an addon.
Zuora Billing knowledge (subscriptions, amendments, charges, invoicing)
Salesforce Admin / CPQ / Platform certification.

Zendesk is transforming the way businesses build meaningful customer relationships. Our products help organizations deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences at scale, and our Admin Experience is central to how customers configure, manage, and get value from the Zendesk platform.

Join us at Zendesk, where we're on a mission to power exceptional service for every person on the planet. We're accelerating our ambition by building products rooted in the belief that behind every interaction is an opportunity to make a human connection.
To achieve this, we're in search of a successful Enterprise Account Executive with a proven track record in B2B sales and a passion for driving growth within the SaaS space. jobs.description:
Job Description
At Zendesk, we’re revolutionizing what’s possible in Customer Experience (CX) and Employee Services (ES). Our rapid innovation and Agentic AI leadership have earned the trust of thousands of forward-thinking businesses.
We are seeking aSenior Sales Engineer to sit at the intersection of enterprise software strategy, hands-on systems architecture, and advanced AI automation. This is not a traditional generalist presales role. This is a role built for highly technical builders who are deeply curious about how autonomous agents, security, analytics, and deep integrations fundamentally transform how enterprise work gets done. You will own the technical strategy for our global customer engagements, acting as a strategic advisor to both the C-suite and engineering leadership.
Why This Role? Why Now?
Drive the AI Revolution: Step into an elite presales environment where you will directly architect the deployment of modern Agentic AI workflows and Large Language Models (LLMs) for top global enterprises.
Strategic Scope: Evolve your career by expanding your enterprise influence by presenting technical value narratives directly to economic buyers and C-level stakeholders.
Innovative Culture: Work within an ecosystem designed to optimize human potential through advanced digital tools, where continuous learning, curiosity, and experimentation are hardwired into our daily performance.
Who We're Looking For
We are looking for a highly technical Individual Contributor who operates with considerable judgment and initiative. You understand the complex operational and financial implications of architecture choices and can confidently design customized enterprise-grade solutions. You have a passion for clean system configurations, combined with a sharp commercial mindset that links technical capabilities directly to business metrics, ROI, and organizational transformation.
What You'll Be Doing
Architect Agentic AI & Integration Workflows: Design, build, and operationalize advanced, agentic AI-driven customer workflows leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), deep prompt engineering, and modern automation frameworks.
Lead Technical Architecture Discovery: Conduct rigorous, deep-dive technical discovery and AI readiness assessments. Translate complex system requirements into scalable pilots and proofs-of-concept (POCs) and enterprise-grade pilots that demonstrate clear business value.
Build Scalable Accelerators: Proactively develop production-ready, reusable technical accelerators, middleware templates, and open-source-aligned API components that allow regional teams and Systems Integrators (SIs) to deploy Zendesk solutions at scale.
Own the Technical Sales Lifecycle: Serve as the absolute technical authority from qualification through execution. Architect secure, scalable topologies leveraging Zendesk APIs, webhook frameworks, and leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Bridge Product & Field Strategy: Partner directly with Product Management and Engineering to provide real-world, technical feedback from the field, identifying product gaps and shaping the future roadmap of Zendesk's core AI and platform ecosystem.
What You Bring to the Role (Basic Qualifications)
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related highly quantitative technical discipline is required.
Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience in technical presales, solution engineering, or a system architect/developer role within enterprise SaaS or complex software environments.
Technical Fluency: Deep expertise with modern web and scripting technologies (e.g., Python, Node.js, JavaScript), REST/SOAP APIs, middleware frameworks, and cloud ecosystem architectures.
AI/ML Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge of AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and autonomous agent deployment.
Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of enterprise infrastructure, contact center tech stacks (CCaaS, telephony, workforce management), or modern IT Service Management (ITSM) systems.
Travel Commitment: Ability and willingness to travel between 30% and 50% annually to lead critical, high-touch on-site customer architecture sessions and strategic regional briefings.
Preferred Qualifications
A Master’s degree or professional technical cloud/AI certifications.
Active engagement in the technical or developer community (e.g., open-source contributions, technical blogging, or community mentorship).
Proven track record of designing reusable implementation guides, integration playbooks, or localization toolkits for global delivery partners and systems integrators.
Experience flattening complex technical narratives into high-impact presentations tailored for executive, economic buyers and C-level stakeholders.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Fullstack Backend Focused (Ruby+React))
jobs.description:
Job Description
We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical leader for this team. In this role, you’ll define and drive the architecture, execution strategy, and long-term technical roadmap. You’ll lead the development of a feature-rich system that helps company admins onboard, adopt, and manage Zendesk products with ease, while also empowering internal teams to integrate their solutions efficiently.
If you’re passionate about building meaningful experiences, driving platform excellence, and creating extensible systems that serve both customers and internal teams, we’d love to have you on this journey.
Our ideal candidate is someone who takes the lead on anything they work on and is a self-starter with projects that has the initiative to drive a project from start to finish.
This role is based in Pune and requires you to work from office at least 3 days a week
What you’ll get to do each day:
Contribute to the code at the core of Zendesk’s support product - what you write will reach millions of people each day!
Break complex features into granular pieces of work, to facilitate incremental feedback cycles.
Take ownership of features and collaborate with the Tech Leaders to design and implement complete solutions.
Contribute to technical discussions and decision-making with other teams and partners across the global engineering organisation.
Prioritise and estimate work balancing feature delivery with the management of tech debt.
Participate in and lead activities such as pairing sessions and code reviews to facilitate continuous self-improvement for the whole team.
Work closely with our designers and product managers to help define the future of the product.
Triage customer issues in partnership with Product Managers.
Provide operational support for our services in Production.
Actively look for ways to improve the observability, performance, reliability and security of our services.
Show strategic forward-thinking and provide technical leadership to drive near-to-mid-term success (1-2 years).
What you bring to the role:
9+ years of experience in full-stack software engineering, with expertise in building enterprise-scale SaaS or large web applications.
Strong proficiency in any of the programming languages - Java, Ruby on Rails, GoLang, Scala, Typescript, NodeJs or any other object oriented language.
9+ years of experience working with JavaScript and TypeScript, as well as frameworks like React and Redux.
Solid experience with MySQL or similar. A knack for writing efficient queries and optimizing performance in high-traffic environments.
Good to have - experience/knowledge of front end technologies
A track record of delivering large-scale, high quality, and resilient web systems.
Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills in English - you’ll collaborate with our other product teams around the globe.
The ability to understand and communicate sophisticated concepts in a relevant and considerate manner. Explain and reason your technical decisions clearly and effectively to engineers of different levels and non-technical partners.
Experience solving difficult problems across multiple systems.
Experience coaching engineers, leading brainstorming discussions, and facilitating engineers working together to make decisions in a collaborative environment.
Ability to influence without authority, inspire and mentor others.
A culture of learning, growth, and innovation.
You’re comfortable jumping into unfamiliar codebases and languages.
Tech Stack:
You’ll be working on one of the largest Ruby on Rails codebases in the world!
Most of the team’s data is stored in MySQL and Redis.
We occasionally work in other adjacent services in Go and Java.
Our services connect with other services via a combination of gRPC, REST APIs, Kafka event streams, and GraphQL.
Our services are deployed to Kubernetes using Docker via Spinnaker, running on AWS. We don’t require previous experience with these specific technologies; we’re confident you can learn as we go.
We monitor and observe our production systems using Datadog

jobs.description:
Job Description
Why This Role? Why Now?
Customer experience is transforming through AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change — we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionizing how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology. As the technical and product expert for our AI-powered Resolution Platform, the AI Services Consultant role is integral to delivering quick time to value while guiding our customers through their configuration and optimization.
Mission
As an AI Services Consultant at Zendesk, your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. You will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex configurations with agility and precision. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure seamless integration and optimization of AI solutions, driving transformative business outcomes.
Overarching Objective For The Role:
Accelerate customers’ time‑to‑value by driving adoption and operational excellence for Zendesk AI solutions, ensuring customers realize measurable business impact from initial deployment through scale
Be the customer’s AI technical expert. Turn goals into the right configuration, integrations, and design choices, and remove blockers fast.
Lead smooth, on-time delivery. Run projects end-to-end with clear scope, timelines, and stakeholder alignment to deliver reliably.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Strategic Accountabilities
Technical Expertise & Guidance: Provide expert advice on the implementation and optimization of Zendesk AI products, ensuring customers leverage the full capabilities of the technology to meet their business goals.
Change Management & Training: Facilitate change management processes and deliver consultative sessions to ensure smooth adoption and integration of AI solutions within customer organizations.
Successful Project Delivery: Accountable for the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, meeting or exceeding customer expectations and maintaining high standards of quality.
Customer Satisfaction: Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, contributing to customer retention and potential upsell opportunities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including Customer Success and Sales, to ensure alignment on the customer’s AI Roadmap and address any technical challenges that would block the customer from adopting AI.
Tactical solutions for business outcomes: Ensure that AI solutions are effectively aligned with customer business goals, resulting in measurable improvements in customer experience and AI Adoption.
What You’ll Need to Succeed
Strategic Skills & Expertise
Consulting Expertise: Strong consulting skills with the ability to assess client needs, develop strategic solutions, and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Project Management: Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of AI projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.
Technical Proficiency in AI: Deep understanding of AI technologies, particularly Zendesk AI products, with the ability to implement and optimize these solutions effectively.
Agility and Adaptability: Ability to work effectively in diverse and dynamic environments, adapting to changing client needs and industry trends.
Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify challenges and develop innovative solutions.
Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends and advancements, ensuring the delivery of cutting-edge solutions to clients.
Qualifications
Must have a minimum of 3+ years of related experience in Consulting / Professional Services
Previous experience in go-to-customer/GTM roles in enterprise technology / SaaS — either customer success management, professional services/consulting, technical account management, or solutions engineering/pre-sales consulting
Demonstrated experience in using adoption and health analytics to build predictive models and forecasts for churn and expansion; surface early risk signals and recommended mitigations to secure retention and growth
Demonstrated experience designing and executing success plans or roadmaps that drive measurable customer outcomes
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
Experience managing AI or software adoption programs with demonstrated impact on business metrics such as retention or satisfaction.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
Certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred
Excellent program management and cross-functional influence skills
Familiarity with emerging AI trends is a plus
Ability to distill complex AI concepts for diverse audiences, especially executive stakeholders

jobs.description:
Job Description
Security Operations Engineer
Job Description
Zendesk is a global leader in AI-first customer service and employee service software, renowned for its powerful yet customer-friendly solutions. At Zendesk, we believe in building better customer relationships through our suite of products that are smart, flexible, and reliable.
We are looking for an experienced security professional to join our growing Cyber Security team. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical investigation skills with sound judgment, clear communication, and a genuine interest in improving how security operations work.
The Security Operations Engineer helps protect Zendesk, its products, and its customers by monitoring, investigating, and responding to security threats. The role combines hands-on security operations with threat hunting, incident response, cloud security, DLP investigations, and the continuous improvement of security tools, processes, and automation.
This is a hybrid role based in the Pune office.
Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.
What you’ll be doing
Join Zendesk’s global team of cyber responders.
Serve as a primary incident responder addressing critical security alerts and incidents across enterprise infrastructure, product offerings, and client environments.
Leverage enterprise security platforms to perform threat analysis, examine security incidents, and execute daily operational response workflows.
Conduct proactive threat hunts to identify visibility gaps and support deeper investigations.
Analyze Data Loss Prevention alerts, assess data-exfiltration risks, and assist with complex forensic analysis.
Collaborate with audit and compliance partners to respond to regulatory inquiries.
Lead cross-functional tabletop simulations by partnering with key internal stakeholders.
Stay current on emerging threats and attacker tactics. Analyze tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) observed in security events across devices and end-user systems.
Lead or manage technical cybersecurity investigations, including triage, scoping, containment, and documentation.
Contribute to the development and operation of automation and orchestration tools that reduce manual effort and improve response consistency.
Leverage artificial intelligence responsibly to enhance security orchestration, accelerate investigation workflows, and assist with building AI capabilities.
Collaborate with Security Engineering partners to enhance operational monitoring, threat detection, and incident response mechanisms.
Collaborate with the Threat Intelligence team and broader security community to build relationships and share knowledge.
Partner with internal stakeholders and business partners to explain major security incidents and implement actionable risk mitigation strategies.
Demonstrate adaptability by taking on expanding responsibilities and working effectively in dynamic, rapidly evolving environments.
Join Zendesk’s global cyber security on-call rotation to support continuous response operations.
Provide regional coverage across APAC through scheduled operational shifts, currently spanning 6:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. IST and 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. IST, on a rotational basis.
What you bring to the role:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, SOC, incident response, or threat hunting
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret security metrics, user behavior, and event patterns.
A team-first and collaborative approach.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex investigations, incidents, cyber threats, and recommended actions clearly to business stakeholders.
A strong security and analytical mindset, with the ability to think strategically about evolving threats to a customer-service platform, including risks introduced by AI and automation.
Experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR), and other log-aggregation tools such as QRadar, Splunk, or ArcSight.
Experience investigating Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) alerts, with a good understanding of network, proxy, firewall, cloud, Windows, and macOS logs.
Good understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security alerts.
Cybersecurity certifications such as CEH, CHFI, or AWS Certified Security Specialist,Microsoft Azure - SC-200, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer are a plus. Certifications such as GCIH, GPEN, GCFR, GREM, GCFA, CISSP, or CISM are an added advantage.
Hands-on experience building automated security workflows and AI-powered security capabilities is highly desirable.

jobs.title: AR Analyst
jobs.description:
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Finance Operations (FinOps) team provides and enhances core business services that are the backbone for Stripe. FinOps uses data and operational excellence to deliver technology solutions, procurement, billing and payroll services, strategic sourcing, and supplier relationship management to Stripe.
What you’ll do
We're looking for a Monetization Operations Analyst to join our growing team. This individual will help us improve user experience through accurate and timely onboarding of contracts, workflows and deliver improvements in our integrated financial systems with business partners, financial colleagues, and engineers.
Responsibilities
Be responsible for onboarding sold custom contracts into our billing systems
Ability to understand the legal languages of the contract and comfortable working on it and have strong attention to detail
Build scalable and auditable onboarding processes for new and existing users
Partner with internal systems, deal desk, legal, sales ops, internal audit, go-to-market, engineer and account managers to develop and improve the process.
Partner with account managers to solve user inquiries related to onboarding implementation, billing, and collections and if needed troubleshoot as well.
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams to assist with system implementations for billings, collections, and assist with internal and external ad-hoc audit support.
Help scale and optimize our processes by assisting with the execution of key projects and programs.
Gain unique insights into various businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Can quickly learn the Stripe ways of working and make a real impact through process enhancements.
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe
Assist with monthly and quarterly flux analysis of key metrics
Assist with ad hoc projects
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
4-5 years of relevant financial operations/billing experience or 3+ years of customer service experience with a degree in Business Administration, Finance, or relevant field.
Excellent communication and organizational skills, both written and verbal.
Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems and data sets to make complex investigation decisions
Strong knowledge of gSuite tools, Salesforce and MS-Office products and experience working with/analyzing contracts and large data sets.
Independently analyze and evaluate information from various data sources to determine a course of action for a matched case
Demonstrated experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders
Demonstrated history of taking on various types of challenging projects and producing results
Solution-oriented mindset with enthusiasm for establishing best practices
Self-disciplined, diligent, proactive and detail oriented
You will also likely have (not required):
* Knowledge in payments and the fintech industry
The ability to be flexible and comfortable with changing requirements
A builder's mindset and a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom
A passion for creating new systems and solving problems via infrastructure and automation

jobs.title: Finance Controller - Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description
You'll lead planning cycles, drive forecasting accuracy, and design reporting that highlights trends, drivers, and actions. You'll partner with business leaders to shape decisions, streamline operations, and ensure policy adherence. Your insights will improve productivity, margin, and resource allocation across the portfolio.
What you'll bring
You have working experience in controlling or financial analysis and can manage defined workstreams and support business partnering with limited oversight.
Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning, with the ability to conduct performance analysis.
Familiarity with business intelligence tools and data visualisation to prepare reports and present findings to stakeholders.
Working knowledge of accounting principles, financial compliance requirements, and internal controls.
Ability to collect and interpret financial data within the SAP Data and Analytics Ecosystem to identify trends and patterns.
Comfort applying AI-assisted approaches — including context engineering and agentic AI — to improve the quality and efficiency of financial outputs.
Minimum 4-8 years of experience.
We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.
In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools — including agentic AI — in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks, to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and driving adoption of AI practices within their teams.
What you'll build
You'll work closely with business units to deliver financial insights and improve processes across the Finance function.
Coordinate and perform planning activities — including forecasting and budgeting — to support strategic business decisions.
Analyse, streamline, and improve financial operations to drive process improvement.
Collect and organise financial data, interpret results, and identify trends to provide performance insights.
Prepare data visualisations and financial reports for business stakeholders.
Support governance and compliance activities to ensure adherence to corporate financial policies and internal controls.
Apply AI-assisted automation to routine controlling tasks to drive accuracy and efficiency.
Where you belong
You'll join the Finance team in Bengaluru, owning defined controlling and analysis workstreams while developing knowledge of SAP's financial frameworks and performance metrics. The team values analytical precision, data integrity, and a proactive approach to surfacing insights. You'll build depth in financial planning and analysis, with exposure to business intelligence, data visualisation, and process improvement across SAP's Finance function.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Project Manager
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche
Mission
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.
The Opportunity
Engagement Delivery
In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology.
Your work will include but will not be limited to:
understanding the business goal(s) and value of the project and striving to deliver the defined benefits to the organization
leading or being part of global project teams ensuring clear roles and responsibilities and resource assignment to the project plan deliverables
ensuring that the critical success factors of reliability, compliance, efficiency, sustainability, time to value are managed throughout the entire lifecycle of the projects
effectively managing stakeholders through the establishment of key relationships and developing an understanding of their organizations
generating, maintaining and tracking an accurate and realistic project plan, project risk and issue log and ensuring the project status is timely and transparent
preparing and presenting to relevant governance meetings as required by the project methodology and good project management practice
tracking project financials and seek governance approval when needed
applying organizational change management practices as needed and ensuring effective project communication
contributing to business development opportunities where appropriate
Capability Building
Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by:
Continuously improving the project management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics
Supporting the development of training content and toolkits for our team
Actively managing your project management upskilling
Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues
Who you are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes:
Appropriate university degree and 5+ years of project management related work experience
Strong knowledge in project management fundamentals (waterfall, SCRUM and others) and related tools
Experience in leading global/complex projects, organizing and optimizing resources and establishing clear priorities
Ability to motivate and lead a project team or team members if required
Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated proficiency in influencing, negotiating, and effective global collaboration.
Ability to effectively communicate across various levels of a complex, matrix organization. Ideally exposure to an additional field related to project management, such as project change management, business consulting, methodology coaching.
Experience in project management financials and resource management
In addition, the following skills will make you successful in your position and create the foundation for career growth at Roche:
Customer centricity
Collaborative ways of working
Presentation and influencing skills
Business acumen & systems thinking

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.
As a Senior Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst within GATE, you will be a recognized subject-matter expert on the U.S. healthcare data landscape. You will go beyond responding to requests — you will proactively scout, evaluate, and unlock new data assets that expand what Roche's U.S. commercial organization can see and act on. You will operate as a genuine thought partner to U.S. brand, market access, forecasting, field operations, and advanced analytics teams across multiple therapeutic areas, shaping decisions on multi-million-dollar data investments.
The Opportunity
Multi-Facet Data Asset Portfolio: Own the evaluation, acquisition, and lifecycle management of a broad and diverse portfolio of U.S. healthcare data assets — claims, EHR/EMR and clinical real-world data, specialty pharmacy and hub data, lab and biomarker/genomic testing data, payer and formulary intelligence, sales and distribution, provider reference and affiliation data, patient-level longitudinal data, and competitive/market intelligence.
Proactive Data Scouting & Market Sensing: Continuously track the evolving U.S. data vendor and RWD market — new entrants, emerging and innovative asset types, consolidation, and pricing/licensing trends. Bring forward unsolicited recommendations on datasets Roche should consider and on new use cases that existing assets could unlock.
Therapeutic Area Partnership: Partner with stakeholders across Oncology, Ophthalmology, Cardiovascular-Renal-Metabolic (CVRM), Neurology, Immunology and Rare Disease, translating each TA's distinct commercial questions into fit-for-purpose data requirements — recognizing that a retina franchise, a solid-tumor biomarker-driven brand, and a cardiometabolic primary-care brand each demand fundamentally different data strategies.
Vendor Evaluation & Head-to-Head Benchmarking: Evaluate new and incumbent vendors (eg:-IQVIA, Komodo Health, Clarivate/DRG, MMIT, Optum, Truveta, Flatiron, Verana ), on methodology, capture and coverage, patient/provider linkage, recency and lag, known biases, limitations, and fit-for-purpose. Design and run structured bake-offs and overlap analyses rather than relying on vendor claims
External Partnerships: Act as the primary technical counterpart to external data vendors — interrogating source methodologies, resolving data quality queries, influencing roadmap and enhancement requests, and supporting renewal and expansion discussions with an evidence-backed point of view
Data Profiling & Risk Assessment: Perform hands-on profiling, cross-source comparison, and validation. Quantify gaps, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback to ensure alignment with business objectives and realistic expectations of what the data can and cannot support.
Who You Are
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Bioinformatics, Public Health, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Experience: 5–8+ years of relevant experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics, healthcare data strategy, life sciences consulting, or a healthcare data vendor. Prior experience in a Data acquisition, Data strategy, Data governance, or RWD-evaluation function is strongly preferred.
Multi-Facet Data Asset Exposure (core requirement): You have worked hands-on across several of the following and can speak credibly to the strengths, biases, and limitations of each:
Claims: open vs. closed, medical vs. pharmacy, submits vs. remits, switch/clearinghouse vs. payer-sourced (IQVIA LAAD/Dx/PharMetrics, Komodo, Clarivate), patient-lives coverage, payer mix, rejection/denial and reversal analytics
EHR/EMR and clinical RWD: structured vs. unstructured content, clinical depth (stage, biomarkers, labs, performance status, laterality), health-system coverage bias, ambulatory vs. inpatient capture, and the NPI/provider-identifier limitations of EHR sources
Data Linkage: tokenization and patient-level linkage across claims, EHR, lab, and specialty pharmacy assets (e.g., Datavant), and the practical pitfalls of doing so
Specialty pharmacy, hub, and distribution data; buy-and-bill dynamics
Lab, diagnostic, and biomarker/genomic testing data
Payer, formulary, and market access intelligence (MMIT, DRG Fingertip, Policy Reporter), including coverage policy, utilization management, and GTN-relevant inputs
Provider reference and affiliation data (NPI/DEA, IQVIA OneKey, IDN/GPO and health-system hierarchies), and how it powers HCP/account targeting
Competitive and market intelligence (Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group)
Emerging/innovative assets: ambient and digital health data, registries, SDOH, imaging, patient-reported and adherence data
Therapeutic Area Exposure: Demonstrated exposure to either of Oncology (solid tumor and/or heme; biomarker testing, staging, lines of therapy, pathways), Ophthalmology (Imaging and registry data such as IRIS/Verana), or CVRM (cardiovascular, metabolic and obesity, lab-value-driven segmentation such as HbA1c/LDL/eGFR, high-volume PCP targeting). Rare disease, neurology, or immunology exposure is a strong plus.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Strong analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving with meticulous attention to detail. You engage stakeholders consultatively, ask the sharp clarifying question before proposing a solution, and synthesize complexity into clear recommendations and "so what?" insights
Technical Skills: Proficient in SQL or similar technology for independent extraction, profiling, and validation on large patient-level datasets. Comfortable in creating a visualizations in any industry wide known platforms.

jobs.description:
About NCR Atleos

Title: Application Security Compliance Lead

About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) is a global technology company that enables financial access and commerce through assisted and self-service solutions and comprehensive support services. NCR Atleos serves financial and public-sector organizations in more than 100 countries and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, USA.
The opportunity
As an Application Security Compliance Lead, you will help ensure that NCR Atleos software products and development practices meet applicable security, privacy and regulatory requirements. Working within our global Application Security team, you will turn complex requirements into practical guidance, prepare teams for assessments, and help demonstrate that security and privacy are embedded throughout the software lifecycle.
A major focus is organization-level PCI Software Security Framework (SSF) activities: support product teams to achieve and retain PCI Secure Software Standard listings and maintain validation of our Secure Software Lifecycle practices. This role suits someone who combines compliance expertise with software development and application security knowledge.
What you will do
Govern the Secure SDLC. Maintain and improve practices aligned with the PCI Secure SLC Standard.
Enable PCI SSF validation. Guide teams through external assessment, self-assessment, annual attestation and periodic revalidation activities.
Interpret requirements. Translate security, privacy, legal and industry requirements into clear, proportionate guidance.
Assess readiness and close gaps. Coordinate reviews, evidence, gap analysis, remediation and resolution of findings.
Engage and influence. Partner with engineering, Legal, risk, compliance and security teams, QSAs and the PCI SSC.
Build capability. Create training and reusable guidance; monitor developments and communicate material changes.
Drive continual improvement. Use industry changes, stakeholder feedback, internal audits, assessment outcomes, recurring findings, and incidents to strengthen controls and processes.
What you will bring
Essential experience and capabilities
Typically, 7+ years of relevant experience in application security, software security assurance, secure software development, technology risk, privacy, compliance, or audit.
Practical experience developing, operating, governing or assessing a Secure SDLC.
Experience interpreting security or compliance requirements and supporting assessments, evidence collection, gap analysis and remediation.
Working knowledge of threat modelling, vulnerability management, security testing, and risk-based decision-making.
Technical understanding of cloud services, source-code management, and CI/CD practices sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams.
Ability to convert complex requirements into pragmatic guidance and make evidence-based recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
Ability to work independently and effectively within a globally distributed team.
Comfortable using AI assistants, such as Copilot, responsibly in day-to-day work to improve personal productivity, quality, and speed of delivery.
A bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience and qualifications.
Desirable experience and capabilities
Direct experience of PCI SSF validation or a comparable software security assurance framework.
Knowledge of payment-card security, GDPR requirements, NIST CSF and OWASP standards and guidance.
Experience delivering application security or compliance-related training.
Knowledge of security and governance for AI-enabled software development and products.
A relevant certification, such as CISSP, CSSLP, CIPP, CIPT or CIPM.
How you will succeed
Teams receive clear, timely, and actionable compliance guidance.
PCI SSF validation activities are well planned, appropriately evidenced, and progressed effectively.
Compliance gaps and findings are clearly owned, prioritized, tracked, and resolved.
Secure SDLC requirements remain practical, current, and consistently understood.
Assessment and incident lessons lead to sustainable improvements and strong stakeholder relationships.
Evidence we value
In your application, we would particularly welcome examples of how you have interpreted a security standard, prepared a product or organization for assessment, resolved a significant compliance gap, or influenced an engineering team to adopt a more effective security practice.

Position Description
The Customer Engineer 1 (CE1) is the owner of customer incidents as assigned. The Customer Engineer responds to all customer concerns or problems by resolving them or by escalating them to the proper associate, team member, territory manager, or the Control Tower. jobs.title: Global Command Center Operations Senior Manager
jobs.description:
About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
POSITION SUMMARY
The Global Command Center Operations Manager is responsible for leading the 24x7 Global Command Center responsible for monitoring, event correlation, incident response, escalation coordination, operational communications, and service reliability across critical infrastructure, applications, networks, job scheduling, and telephony services. This role provides operational leadership for geographically distributed teams and ensures that Command Center functions consistently meet availability, resiliency, compliance, and service management expectations.
The successful candidate will be a hands-on, metrics-driven operations leader with strong ITIL/ITSM discipline, deep infrastructure operations awareness, and the ability to translate technical events into clear executive-level business impact. This leader will drive process maturity, automation, alert quality, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement across global operations while maintaining a high-accountability and service-focused team culture.
ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Operational Leadership and Service Reliability
Lead day-to-day and shift-based 24x7 Global Command Center operations across monitoring, triage, escalation, incident communications, and operational coordination.
Oversee functional coverage for server operations monitoring, network operations monitoring, application operations monitoring, lab operations monitoring, Helix/Control-M job scheduling, Windows and Linux L2 support, and Genesys/IP telephony operations.
Ensure adherence to SLAs, OLAs, uptime expectations, alert response targets, escalation procedures, and operational performance metrics.
Drive proactive monitoring, event correlation, alert tuning, runbook quality, and automation to reduce noise, improve response times, and minimize manual intervention.
Maintain operational readiness for high-severity events, business-impacting incidents, planned maintenance windows, and critical change activity.
Incident, Problem, and Change Management
Lead Command Center participation in major incidents by coordinating bridge engagement, ensuring role clarity, maintaining focus on service restoration, and escalating to appropriate technical and leadership teams.
Partner with Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, infrastructure, application, security, and vendor teams to support fast restoration and durable corrective actions.
Review incident trends, recurring alerts, failed jobs, chronic infrastructure events, and escalation patterns to identify improvement opportunities.
Support post-incident reviews, root cause analysis, known error documentation, corrective/preventive action tracking, and lessons-learned adoption.
Ensure Command Center teams follow approved change, incident, problem, access, and communication processes.
Governance, Compliance, and Audit Readiness
Create, maintain, and enforce SOPs, technical runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, operational checklists, and process documentation.
Ensure operational evidence is complete, accurate, timely, and defensible for internal reviews, SOX audits, control testing, and regulatory inquiries.
Partner with security, risk, compliance, and technology owners to ensure adherence to enterprise standards, access protocols, and data protection expectations.
Establish governance routines to review operational metrics, control gaps, aged actions, process exceptions, and continuous improvement progress.
Team Leadership and Talent Development
Lead, coach, and develop a globally distributed team of team leads, engineers, analysts, and operations specialists across multiple shifts and domains.
Own staffing plans, shift coverage, onboarding, training, performance expectations, development plans, succession planning, and quality accountability.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, operational discipline, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
Partner with site leadership to monitor team engagement, morale, readiness, skill gaps, escalation behaviors, and adherence to operational standards.
Metrics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
Define, monitor, and report operational KPIs including availability, SLA adherence, alert volume, alert aging, MTTA/MTTR, escalation effectiveness, incident recurrence, job failure trends, change-related incidents, and runbook compliance.
Prepare concise executive-level updates on operational health, incident trends, risk areas, improvement plans, staffing readiness, and service reliability.
Use data to identify systemic issues, automation opportunities, process bottlenecks, and training needs.
Partner with tool owners and engineering teams to improve dashboards, observability, event correlation, workflow automation, and operational intelligence.
Vendor and Stakeholder Management
Manage vendor engagement related to operations tools, monitoring platforms, job scheduling, infrastructure services, telecom platforms, and support escalations.
Hold vendors and internal service teams accountable for service delivery, timely escalation, issue ownership, and contractual/service commitments.
Serve as an operational bridge between senior leadership, infrastructure teams, application teams, security, service management, vendors, and site leadership.
Support budget planning, resource planning, capacity needs, tool rationalization, and operational investment recommendations.
SKILL REQUIREMENTS/PREFERENCES
Required Skills and Experience
12+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure operations, technology operations, command center, NOC/SOC/AOC, service management, or related enterprise technology functions.
8+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers, team leads, engineers, analysts, or shift-based operational teams in a 24x7 environment.
Demonstrated experience managing global or multi-site operations with cross-functional responsibility for service reliability, monitoring, incident response, escalation, and executive communication.
Strong working knowledge of ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, major incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, and service level management.
Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, alerting, ITSM, and job scheduling platforms such as ServiceNow, Helix, Control-M, SolarWinds, Grafana, Splunk, Nagios, Zabbix, Datadog, AppDynamics, or equivalent tools.
Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server operations, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, network fundamentals, firewalls, VPNs, SD-WAN, DNS/DHCP, telephony/VoIP, and application operations monitoring.
Experience creating operational dashboards, performance reporting, service health reviews, incident trend analysis, and continuous improvement plans.
Experience supporting audit, compliance, access control, SOX, control evidence, policy adherence, and operational governance processes.
Strong vendor management, escalation management, service accountability, and stakeholder communication capabilities.
Preferred Technical Skills
Experience with hybrid cloud environments including Azure, Oracle Cloud, AWS, VMware vSphere, or similar enterprise platforms.
Experience improving event management through alert rationalization, event correlation, automation, AIOps, or runbook orchestration.
Familiarity with resiliency practices including disaster recovery, business continuity, capacity planning, lifecycle management, backup/recovery, high availability, and operational risk reduction.
Familiarity with scripting or automation concepts using PowerShell, Python, Bash, API integrations, workflow automation, or infrastructure-as-code concepts.
Experience leading transformation efforts that modernize command center operations, reduce toil, improve service health visibility, or improve incident response maturity.
SOME OF THE SOFT SKILLS / ABILITIES REQUIRED FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE INCLUDE
Calm, composed leadership during high-pressure, business-impacting incidents.
Clear, concise, and audience-appropriate communication for executives, technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
Ability to command and control incident bridges while maintaining accountability, urgency, and respectful collaboration.
Strong judgment, prioritization, and decision-making when managing competing business, technical, and operational demands.
Ability to translate technical issues into business impact, risk, service health, and actionable leadership updates.
Coaching mindset with the ability to build trust, develop team leads, provide feedback, and reinforce standard work.
High ownership and follow-through across open actions, recurring issues, audit items, staffing needs, and operational risks.
Process discipline with the ability to standardize work, reduce ambiguity, document expectations, and drive consistent execution.
Strong analytical capability with a focus on metrics, trend analysis, root cause thinking, and measurable improvement.
Ability to influence across teams without direct authority and create alignment across geographically distributed stakeholders.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, global, shift-based environment where priorities may change quickly.
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
ITIL 4 Foundation, ITIL Managing Professional, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, CISSP, CISM, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Linux, Cisco, VMware, ServiceNow, or equivalent certifications.
Experience leading a global command center, NOC, SOC, AOC, infrastructure operations center, managed services operations, or enterprise service reliability function.
Experience building or maturing operating models, RACI matrices, escalation frameworks, QA programs, knowledge management practices, or operational control points.
Experience with financial services, payments, ATM, retail banking, regulated infrastructure, or other high-availability customer-impacting technology environments.
Experience supporting business continuity, disaster recovery exercises, command center readiness testing, crisis management, or operational resilience programs.
Experience managing cross-cultural teams, offshore/onshore delivery models, and vendor-supported services.
EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Technology, or a related discipline required, or equivalent combination of education and progressive enterprise IT operations experience.
Master’s degree in Information Systems, Technology Management, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred.
Relevant professional certifications may be considered in combination with demonstrated leadership and enterprise technology operations experience.
WORK ENVIRONMENT AND EXPECTATIONS
Full-time role based in Mumbai, India with expectation to work from the office five days per week unless otherwise approved by leadership.
Must be able to support a 24x7 global operations model, including rotational schedules, after-hours escalations, planned maintenance windows, and major incident response as business needs require.
Must be comfortable working with global stakeholders across multiple time zones and supporting business-critical technology services.

jobs.title: Staff Quality Analyst — Service Quality
jobs.description:
The Staff Quality Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for the analytical engine of defect reduction across the Expert Network. You own the measurement system that decides what gets fixed: you design defect detection and quantification approaches, build and analyze defect funnels, isolate root causes in large operational datasets, size the customer impact of candidate fixes, and validate — statistically, not anecdotally — that improvement initiatives actually moved resolution, quality, and customer friction outcomes.
This is an analytics role with a quality mission. You will apply descriptive, diagnostic, and causal analysis to one of the richest operational datasets anywhere — AI-scored conversation data covering ~100% of customer interactions — and translate it into a prioritized, defensible improvement roadmap. Structured improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, root cause analysis) are tools in your kit for driving the fixes your analysis identifies; the analysis itself is the craft. You will operate as a single-threaded owner for specific defect domains and hold cross-functional partners — service delivery, training, partner management, product, and platform teams — accountable for their share of the quality outcome using evidence they cannot argue with.
Responsibilities
1. Analytics Strategy & Defect Measurement
Design the measurement approach for assigned defect domains: define the defect, the opportunity base, and the DPMO (Defects Per Million Opportunities) instrumentation so every defect rate ladders directly to a customer outcome metric
Build and maintain defect funnels — quantifying defect volume, severity, and contribution to outcome degradation — and evolve the defect taxonomy as the operating environment changes (new categories, refined severity weights, expanded coverage)
Prioritize the defect backlog analytically: rank initiatives by modeled customer impact, and defend the ranking with data when it is contested
Contribute to the continuous improvement of the quality measurement architecture itself — ensuring we measure the right things, validating that our measures stay true, and pressure-testing quality markers against outcome data
2. Analysis, Root Cause & Outcome Validation
Analyze resolution, quality, sentiment, and customer friction signals across large operational datasets (SQL and Python/R against conversation-level and journey-level data) to identify defects and isolate root causes — moving from symptom to verified cause, not plausible narrative
Design the leading-indicator instrumentation beneath each outcome metric and monitor it for signal, drift, and regression
Validate initiative impact with appropriate rigor: pre/post analysis with controls, cohort comparison, or causal methods where the stakes demand them — and say clearly when the needle did not move and why
Partner with analytics and data science teams to evaluate, adopt, and improve AI-native quality measurement (conversation scoring, resolution scoring, customer distress detection) — including validating AI-scored metrics against human-labeled ground truth
3. From Insight to Improvement — Driving the Fix
Own the operating loop for assigned defect domains: defect detected → root cause verified → initiative launched → outcome validated → loop closed
Deploy structured improvement methods — root cause analysis, Kaizen and rapid improvement events, value stream mapping, standard work — as the delivery mechanism for what the analysis has prioritized
Translate analytical findings into technical solutions and roadmap commitments in partnership with systems and platform teams
Drive adoption and change management for the fixes, and embed the measurement disciplines (daily management, leader standard work) that keep improvements from decaying
Hold dependencies — product, platform, routing, back-office — accountable for their share of customer friction using quantified evidence and structured escalation
4. Data Visualization, Insights & Executive Communication
Build and maintain the dashboards and reporting that surface defect signals, track outcome metrics, and support leadership decisions — designed for action, not decoration
Present defect reduction progress and outcome movement in leadership operating mechanisms (daily huddles; weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews) with clear data storytelling for both operational and executive audiences
Communicate uncomfortable findings credibly: when the data contradicts the prevailing narrative, make the case with rigor and land it with senior stakeholders
5. AI-Native Analytics
Use modern AI tools — LLM-based assistants and agentic workflows — as a core part of the analytical workflow, accelerating defect detection, root cause analysis, and prioritization from weeks to days
Design and iterate AI-assisted workflows across the defect reduction loop, from automated signal identification to outcome tracking and reporting
Build repeatable AI-assisted playbooks for defect identification and root cause analysis that the whole team can run — making the analytical craft scalable rather than dependent on individuals
Stay current on emerging AI capabilities relevant to quality analytics and proactively apply them to customer outcomes
Qualifications
Required
Strong hands-on analytical skills: SQL proficiency and working fluency in Python or R for analysis of large operational datasets; solid grounding in applied statistics (distributions, hypothesis testing, control charts, confidence in what a metric movement does and does not prove)
Demonstrated experience turning operational data into prioritized, quantified improvement roadmaps — and validating whether the improvements worked
Experience with defect- or rate-based measurement frameworks (DPMO or equivalent) and translating process-level defects into outcome-level impact
Experience in complex, high-stakes service operations — contact centers, fintech, financial services, or expert/advisor networks
Demonstrated ability to build dashboards and analytical products that drive leadership decisions, including with AI-powered tools
Working knowledge of structured improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis) and experience using them to drive fixes from analytical findings
Experience driving accountability in matrixed organizations without direct authority over execution teams
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, Business Analytics) or equivalent professional experience in operational analytics
