jobs.title: AM/Manager– Procurement (Admin, Real Estate & HR)
jobs.description:
Buyer – Admin Real Estate & HR Procurement:

Role Overview:

The Buyer – Admin, Real Estate & HR Procurement will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and procurement activities across Administration, Facility Management, Lease Rentals, and HR-related categories. The role includes vendor sourcing and management, commercial negotiations, contract and lease administration, PR-to-PO processing, spend analysis, and ensuring the timely procurement of goods and services in compliance with company procurement policies.

The ideal candidate should possess strong negotiation, analytical, stakeholder management, and coordination skills, along with a service-oriented approach and a keen eye for detail.

Key Responsibilities:

Administration Procurement:
- Manage procurement of office supplies, stationery, pantry items, and other administrative requirements.
- Coordinate procurement for facility management services, including housekeeping, security, pest control, and maintenance services.
- Source and procure office infrastructure such as furniture, workstations, printers, and related equipment.
- Track and manage Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), ensuring timely renewals.
- Support procurement requirements for corporate events, employee engagement initiatives, and office activities.
- Coordinate travel and accommodation bookings in line with company policies.
- Ensure timely conversion of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) into Purchase Orders (POs).
- Maintain an updated vendor database and monitor vendor performance.
- Conduct cost comparisons and negotiate commercial terms within the approved authority limits.

Lease Rental Management:
- Manage procurement support for office spaces, branches, warehouses, fleet hubs, and other leased facilities.
- Collaborate with Business, Administration, Finance, and Legal teams for new lease acquisitions, renewals, amendments, and lease closures.
- Participate in commercial negotiations with landlords, property owners, and real estate consultants to secure competitive lease terms.
- Review lease proposals and ensure compliance with procurement policies and internal approval processes.
- Coordinate lease agreement execution and maintain trackers for lease expiries, renewals, rent escalations, security deposits, lock-in periods, and notice periods.
- Process lease-related PRs, POs (where applicable), rental invoices, and payment coordination.
- Monitor rental payments, Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges, utility-related obligations, and other lease-associated commercial commitments.
- Maintain centralized lease documentation and ensure audit readiness.
- Identify opportunities for lease cost optimization through renegotiation, benchmarking, and space utilization initiatives.
- Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external landlords to resolve commercial and operational issues related to leased properties.

HR Procurement:
- Coordinate with employee benefits vendors, including Group Medical Cover (GMC) and Group Term Life (GTL) insurance providers.
- Support onboarding and management of Training & Development partners.
- Coordinate with recruitment agencies for billing, documentation, and vendor management.
- Manage background verification vendor coordination.
- Oversee procurement of employee onboarding kits, corporate gifting, and engagement materials.
- Support coordination with payroll and HRMS service providers.
- Track contract validity, renewals, and compliance for HR-related vendors.

Operational Responsibilities:
- Ensure compliance with procurement policies, governance standards, and approval workflows.
- Prepare comparative statements, vendor evaluations, commercial assessments, and sourcing recommendations.
- Monitor procurement timelines and proactively resolve vendor-related issues.
- Maintain procurement records and documentation to support audit and compliance requirements.
- Support budget monitoring, spend analysis, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Ensure timely contract renewals and drive effective vendor performance management.

Skills & Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
- Minimum 5 years of procurement experience, with exposure to Administration, - Facility Management, HR, and Lease Rental procurement categories.
- Strong understanding of sourcing, commercial negotiations, procurement lifecycle (PR-to-PO), contract administration, and vendor management.
- Prior experience in lease commercial negotiations and lease agreement management will be an added advantage.
- Excellent analytical and commercial evaluation capabilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
- Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- High attention to detail with strong documentation and record management capabilities.
- Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities while delivering high-quality procurement support.

jobs.title: Analytics Lead - UPI Product | Experience : 7-9 yrs
jobs.description:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role
UPI is the backbone of India's digital payments revolution — and Paytm is one of its largest participants, processing hundreds of millions of transactions every month. We are looking for a Product Manager to join our UPI team and drive product strategy, user growth, and experience excellence across our UPI-powered flows.
This role sits at the intersection of consumer behaviour, financial infrastructure, and regulatory nuance. You will own high-impact product surfaces and work closely with engineering, design, data, and business teams to ship products that millions of Indians use daily.

Key Responsibilities
1. Analytics Strategy & Ownership
- Own the end-to-end analytics charter for one or more UPI surfaces — from metric definition to instrumentation to insight generation
- Build and maintain the source-of-truth framework for north-star and guardrail metrics across the UPI funnel (initiation, authentication, success/failure, retention)
- Partner with NPCI-mandated reporting requirements and ensure analytical rigor aligns with regulatory data standards
- Lead a team of analysts, setting priorities, reviewing outputs, and raising the bar on analytical craft

2. Funnel, Growth & Behavioural Insights
- Diagnose friction points across the UPI journey using deep-dive analysis, cohort studies, and funnel decomposition
- Build engagement, frequency, and top-of-wallet models to inform product and growth strategy
- Design analytical frameworks for discovery and nudge effectiveness as new UPI capabilities are adopted
- Partner with design and product research to combine quantitative and qualitative signals into a single narrative

3. Platform Reliability & Scale Analytics
- Define and monitor SLA, success-rate, and latency benchmarks; build alerting and anomaly-detection frameworks tied to these metrics
- Build root-cause analysis playbooks for payment failure spikes and incident-linked drop-offs
- Model traffic and failure patterns ahead of high-volume events (festive seasons, IPL, government disbursements) to support platform readiness

4. Experimentation & Decision Science
- Own the experimentation backbone — design, power, and evaluate A/B tests across the UPI funnel
- Drive a test-and-learn culture: hypothesis → experiment → read-out → scale, with statistically sound methodology
- Build self-serve dashboards and tooling that let product, engineering, and business teams access trusted insights without analyst dependency
- Proactively surface insights that shape upstream roadmap and prioritization decisions

Required Qualifications
- 7–9 years of analytics/data experience, with a mandatory focus on consumer-facing products or fintech; prior experience in payments or UPI strongly preferred
- Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, or equivalent); working knowledge of Python/R for deeper statistical analysis
- Solid grounding in experimentation design — hypothesis framing, sample size/power calculations, and interpreting A/B results correctly
- Proven ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear, decision-ready recommendations
- Experience building and owning dashboards and metrics frameworks at scale, including data quality and governance practices
- Strong written and verbal communication skills — ability to present findings crisply to leadership and align cross-functional stakeholders
- Experience managing or mentoring a team of analysts, with a demonstrated ability to review work and raise analytical standards

Good to Have
- Prior experience working in a UPI-regulated environment or with NPCI data/reporting constructs
- Exposure to large-scale transaction data systems and familiarity with data warehousing/pipeline concepts (e.g., working with data engineering teams on instrumentation)Experience with growth, lifecycle, or CRM-driven analytics
- Familiarity with fraud/risk analytics in a payments context

Why Join Us
- Work on one of India's most critical financial infrastructure products — UPI — at massive scale
- Join a high-performance analytics org embedded deeply with product and engineering, with a bias for shipping insights that matter
- Influence decisions that affect hundreds of millions of transactions every day
- Operate in a fast-moving, ownership-driven culture where analytics leads have real authority — and real accountability

Compensation
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500 mn+ registered users, 25 mn+ merchants, and unmatched transaction data depth, Paytm is uniquely positioned to define the next chapter of UPI in India — and we want you to help write it.

Business Insights & Growth

- Conduct funnel, cohort, campaign and attribution analysis to identify performance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
- Reconcile promotional burn against incremental GMV; establish ROI and cost-per-incremental-user benchmarks by campaign and segment.
- Analyse A/B tests and control-group experiments to isolate true incrementality.

Metrics, Dashboards & Models
- Build and track key business metrics, dashboards, performance frameworks and analytical models to monitor growth against AOP.
- Own metric definitions and data integrity; maintain a single source of truth across teams.
- Develop forecasting and scenario models for GMV, revenue and user base to support planning cycles.

Stakeholder Partnership
- Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Growth, DWH and Business teams to convert insights into measurable outcomes.
- Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives for senior stakeholders and drive data-backed decision-making.
- Own analytical inputs for MBRs and business reviews — with a clear storyline, not just charts.

REQUIREMENTS
Experience
- 8-10 years of experience in business analytics, growth analytics or data science — preferably in consumer internet, fintech, e-commerce or financial services.
- Demonstrated ownership of a product vertical or growth charter with measurable business impact.
- Experience with large-scale transactional and behavioural datasets in a high-velocity consumer business.

Technical Skills
- SQL — advanced: complex joins, window functions, CTEs and query optimization on large distributed datasets (Trino/Presto/Hive/Redshift/BigQuery).
- Python — pandas, numpy, statistical testing and automation; modelling libraries a plus.
- Advanced Excel — pivots, complex formulas & macros
- Data Modelling — dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, event and funnel data structures, metric-layer design.
- Data Visualization — Tableau, Power BI, Superset or equivalent; dashboards that get used, not just built.
- Product & Web Analytics — Google Analytics, CleverTap, Mixpanel, Amplitude or Firebase for funnel and journey analysis.

Analytical & Business Capabilities
- Strong command of cohort analysis, funnel analysis, retention curves, LTV modelling, attribution methodologies and experiment design.
- Comfort with significance testing, regression, segmentation and clustering techniques.
- Commercial instinct — able to connect a metric movement to the underlying business mechanic and the money at stake.
- Excellent communication; able to defend a recommendation with evidence in front of senior leadership.

Education
- Bachelor’s in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related quantitative discipline. MBA or Master’s in a quantitative field preferred.

GOOD TO HAVE
- Exposure to wealth, investments, savings or commodity-linked products.
- Experience with SIP / recurring-payment analytics, including mandate and autopay behaviour.
- Familiarity with pricing, margin and unit-economics analysis.
- Experience mentoring junior analysts.

CORE COMPETENCIES
- Diagnostic mindset — pushes past the symptom to the root cause.
- Rigour — validates counts and stress-tests assumptions before publishing.
- Ownership — treats the business target as their own.
- Clarity — reduces complexity to a decision, not a data dump.
- Constructive dissent — challenges assumptions and targets with data, early.

jobs.description:
Role Overview  
The Area Collections Manager will be responsible for managing end-to-end collections across  bucket segments, driving resolution strategies, ensuring portfolio health, and leading large  on-ground and tele-calling teams. The role requires strong expertise in delinquency  management, compliance, analytics, and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities  
1. Bucket & Portfolio Management  
● Manage collections across delinquency buckets (0–30, 31–60, and higher DPD  segments)  
● Improve resolution rates in both early and late buckets  
● Focus on non-starter and delinquent accounts to prevent roll-forward  
● Drive collection efficiency and overall portfolio health  
● Monitor daily performance and ensure adherence to CAPE norms  

2. Tele-Collections Management  
● Handle soft delinquency buckets (0–30 & 31–60 DPD) through tele-calling strategies  
● Design and optimize calling patterns based on customer risk profiling  
● Improve dialer efficiency, call connect rates, and campaign performance  
● Maximize early-stage resolutions to prevent migration to hard buckets  

3. Field Collections & Risk Control  
● Ensure strong field discipline (app usage, visit tracking, audit trails)  
● Drive legal escalation for critical/high-risk cases  
● Conduct audits to identify and mitigate portfolio risks  
● Maintain strong governance and control mechanisms  

4. Team Leadership & Vendor Management  
● Lead large teams including Collection Managers, Team Leaders, and Executives  
● Manage third-party/vendor collection agencies  
● Allocate portfolios and set bucket-wise targets  
● Conduct daily huddles, reviews, and performance tracking  
● Coach teams on negotiation, objection handling, and resolution strategies  

5. Target Achievement & Performance Delivery  
● Drive monthly collection targets and improve resolution ratios  
● Enhance PTP (Promise to Pay) conversion and kept rates  
● Focus on First-Time Delinquent (FTD) customers to reduce future NPAs  
● Ensure productivity metrics such as calls, RPC (Right Party Contact), and CE% are met  

6. Compliance & Governance  
● Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines and regulatory standards  
● Handle escalations and customer grievances effectively  
● Maintain ethical and compliant recovery practices  
● Support internal and external audit requirements  

7. MIS, Analytics & Reporting  
● Track and analyze KPIs: CE%, RPC, PTP, dialer metrics, and resolution ratios  
● Manage large portfolio data and generate actionable insights  
● Identify gaps in collection strategies and recommend improvements  
● Present performance reports and insights to senior management.  

8. Key Skills & Competencies  
● Strong expertise in collections strategy (early & late buckets)  
● Proven leadership experience managing large teams and vendors  
● Analytical mindset with strong MIS and reporting skills  
● Knowledge of RBI regulations and compliance frameworks  
● Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills  



● Ability to drive performance in high-pressure, target-driven environments

Maintain clear documentation of risks, decisions, open items, dependencies, and closure actions.
Process, Playbooks, and Scalability
Build standard onboarding playbooks, project templates, go live checklists, training material, and implementation SOPs.
Define delivery metrics such as time to onboard, milestone adherence, integration success rate, client readiness, go live success, and early adoption.
Create dashboards and review cadences to track implementation health across enterprise clients.
Improve onboarding processes continuously through post implementation reviews and client feedback.
Build scalable delivery systems that reduce dependency on individuals and improve implementation quality at scale.

Lead and mentor Client Onboarding Managers across enterprise delivery workstreams.

Work closely with Enterprise GTM, Pre Sales, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, and Support teams.

To strengthen the Finance control environment by ensuring adherence to

first line of defense within Finance to ensure financial processes are accurate,
compliant, well-governed, and audit-ready.

Ensure adherence to approved Finance SOPs, policies, and internal control
frameworks.

opportunities.
Conduct periodic control reviews and ensure timely implementation of
corrective actions.
Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement
initiatives.

Oversee critical reconciliations, including bank, GL, settlement, and
suspense accounts.
Monitor ageing of unreconciled items and ensure timely closure of
exceptions.
Investigate recurring reconciliation breaks and recommend preventive
controls.
Publish periodic dashboards on reconciliation status and control exceptions.

Monitor SAP financial controls, master data governance, and accounting
configurations.
Review user access, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and maker-checker

reversals, and suspense accounts.
Participate in UAT for ERP enhancements and ensure financial controls

Track closure of Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, and Regulatory

interventions.

Working knowledge of SAP FI/CO (ECC or S/4HANA), financial systems, and

Financial Controls & Governance

Process Improvement & Automation
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
Stakeholder Management
Strong Communication & Attention to Detail

100% adherence to Finance SOPs and control processes.
Timely completion of critical reconciliations and reduction in ageing items.

Closure of audit observations and control deficiencies within agreed
timelines.
Effective SAP access governance, SoD compliance, and system control
monitoring.
Reduction in manual processes through automation and enhanced system
controls.
Accurate and timely Finance Control MIS with zero material control failures.

We are seeking an experienced and result-oriented IT Procurement Professional
with 5-7 years of proven expertise for strategic sourcing and procurement of IT
products and services. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in procuring IT hardware, software, cloud services, SaaS applications, cybersecurity solutions, telecommunications, and professional services. The role requires end-to-end ownership of procurement activities, supplier relationship management, commercial negotiations, contract management, and stakeholder engagement while ensuring cost optimization, regulatory compliance, and procurement governance.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Procurement & Sourcing:
 End-to-end procurement of IT hardware, software, cloud services, SaaS applications, cybersecurity solutions, telecommunications, data center infrastructure, and technology services.
 Proven experience in procurement of IT infrastructure, software licensing,
cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), SaaS applications, cybersecurity solutions, telecommunications, and managed services.
 Develop and execute category sourcing strategies aligned with business
objectives and technology roadmaps.
 Manage the complete sourcing lifecycle, including requirement gathering,
market assessment, RFI/RFP/RFQ preparation, supplier evaluation, commercial analysis, negotiations, and contract award.
 Drive competitive bidding and supplier selection to achieve optimum
commercial and technical outcomes.

Commercial & Contract Management:

support agreements, renewals, and long-term contracts.
 Ensure timely execution of contracts in collaboration with Legal, Finance,
Information Security, and business stakeholders.
 Manage contract renewals, amendments, vendor obligations, and commercial
risk throughout the contract lifecycle.
 Deliver measurable cost savings while optimizing Total Cost of Ownership
(TCO).

Vendor & Stakeholder Management:

integrators, cloud providers, and technology partners.
 Conduct supplier performance reviews, governance meetings, and business
reviews to improve service quality and vendor performance.
 Collaborate with IT, Information Security, Finance, Legal, Risk, and business
teams to understand procurement requirements and deliver timely sourcing
support.
 Act as a trusted procurement advisor to business stakeholders on sourcing
strategies and commercial decisions.

Required Skills & Competencies:
 Strategic Sourcing & Category Management
 IT Hardware, Software, SaaS & Cloud Procurement
 Cybersecurity & Telecom Procurement
 Commercial Negotiation & Contract Management
 Vendor Relationship & Performance Management
 Procurement Governance & Compliance
 Cost Optimization & Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
 Procurement Analytics & Spend Management
 Risk Assessment & Business Continuity
 Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration
 ERP/eProcurement Platforms (SAP, Oracle, Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, etc.)
 Excellent negotiation, analytical, communication, and presentation skills.
 Exposure to European procurement and regulatory requirements will be
preferred.

jobs.title: Key Account Management - Assistant Manager - Nearbuy
jobs.description:
About Us
Paytm is India's leading financial services company that offers full-stack payments & financial solutions to consumers, offline merchants, and online platforms. The company is on a mission to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through payments, commerce, banking, investments, and financial services. One97 Communications Limited, which owns the Paytm brand, was founded by Vijay Shekhar Sharma.

About the Role
We are looking for a high-energy, target-driven Key Account Manager focused primarily on hunting and bringing incremental business to the platform. This is a new-business acquisition role rather than a traditional account-maintenance role. The person will identify prospects, build a pipeline, pitch our offerings, negotiate commercials, close new business and deliver measurable monthly revenue.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and acquire new merchants/accounts through outbound prospecting, market mapping, references, networking and other lead-generation channels.
- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects and continuously convert prospects into live business.
- Own the complete sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, pitching, negotiation, closure and onboarding.
- Generate incremental business every month and take complete ownership of the revenue brought in.
- Develop strong understanding of the local market, competitor landscape and merchant opportunities.
- Create prospect-wise action plans to achieve monthly business targets.
- Follow up consistently and move opportunities through the sales funnel.
- Work with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and activation of newly acquired business.
- Maintain accurate sales pipeline, conversion and revenue reporting.
Identify opportunities for repeat business and upselling after initial acquisition.

Performance Expectations
- The role is heavily performance-driven and focused on incremental/new business generation.
- A strong incentive structure will provide high performers the opportunity to earn significantly above their fixed salary through incentives.

Ideal Candidate
- Strong hunting/new-business sales background.
- Demonstrated history of personally generating incremental revenue.
- Comfortable with cold calling, outbound sales and repeated follow-ups.
- Strong prospecting, negotiation and closing skills.
- Highly target-oriented and motivated by performance-linked earnings.
- Able to build a territory and pipeline from scratch.
- Strong communication and presentation skills.
- Comfortable working with numbers and tracking business performance.
- Experience in F&B, hospitality, lifestyle, beauty, local commerce, advertising, or marketplace businesses is an advantage.

Key Success Metrics
Qualified opportunities created 
New merchants/accounts acquired Conversion/closure rate
Monthly incremental business generated 
Consistency of monthly business generation
Revenue/incentive contribution

Join Us
A collaborative, output-driven environment that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology.

Drive and achieve zonal collection targets across assigned products, branches, and delinquency buckets.

Ensure effective allocation of collection resources across branches and territories based on portfolio size, delinquency levels, and business requirements.
Drive employee productivity, performance reviews, capability building, and continuous improvement across the zonal team.
Prepare and present periodic collection performance updates, recovery forecasts, and action plans to senior management.

Strong expertise in collections, recovery management, and delinquency control.
Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to manage large, geographically distributed teams.

Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong understanding of collection processes, agency management, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
Ability to drive results, manage escalations, and deliver targets in a high-performance environment.
Strong planning, execution, and decision-making capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting tools, and collection management systems.
A proactive approach to process improvement, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation.

Education and Experience:

Compensation:
Compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience, expertise, and suitability for the role.

jobs.description:
Leading at Cognizant
This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level: Drive our business strategy and inspire teams around our future. Live the leadership behaviors, leading themselves, others and the business. Uphold our Values, role modeling them in every action and decision. Nurture our people and culture, creating a workplace where all can thrive.
At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
About the role
As an AVP- Principal Architect you will make an impact by setting the strategic direction for AI-augmented delivery or the AI-era operating model across the enterprise. You will serve as Cognizant’s senior Frontier authority, partnering directly with C-suite clients to co-design AI transformation strategies, govern frontier-model evaluation, adversarial-AI risk and responsible-AI practices, and shape the direction of a Frontier practice. You will also maintain the learning community, methodologies, and gold standards of the capability while serving as an external domain authority and intellectual anchor for the program.
In this role, you will:
Set the strategic direction for AI-augmented delivery or the AI-era operating model across the enterprise.
Co-design AI transformation strategies directly with C-suite client stakeholders and produce enterprise transformation blueprints.
Define evaluation frameworks for frontier-model deployment, including red-team protocols, safety benchmarks, and responsible-AI standards.
Govern adversarial-AI risk and AI safety policy, and lead incident-response strategy at the enterprise perimeter.
Own the direction of a Frontier practice and help structure outcome-based commercial models.
Maintain the Frontier learning community, methodologies, and gold standards while consistently demonstrating the Cognizant Way to Lead: Personal Leadership, Organizational Leadership, and Business Leadership.
What you need to have to be considered
20+ years of experience with demonstrated enterprise AI leadership and recognized authority in AI delivery or AI-era operations.
Deep expertise in AI transformation strategy, frontier-model evaluation, red-team governance, adversarial machine learning, and AI safety policy.
Proven ability to engage C-suite and board-level stakeholders and translate complex AI themes into enterprise transformation strategies and clear business outcomes.
Experience leading or shaping an advanced AI, frontier technology, delivery transformation, or AI-era operating model practice.
Strong capability in multi-agent coordination strategy, cross-business influence, standards-setting, and outcome-based commercial structuring.
Demonstrated track record of building Frontier talent, learning communities, methodologies, and reusable gold standards for enterprise-scale adoption.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Memory Layout Design
jobs.description:
Memory Layout, Staff Engineer
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years in the trenches of custom layout, and somewhere along the way you realized the real leverage is not in drawing one more SRAM cell, it is in building the frameworks that let hundreds of those cells get generated correctly, verified automatically, and scaled to the next node without reinventing everything. You think in systems, not schematics. When you look at a new process node, you are already mapping out the design rules, the automation gaps, and the verification bottlenecks before anyone asks.
You are the engineer who gets called when a layout flow breaks at 3nm or when a compiler needs to scale and no one is sure how to get StarRC and Custom Compiler to play nicely together. You do not just script solutions, you architect them with an eye toward maintainability, reuse, and the next three nodes. You have strong opinions about what good automation looks like, and you are not afraid to push back when a methodology does not serve the people who will actually use it.
At Synopsys, you will define how next-generation embedded memory gets built, not by drawing it yourself, but by creating the infrastructure that makes it possible for teams across the company to do it faster, cleaner, and more reliably.
What You'll Be Doing
Lead technology studies and process entitlement evaluations for advanced nodes (FinFET, GAA) to define what is physically possible and translate that into actionable layout guidelines for embedded memory compiler teams
Architect and build layout automation frameworks using Python and TCL that generate, verify, and validate custom memory IP layouts at scale, not one-off scripts but production infrastructure
Develop and maintain automated physical verification flows integrating Synopsys Custom Compiler, StarRC for parasitic extraction, and Ansys Totem for EM/IR reliability analysis across memory compiler products
Author and document physical implementation design rules, best practices, and layout methodologies that become the standard for how SRAM, ROM, and register file compilers are built and scaled
Evaluate next-generation EDA tools and capabilities, working directly with vendors and internal teams to define what gets adopted, how it gets integrated, and what productivity gains are realistic
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to layout development teams, troubleshooting complex verification failures, flow bottlenecks, and tool integration issues that block progress
Collaborate with foundry partners on design-technology co-optimization, feeding real-world layout constraints and automation needs back into process development discussions
The Impact You Will Have
Enable Synopsys memory compiler teams to scale to next-generation nodes faster by defining clear, automated methodologies that eliminate guesswork and rework
Reduce time-to-market for embedded memory IP by building verification and extraction flows that catch issues early and run without manual intervention
Improve layout productivity across the organization by delivering automation tools and infrastructure that teams actually use and trust
Influence foundry roadmaps and EDA tool development by representing real custom layout challenges and methodology needs in co-optimization discussions
Establish the technical standard for how advanced memory architectures are physically implemented, verified, and delivered at Synopsys
Mentor and elevate layout engineers by providing them with better tools, clearer guidelines, and a methodology framework that scales with their work
Drive reliability and quality improvements by automating EM/IR analysis and parasitic extraction in ways that surface problems before tapeout
What You'll Need
8+ years of hands-on experience in custom IC layout methodology, EDA automation, or physical design enablement, with a strong focus on embedded memory architectures like SRAM, ROM, or register files
Deep proficiency in Python and TCL for building production-grade layout automation tools, verification flows, and EDA infrastructure, not just scripting but software development
Extensive experience developing and deploying automated physical verification flows using Synopsys Custom Compiler, StarRC, Ansys Totem, or equivalent industry-standard tools
Solid understanding of advanced process nodes (FinFET, GAA, 5nm and below) and the ability to translate complex foundry design rules into engineering guidelines and automation requirements
Strong working knowledge of DRC/LVS/Antenna checking, EM/IR drop analysis, and parasitic extraction methodologies in the context of full-custom layout
Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with a focus on EDA or layout methodology
Experience collaborating with foundry teams on design-technology co-optimization or familiarity with AI/ML frameworks for automating engineering tasks is a strong plus
Who You Are
You can walk into a room with a process design kit and walk out with a methodology roadmap that accounts for layout complexity, tool limitations, and team bandwidth
When a verification flow fails in a way no one has seen before, you do not escalate immediately, you dig into the tool logs, reproduce the issue, and figure out what broke and why
You write automation code that other engineers can actually read, maintain, and extend six months later without needing you to explain every function
You have a point of view on what good layout methodology looks like and you are comfortable defending it in a room full of senior engineers who may not agree
You can explain a complex tradeoff between layout density, verification runtime, and EM reliability to a product manager in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
You stay current on EDA tool capabilities, process technology trends, and automation techniques because you know that what worked at 7nm will not necessarily work at 3nm
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join the Memory Layout Methodology and Automation team in Noida, a group responsible for defining how embedded memory compilers are physically implemented, verified, and scaled across Synopsys IP products. This is a technical leadership role where your work directly shapes the infrastructure and guidelines that memory development teams rely on to deliver next-generation SRAM, ROM, and register file IP to customers.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Job Description:
Alternate Job Titles
VLSI Characterization Apprentice
Standard Cell Library Development Apprentice
CMOS Circuit Simulation Apprentice
Digital Library Characterization Trainee
Semiconductor Characterization Trainee
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You are someone who wants to learn how semiconductor design works, not from slides or theory, but by running real simulations on real circuits that will ship in real products. You spent time in the college understanding CMOS fundamentals and digital logic, and now you want to see how that knowledge translates into production-quality standard cell libraries.
You are looking for a structured learning experience where you can work alongside engineers who have been doing characterization and library development for years. You want to build skills that matter, transistor-level debugging, EDA tool fluency, automation scripting, and the discipline to document your work so others can build on it.
What You'll Be Doing
Run transistor-level simulations on digital standard cells using industry-standard circuit simulators to extract timing, power, and leakage data across PVT corners
Analyze CMOS circuit behavior at the transistor level, reviewing schematics, debugging simulation failures, and identifying issues in logic implementation or device models
Support characterization and validation of standard cell libraries by running automated flows, reviewing results, and flagging anomalies or quality issues
Document simulation results, technical findings, and circuit-level observations in clear, structured reports that senior engineers can act on
Collaborate with library development engineers to improve characterization methodologies, refine automation scripts, and close gaps in coverage or accuracy
Learn and apply concepts from Liberty (.lib) format, Static Timing Analysis, and low-power design as you work through real library development cycles
Participate in technical reviews and team discussions to understand how characterization fits into the broader semiconductor design and IP development process
The Impact You Will Have
You will contribute to production-quality standard cell libraries that power chip designs across automotive, mobile, AI, and data center applications
Your simulations and analysis will help catch timing, power, or functional issues before they reach customers, protecting design schedules and silicon success
The characterization data you generate will support SoC designers as they meet performance, power, and area targets
Your debugging work will surface circuit-level insights that improve library quality and inform next-generation design decisions
You will help build and refine automation flows that make characterization faster, more accurate, and more scalable across technology nodes
The documentation and analysis you create will enable senior engineers to make data-driven decisions about library tradeoffs and optimization strategies
You will develop a strong foundation in semiconductor characterization and EDA tools that prepares you for the next stage of your engineering career
What You'll Need
B.E. or B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI, Microelectronics, or a related field
0 to 2 years of experience, fresh graduates are eligible and encouraged to apply
Strong understanding of CMOS fundamentals including MOSFET operation, inverter characteristics, static and dynamic logic, noise margins, delay, power dissipation, and leakage mechanisms
Solid knowledge of digital logic design including combinational and sequential circuits, Boolean algebra, flip-flops, latches, and timing concepts like setup, hold, recovery, and removal
Familiarity with at least one circuit simulator such as PrimeSim, FineSim, and the ability to read and debug transistor-level schematics
Comfort working in Linux or Unix environments, basic scripting knowledge in Python, Perl, Tcl, or Shell is a plus
Exposure to standard cell libraries, Liberty format, or Static Timing Analysis concepts is a plus
Who You Are
You can look at a simulation waveform and spot when something is off, whether it is a timing violation, a leakage spike, or a logic glitch, and you are willing to dig in until you understand why
You are comfortable working through ambiguity, if a simulation fails or results look strange, you check the netlist, review the setup, and try different scenarios before asking for help
You take ownership of your work, when you run a characterization sweep or debug a circuit, you make sure the results are correct and the documentation is clear enough for someone else to pick up where you left off
You communicate technical details clearly, whether you are writing up a simulation summary, flagging an issue in a review, or explaining a circuit behaviour to a peer or mentor
You are genuinely curious about how things work at the transistor level and eager to learn advanced EDA tools, characterization flows, and semiconductor technologies from experienced engineers

Join Arm's Bengaluru Silicon Characterization team to validate and characterize next-generation Arm SoCs and help customers bring products to market.
As a Staff Post-Silicon DDR Characterization Engineer, you will focus on DDR/LPDDR memory subsystems, characterizing silicon across process, voltage, temperature, and frequency (PVTF) conditions. Education & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master's degree preferred.

Experience identifying, reproducing, and debugging complex silicon bugs, including memory instability, training failures, timing issues, and data corruption.

Staff Engineer – Distributed Storage & Transactions (DST)
About Yugabyte
At Yugabyte, we are on a mission to become the default transactional database for enterprises building cloud-native applications. YugabyteDB is our PostgreSQL compatible distributed database for cloud-native apps. Resilient, scalable, and flexible, it runs on any cloud and enables developers to become instantly productive using well-known APIs.We are looking for talented and driven people to join us on our ambitious mission and help us build a lasting and impactful company.The transactional database market is estimated to grow to $150B by 2030. YugabyteDB is cloud-native by design, has on-demand horizontal scalability, and supports geographical distribution of data using built-in replication. This means that we are well-positioned to meet market demand for geo-distributed, high-scale, high-performance workloads.
Yugabyte offers a culture of innovation, ownership, and technical excellence, with opportunities to impact a cutting-edge distributed SQL database used by global enterprises. As a member of the DST team, you’ll help meet growing demand for high-scale, high-performance, globally distributed transactional workloads — instrumental to our product’s success.
Role Overview
As a Staff Engineer on the Distributed Storage & Transactions (DST) team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the core distributed storage, replication, and transaction foundations of YugabyteDB.
You will work on some of the most challenging problems in distributed systems — including consistency, durability, fault tolerance, performance, and scalability — while collaborating closely with query layer, platform, and cloud teams. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive in low-level systems work and want to shape the future of a globally distributed database.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, testing, and delivery of core storage and replication features in YugabyteDB.
Write high-quality C/C++ code with comprehensive automated tests; actively participate in design discussions and code reviews.
Troubleshoot and resolve correctness, stability, and performance issues in complex distributed storage and transactional subsystems.
Improve database scalability and throughput as cluster sizes, data volumes, and transaction rates continue to grow.
Build and streamline database management operations, including:
Horizontal cluster scale-out
Incremental and point-in-time backups
Online schema and index operations
Rolling upgrades and blue-green deployments
Identify and implement performance improvements across the storage engine, transaction processing, and replication layers.
Contribute to the open-source YugabyteDB project, helping evolve its storage architecture and operational reliability.
Mentor and technically influence other engineers in distributed systems design, performance engineering, and systems-level debugging.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in systems programming using C/C++.
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science (or related field), or equivalent practical experience.
Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including:
Replication and consensus
Transactions and consistency models
Fault tolerance and recovery
Experience working on storage engines, databases, or other infrastructure-level systems.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in a collaborative, distributed team environment
Preferred Skills
Hands-on experience with distributed storage systems, transactional engines, or consensus protocols.
Familiarity with LSM-tree based storage engines, WALs, snapshots, or compaction strategies.
Experience with PostgreSQL internals or other relational database engines is a strong plus.
Prior contributions to open-source systems or database projects.

Ownership: You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.
Learning and Growth : You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.

Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.

Test and Review: Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.
Operate What You Build: Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.
You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.
Some of our projects include:
Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation
Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith
Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
Improving service accounts and secure automation
Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)
What you'll do
Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.
Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.
Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.
Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.
Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.
Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.
Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.
Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.

Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.
Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).
Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.
Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.
Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.
Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.
Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams, solving the highest-scope and most complex problems in your area. You will lead large, cross-cutting backend initiatives, drive our modular architecture strategy, and define the standards that let teams move faster without compromising quality, security, reliability, or operability.
This is a technical leadership role that combines deep backend expertise, systems judgment, product judgment, and influence across organizational boundaries. You will work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Engineering Managers, and engineers across product groups, bringing subject matter expertise, and you will do it without relying on formal authority.
Why you’ll love this role
Leverage: Your work multiplies across teams. The platforms, standards, and architectural decisions you lead determine how quickly everyone else can ship.
Genuinely Hard Problems: You’ll lead the modernization of a large monolith toward modular, reusable, appropriately independent systems — at the scale of a platform used by millions of users.
Influence Without Bureaucracy: You’ll shape technical direction across teams through clear written proposals and decision records, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform roadmap and investment trade-offs.
Frontier AI Work: You’ll lead adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows and define the review, quality, security, and privacy guardrails that make them safe to rely on.
Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.
What you’ll do
Lead Cross-Cutting Initiatives: Lead the technical design and delivery of large backend initiatives that span teams, and identify and remove systemic bottlenecks across product and infrastructure groups.
Own Architecture Strategy: Drive modular backend, service, data, and platform architecture. Lead modernization of the monolith and legacy backends toward modular, reusable, and appropriately independently operated systems — while preventing fragmentation and service sprawl.
Set the Standards: Define and improve standards for APIs, contracts, compatibility, schema evolution, testing, security, performance, observability, operability, and maintainability — plus the build, test, deploy, release, rollback, and production-readiness practices needed to operate modular features safely.
Establish Shared Patterns: Create the patterns for dependency management, data ownership, eventing, failure isolation, service maturity, and operational documentation. Establish Go service patterns and Kubernetes operating practices where they matter to our production estate, and guide Rust adoption where it solves a real systems, security, performance, or supply-chain problem.
Own What You Build in Production: Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during complex incidents, and turn what you learn into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence.
Influence and Partner: Shape technical direction across teams without formal authority, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform-level roadmap decisions and investment trade-offs.
Grow Engineers: Mentor Senior and Intermediate engineers, shepherd technical debt reduction and reusable patterns that improve throughput, and raise the technical capability of the wider team.
Lead AI Adoption: Lead team-level adoption of AI-assisted and agentic workflows, including the quality, security, privacy, and operational guardrails, and help engineers direct, validate, reject, and course-correct agent output.
What you’ll bring
Cross-Team Technical Leadership: A sustained record of technical leadership across more than one team or a broad product area.
Deep Architecture Experience: Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components.
Modularization in Production: Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, or an equivalent approach.
Influence Without Authority: A strong ability to create alignment through clear written proposals and decision records, so decisions are documented, understood, and adopted without constant escalation.
Product Judgment: The ability to balance customer outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, reliability, and long-term platform investment.
Mentorship: Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review, documentation, and example.
Agentic AI Leadership: Production experience with AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate and improve how a team adopts them.
Helpful experience 
Go services and APIs at scale.
Kubernetes and cloud-native operations, including deployment, scaling, observability, rollback, and production readiness.
Rust adoption or production ownership for systems, security, performance, or platform components.
Ruby/Rails modularization and large-monolith modernization.
PostgreSQL scaling, data partitioning, queues, messaging, or distributed systems.
Security-sensitive product or software supply chain engineering.
Experience across SaaS, single-tenant, self-managed, or air-gapped deployment constraints.

In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. 
Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.
Some examples of the projects you could work on:
Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes
Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab
Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)
Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants
Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale
Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response
Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)
Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure
What You’ll Do
Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure: Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.
Debug & Resolve Production Issues: Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.
Automate Operations at Scale: Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.
Monitor & Predict Capacity: Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.
Respond & Lead During Incidents: Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.
Architect & Collaborate: Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.
What You’ll Bring
Production-Scale Experience: Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.
Terraform & IaC Mastery: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.
Kubernetes in Production: Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.
Programming & Code Analysis: Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis.
Large Scale Operations Background: Experience supporting infrastructure for many customers or environments simultaneously. Comfortable managing isolation, scaling, monitoring, and incident response across diverse workloads.
Architecture & Incident Response: Able to reason through complex systems and operational challenges. Brings on-call experience and can lead technical discussions and incident resolution efforts under pressure.

An overview of this role
As a Software Engineer on GitLab's Authorization team, you'll help build and maintain the system that decides what every user, token, and automated agent can access on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who guide the larger design decisions, delivering well-scoped changes and growing into ownership of larger parts of the system.
Today, that work is Ruby on Rails. Roughly 400 policy classes and a catalog of about 1,900 permissions sit behind every application programming interface (API) request. You'll work on fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and representational state transfer (REST) APIs that enforce them. A single request can trigger hundreds of permission checks, so correctness and performance both matter.
You'll also contribute to moving the permission model to a new authorization stack that pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine. The engine represents access relationships and evaluates permission rules, and can run within the monolith's process or be reached through remote procedure calls using gRPC. You don't need prior Rust experience: several engineers on the team learned it for this work, and we'll support you doing the same.
Some examples of our projects:
Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and the new authorization service
Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources, with guidance from senior engineers on the design
What you'll do
Implement authorization changes in GitLab's Ruby on Rails monolith so permission checks allow intended access and deny unauthorized access.
Deliver well-scoped workstreams from feature-flagged rollout through verifying that the old and new systems produce the same results, with review and guidance from senior engineers.
Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles so additional resources have permission coverage consistent with the established catalog.
Extend and fix authorization enforcement so GraphQL and the REST API enforce the intended permissions consistently.
Make incremental refactors to long-lived policy code without changing behavior for existing customers.
Investigate and fix reliability, performance, and security issues so affected permission checks return the expected results without regressions.
Work with the authentication, platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) teams to document interface contracts that keep permission checks consistent as authorization moves toward a shared service.

We work in a fully asynchronous organization, with most decisions made in documents or merge requests rather than meetings.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As an Threat Research Engineer at GitLab, you'll research emerging security threats and turn your findings into protection for GitLab customers. You'll investigate new attack surfaces, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems, and build systems that help detect threats and improve vulnerability advisories.
This is a full-stack role: you'll take an idea from the first research question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. You'll use AI tools daily and build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection.
What you'll do
Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.
What you'll bring
Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with an understanding of package ecosystems and software supply chain attacks.
Both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model (LLM) application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).
Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices, including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and writing maintainable code.
Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward, balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.
Clear writing for engineers and a general audience, and keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
Helpful, but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP); Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entries or published findings; research on AI agents, LLM applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; blogs, talks, or open source security tools; Terraform or OpenTofu; databases or data pipelines at scale; reverse engineering.
You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.
About the team
We're the Threat Research group. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning, and publish our findings on the Security Labs blog.
Our work includes research on the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent.

jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
About the Team
At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative—our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows.
Within this broader ecosystem, the Workday Adaptive Planning Support team plays a critical role in empowering our customers to build agile, data-driven financial strategies. We partner directly with core engineering, data science, and product development to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability across both traditional SaaS features and next-generation AI workflows for our global customer base.
About the Role
We are seeking a customer-focused Support Engineer who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this high-visibility, customer-facing role, you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.
You will drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.
A key part of this role will also involve hands-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
Location & Shift
Location: This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.
Hybrid Work: Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
Hours: Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM IST
On-Call: Participation in an on-call rotation is required to provide after-hours support when needed.
Key Responsibilities
Core Planning and Reporting Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot with customers on cases to resolve reported issues with their financial data, reporting, and/or financial integrations.
Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
Hands-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
Technical Troubleshooting & RCA: Assist in root-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
Documentation & Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.
About You

Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
Technical & Diagnostic Skills:
Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.

Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.
AI & LLM Exposure: Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
Triage & Operations:
Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
Have these technical skills:
ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
Jenkins & Git
Kubernetes and Docker
ELK or other log aggregation tool
JavaScript
