jobs.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
Job Summary:
About the role
At PayPal, real-time decisioning powers customer protection and global commerce. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end delivery across a portfolio of risk strategies and the next-generation Risk Decisioning Platform. From roadmap to production, you’ll be accountable for the integrated plan, the cross-team execution, and the measurable results. You’ll partner with the Product Manager, risk strategy leaders, data science, modeling, and engineering to turn the roadmap into outcomes: loss reduction, approval rates, and customer experience.
Near term, you’ll lead the program to move strategies off legacy systems and ramp them to full production. Beyond that, you’ll orchestrate the launch of new strategies and build the delivery mechanisms, including experimentation and automation, that keep them improving.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Scope: The project & program responsibilities are focused on internal information system-specific project tasks or non-technical project completion using an internal customer perspective, both typically from initiation through delivery.
Organize daily activities based on organizational goals.
Develop and implement new programs that support objectives.
Monitor projects and oversee project managers.
Evaluate program strengths and weaknesses.
Develop program budgets and plans.
Meet with stakeholders to discuss program status and goals.
Improve strategies with the marketing team.
Minimum Qualifications:
5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
What you’ll do
Own end-to-end program delivery. Turn the product roadmap into an integrated, multi-quarter plan spanning rules, models, data pipelines, platform capabilities, and customer treatments, with clear milestones, owners, and dependencies. Lead independently.
Lead the legacy migration. Own the strategy, sequencing, and execution of moving risk strategies to the Risk Decisioning Platform, including parity validation, shadow and champion/challenger testing, cutover, and ramp to full production.
Drive new strategy launches. Establish repeatable launch processes, from design through readiness reviews, rollout gating, monitoring, and rollback, that other teams adopt as the standard.
Align teams and leaders. Partner across data science, modeling, engineering, platform, risk operations, and strategy teams on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs. Resolve cross-org blockers early and influence without direct authority.
Manage dependencies and risk. Make critical paths and dependency maps visible, and anticipate risks to data, models, platform capacity, and infrastructure before they hit the schedule.
Enable experimentation and automation. Work with engineering and data science to make testing, deployment, and strategy optimization faster and safer, focusing on the highest-leverage automation.
Track, report, and govern. Define program metrics and dashboards covering delivery health, strategy performance, and captured savings. Present in program, product, and steering committee reviews, shaping the narrative and trade-off recommendations for senior leadership.
Raise the bar. Introduce scalable program practices and post-launch retrospectives, and mentor other program managers.
What you bring
5+ years of program or technical program management experience delivering complex, cross-functional technical programs, including programs spanning multiple teams or organizations
Strong technical fluency in data pipelines, model deployment, APIs, and distributed systems, enough to engage credibly with engineers and data scientists and challenge technical trade-offs
Proven experience leading large-scale migrations or platform transitions, including cutover and ramp planning, with ownership of strategy as well as delivery
Excellent planning, prioritization, and risk management skills, with a record of delivering on time in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across competing priorities without direct authority
Outstanding written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief executives and steering committees
Comfort working with data: you define metrics, read dashboards, and use them to steer the program
Bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field, or equivalent experience
Nice to have
Hands-on background in engineering, data science, or risk analytics
Experience with real-time decisioning or rules-engine platforms
Experience mentoring or leading other program managers

jobs.title: Major Incident Management Analyst
jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:
Job Title: Major Incident Management Analyst
Location: Bangalore
Who we are:
Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com.
Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.
Our Core Beliefs:
Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.
Role Purpose
Support Service Management transformation by analysing operational information, identifying improvement opportunities, developing practical automation and AI-enabled solutions, and assisting senior specialists with implementation. This role is intended for someone earlier in their career who has sound Service Management fundamentals, strong analytical ability, curiosity and the potential to develop into a transformation specialist.
Key Responsibilities
Analysis and Improvement
· Analyse incident, problem, change and service operational data to identify patterns, recurring issues and improvement opportunities.
· Support proactive Problem Management and service-improvement activities.
· Validate findings with Service Management practitioners, resolver teams and technical specialists.
· Help quantify the expected and realised impact of improvements.
AI and Automation Support
· Identify repetitive manual activities that may be suitable for automation.
· Use approved AI and productivity tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, documentation and operational activities.
· Support development and testing of simple ServiceNow workflows, Power Automate solutions, dashboards or similar automations.
· Document use cases, testing results, controls and user guidance.
Service Management Delivery
· Support Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and Continual Improvement activities as required.
· Assist senior specialists with process assessments and transformation initiatives.
· Maintain improvement actions, risks, decisions, dependencies and outcome tracking.
· Help ensure that operational learning is converted into practical actions rather than reporting alone.
Technical Collaboration
· Work alongside Cloud, Infrastructure, Application, Platform and Engineering teams.
· Learn how monitoring, events, logs, metrics and traces connect with Service Management processes.
· Support correlation of incidents with operational events, changes and technical data.
· Escalate data-quality, tooling or process gaps to the relevant workstream owner.
Continuous Learning and Knowledge Sharing
· Develop knowledge of AI, automation, Cloud, DevOps, SRE and observability concepts.
· Experiment with new approaches under appropriate guidance and controls.
· Create clear documentation and reusable analysis templates.
· Share successful solutions and lessons with other team members.
#LI-RB1
You will be successful in this role if you have:
Experience and Skills
Must Have
· Approximately 2-5 years of experience in IT Operations, Service Management or a related discipline.
· Working understanding of at least one area such as Incident, Major Incident, Problem or Change Management.
· Strong Excel or equivalent data-analysis capability.
· Good written communication, problem-solving and attention to detail.
· Ability to collaborate with Service Management and technical teams.
· Strong curiosity, learning agility and willingness to take ownership of assigned work.
Should Have
· Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira or a comparable ITSM platform.
· Basic understanding of Cloud or modern IT operations.
· Exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Claude or equivalent AI tools.
· Interest in automation, analytics or workflow improvement.
Good to Have
· Power BI or another visualisation platform.
· Power Automate or comparable workflow tools.
· Basic scripting or API awareness.
· Exposure to monitoring or observability tools.
· ITIL Foundation or equivalent knowledge; certification is not mandatory.
Success Measures
· Accurate analysis that leads to actionable improvement opportunities.
· Assigned automation, dashboard or improvement tasks completed to agreed quality.
· Clear documentation and reliable tracking of actions and outcomes.
· Demonstrated growth in Service Management, analytics and automation capability.
· Positive collaboration with senior specialists, operational teams and engineering stakeholders.
Role Boundaries
The role is not expected to arrive as a fully formed transformation consultant. The individual will work under guidance on larger initiatives while progressively taking ownership of analysis, automation and improvement deliverables. Coding and deep Cloud engineering expertise are not mandatory.
Unisys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that considers all qualified applicants without regard to age, blood type, caste, citizenship, color, disability, family medical history, family status, ethnicity, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, national origin, parental status, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, transgender status, veteran status or any other category protected by law.
Local employment practices and rights may vary by jurisdiction and are subject to applicable local laws. This commitment includes our efforts to provide for all those who seek to express interest in employment the opportunity to participate without barriers.
If you are a US job seeker unable to review the job opportunities herein, or cannot otherwise complete your expression of interest, without additional assistance and would like to discuss a request for reasonable accommodation, please contact our Global Recruiting organization at GlobalRecruiting@unisys.com. US job seekers can find more information about Unisys’ EEO commitment here.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Workforce Development
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
The Senior Manager, Workforce Development at Micron is a pivotal role responsible for building, scaling, and sustaining a certified, production-ready, and future-capable workforce. This position offers an outstanding chance to lead and develop the workforce strategy for Micron Semiconductor India. It ensures our operations run flawlessly and our ramp-up goals are met with precise accuracy.
Key Responsibilities
Workforce Readiness & Ramp Execution
Own the overall workforce readiness strategy aligned to Micron ramp plans and hiring roadmap.
Ensure operators, technicians, and engineers are certified on time to support volume ramp with minimal learning loss.
Translate ramp targets into weekly executable training and certification plans.
Drive closure of WFD gaps impacting yield, efficiency, compliance, or safety.
Training Program & Curriculum Ownership
Define, maintain, and continuously improve role-based training curricula (MA, Technician, Engineer).
Ensure inclusion of MES or equivalent experience, SAP, YMS, PR issuance, blocking issue resolution paths, and system differentiation (internal vs external issues).
Standardize training modules, assessment methods, and certification criteria across Micron Semiconductor India site.
Partner with engineering services, quality control, tech support, manufacturing, and EHS to validate the transfer of learning.
Certification, Skills & Proficiency Framework
Build and implement a proficiency/skills readiness framework for engineers and technicians.
Own certification governance: tracking, re-certification, audit readiness, and risk closure.
Provide leadership visibility through clear readiness dashboards and skill heatmap.
Benchmark and leverage proven frameworks from other Micron sites where applicable.
Training Infrastructure & Capacity Management
Ensure sufficient training rooms, cleanroom training space, and system environments to support bulk hiring.
Coordinate with Facilities, Procurement, and Site Leadership on space and infrastructure readiness.
Explore and implement solutions such as training centers, simulated environments, or phased certification models.
Collaborator & Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as the single-point owner for Workforce Development (WFD) across Micron, partnering closely with Manufacturing, Area Owners, Engineering, Quality, IT/MES, People Org/HR, and EHS & Compliance, while representing workforce readiness in site reviews, ramp readiness forums, and executive updates.
Metrics, Reporting & Governance
Establish and maintain weekly WFD progress reporting across all roles (MA, Tech, Engineer, and other professionals), track KPIs such as certification attainment versus plan, time‑to‑certification, training efficiency, learning retention, production readiness impact, and overdue classes, and proactively identify risks to drive structured mitigation actions and timely leadership decisions.
People Leadership
Lead and develop WFD team members with clear role clarity, performance expectations, and growth plans.
Build a strong execution culture built on rigor, ownership, and outcomes.
Mentor leaders to operate independently while maintaining site-level alignment.
Required Qualifications
Required is a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or an associated area (a Master’s degree or matching hands-on experience is preferred).
10–15+ years in manufacturing operations, workforce development, training, or industrial engineering.
Proven experience supporting factory ramp-ups or large-scale workforce onboarding.
Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing or high-tech manufacturing environments.
Key Proficiencies
Strategic workforce planning with a hands-on execution approach.
Strong multi-functional influence and collaborator management.
Data-driven decision making and executive communication.
Ability to translate high-level goals into shop-floor execution.
High ownership, bias for action, and structured problem solving.
Success in This Role Looks Like
Micron Semiconductor India ramps with no risks caused by workforce limitations.
Training completion aligned to hiring plan with minimal rework.
Clear, reliable certification transparency for leadership.
Workforce that is safe, compliant, confident, and productive from Day 1!

jobs.title: Analog Circuit Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
Intel is looking for an experienced Analog Designer to join the IO Design Team in Bengaluru. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the design and development of advanced analog and mixed-signal circuits that enable high-speed chip-to-chip, package-to-package, and system-level connectivity for Intel's next-generation products.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in transistor-level circuit design, high-speed IO architectures, and silicon debug. This position requires technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership of critical IP blocks from concept through silicon validation.
Key Responsibilities-
• Lead the design, analysis, and optimization of analog and mixed-signal circuits for high-speed IO interfaces.
• Develop and drive architecture and circuit implementation for:
• High-speed TX and RX circuits
• Serializer/Deserializer (SerDes) building blocks
• PLLs, DLLs, CDRs, and clocking circuits
• Equalization and signal conditioning circuits
• Bandgap references, bias generation, and LDOs
• ESD protection and IO pad circuitry
• Perform detailed transistor-level design, simulation, and verification across multiple PVT corners.
• Drive design closure for performance metrics including bandwidth, jitter, noise, power, area, yield, and reliability.
• Collaborate closely with physical design teams on layout reviews and post-lay out optimization.
• Support silicon bring-up, characterization, root-cause analysis, and correlation between simulation and silicon measurements.
• Work with architecture, digital design, signal integrity, package, product engineering, and validation teams to ensure successful product execution.
• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team-wide design methodologies and best practices.
• Drive technical reviews and provide leadership in solving complex design challenges.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, VLSI, Microelectronics, or a related discipline.
• 5 to 9 years of industry experience in analog/mixed-signal IC design.
• Strong expertise in CMOS analog circuit design fundamentals.
• Proven experience designing high-speed analog circuits in advanced technology nodes.
• Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: SerDes architectures, High-speed IO interfaces, PLL/DLL/CDR circuits, TX/RX analog front-end circuits, Clock distribution networks, Reference and bias circuits, LDOs and power management circuits.
• Deep understanding of circuit noise, mismatch, jitter, stability, and reliability considerations.
• Strong experience with Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, and industry-standard analog verification flows.
• Expertise in: Corner analysis, Monte Carlo simulations, Statistical design methodologies, post-layout verification and extraction analysis, Strong debugging and analytical problem-solving skills.
• Experience with industry-standard high-speed interfaces such as: PCI Express (PCIe), DDR Memory Interfaces, USB, Ethernet, MIPI, DP, eDP, HDMI, UCIe.
• Experience in advanced process technologies such as FinFET and Gate-All- Around (GAA) nodes.
• Knowledge of signal integrity, channel modelling, and equalization techniques.
• Experience in silicon validation and lab characterization.
• Familiarity with reliability signoff, ESD verification, and EM/IR analysis.
• Scripting experience using Python, Perl, TCL, or SKILL for design automation and productivity enhancement.
Key Competencies
• Technical leadership in analog and mixed-signal design.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work effectively in global, cross-functional environments.
• Structured problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
• Passion for innovation and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Director, Systems Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Oracle is seeking an engineering director to build and lead a new Systems Firmware team in Bengaluru. You will hire the founding engineers, establish the team’s technical direction and culture, and take responsibility for outcomes that directly affect the reliability and serviceability of our server fleet.
The team’s initial mission is to resolve BMC and BIOS firmware issues in production. Working closely with US engineering teams, infrastructure operations, hardware teams, and external partners, you will lead complex investigations, drive lasting fixes, and improve the diagnostics, testing, and release practices that prevent problems from recurring. The team will participate in on-call rotations during India daytime hours, complementing US coverage through coordinated response and clear technical handoffs.
You will start with four senior engineers and provide close technical leadership while building the practices and partnerships needed for the team to succeed. You will set priorities, develop your engineers, and balance immediate fleet needs with longer-term improvements in firmware quality, security, and operational efficiency.
You will also shape the team’s roadmap and future capability. As additional hiring is approved, our intent is to expand its responsibilities into firmware development and delivery for new server and GPU platforms. This includes working with original design manufacturers and joint design manufacturers (ODM/JDMs), particularly Taiwan-based partners, on platform requirements, firmware integration, bring-up, validation, and production readiness.
This role calls for a leader with deep systems firmware expertise, sound operational judgment, and a record of building strong engineering teams. You should be comfortable guiding difficult technical investigations, holding partners accountable for delivery, and translating lessons from production into better engineering decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Build and lead the Bangalore Systems Firmware team. Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional engineers working on BMC firmware and BIOS. Establish clear ownership, coach technical leaders, and create an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Own firmware operational support during India daytime hours. Establish sustainable on-call rotations and effective handoffs with US teams to provide continuity of support for Oracle’s server and GPU fleet.
Lead resolution of complex firmware issues. Guide incident triage, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions across firmware, hardware, and software boundaries. Prioritize work by customer impact and ensure timely resolution and clear stakeholder communication.
Turn fleet experience into better products. Partner with engineering, operations, and vendors to address recurring defects, improve diagnostics and recovery, and translate customer and operational needs into firmware enhancements.
Establish engineering and operational standards. Define and evolve runbooks, escalation processes, maintenance procedures, and firmware validation and deployment practices that improve fleet availability, health, security, and reliability.
Drive disciplined execution. Set priorities and manage interdependent initiatives across teams, balancing urgent fleet issues with long-term improvements. Establish measurable outcomes, manage dependencies, and adjust plans as business needs and resources evolve.
Champion firmware quality and security. Partner with security and engineering stakeholders to establish secure development practices, clear acceptance criteria, and appropriate testing and release controls.
Develop strong global partnerships. Align priorities and ownership across US and India engineering teams, fleet operations, hardware engineering, and external partners. Build productive relationships with ODM/JDM vendors, including Taiwan-based partners.
Expand the team’s product development capabilities as it grows. Build the expertise and processes needed to contribute to firmware architecture, platform bring-up, integration, validation, and production readiness for new server and GPU products.
Drive continuous improvement. Evaluate emerging firmware technologies, identify team skill gaps, and invest in automation, knowledge sharing, and engineering practices that improve execution and reduce recurring operational work.
Required Qualifications
Demonstrated success leading systems firmware engineering teams, with experience hiring, coaching, managing performance, and developing senior technical talent.
Deep technical expertise in server firmware, with substantial experience in BMC firmware and/or BIOS/UEFI and the ability to lead engineering decisions across both domains.
Experience supporting production server environments and leading the investigation and resolution of complex issues spanning firmware, hardware, operating systems, and platform management.
Strong technical judgment, including the ability to guide architecture and design reviews, evaluate competing solutions, and connect immediate corrective actions to long-term reliability improvements.
Experience establishing operational support practices, including on-call rotations, incident escalation, root-cause analysis, runbooks, and coordination across geographically distributed teams.
A record of delivering complex engineering initiatives through clear priorities, resource planning, dependency management, and effective cross-functional execution.
Experience applying secure development practices, firmware validation, release management, and controlled deployment processes.
Strong communication and partnership skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, manage escalations, and align engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors.
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building a new engineering team or expanding an existing team from operational support into firmware development and product delivery.
Experience working directly with ODM/JDM partners on server firmware development, platform bring-up, qualification, and production issue resolution; collaboration with Taiwan-based vendors is particularly relevant.
Experience with GPU or accelerated computing platforms and the firmware requirements of large-scale cloud infrastructure.
Familiarity with OpenBMC or other BMC firmware stacks, BIOS/UEFI implementations, and server management interfaces and standards such as Redfish and IPMI.
Experience improving fleet reliability through firmware telemetry, automated testing, diagnostic tooling, and safe update and recovery mechanisms.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Firmware connects hardware capability to cloud reliability. At OCI, you will work where those layers meet—investigating challenging failures, developing lasting fixes, and improving how firmware is tested, deployed, and operated across our infrastructure.
As a Principal Systems Firmware Engineer, you will design, develop, and improve BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI and the tools that support its deployment across OCI’s server and GPU infrastructure. You will own complex engineering problems across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, delivering changes that improve platform reliability, diagnosability, security, and recovery.
Your initial focus will be engineering improvements for platforms already operating in our fleet. You will use production findings to identify design weaknesses, develop and validate firmware fixes, extend automated testing, and eliminate recurring failure modes. Success means delivering durable improvements that reduce failures and the need for manual intervention.
You will also participate in an India daytime on-call rotation, complementing US engineering teams. This responsibility connects your engineering work directly to how platforms behave in production and includes incident investigation, mitigation, and coordinated handoffs.
As the team grows, its scope is expected to expand into new server and GPU platform development, with opportunities to work alongside silicon suppliers and ODM/JDM partners on firmware integration, platform bring-up, and validation.
This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team’s engineering practices while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and complex technical investigations.
Key Responsibilities
Own firmware development and integration. Design, develop, debug, and maintain BMC or BIOS/UEFI components and supporting systems software. Define clear interfaces across firmware, hardware, operating systems, and fleet management services.
Resolve complex fleet issues. Lead investigations into boot failures, management controller faults, firmware update problems, hardware initialization failures, and other platform reliability issues. Develop mitigations, establish root cause, and deliver durable fixes.
Provide operational support. Participate in the India daytime on-call rotation, coordinate investigations and handoffs with US teams, and communicate impact, progress, and resolution clearly.
Build automation and preventive controls. Develop tools for firmware provisioning, updates, diagnostics, recovery, and validation. Improve telemetry, logging, and failure analysis to reduce recurring incidents and manual intervention.
Drive software quality and security. Write maintainable code, lead design and code reviews, and develop functional, regression, negative, and recovery tests. Apply secure development practices and support firmware vulnerability remediation.
Contribute to platform bring-up. Diagnose interactions across firmware, hardware, bootloaders, and operating systems. Use platform logs and appropriate hardware debugging tools to isolate faults and validate end-to-end behavior.
Collaborate with engineering and vendor partners. Work with hardware, silicon, operating system, validation, and fleet operations teams. As product development scope grows, work with ODM/JDM partners on requirements, defect resolution, firmware releases, and platform readiness.
Provide technical leadership. Own delivery of complex engineering work, identify dependencies and risks, document designs and debugging methods, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and continuous improvement.
Required qualifications
Meet one of the following education and software development experience combinations:
11 years of software development experience; or
A bachelor’s degree/B.Tech in a relevant engineering, computing, information technology, mathematics, physics, or related field, with 7 years of software development experience; or
A master’s degree/M.Tech in one of these fields, with 5 years of software development experience; or
A doctorate in one of these fields, with 3 years of software development experience.
At least 6 years of experience using programming and scripting languages, with strong C/C++ skills and the ability to build diagnostic and automation tools.
Substantial hands-on development and debugging experience in BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI, with the ability to investigate interactions across the broader server platform.
Strong understanding of server architecture, embedded systems, hardware/software interfaces, and Linux fundamentals.
Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, using evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes.
Experience owning software components through design, implementation, code review, testing, release, and ongoing support.
Experience developing automated tests, diagnostics, or operational tooling and improving reliability, observability, or performance.
Ability to lead technical investigations, mentor colleagues, and communicate effectively across engineering teams and external partners.
Willingness to participate in the India daytime on-call rotation.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with OpenBMC or other server BMC stacks, or with server BIOS/UEFI implementations such as EDK II or commercial firmware platforms.
Familiarity with relevant platform interfaces and protocols, such as Redfish, IPMI, PLDM/MCTP, SMBus/I²C, SPI, PCIe, or ACPI.
Experience with server or GPU platform bring-up, hardware initialization, power and thermal management, or reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS) features.
Experience using JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or emulators, and interpreting schematics and board documentation.
Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, update and recovery mechanisms, or firmware security remediation.
Experience supporting production infrastructure at cloud or hyperscale environments, including controlled firmware rollouts and incident response.
Experience collaborating with silicon suppliers, BIOS/BMC vendors, or ODM/JDM engineering teams.

The AI & ML platform team builds and runs the infrastructure that underpins dozens of Atlassian's AI, Machine Learning & Search capabilities across our wide range of products. The Position
About the Role
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Use Case Engineering & Operations Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Full-Stack AI Engineer / Data Scientist with a deep sense of ownership. Rather than being a narrowly specialized Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or MLOps Engineer, you will combine these skill sets. You will build agentic generative AI systems and classical ML systems end-to-end, taking accountability from concept and exploratory data analysis all the way to production releases and monitoring.
Core Tech Stack & Scope
This role involves working deeply with multimodal foundation models, advanced agentic workflows (including Agent-to-Agent/A2A communication), Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, other emerging AI technologies, and MLOps subsystems. You will utilize cloud services (AWS and multicloud) alongside vector, graph, and traditional databases to develop scalable and robust AI solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Agentic & GenAI Application Development:
Design and build advanced AI agentic systems, state machines, search-based conversational systems that solve complex business problems.
Develop workflows leveraging Large Foundational Multimodal Models to process and reason across text, audio, and video modalities.
Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients to standardize context exchange between agents, data sources, and external tools.
Collaborate with AI Architects, Product Owners, and fellow developers to integrate AI capabilities into scalable, fair, and ethical end-user applications focusing on relevance and real-time performance.
Full-Stack Engineering & Agentic SDLC:
Leverage AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles, maintaining high productivity across frontend, backend, and infrastructure tasks.
Take end-to-end accountability for features: write high-quality, production-ready Python (and occasionally TypeScript) code with comprehensive testing and documentation.
Manage the DevOps/MLOps lifecycle: containerize applications using Docker, configure CI/CD pipelines, and architect high-throughput, reliable cloud-native solutions on AWS/multicloud.
Data Science, EDA & Strategy:
Perform thorough Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to understand dataset characteristics, uncover patterns, detect biases, and identify data quality issues.
Use statistical and visualization techniques to inform feature engineering, model selection, and optimization of foundation model-based applications.
Design robust data pipelines to curate, preprocess, and structure diverse datasets that maximize LLM effectiveness and reduce bias.
Algorithm Development & Optimization:
Design, customize, optimize, and fine-tune LLM-based and traditional AI algorithms for specific use cases (e.g., text generation, summarization, AI agents, sequence modeling).
Lead advanced prompt engineering strategies, utilizing zero-shot, few-shot and other paradigms to optimize model outputs without extensive fine-tuning.
Implement pre-generative AI models (e.g., classification, clustering, regression) when they provide a more efficient, interpretable, or cost-efficient solution compared to LLMs.
Optimize model inference speed, reduce latency (cold start reduction, caching strategies), and manage resource usage across cloud architectures.
Evaluation, Observability & Continuous Improvement:
Conduct rigorous experimentation (A/B testing) and implement automatic metric pipelines (e.g. BLEU/ROUGE, RAG retrieval accuracy, human rating frameworks, etc.) to evaluate generative and multimodal systems.
Implement real-time algorithms monitoring and observability practices, ensuring visibility into pipelines behavior, drift detection, and anomaly identification using telemetry tools.
Translate complex technical results into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, driving data-driven decision-making.

Experience:
7+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering and Data Science, with exposure to generative AI, agents and classical ML.
3+ years of hands-on experience with generative large language models and agents.
Proven experience managing the end-to-end MLOps lifecycle and deploying models at scale.
Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents within an agentic SDLC to accelerate feature delivery.
Skills:
Must-have:
Expert Python: Advanced production-grade proficiency in Python.
Cloud Platforms: Practical experience designing cloud solutions on AWS (familiarity with multicloud is a plus), utilizing GenAI-specific services (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker).
AI/GenAI Frameworks: Deep expertise with LangChain, LangGraph or similar LLM orchestration frameworks, agentic system design, and state machine logic.
Building production-level AI systems including RAGs, Vector DBs, MCP, end-users, integrations, etc., but also observability, DevOps, durable and available system designs.
Software Engineering Best Practices: Expertise in API design, CI/CD, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, and rigorous automated testing.
aSDLC expertise: Proven experience in leveraging agents for SDLC (software development lifecycle).
Databases: Snowflake, SQL, NoSQL, and data lakes.
Data Skills: Strong background in statistics, data manipulation, synthetic data generation, and feature engineering.
Should-have:
Could-have:
Familiarity with TypeScript is considered an advantage - to have a common language with the full-stack Software Engineers.
Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience in working within highly regulated industries.
Capabilities:
Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent analytical skills to tackle complex engineering and statistical challenges.
Ownership & Leadership: Deep sense of accountability, eager to define architectural patterns, and able to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Frontend, Backend & Cloud) – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Job description
We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on Full-Stack Software Engineer who will cover frontend UI, backend architecture, cloud deployment, and DevOps engineering all under one hat. Since our team already includes dedicated AI Engineers and Data Engineers, your primary mission is to be the foundational software engineering anchor: building the robust, scalable, and secure user interfaces, infrastructure, integrations, and server-side logic that allows our AI solutions to thrive in a production environment.
Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high-value AI solutions spanning advanced agentic frameworks, Generative AI applications, and classical Machine Learning. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building these innovative AI applications end-to-end to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through agentic SDLC).
Job Responsibilities
Frontend Architecture & Generative UI: Develop highly scalable, reusable UI components using expert-level TypeScript and modern frameworks (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Shift from static layouts to flexible, dynamic interfaces that gracefully handle unpredictable data and real-time LLM streams.
Core Backend Engineering & API Design: Design and build highly scalable, reusable backend services and APIs (using Python) that serve as the backbone for multi-agent workflows and GenAI applications. Build, host, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and standard APIs to standardize data exchange.
Cloud Architecture & DevOps Excellence: Design, implement, and manage secure and scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS) tailored for diverse AI workloads. Apply Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform. Build, maintain, and optimize fully automated CI/CD pipelines and manage application containerization (Docker).
Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code.
Qualifications / Education / Experience
Experience: 7+ years of strong software engineering experience with a demonstrable focus on backend development, cloud infrastructure, advanced frontend architecture, and DevOps.
AI Integration Experience: Proven experience building backends for complex solutions and AI / LLM-powered applications, managing streaming responses, and translating non-deterministic AI outputs into safe, functional user interfaces.
Agentic Workflow: Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents within an agentic SDLC to accelerate feature delivery.
Hold a B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng., PhD, or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Be a passionate builder, staying continuously up-to-date with the latest developments in cloud computing, backend architectures, frontend paradigms, and AI integrations.
Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, thriving in a fast-paced environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary.
Have a deep sense of accountability, capable of diagnosing complex system-level issues across the entire stack, and able to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary.
Skills
Must-have:
Software Engineering Best Practices: Robust automated testing (TDD) to verify both code written by AI agents and dynamic UI components generated at runtime.
Frontend & User Interface: Deep expertise in TypeScript and a major framework (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Strong capability in complex state management and handling real-time data flow.
Backend Programming: Advanced, production-grade proficiency in Python. Excellent enterprise API design and microservices architecture skills.
Cloud & DevOps: Deep expertise in AWS (IAM, Lambda, S3, ECS, etc.), Docker, CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions), and Terraform.
APIs and integrations: Building API-driven applications and integrating different enterprise systems into one solution.
Should-have:
Data & AI Tooling: Experience integrating with modern databases (Snowflake, OpenSearch). Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), graph databases, and Generative UI libraries.
aSDLC: leveraging Agentic AI in the Software Development Lifecycle
Building scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available systems.
Could-have:
Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience in working within highly regulated industries.
Additional Qualifications
Security Mindset: Strong understanding of enterprise security risks, IAM, and safe data handling along with a strong understanding of responsible AI deployment.
Communication: Be an excellent problem solver, detail-oriented, and a great communicator, able to present complex technical matters clearly to diverse audiences. Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1+.
Be deeply interested in developments in AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in agentic SDLC, cloud computing, and software development practices.
Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+.
Working Hours: Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).
Shift: CET time zone

jobs.title: Fullstack AI Quality Engineer – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
External Job Ad Text
Job description
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Quality Engineer specializing in testing Generative (and non-Generative) AI applications and agentic systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both traditional software testing and specialized testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs)-based and AI-based systems.
As a fullstack Quality Engineer within a lean, agentic software team, you will cover the entire spectrum of quality assurance. You will span manual exploratory testing, traditional automated UI/API/MCP testing (across our Python and TypeScript stack), classical machine learning validation, and cutting-edge generative and agentic AI evaluation. This role requires a deep understanding of LLM, agentic and ML systems behaviors, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability, fairness, and effectiveness of our AI-powered solutions.
Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions and services to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small, highly autonomous agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. In this highly regulated environment, quality cannot be an afterthought. You will be the foundational pillar ensuring our rapidly developed agentic workflows and AI, GenAI, and agentic applications are safe, compliant, and robust before they reach the clinical or enterprise user.
Job Responsibilities
Generative & Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi-agent behaviors and tool-use accuracy.
Full-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends.
Quality Assurance Framework & Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices.
Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases.
Security & Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring.
Qualifications
Hold B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree with strong background in testing methodologies.
Be passionate about quality assurance and testing, particularly in the context of AI and GenAI applications and agents.
Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving when using AI prompts (in e.g. NLP, data distributions and edge cases).
Be proactive in identifying potential issues and suggesting improvements.
Education / Experience
Experience: 7+ years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year focused on genAI and/or agentic applications.
Regulated Environments: Be ready to work in a regulated environment with qualified infrastructure and validated applications, understand the difference between GxP and non-GxP products and the importance of CSV and ITSM processes in the delivery.
Agile Integration: Be experienced in working with Agile development teams.
Skills
Must-have:
Comprehensive Full-Stack Testing Mastery
Core Languages & Testing Frameworks: Advanced command of Python and standard testing frameworks (e.g., pytest, allure), alongside practical familiarity with specialized AI evaluation tools. High competence in TypeScript-driven test frameworks (such as Playwright, Jest, and Cypress) for thoroughly verifying dynamic generative user interfaces.
End-to-End Automation & CI/CD: Proven expertise in architecting and maintaining end-to-end automated testing suites that bridge traditional UI/API validation with complex, asynchronous AI/LLM evaluation pipelines.
Pipeline Integration: Hands-on experience integrating these comprehensive suites within GitHub Actions or modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks throughout the entire development lifecycle.
Advanced AI Quality & Evaluation Mastery
AI Evaluation Frameworks: Expertise in implementing evaluation harnesses (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo) to quantify LLM performance, hallucination rates, and answer relevancy.
Agentic Workflow Validation: Ability to test autonomous agentic loops, including tool-use accuracy, step-by-step reasoning verification, and goal-directed performance metrics.
Evaluation Datasets: Experience in curating, managing, and versioning 'Golden Datasets' for benchmarking model responses against ground truth in both development and production environments.
Observability & Feedback Loops: Leveraging tracing (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) to monitor production inputs/outputs, identify drift, and capture user feedback for continuous improvement.
Basic broad AI knowledge: Understanding of LLM architectures, RAG systems, agents, and common failure modes in AI applications.
Python Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing robust, maintainable Python code for test automation (e.g., pytest). Experience using Python to orchestrate complex AI evaluation workflows, process large datasets for benchmarking, and automate interactions with LLM/AI services. Ability to integrate Python scripts into CI/CD pipelines for automated quality checks and performance observability in agentic systems.
Should-have:
Cloud: Practical experience with testing applications on cloud platforms (AWS) and working with cloud-based AI services.
Observability & ALM: Experience with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and performance metrics tracking (Grafana). Experienced in Roche mandatory ALM tools (Jira, GitHub).
Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development and testing cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code.
Security: Understanding of security testing methodologies, particularly in the context of AI applications.
Could-have:
Regulatory Compliance: Proven understanding of AI quality assurance and testing standards within highly regulated industries.
Additional Qualifications
Stay current with the latest developments in AI and GenAI testing methodologies and best practices.
Have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly document findings and recommendations.
Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1+.
Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).
Shift: CET time zone

jobs.title: P&C Business Partner, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) / Roche Information Solutions (RIS)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
People & Culture Business Partner – Roche Digital Technology (RDT) / Roche Information Solutions (RIS)
The Opportunity
As business partners supporting Roche Digital Technology (RDT) / Roche Information Solutions (RIS), we partner with the business to explore new frontiers to deliver medical advances and high-medical value for our future Insights Business. In this role as P&C Business Partner in Pune, India, you’ll play a crucial role as part of a diverse Business Partner network dedicated to shaping the future for our combined digital hub for the RDT & RIS. You will be encouraged to collaborate and contribute towards architecting a data driven organization which delivers healthcare solutions that enable more personalized and patient-centric care. In this role specifically, you will be tagged to our Roche site in Pune, India where you will be enabling the growth and development of our RDT & RIS footprint in Pune. You will also have the opportunity to shape the culture and employee experience at our Pune site.
Job Facts
In this position you will
Have the mindset of a business leader and entrepreneur.
Partner flexibly with multiple leadership areas in the business as part of the APAC network
Collaborate closely with your global and regional business partner network & relevant Business Leaders to understand long term business needs and strategic P&C priorities.
Translate business strategy into P&C strategies for the leadership areas and drive fit for purpose implementation.
Lead and drive change initiatives, people streams, Work Product Teams (WPTs) and squads to embed and implement the overall P&C strategies for the Pune site Support Work Package Teams / squads or initiatives in other parts of the business based on overall priorities.
Be accountable as a trusted strategic partner and coach for creative leadership, advancing organizational design and effectiveness (including driving transformation in mindset, behaviors and ways of working), for building a diverse and inclusive work culture, and securing future talent and capabilities.
Who You Are
As a People & Culture Business Partner you have:
10+ years of broad and progressive HR management or consulting experience in or with organizations recognized for best HR practices

jobs.description:
About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
Key Expectations
Data Engineering — the foundation
Ingestion & integration
Build and operate ingestion pipelines from enterprise source systems — cloud and on-premise ERP, CRM, ITSM, billing/revenue, planning and quoting platforms, and third-party operational systems — into the enterprise data lakehouse.
Work across multiple ingestion patterns — change data capture (CDC), orchestrated batch pipelines, event streaming, packaged analytics/replication tooling, and API-based ingestion — and select the pattern that fits the latency, volume, and cost profile of the use case, including near-real-time ingestion where the business value justifies it.
Own new-source onboarding end to end: source system analysis with application and ERP teams, schema and field availability confirmation, ingestion design, historical backfill, incremental load strategy, and exposure through the curated serving layers.
Modeling & curation
Build and extend the medallion architecture — raw landing, cleansed/conformed, and curated business layers — including a conformed star-schema layer of facts and dimensions and a denormalized, query-optimized serving layer consumed by BI tools and downstream applications.
Write and optimize SQL/stored-procedure and Spark-based transformations; model dimensional entities and conformed keys (customer, supplier, product, order, contract, site) so data joins cleanly across Finance, Sales, Service and Supply Chain domains.
Build the semantic and reporting layer, landing business definitions, hierarchies and metric logic once in the curated layer with documented ownership — so definitions are reusable and AI-consumable rather than rebuilt inside every tool.
Data quality, reconciliation & observability
Build and extend source-to-target reconciliation frameworks — record counts, change-timestamp deltas, and critical-column matching — and push beyond count-based recon toward content-level sync validation across replication, packaged-analytics and API-sourced data.
Implement data accuracy, completeness and freshness/recency metrics per data domain and surface them through the platform's observability layer.
Investigate and resolve production data disconnects end to end — isolate root cause across source, pipeline and curation; repair or reprocess; and put a control in place so the same failure doesn't recur.
Reliability, performance & cost
Tune long-running transformations and reduce compute consumption; contribute to platform right-sizing, storage cleanup and cost-optimization work.
Manage schema drift and upstream release changes — programmatically detect deprecated or altered objects, assess downstream impact, and regression-test pipelines across lower environments before production.
Work within CI/CD and Git-based change control, with automated test generation and validation rather than manual regression cycles.
Support production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage and RCA for the pipelines you own, including month-end and quarter-close critical windows.
Automation
Automate what the team does repeatedly — period-close processes, report generation, reconciliation, environment and admin workflows, infrastructure-as-code, and test generation — rather than absorbing the manual effort.
AI Systems Engineering
Context engineering: assemble what enters each model call — facts, history, retrieved knowledge, state — favoring signal over volume.
Harness & scaffolding: build components of the runtime around the model — tool/action interfaces, state handling, retries, error handling, stop conditions.
Evaluations: write automated evals, groundedness checks, and regression tests so quality regressions are caught before users see them.
Guardrails: apply input/output constraints, permission gates, and human-in-the-loop review per platform standards.
Observability: instrument tracing and telemetry; investigate failures instead of retrying blindly.
Work cost-aware — understand token and compute spend and where it goes.

jobs.title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Engineer
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You are an early-career engineer ready to make your mark in semiconductor design. You have spent your academic years drawn to digital design that requires proof, not just simulation. When you see a spec, you think about corner cases and what could break. You have written Verilog or SystemVerilog, debugged logic that did not behave as expected, and you are comfortable in a Unix terminal. Formal verification might be new to you, but the rigor makes sense. You learn by doing, ask questions when stuck, and you do not mind being the person who finds the bug everyone else missed.
What You'll Be Doing
Learn the latest formal verification methodology from experts and apply your learnings to live projects.
Work with a team of seasoned FV engineers and execute validation as per defined plans.
Support quality improvements and contribute insights that help enhance verification tool capabilities.
Write and refine assertions in SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) to capture design intent and uncover edge-case failures.
Script verification flows using Python, Perl, or Tcl to automate repetitive tasks and improve team productivity in Unix/Linux environments.
The Impact You Will Have
Help catch critical design bugs before tapeout that would otherwise cost months and millions to fix in silicon.
Contribute to the quality and reliability of Synopsys IP and EDA tools that power semiconductor development across the industry.
Accelerate verification closure on complex designs by applying formal methods that simulation alone cannot cover.
Strengthen the formal verification methodology at Synopsys by bringing fresh perspectives and identifying gaps in existing flows.
What You'll Need
Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline. (2026 Fresh Masters Grad Expected).
0 to 2 years of experience in digital design, verification, or related semiconductor work (internships, projects, and coursework count).
Strong understanding of computer architecture and digital design fundamentals including state machines, pipelining, and timing.
Hands-on experience with hardware description languages, Verilog or SystemVerilog preferred.
Proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Python, Perl, or Tcl, and comfort working in Unix or Linux environments.
Solid academic performance with relevant coursework or project work in VLSI, digital design, or verification.
Experience with formal verification tools, assertion languages, or model checking is a strong plus.
Who You Are
You can look at a block diagram or RTL code and start asking the right questions about what could go wrong, not just what is supposed to work.
You are comfortable learning new tools and methodologies on the job without needing everything explained upfront, you read documentation, try things, and ask targeted questions when you are stuck.
You communicate clearly when you find something, whether it is a bug, a gap in coverage, or a script that is not working the way it should.

jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. You Are
You have spent the last few years deep in FPGA design and implementation, and you have learned that the real work begins when a customer's design does not compile the way they expected or when partitioning across multiple FPGAs creates timing issues no one saw coming. You are the engineer who stays on the call until the problem is solved, not because you have to, but because leaving something half-fixed bothers you.
You are comfortable reading Verilog or SystemVerilog that someone else wrote, understanding what they were trying to do, and figuring out why the synthesis tool is choking on it. You know your way around FPGA architecture well enough to explain why a design that worked fine in simulation is failing in hardware, and you can do it in a way that does not make the customer feel like they missed something obvious.
Working with customers energizes you. You like the variety of problems, the pressure of real deadlines, and the satisfaction of helping someone get unstuck. You do not need everything documented perfectly to move forward. You ask the right questions, dig into log files, reproduce issues locally, and escalate to R&D when needed with enough context that they can actually help.
At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most complex emulation and prototyping workflows in the industry, supporting global customers who depend on Zebu and Protocompiler to verify chips that power everything from automotive systems to data centers.
What You'll Be Doing
Provide technical support to global customers using Synopsys Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping software, troubleshooting issues across partitioning, synthesis, place and route, and hardware debug
Work directly with customers to migrate their designs to new software releases, ensuring compatibility and resolving any regressions or performance issues that surface
Deploy new software features on live customer designs, helping them adopt capabilities like advanced partitioning algorithms, new debug modes, or updated FPGA target support
Deliver technical training sessions to customers, ranging from basic tool usage to advanced workflows for multi-FPGA partitioning and hardware-software co-verification
Collaborate with Synopsys HAV R&D teams to report customer issues, provide reproducible test cases, and advocate for product improvements based on real-world usage patterns
Support pre-sales evaluations by running customer designs through the Synopsys emulation and prototyping flow, demonstrating performance and identifying potential adoption blockers
Travel occasionally to customer sites for onsite support, training, or critical issue resolution
The Impact You Will Have
Enable customers to bring up complex SoC designs on emulation and prototyping platforms faster, reducing their verification cycle time by weeks or months
Improve product quality by surfacing real customer pain points to R&D with enough technical detail that fixes can be prioritized and implemented effectively
Build customer confidence in Synopsys HAV solutions through responsive, expert-level support that helps them solve problems they could not solve on their own
Expand adoption of new software features by showing customers how to use them on their actual designs, not just in demos
Reduce escalations and support load over time by delivering training that helps customers become more self-sufficient with the toolchain
Strengthen customer relationships by being the engineer they trust to pick up the phone when something is broken and production timelines are at risk
Contribute to the technical knowledge base and internal best practices that make the entire support organization more effective
What You'll Need
Bachelors in Electronics Engineering with 2-3 years of experience, or Master's in Electronics Engineering with 1-2 years, specifically in emulation or prototyping environments
Hands-on experience with logic design and implementation using FPGAs, including synthesis, place and route, and timing closure
Strong working knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL, including the ability to read, debug, and modify RTL written by others
Practical experience with FPGA architecture and back-end implementation flows, including understanding of resource utilization, clock domain crossing, and design partitioning
Exposure to Xilinx or Altera synthesis tools is a plus, as is familiarity with Synopsys Prototyping or Emulation hardware and software
Experience with interface protocols like PCIe, AXI, UART, or I2C is a plus, particularly in the context of hardware-software integration
Scripting experience in Python, Tcl, or shell is desirable for automating workflows and analyzing log files
Who You Are
You can take a vague customer complaint like 'the compile is failing' and turn it into a specific, reproducible issue with enough detail that R&D can act on it
You stay calm when a customer is frustrated or under pressure, and you focus on solving the problem rather than defending the tool
You are comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple customer issues in parallel without losing track of who needs what by when
You do not mind digging through synthesis logs, waveform dumps, or FPGA utilization reports to find the root cause of a problem
You can explain a complex technical tradeoff, like why a design needs to be repartitioned or why certain optimizations are not possible, in a way that makes sense to someone who is not an FPGA expert
You are open to occasional travel for customer support, training, or onsite troubleshooting when remote support is not enough
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join Synopsys Technical Sales Group (TSG) as part of the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) team, working alongside expert-level field engineers who support customers globally on Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping solutions. The team works closely with R&D and directly with customers at all stages of the emulation and prototyping cycle, from pre-sales evaluation through post-deployment support. You will collaborate with engineers across geographies and gain exposure to Synopsys HAV hardware platforms as part of your technical development.

jobs.description:
Job Overview
At Arm, enterprise security risk management requires an understanding of diverse technologies, evolving threats and their potential impact on our business. Our Enterprise Security team works with engineering and technology teams to assess security risks and provide the insights needed to support informed business decisions.
We're looking for a Senior Technical Security Risk Specialist to join our team in Bangalore!
You'll lead security risk activities across Arm's global operations, using your technical knowledge and experience to help teams navigate difficult decisions and find practical solutions.
The work is varied, covering cloud infrastructure, engineering environments, physical security and third-party relationships. You'll collaborate with specialists across Arm, bringing technical expertise and fresh thinking to problems that don't always have straightforward answers.
AI is changing how cyber threats emerge and how we defend against them. At Arm, we're putting AI and automation to work across Enterprise Security, creating exciting opportunities to develop innovative solutions that keep pace with evolving threats and the growing use of AI.
Responsibilities
Lead security risk assessments across technology, infrastructure, physical environments and third-party services, evaluating threats, control weaknesses and potential business impacts.
Take responsibility for assessing security risks, issues and exceptions, recommending appropriate treatment options and working with teams to address identified weaknesses.
Lead third-party security assessments, examining supplier security practices, technical controls and supporting evidence to identify and reduce risks to Arm.
Guide engineering, technology and business teams on security risks, helping resolve difficult questions and evaluate proposed solutions.
Develop and improve risk assessment methods, remediation plans, reporting and workflows, including opportunities to use AI and automation. Maintain risk information in ServiceNow IRM.

You'll have deep expertise in cybersecurity and practical experience leading security risk assessments, handling exceptions and evaluating technical controls.
You'll understand enterprise technologies such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, networks, identity management, endpoint security, applications and on-premises infrastructure. You'll have experience applying recognised security frameworks, such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53 or ISO 27001, and using GRC platforms such as ServiceNow IRM to manage risks, issues and remediation.
You'll be able to work independently, question technical assumptions and explain security risks clearly to people with different levels of technical knowledge.

Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CRISC or CISM.
Experience assessing security risks in data centres, laboratories or other secure facilities.
Experience improving governance, risk and assurance processes through AI, automation or scripting.
