About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
The Experience
We are seeking a lead full stack engineer with enterprise software engineering experience to drive the architecture, technical roadmap, and execution for our next-generation Security Assurance Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform. In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform’s core engines—including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules.
Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. You will also pioneer the team’s operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization.
What You'll Actually Be Doing
End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle.
Architecture & System Design: Architect resilient, cloud-native microservice architectures that process large-scale compliance telemetry, support automated evidence ingestion, and execute low-latency risk evaluation engines.
Roadmap & Project Planning: Partner with Product Management, Security Architects, and GRC leaders to translate broad business and regulatory strategies into detailed technical roadmaps, milestones, and sprint backlogs.
Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org.
Policy & Governance as Code: Design and implement extensible Policy as Code and Compliance as Code engines (e.g., leveraging Open Policy Agent/OPA or custom evaluation frameworks) and runtime platforms (e.g. CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules.
Automated Evidence Collection: Lead the design of automated evidence collection pipelines integrating with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers, enterprise security tools, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and productivity / corporate applications (Workday, Netsuite, etc).
Risk & Regulatory Modeling: Build dynamic risk analysis engines and auditing interfaces capable of mapping continuous technical evidence against major regulatory standards (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption and integration of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI APIs) across the engineering lifecycle to optimize team productivity, automate test generation, and streamline refactoring.
Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
Lead cross-functional alignment and technical discussions across a geographically dispersed team operating in an asynchronous-first culture.
You're Our Person If...

Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove that controls worked months ago. We work to improve the state of controls, drive decisions with risk, govern with code, and make compliance a streamlined business process.
Our strategy:
Risk-informed, control managed. We monitor, validate, and improve the security controls that stand against threats and failures. Visibility and invention. We give Salesforce a clear, current view of its security posture. Automate first. If it's done manually twice, it's a candidate for a build.
Signals, not surprises. Gaps become alerts and workflows, and control failures resolve through defined escalation paths.
Embedded partners. We work alongside T&P teams and solve problems with them, not at them.
Outcomes over activity. We measure risk reduced, effort saved, and audit friction removed.

Come join our growing Hyperforce Enterprise Security organization. We are chartered with architecting, implementing, and operating security solutions that protect Salesforce’s complex, multi-cloud technology landscape at scale.
As a Principal Member of Technical Staff, you will provide technical leadership in building the next generation of infrastructure security and developer security guardrails. You will work across the software development and deployment lifecycle to identify security risks early, build scalable controls, and enable secure-by-default engineering practices without compromising developer velocity.
Our team operates at the intersection of cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and runtime security. We build and operate security guardrails that identify and prevent high-risk security issues from source code and Infrastructure as Code through CI/CD and into runtime environments.
You will be expected to operate at both strategic and hands-on technical levels, defining architecture and technical direction while also diving deeply into complex engineering problems, writing production-quality code, and driving solutions from concept through deployment and operation.
This role is an opportunity to shape security capabilities that operate at significant scale across Salesforce infrastructure and to influence how security is embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle.
Responsibilities
Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert for infrastructure security and security guardrails, providing architectural direction across teams.
Design and build scalable shift-left security capabilities that identify security risks in source code, Infrastructure as Code, containerized workloads, and deployment configurations before they reach production.
Architect and build shift-left security controls that identify security risks early while providing developers with actionable findings and straightforward remediation paths.
Design scalable policy-as-code and security enforcement frameworks for consistent security controls across multiple gates and environments.
Drive risk-based security engineering by identifying exploitable, high-impact, and meaningful security risks rather than treating all scanner findings equally.
Design mechanisms for security finding correlation, prioritization, deduplication, and enforcement when signals originate from multiple security systems.
Lead architecture and implementation of Kubernetes admission control and workload security capabilities.
Define technical strategies for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness of security services.
Establish and evolve SLIs, SLOs, telemetry, rollout strategies, and operational practices for critical security services.
Own technical outcomes across the complete lifecycle — requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production readiness, rollout, and ongoing operations.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve security coverage, automation, detection quality, enforcement, and developer experience.
Establish engineering standards and best practices for reliability, scalability, observability, testing, and operational readiness of security services.
Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization.
Influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions across teams and drive initiatives from concept through production.
Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code.
Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.
Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably.
Critically evaluate code (human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
15+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, security engineering with significant experience designing and delivering large-scale production systems.
Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, or Python, with the ability to design, implement, debug, and review production-quality systems.
Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security, including experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure.
Strong understanding of CI/CD architecture and DevSecOps, including deployment pipelines, security gates, policy enforcement, and automation.
Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing distributed, highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems.
Strong understanding of security engineering concepts including vulnerability management, configuration security, policy enforcement, workload security, identity/access controls, and risk assessment.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous security problems, identify the core technical challenge, and drive an architecture and implementation to completion.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architectures and trade-offs to senior technical and business audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
Deep experience in cloud-native security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, or application security.
Experience building security platforms/services or guardrails that operate at large enterprise scale.
Experience with Kubernetes Admission Controllers, admission policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or similar policy enforcement technologies.
Experience with policy-as-code and security-as-code frameworks.
Experience with IaC security and tools such as Checkov, OPA, Terraform security scanning, or equivalent technologies.
Strong understanding of container and workload security, including Seccomp, Linux security mechanisms, container isolation, and runtime security.
Experience building systems that correlate security signals from multiple sources and prioritize findings based on risk, exploitability, exposure, and business impact.
Experience with vulnerability management, cloud security posture management, container security, or automated security remediation.
Experience designing developer-facing security products with a strong focus on actionable findings, low friction remediation, and developer experience.
Experience designing security controls across the complete lifecycle: source → IaC → CI/CD → deployment → admission → runtime.
Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, workload architecture, and distributed systems.
Experience driving technical strategy across multiple engineering organizations.
Demonstrated ability to identify new security opportunities and turn them into scalable engineering solutions.
Experience mentoring senior engineers and serving as a technical leader for complex, multi-team initiatives.
A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready
What Success Looks Like
In this role, you will be expected to:
Raise the technical bar for infrastructure and developer security engineering.
Build security controls that are effective, scalable, reliable, and developer-friendly.
Move security closer to the point where risks are introduced through strong shift-left and automated enforcement.
Improve the ability to distinguish noise from meaningful and exploitable risk.
Establish consistent security coverage and enforcement across the software delivery lifecycle.
Drive complex initiatives from architecture and design through implementation, production deployment, and operational maturity.
Identify gaps in the current security landscape and proactively develop innovative solutions to address them.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Consultant
jobs.description:
Job Summary
We are recharging how HR delivers impact at NetApp.
As the Senior Manager, People Consultant, you will lead the People Consultant team in APAC and directly manage complex employee relations, performance management, and workplace matters. You will be accountable for regional service delivery, team capability, workload management, and case quality while contributing to the continued development of the global People Consultant operating model.
You will strengthen manager capability and ensure employee matters are addressed with sound judgment, appropriate speed, and clear accountability. You will use case trends, workload data, and local insights to improve team effectiveness, identify emerging risks, and inform scalable improvements to the global People Consultant model.
About the People Consultant Team
The People Consultant team is chartered to empower and enable people managers through targeted coaching, proactively resolve employee relations risks, and seamlessly execute critical HR programs to foster a high-performing, compliant, and supportive workplace. Responsibilities include:
Elevate manager decision quality through expert coaching, performance management guidance, and real-time advisory on complex employee situations
Translate case insights into scalable solutions, working with the HR Leadership team to identify systemic gaps and drive improvements in policies, tools, training, and HR programs
Act as a critical feedback loop for the business, surfacing trends and insights that inform Talent, HR, and business strategy
Job Responsibilities
Lead the APAC People Consultant team and establish clear priorities, operating rhythms, workload allocation, quality standards, and development plans.
Lead and develop People Consultants through regular case reviews, feedback, and development planning, strengthening judgment, documentation quality, manager guidance, escalation decisions, and effective resolution.
Directly manage the most complex or sensitive employee relations, performance management, workplace conflict, and investigation follow-up matters.
Provide expert consultation to managers on performance concerns, documented coaching, performance improvement plans, workplace expectations, conflict resolution, and difficult employee conversations.
Support early resolution of employee and workplace concerns that do not require a formal investigation, including mediation, relationship issues, communication concerns, and recurring manager or team friction.
Partner with Employment Legal and Investigations on appropriate triage, investigation close-out, corrective action, and manager follow-through, while limiting escalations to matters that require their authority or expertise.
Maintain clear operating boundaries and handoffs across People Consultants, HR Operations, HR Business Partners, Legal, Investigations, and specialist teams.
Monitor case demand, complexity, capacity, cycle time, escalation patterns, and recurring themes to balance workload across the team, adjust assignments and priorities, identify performance or capability gaps, and ensure timely, consistent delivery.
Use case insights to identify emerging risks, capability gaps, and opportunities for manager enablement, policy or process improvements, tools, training, and broader HR solutions.
Build strong relationships with business leaders and HR partners while contributing to a consistent global People Consultant operating model.
Support the continued development of the People Consultant function, including designing workflows, service standards, measures of success, and scalable ways of working.
Job Requirement
8 or more years of relevant HR experience, including significant experience in employee relations, performance management, HR business partnership, or a comparable people advisory role.
People Leadership: 4 or more years of people management responsibility, with demonstrated experience developing professionals, managing performance, allocating work, and leading teams responsible for moderately complex, sensitive, and judgment-based matters.
India Expertise: Experience supporting a complex organization in India, with strong knowledge of local employment practices, cultural considerations, and manager needs.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Experience partnering effectively with Employment Legal, Investigations, HR Operations, HR Business Partners, and business leaders.
Other Qualifications
Leadership and Team Development: Ability to establish priorities, operating objectives, work plans, and quality standards while developing talent and creating accountability for results.
Judgment and Decision Making: Sound judgment in situations where facts may be incomplete, problems are not clearly defined, or multiple risks and stakeholder interests must be balanced.
Employee Relations Expertise: Deep understanding of employee relations, corrective performance management, workplace conflict, manager coaching, and investigation follow-up.
Legal and Compliance Knowledge: Ability to interpret policies and practices consistently while accounting for local legal, regulatory, and cultural requirements.
Business Acumen: Ability to connect people decisions to team effectiveness, employee experience, risk, and business outcomes.
Stakeholder Management: Ability to influence stakeholders in sensitive and complex situations, build trusted relationships, and communicate clear recommendations, risks, and trade-offs.
Operating Model Clarity: Ability to distinguish among manager-owned decisions, People Consultant advisory work, HRBP strategic partnership, HR Operations execution, and matters requiring Legal or Investigations involvement.
Analytical and Operational Discipline: Ability to use case data, workload patterns, and recurring themes to improve service delivery, identify root causes, and inform scalable solutions.

Your Opportunity
As a Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist within PD Regulatory Innovation and Sustainment Chapter at RSS Hyderabad, you will drive the hands-on digital execution of regulatory operations. Collaborate with regulatory stakeholders to evaluate incoming AI/automation requests, assess technical feasibility, and help prioritize high-value use cases for regulatory document workflows.

Perform operational process mining and opportunity mapping by partnering directly with SMEs from PDR Innovation & Sustainment chapter and global regulatory SMEs to identify high-impact AI and automation opportunities.

Drive cross-functional Agile and DevOps execution in a matrixed environment, collaborating with PDR Innovation & Sustainment chapter leads, regulatory teams, IT, and RSS peers through sprint planning, rapid PoC prototyping, iterative testing, and continuous feedback loops.
Monitor operational performance metrics and deliver clear project updates, technical insights, and continuous improvement recommendations to functional leadership and regulatory stakeholders.
Partner with global regulatory teams to showcase the practical applications of AI, NLP, and automation, translating technical features into clear business benefits like compliance risk reduction, improved document processing throughput, and operational efficiency.
Who You Are
You are a hands-on technical builder with 4–6 years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or AI/automation development and exposure of working in pharmaceutical R&D regulatory affairs or clinical development departments. You possess strong analytical problem-solving skills and thrive in an agile setting where you take ownership of technical execution, turning complex operational processes into automated, production-ready AI tools.
Qualifications & Technical Skillset:
Education & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, with 4–6 years of hands-on experience building and deploying software, automation, or AI/ML solutions
Education & Experience: Direct experience in pharmaceutical R&D regulatory affairs or clinical development.
Advanced GenAI: Experience exposure to prompt evaluation frameworks, or multi-agent orchestration.
Core Programming & Data Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for data extraction, manipulation, pipeline creation, and writing modular, production-ready code.
Document AI & Text Processing: Practical experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), Optical Character Recognition (OCR like Tesseract, AWS Textract, or Azure AI Document Intelligence), and unstructured document parsing (PDFs, XML, JSON, Word).
AI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience developing application logic around modern LLM frameworks (e.g., Lang Chain, Llama Index, OpenAI/AWS Bedrock APIs) and building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for document querying.
Software Engineering & APIs: Solid experience with REST APIs, Git version control, unit testing, and basic CI/CD practices.
Workflow & Process Automation: Experience automating workflows using Python orchestration, low-code automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath), or enterprise schedulers.
Exposure to Deployment & Cloud: Basic exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerization (Docker) for deploying scripts and API services.
Strong to have:
Prompt Architecture & Validation: Ability to design complex, multi-step prompts; validate outputs against business logic; and refine solutions iteratively.
Regulatory Domain Knowledge: Foundational knowledge of ICH guidelines FDA/EMA submission processes, regulatory document formats (eCTD, GxP guidelines, CT documentation), emerging AI/ML regulatory guidance.

jobs.title: Layout Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Summary
Our Solutions Engineering Physical IP team comprises some of the industry’s leading experts in deep submicron circuit design. This position is a wonderful opportunity for you to work with our custom standard cell design engineering team on innovative technologies. Your work will have a significant lasting impact as the designs will be used in Solutions Engineering products servicing the infrastructure, client, automotive, and IoT market segments.
In this role, you will be responsible for the layout development of Arm custom standard cells in the latest, sub-3nm process technology nodes. The ideal candidate will be an expert in standard cell layout, physical verification, and automation techniques. You will work in close collaboration with the circuit design team to provide optimally tuned layout, and validate them through QA flows that use a variety of tools. This role is crucial in delivering high-performance, area-optimized, and DRC-clean logic libraries for next-generation SoCs and custom digital IPs.
Key Responsibilities
Layout design of logic standard cells (inverters, muxes, flops cells, complex logic gates) optimized for performance, area, and power.
Work with automation and QA teams to support library validation flows.
Collaborate with circuit designers to understand schematics and translate them into clean, compact layouts.
Drive design rule clean (DRC) and layout vs. schematic (LVS) closure using industry-standard verification tools (e.g., Calibre ).
Perform layout debugging and root-cause analysis for DRC, LVS, and other physical sign-off issues.
Handle cell abutment, cell profiling, and cell integration constraints for logic libraries.
Address layout-dependent effects (LDE) and double patterning/EUV compliance in advanced nodes.
Review and debug standard cell physical views (LEF, GDS, abstract views) for integration into digital flows.
Automate layout QA, regression checks, and PDK-driven layout verifications using scripts (e.g., SKILL, Python).
Participate in library quality audits and delivery cycles including signoff package creation and documentation.
Required Skills and Experience
1 to 3 years of custom layout experience in logic standard cell development.
Proven track record of working at 5nm, 3nm, or 2nm nodes with FinFET/GAA-based technologies.
Proficiency in Cadence Virtuoso.
Deep understanding of advanced DRC rules, LVS methodologies, and multi-patterning constraints.
Solid experience in cell layout optimization for PPA (Power, Performance, Area).
Strong grip on pin accessibility, cell architecture trade-offs, and physical synthesis-aware design.
Automate layout-related tasks and workflows using scripting languages like Python, PERL, SKILL, and TCL.
Maintain accurate documentation of layout designs, changes, and verification results.
Working knowledge of version control, configuration management, and flow automation
Make effective use of AI tools and automation to improve productivity, accelerate learning, and enhance the quality of technical solutions
Strong documentation and communication skills to interface with cross-functional teams (PDK, design, QA).
Stay updated on best practices for standard cell layout, design rules, and advanced node requirements.
“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :
Exposure to physical design implementation flow

jobs.description:
Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
About The Role
Build AI-powered developer experience that makes engineers enabled.
You’ll join our Developer Experience team, united by the mission of “Engineers can do their work quickly, easily, comfortably, and safely.” You’ll be part of a team spanning the US and India that turns ambiguous goals into shippable projects that meaningfully improve developer throughput and reliability.
Your team owns AI experiences, remote and local dev environments, builds and CI, deploys, testing, and verification. You’ll work on a relatively broad scope within a well-resourced team.
This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.
What You'll Achieve
You build an AI harness to auto-resolve bugs reported for the Notion app. This is high-leverage work for the engineering org and requires solid engineering to improve resolution accuracy.
You improve CI and build reliability so engineers get early feedback when changes break CI. We’re committed to a 5-minute CI time and are already on track.
You improve developer features for our in-house, AI-first remote development environments - helping shape the future of software engineering.
You execute a shared roadmap with our US engineering team to increase developer satisfaction and enablement, informed by our DevEx survey.
You collaborate with engineers across the company to deliver an industry-leading developer experience, working deeply with tools like the TypeScript language server, lint tooling, and the Notion CLI to improve developers’ day-to-day experience.
Skills You'll Need to Bring
Over 10 years of experience with strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of turning ambiguous goals into well-scoped, shippable milestones.
Leadership: Can create technical roadmap and has a strong ability to plan and execute very large projects. Motivate the team for the goal.
Enjoys learning new technologies and has demonstrated innovation through past work.
Thrive in ambiguity and can solve business problems through technology.
Ownership: Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability for the success of the project and the team.
Collaboration: Demonstrates strong communication and collaboration skills. Able to partner with cross-functional teams and engineering teams across time zones.
Experience building or operating developer tooling (CI/CD, infrastructure workflows, internal platforms) with a focus on reliability, observability, and developer trust.
Comfortable with creating with AI agents and hardening them: defining guardrails, adding evaluation/testing, and iterating based on real workflow feedback.
Comfortable with creating with agentic workflows: pros-cons of code based orchestration; cost analysis; scalability issues; very long running workflows; verification/ralph loops.
Systems-level debugging and performance thinking; you can identify bottlenecks, choose pragmatic fixes, and avoid accidental complexity.
Ability to multiply the team: clear written communication, high-quality reviews, and coaching/mentoring that helps others ship faster and better.
Some knowledge about building AI harness would be additive - tool building; context harness.

Fab Facilities & Critical Utilities Operations
Lead operations of bulk & specialty gas systems, chemical distribution systems, UPW, process cooling water, wastewater treatment, Electrical System, Building Infrastructure HVAC, and cleanroom environmental systems.

Drive standardization of operating procedures, maintenance practices, and commissioning processes.
Implement succession planning and skill‑depth development for critical systems ownership.

Establish and govern preventive and corrective maintenance programs for all fab utilities and infrastructure.
Leverage artificial intelligence to track and drive KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, response time, safety metrics, and PM compliance
Lead root‑cause analysis (RCA) for utility‑related excursions impacting production.

Lead commissioning of new fab utilities, equipment, and facility expansions supporting ramp‑up or technology node changes.
Partner with construction, operational, and equipment groups to integrate facilities systems with minimal disruption.

Own facilities operations budget, forecasting, and cost‑optimization initiatives.
Handle strategic vendors providing gas, chemical, UPW, waste, and maintenance services.
Ensure contract compliance and SLA alignment for critically important services.

Proven understanding of gases, chemicals, UPW, wastewater systems, Electrical System, HVAC, and cleanroom facilities.
Preferred
Exposure to BMS / FMS / CMMS / SCADA systems.
Knowledge of local and international EHSS standards applicable to semiconductor fabs.

Mission‑critical operations leadership
Safety‑first perspective
Incident & emergency management

Fab utility uptime

PM compliance rate

Overview
The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally.
The Advisors Creative Desk sits within Services as a full-service creative and advertising capability, helping Services clients build and grow their brands through end-to-end solutions, from brand positioning and strategy to creative development, campaigns, and content.

• 8+ years of experience in data strategy, consumer insights, or marketing analytics roles within advertising agencies, preferably full-service network agencies.

• Experience working closely with strategy, creative, and client teams to develop insight-led campaigns, experiences, and engagement programs.

Job Summary
The Finance Project Management Office provides project leadership, consulting, change management, and process improvements across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and cross-functional initiatives. We curate the master portfolio of work, develop the plan, and execute high-priority projects while cultivating a high-performing team.
If you run toward problem-solving, you’re our kind of person. As a NetApp project manager within the Finance organization, you will lead enterprise-wide initiatives. The primary assignment for each initiative will be either project management or change management, based on portfolio priorities, project needs, and the pipeline of work; some initiatives may require contributions across both disciplines. Across assignments, you will use strong project, program, and change management experience to understand business requirements, shape and guide the plan, align stakeholders, assess impacts and readiness, and drive successful delivery and adoption. Strong communication skills and command over business processes are key to success in this role.
A proven track record on AI initiatives is strongly preferred.
This is a hybrid role requiring in office expectations. Hiring in San Jose, CA or Raleigh, NC only.
Job Requirements
Flex between project management and change management assignments based on portfolio priorities and the pipeline of work, taking end-to-end ownership of the discipline assigned for each initiative.
Organize, lead, and facilitate cross-functional project teams related to finance and operations business systems and initiatives.
Determine project cost, resource requirements, and project timing based on the scope and complexity of the project.
Manage stakeholder alignment, communication, governance updates, decisions, risks, dependencies, and accountability.
Partner with leaders, project teams, and subject-matter experts to assess stakeholder readiness and resistance using surveys, interviews, focus groups, or other methods; summarize findings for operating and steering committees.
Map the current and future state; develop and prioritize change impact assessments; and deliver impact readouts to stakeholder and governance groups.
Identify and communicate change-specific risks and develop practical mitigation strategies.

Craft communications that connect corporate and departmental messaging, business context, and values for affected audiences.
Develop and implement training strategies and supporting materials in partnership with subject-matter experts.
Identify, motivate, and coordinate change champions who can share information, surface feedback, and reinforce adoption within their teams.
In collaboration with key subject-matter experts, develop and monitor metrics for process improvement, business readiness, technology readiness, adoption, and utilization.
Identify root causes of project or adoption issues and develop “get well” plans.
Develop and deliver clear, concise executive presentations that include analysis, metrics, recommendations, project improvements, and controls.
Research and apply project and change management best practices; document and share lessons learned to accelerate continuous improvement.
Perform cost-benefit analyses to help prioritize projects and change investments.

Formal change management training or certification, such as Prosci, is preferred.
PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI)™ certification is preferred.
Group facilitation experience.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business or a related field.
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

The target salary range for this position is 129,200 - 152,000 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off, various Leave options, Performance-Based Incentives, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s), with all offerings subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer(Growth & ML), Hyderabad
jobs.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.
If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!
ㅤ
Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth & ML), Hyderabad
Meet our Team
Our Data & Audience Platform organization builds advanced AI/ML solutions that power identity, audience intelligence, advertising, and personalization at scale. Our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad develops foundational AI/ML capabilities that transform first-party data signals into production-ready machine learning systems. These solutions help expand addressable audiences, improve targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, user engagement, and retention.
Our Machine Learning Engineers combine strong data science expertise with hands-on engineering capabilities to take models from development to production. This includes building production-grade ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and scalable ML infrastructure such as feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps frameworks.
We primarily leverage Databricks, along with Snowflake and AWS, and actively embrace emerging technologies, including agentic AI development workflows, to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent machine learning solutions.
About the Role
As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across our global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring.
Roles & Responsibilities:
ML System Design & Ownership
Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models.
Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs.
Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM).
Modeling & Experimentation
Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching.
Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case.
Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs.
Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR).
MLOps & Infrastructure
Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks.
Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency.
Contribute to the team’s feature-store strategy — feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs — and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds.
Embed FinOps cost discipline (compute caps, auto-termination, job tagging) into pipeline design.
Mentorship & Cross-functional Collaboration
Mentor MLE 2s through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing; contribute to team technical standards.
Partner with Product, Marketing, and Ad Sales to translate business requirements into ML problem formulations, and with Data Engineering on data contracts and pipeline SLAs.
Communicate model performance, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Flagship Projects You’ll Work On
Identity Intelligence — foundational, privacy-safe identity across all brands: probabilistic ID resolution that resolves unauthenticated signals to households/persons with calibrated confidence (entity resolution with gradient boosting and embeddings, representation learning, isotonic calibration, candidate blocking, champion/challenger pipelines), expanding addressable audiences beyond deterministic matching.
Audience Intelligence — advertising and marketing use cases: lookalike and predictive audiences (LAL across 1,000+ features), ML-driven smart audiences, layered retrieval + propensity, and incrementality/closed-loop optimization, with privacy-safe activation including data clean rooms.
ML-based Forecasting — audience growth, demand, and advertising yield/pricing forecasting that powers ad sales and marketing decisions.
Content Preferences & Affinity — genre-preference, content-preference, and single-title affinity modeling (two-tower retrieval with semantic content embeddings) that ranks audiences for upcoming titles and powers cross-channel promotion.
What You’ll Bring
Required
5–8 years of industry experience in ML engineering or applied data science (3+ years with a Ph.D.).
Deep Python expertise and production-quality software engineering practices; production experience building and deploying ML at scale (millions+ of users/records).
Strong proficiency in Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/DLT, MLflow, Unity Catalog) and solid SQL/Snowflake experience for feature sourcing and model-output delivery.
Experience with AWS ML services (SageMaker, S3, Lambda).
Strong understanding of ML model evaluation, A/B testing, and statistical inference; knowledge in one or more of recommendations & ranking, identity resolution, embeddings/retrieval, causal/interpretable ML, forecasting, bandits, or optimization.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions and mentor engineers.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to advocate technical solutions to engineers, scientists, and product stakeholders.
Preferred:
Recommendation systems, personalization, identity resolution, or audience modeling in a media / streaming / ad-tech context.
Familiarity with Data Clean Room environments (Snowflake DCR, AWS Clean Rooms) and consent-aware activation.
Experience with two-tower / retrieval architectures, probabilistic identity resolution (graph-based matching, entity resolution), and probability calibration.
Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP), Databricks Genie Space configuration, and Snowflake Cortex.
Experience with feature stores (Databricks Feature Store, Tecton, Feast) and contributions to open source or ML publications.
What We Offer:
A Great Place to work
Equal opportunity employer
Fast track growth opportunities

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

jobs.description:
Voyager (94001), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka
Distinguished AI Engineer
At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.
Team Description:
The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our Generative AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products by composing powerful, safe and explainable AI capabilities such as agentic workflows, and shared services such as guardrails, observability and evals coupled with foundational model power of open-weight and proprietary frontier models. The team is also delivering capabilities on top of the platform to optimize the software development life-cycle to dramatically enhance developer productivity and model-development life cycle to improve time-to-market of machine learning models.
In this role, you will:
Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, evals engine, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, Nemo Guardrails, PyTorch, and more.
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art LLM optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
Devise novel context generation techniques that optimize cost / quality trade-offs.
Design and implement capabilities for automated monitoring, anomaly detection and RCA for multi-turn and headless agentic applications.
You will collaborate with lines of businesses to design and implement high value agentic applications
Finally you will coach and evangelize, mentoring Staff, Principal and Senior engineers, authoring technical design documents and blogs and representing Capital One at Tier1 AI conferences.
The Ideal Candidate:
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production.
You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven.
You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss.
You are a resilient trail blazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown.
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
At least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 8 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java
Preferred Qualifications:
10+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
4+ years of experience architecting, designing, developing, integrating, delivering, and supporting complex AI systems
6+ years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, or Golang
2+ years of experience with Agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen etc.)
2+ years of experience leading GenAI or LLM-Powered application architectures in production
2+ years of experience developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing training and inference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost
2+ years of experience with Observability and Evals for agentic applications
Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor multiple engineering teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders up to the VP level
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers
Master’s or Ph.D in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, especially in AI/ML areas.

jobs.title: Technical Instructional Designer
jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
The Opportunity
We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Content & Training Designer to join our Service Strategy & Enablement team. This role is responsible for creating high‑quality training materials, scalable digital learning experiences, and technical documentation that educate and enable our global support teams, partners, and customers.
This position plays a critical role in developing content designed for both human and machine consumption—ensuring our knowledge assets are structured, discoverable, and optimized for efficient delivery across platforms.
As a key contributor within our Global Support Organization, you will execute against an established content and enablement strategy, translating priorities into clear, effective technical and training assets. The primary focus of this role is designing, developing, and delivering high‑quality video‑based learning and enablement content that improves support agent readiness, accelerates issue resolution, and enhances the overall customer experience.
This role blends hands‑on content creation with close cross‑functional collaboration, working alongside support teams, product experts, and customer experience partners to ensure content is accurate, relevant, and aligned with customer and business needs.
About the Team
The Service Strategy & Enablement Technical Training team at Nutanix is a globally distributed team dedicated to ensuring the Support organization is effectively onboarded and continuously enabled on Nutanix products and features. The team is instrumental in empowering support engineers to confidently support customers by delivering high‑quality, timely training and enablement content,
This role reports to the Senior Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement – Technical Training. Collaboration is strongly encouraged, and while the team works closely together, individuals are trusted with a high degree of autonomy. The team is a highly productive, cohesive group where contributions are valued, ideas are shared openly, and every member is motivated to deliver their best work.
If you are looking for a team‑oriented environment that values collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement, the Service Strategy & Enablement team at Nutanix may be an excellent fit.
Your Role
Key Responsibilities
Content Development & Technical Writing
Create clear, accurate, and user‑friendly technical documentation, videos, guides, and troubleshooting content.
Develop digital training assets, including eLearning modules, instructional videos, job aids, quick reference guides, and knowledge base articles.
Translate complex technical concepts into accessible, consumable learning materials for diverse audiences.
Instructional Design
Design and maintain scalable training curricula for support teams, partners, and internal stakeholders.
Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to create scenario‑based learning and real‑world practice activities.
Measure training effectiveness and continuously iterate content based on data, feedback, and performance insights.
AI-Ready Knowledge Engineering
Structure content to support ingestion into AI‑driven and self‑service platforms.
Partner with AI and Knowledge Management teams to standardize content formats, metadata, and tagging.
Ensure documentation aligns with evolving automation, self‑service, and intelligent support strategies.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment
Work closely with Support, Product, Engineering, and Partner Enablement teams to ensure training materials are accurate, current, and aligned with product changes.
Gather requirements, align on learning objectives, and manage the full content lifecycle from creation through maintenance.
Participate in project planning and contribute to broader enablement initiatives.
The role involves performing duties requiring the application of
professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion,
creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out
responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of
the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements.
Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for
additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities.
Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in technical writing, instructional design, technical training, or content development within the technology or Support domain (8+ years preferred).
Experience with AI tools for helping to create content.
Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable, and engaging content for technical audiences.
Strong experience designing and delivering digital learning assets, including eLearning modules, instructional videos, job aids, and knowledge base content.
Hands-on experience with eLearning and video creation tools (e.g., Synthesia, Articulate Rise and Storyline 360), including video editing platforms with Generative AI capabilities.
Expertise in documentation and collaboration tools such as Confluence, SharePoint, markdown editors, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS), learning content management systems (LCMS), and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong storytelling, scriptwriting, and instructional design skills, with an emphasis on simplifying technical material.
Demonstrated ability to create accessible, globally scalable content (e.g., captions, subtitles, localization readiness).
Strong organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and meet deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a track record of effectively collaborating across cross‑functional teams.
Attention to detail and a consistent focus on delivering high‑quality, well‑governed content.
Ability to influence outcomes through collaboration and demonstrated results.
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Certifications in instructional design, video production, or related disciplines are a plus.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience designing content for support organizations or technical audiences.
Working knowledge of customer support tools and analytics platforms (e.g., Salesforce Service Cloud, Confluence).
Ability to structure content for AI ingestion, search optimization, and self‑service flows.
Understanding of customer support workflows, troubleshooting processes, or SaaS environments.
Experience with metadata, tagging standards, and content governance models.
UX writing,graphic design, and animation experience is a plus.
Work Arrangement
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. For most roles, that will mean coming into an office a minimum of 3 days per week. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be
provided by your manager.

An overview of this role
This role is not a typical infrastructure operations role. As Manager, Engineering, Git & Gitaly Operations, you'll lead the team responsible for the infrastructure layer underneath Git at GitLab: the open source Git project itself, Gitaly, GitLab's Git storage and remote procedure call layer, and the services that make Git perform at enterprise scale.
Git and Gitaly are core to GitLab. If they go sideways in production, they affect everything downstream, including continuous integration, code review, and deployments. This role starts with genuine subject matter expertise in Git technologies and extends to reliable operation across GitLab's deployment models: Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.
You'll build and develop a team with deep platform expertise and strong operational judgment. You'll partner across engineering groups to shape how Git and Gitaly operations evolve as the platform grows.
What you’ll do
Build and lead a team with deep platform expertise in Git and Gitaly, hiring and developing engineers who can operate this infrastructure layer with strong operational judgment.
Own production reliability for Git and Gitaly across GitLab's full deployment footprint.
Drive incident management, root cause investigation, and postmortems with the technical depth to distinguish a Git internals problem from a generic infrastructure problem.
Design and operate Git and Gitaly service models that work across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS, with a clear view of which elements are common and which must differ between them.
Maintain cloud-agnostic architecture and tooling decisions, avoiding designs that assume a single hyperscaler's primitives.
Partner with the teams that own each deployment model so operational practices stay coherent rather than fragmenting into separate playbooks.
Apply distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, and failure domains, to Gitaly's storage and replication model.
Own elastic storage and compute strategy for Git repository data, including capacity planning, autoscaling, and consumption-based provisioning for GitLab's largest self-managed and SaaS customers.
What you’ll bring
Familiarity with GitLab's product and deployment models, and how Git and Gitaly support repository operations across self-managed, dedicated, and SaaS environments.
Hands-on subject matter expertise in Git internals, including how the protocol, object model, and storage layer behave under load and at scale, not only familiarity with Git usage.
Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, failure handling, and horizontal scalability.
Experience running production infrastructure across multiple deployment models, such as self-managed, dedicated or single-tenant, and multi-tenant SaaS, or a credible path from adjacent experience to it.
Experience with elastic storage and compute, and consumption-based system design for variable, unpredictable load.
People management experience, ideally leading site reliability engineering-style or platform operations teams.
Direct experience with Gitaly, libgit2, JGit, or another Git implementation's internals is advantageous.
Experience operating cloud-agnostic infrastructure across multiple hyperscalers or on-premises environments is advantageous.
About the team
The Git & Gitaly Operations team owns the Git infrastructure layer that powers GitLab and works at the intersection of Git internals, distributed systems, storage, and production operations.
We expect the Git & Gitaly Operations team to go deep on one of GitLab's most critical platforms. The work requires technical depth, strong operational discipline, and the ability to solve complex reliability and scaling challenges in Git and Gitaly.

jobs.title: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
Job Summary:
What you need to know about the role:
We're looking for a Finance Manager to be the analytical engine behind our payments economics. You'll own the data, reporting and dashboards that explain how our Total Processing Volume (TPV), revenue and transaction expenses (interchange, scheme fees and processing fees) turn into transaction margin. Most of our pricing is Interchange++ (IC+), so cost changes flow through to revenue.
Meet our team:
You'll join the Payments Finance team, reporting to the Senior Finance Manager. The team owns revenue and transaction expense performance for the business. We work closely with Accounting on month-end close and reconciliation, with Corporate Finance on forecasting and planning, and with Product on pricing and margin initiatives. We're a small, hands-on team that values curiosity, ownership and clear answers to messy questions.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Facilitate collaborative engagement with business to cultivate strong partnership and unlock incremental value for the enterprise
Ensure in-depth understanding of the business to proactively identify key business drivers
Effectively communicate financial results & key drivers through concise & effective storytelling
Streamline, improve, & automate designated workstreams and processes to drive efficiency
Manage business case modeling, run deep dive analysis, and other ad-hoc financial analysis
Monitor expense and headcount plan vs actual and provide analysis/recommendation for business partners and Finance team
Work autonomously but in collaboration with teammates and business partners supporting a global business
Guide the business through various finance-related tasks
Own budgeting, forecasting, month-end close, variance analysis, and reporting
Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Controllership, Corporate FP&A, Legal, and a broad group of business stakeholders
Minimum Qualifications:
5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:
Your way to impact:
Turn transaction-level data into clear insight on what is driving take rate, TE rate and margin: mix, card type, region, merchant segment, scheme fee changes and more.
Build the dashboards leadership uses to monitor payments performance, replacing manual spreadsheets with scalable, automated reporting.
Find margin opportunities, such as interchange optimization, scheme fee leakage, IC+ pass-through gaps and pricing outliers, and size them for Product and leadership.
Improve the accuracy of forecasts by giving Corporate Finance reliable volume and rate drivers.
Strengthen the link between operational data and the general ledger so our numbers tie out.
In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for:
Writing and maintaining SQL queries to pull and transform transaction, revenue and cost data.
Building and maintaining dashboards in [Tableau / Looker / Power BI] tracking TPV, revenue, transaction expenses, take rate, TE rate and margin.
Running monthly and quarterly variance analysis (actual vs. forecast vs. prior period) and explaining the drivers in plain language.
Supporting month-end close by reconciling revenue and transaction expenses with Accounting.
Monitoring scheme fee and interchange changes and quantifying their impact on cost and pass-through.
Doing ad hoc deep dives for leadership and Product, for example merchant profitability or pricing scenarios.
Documenting data definitions and metric logic so everyone uses one version of the truth.
What do you need to bring:

You will perform reliability testing and data analysis on material associated with sustaining qualifications through change requests, product proliferations, special work requests and conversions. Identify and manage material for sampling

Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Identify deviated material within Material Review Board (MRB)
Take part in containment activities
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Determine disposition of materials
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Manage and coordinate various inputs from various stakeholders in Quality Reliability
Collaborate with discrete component product quality and reliability team for product reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Collaborate with package quality and reliability team for package-related reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Manage Product Outgoing Quality and Reliability Monitoring
Provide the plan for operations to execute for SSD product OQRM data collection
Analyze the data from Micron Manufacturing Execution System (MES) such as MAM
Use statistical analysis tools to provide conclusions and verify results
Summarize the reult of analyzed data through a regular OQRM metrics report
Digital & AI Tool Usage
