jobs.title: Sr Manager, Procurement Platform Excellence
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
The Global Procurement team is an integral engine to Micron’s growth, delivering best-in-class total cost and supply chain resiliency through innovative predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members, our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to ignite your talent.
As Senior Manager, Platform Excellence within Global Procurement’s Center of Excellence Digital Transformation & AI organization, you drive the Source-to-Pay (S2P) platform strategy and roadmap and lead end-to-end management of the S2P platform landscape. This is a collaborative role: you shape one coherent S2P platform direction together with your peer Senior Managers for S/4HANA Transformation, AI Transformation, Data & Process Automation, and Data Excellence & Governance. Your portfolio spans sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team, and you lead a team based in Hyderabad, India.
This is not a SAP or ERP configuration role. The SAP S/4HANA and Ariba transformation is driven by a separate team; you partner closely with them so the S2P platform landscape integrates cleanly with the ERP core and enterprise systems, and every platform decision reinforces one coherent, standardized S2P experience. Similarly, new AI transformation products that are still at an early, incubation stage sit with the AI Transformation team — your accountability is the established S2P platform portfolio and how it is run, integrated, and adopted.
You set direction and priorities and own value realization measured in real business terms — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality. You bring strong product and user-centered discipline to how the portfolio is run: grounding decisions in user personas, journeys, and end-to-end processes, and owning supplier-supported and third-party products end-to-end, including escalation, supplier performance (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
This is a people-leadership role. A core part of your mandate is to move platform operations from reactive, ticket-driven support to a proactive, agent-embedded model, and to embed product and user-centered discipline across the portfolio. You develop a team of platform and product professionals and partner closely with AI Transformation, Data & Process Automation, Data Excellence & Governance, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Compliance. GP-centric platform products are owned here end-to-end; enterprise-wide systems and IT infrastructure remain with IT — the role does not perform software development or manage infrastructure.
▍ Key Responsibilities
A core expectation is to run Global Procurement’s Source-to-Pay platforms as products — end-to-end, value-driven, well-integrated, and adopted — while moving platform operations toward a proactive, agent-embedded model.
Platform Strategy & Value Optimization
Own the end-to-end S2P platform portfolio strategy and roadmap — including the analytics and reporting platforms — framing business problems into clear product strategies that maximize outcomes over outputs.
Prioritize opportunities and make build-versus-buy-versus-partner trade-offs, sequencing platform investment against S2P Reimagined and ERP transformation milestones.
Track value through real business indicators — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality — and engage stakeholders on investment decisions and supplier and technology trends.
End-to-End Platform Leadership & Lifecycle
Lead and be accountable for the S2P platform portfolio across its full lifecycle — sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and analytics platforms — setting clear direction and adapting priorities as needs evolve.
Own supplier-supported and third-party products for GP-centric solutions, including escalation, supplier performance management (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
Apply product-management fundamentals — budgeting, cost-versus-value trade-offs, and lifecycle planning — to keep platforms fit-for-purpose as scale and complexity grow, while keeping GP-centric solutions PM-owned and enterprise-wide systems with IT.
Platform Operations, Integration & Health
Own platform stability, configuration, release, environment and test, and incident and problem management across the S2P landscape.
Ensure the S2P platforms integrate cleanly with the SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core and enterprise systems, so data, controls, and processes flow reliably end-to-end.
Establish platform health KPIs, service levels, and monitoring, and shift from reactive support to proactive, increasingly self-healing platforms — with agents handling detection, triage, routing, and routine configuration and testing.
Analytics Platforms, Adoption & Product Performance
Product-manage the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team — ensuring the tooling is reliable, well-integrated, and fit-for-purpose, while analytics outputs and insights remain owned by the data analytics team.
Instrument platforms to measure usage, adoption, and value, and use those signals to refine roadmaps and features.
Define what “good adoption” means beyond usage — decision confidence, reduced rework, and behavior change.
User-Centered Solution Design
Ground solutions in user personas, journeys, and end-to-end process understanding, balancing usability, feasibility, business value, and enterprise constraints.
Challenge low-value features and over-customization; advocate scalable, standard-driven design and consistent interaction patterns across S2P tools and AI-enabled capabilities.
Anticipate adoption risks and continuously improve solutions based on user behavior and usage signals.
Stakeholder Engagement, Enablement & Change
Engage stakeholders, build trust, and bring people along through change; translate needs into clear action plans and resolve issues through influence and partnership.
Own the platform enablement and support model — training, documentation, self-service, and a responsive support experience across regions.
Embed change management into the product journey and drive adoption through clear, simple, actionable communication.
Innovation & Agent-Embedded Ways of Working
Reimagine platform operations and enablement with agents embedded — platform support copilot, configuration and testing agents, integration-monitoring agents, and enablement copilot.
Sponsor rapid experiments, validate impact, and turn the best into reusable building blocks for broader adoption across Source-to-Pay.
Team Leadership & Enterprise Partnership
Lead, coach, and develop a Hyderabad-based team; build depth, ownership, and succession, and coach the team for a product-led, agent-embedded operating model.
Partner across DTAI pillars, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Compliance, and functional Global Procurement teams, and represent the platform agenda in program reviews and executive readouts.
Serve as the primary escalation point for platform stability, integration, and adoption risks, translating complex dynamics into clear decisions and tradeoffs for senior stakeholders.
▍ Leadership Expectations
This leader is expected to embody Micron’s core values and set the tone for the team:
People
Care for each other — build an inclusive, high-trust team; develop talent, grow capability, and plan succession within the team.
Innovation
Shape the future — run platforms as products and champion agent-embedded ways of working; experiment, learn fast, and scale what works.
Tenacity
Nothing shakes our resolve — own platform stability, integration, and adoption outcomes end-to-end through complex, cross-system challenges.
Collaboration
Aligned to win — break silos across DTAI, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and the business; win as one team across time zones.
Customer Focus
Partner and win together — treat procurement stakeholders and end-users as customers; design for their journeys and deliver adopted, high-value platforms.
Speed
Act with purpose and set the pace — make timely, well-reasoned decisions and move prioritized platform work from pilot to scale without losing rigor.
▍ Leadership Competencies
Product & value judgment: Frame problems into value-driven strategy, prioritize outcomes over outputs, and make build-versus-buy-versus-partner calls with clarity.
User-centered & adoption mindset: Design for real user journeys and adoption, not just delivery, and define value beyond usage.
Talent & coaching: Develop, coach, and grow a multi-region team; build bench strength and succession within the function.
Cross-cultural leadership: Work effectively across U.S. and Asia cultures and time zones, partnering with globally distributed stakeholders and peers.
Influence & partnership: Lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
Executive communication: Translate complex platform, integration, and product topics into crisp, decision-ready narratives for senior leaders.
Change leadership: Drive adoption of new platforms and agent-embedded ways of working through enablement and change management.
Outcome ownership: Set direction, prioritize ruthlessly, and hold the function accountable for measurable stability, adoption, and value.
▍ Minimum Requirements
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
Experience — depth: 13+ years in enterprise platform, digital product, or Source-to-Pay application management, including 5+ years leading platform or digital product delivery and operations and 3+ years leading teams.
Experience — scale: At least 5 years in a large, multi-region enterprise (5,000+ employees), including environments running on SAP (ECC and/or S/4HANA).
Experience — domain: Deep, hands-on ownership of a Source-to-Pay platform landscape (several of sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and procurement analytics platforms), with close working knowledge of how these integrate with an SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core.
Product management: Proven end-to-end product ownership — vision, roadmap, prioritization, and value realization — with a track record of driving outcomes over outputs.
Supplier / third-party product management: Managing supplier-supported products, including escalation, SLAs, performance reviews, licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
Analytics & adoption: Working knowledge of analytics and business intelligence (Power BI or Tableau) and of instrumenting products to measure adoption and value.
Integration: Proven experience integrating SaaS platforms with an ERP core — APIs, middleware, connectors, and cross-system data and controls.
AI / agentic ways of working: Experience defining requirements for, or embedding, AI agents into platform operations, support, configuration, testing, or enablement.
Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority on enterprise-scale, multi-region initiatives.
Ways of working: Able to collaborate across U.S. and Asia time zones, including regular overlap with U.S.-based stakeholders and partners.
▍ Preferred Requirements
Product management certification (Pragmatic Institute, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager, or equivalent).
Hands-on experience with Source-to-Pay or procurement platforms (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, GEP, Icertis, or Ironclad) and procurement analytics platforms.
Experience reimagining platform operations and enablement with AI or agents embedded.
Service management (ITIL) and Agile or DevOps ways of working for enterprise applications.
Depth in Source-to-Pay and Procure-to-Pay processes and the broader procurement platform landscape.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Procurement Data Excellence & Governance
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
The Global Procurement team is an integral engine to Micron’s growth, delivering best-in-class total cost and supply chain resiliency through innovative predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members, our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to ignite your talent.
As Senior Manager, Data Excellence & Governance within Global Procurement’s Digital Transformation & AI organization, you will lead the function that makes procurement data trusted, measurable, and ready for AI. You own data governance and quality operations, Global Procurement performance metrics and reporting, and the procurement data strategy — and you lead a multi-region team across Singapore, the United States, India, and Malaysia.
Data readiness is the single largest constraint to unlocking value from AI, automation, and analytics in procurement. A core part of your mandate is to reimagine the data governance and excellence operating model with AI agents embedded — redefining how policies, quality monitoring, lineage, and stewardship operate when agents handle detection, enrichment, routing, and maintenance, and where people focus on exception handling, governance, and continuous improvement. Success is measured by whether prioritized workflows run on trusted, agent-consumable data, and whether the data foundation strengthens itself through automated feedback loops rather than manual clean-up.
This is a people-leadership role. You will develop a team of data governance and analytics professionals, set the standards and stewardship model for procurement data, and partner closely with AI Transformation, Data & Process Automation, Platform Excellence, IT, Security, and Compliance to ensure the data foundation aligns with enterprise platforms, ERP readiness, and enterprise data governance standards.
▍ Key Responsibilities
A core expectation is to move procurement’s data function from reactive clean-up to an agent-embedded, self-improving operating model — where governance is executable, quality is measurable, and business value is demonstrable.
Data Governance & Quality Operations
Own the procurement data governance framework — policies, standards, decision rights, and the data stewardship operating model — and ensure it is applied consistently across systems and regions.
Lead data quality and master data operations (Vendor Master, Material Master, spend, category taxonomy), moving from recurring manual clean-up toward monitored, controlled, and preventable quality at the source.
Shift governance from static documents to executable rules — champion lightweight, machine-readable policies and standards that agents can enforce automatically.
Align data handling with enterprise controls — sensitivity labels, data loss prevention, and approved access — so data can be used safely by both people and AI agents.
Business Value & Performance Measurement
Own Global Procurement KPIs, metrics, and program reporting — providing leaders with a single, trusted source for performance and value.
Lead the labor productivity and business value agenda: define, quantify, and report the value realized from transformation, automation, and AI initiatives.
Establish data quality KPIs, service level agreements, and monitoring so quality and value are managed with evidence, not assumed.
Procurement Data Strategy & AI Readiness
Reimagine the data governance and excellence operating model with agents embedded — defining the target model, the agentic patterns that apply (data quality agent, lineage agent, maintenance agent, steward copilot), and a getting-started roadmap sequenced against ERP and transformation milestones.
Set and drive the procurement data strategy, prioritizing the Critical Data Elements that carry the most downstream value.
Partner with the AI Data Strategist and agent build leads to define the data elements, quality thresholds, and validation rules each agent needs — mapping every business requirement to a source, owner, and readiness action.
Direct the design of the feedback loop between agent, source system, and steward so validation, correction, and prevention happen without manual clean-up wherever feasible.
Data Lineage & Technical Foundations
Direct the working-level technical foundations that make the agentic model possible — data lineage, relationships, schema, and cross-system mapping — so downstream impact is traceable before a change lands.
Stand up and maintain a searchable data dictionary, business glossary, documentation, versioning, and change history that both people and agents can query and update.
Define control points at the point of entry so quality is protected where data originates.
Innovation & Reusable Assets
Sponsor rapid experiments on agentic data patterns, validate impact, and turn the best into reusable building blocks for broader adoption across Source-to-Pay.
Pilot AI-based data validation and cleansing tools and assess fit against Micron’s data landscape.
Team Leadership, Enterprise Partnership & Change
Lead, coach, and develop a multi-region team; build depth, ownership, and succession, and coach stewards, custodians, and business owners for an agent-embedded operating model.
Partner with IT, Security, Compliance, and Data Excellence to align procurement’s data strategy with enterprise standards, ERP migration readiness, and approved connectors.
Represent the data agenda in program reviews and executive readouts, and drive adoption through clear communication, enablement, and change management.
▍ Leadership Expectations
This leader is expected to embody Micron’s core values and set the tone for the team:
People
Care for each other — build an inclusive, high-trust team; develop talent, grow capability, and plan succession across regions.
Innovation
Shape the future — champion agent-embedded ways of working; experiment, learn fast, and scale what works.
Tenacity
Nothing shakes our resolve — own data quality and value outcomes end-to-end through complex, cross-system challenges.
Collaboration
Aligned to win — break silos across DTAi, IT, Security, and the business; win as one team across time zones.
Customer Focus
Partner and win together — treat procurement stakeholders and end-users as customers; deliver trusted data that enables their decisions.
Speed
Act with purpose and set the pace — make timely, well-reasoned decisions and move prioritized data and AI work from pilot to scale without losing rigor.
▍ Leadership Competencies
Talent & coaching: Develop, coach, and grow a multi-region team; build bench strength and succession within the function.
Cross-cultural leadership: Lead effectively across U.S. and Asia cultures and time zones, creating an inclusive, globally minded team.
Influence & partnership: Align IT, Security, and business stakeholders around common data standards without direct authority.
Executive communication: Translate complex data topics into crisp, decision-ready narratives for senior leaders.
Change leadership: Drive adoption of new standards and agent-embedded ways of working through enablement and change management.
Outcome ownership: Set direction, prioritize ruthlessly, and hold the function accountable for measurable value.
▍ Minimum Requirements
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Data Science, Computer Science, Data/Information Management, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative or supply-chain field.
Experience — depth: 10+ years in enterprise data management, analytics, or governance, including 5+ years leading data governance, master data management (MDM), or data quality programs and 3+ years leading teams.
Experience — scale: At least 5 years in a large, multi-region enterprise (5,000+ employees) running on SAP (ECC and/or S/4HANA).
Experience — domain: 3+ years working with procurement, sourcing, or supply-chain data, spanning several of Vendor/Business Partner Master, Material Master, Spend, Category Taxonomy, and Contracts.
Governance model delivered: Designed and operationalized an enterprise data governance operating model (roles, decision rights, policies, data quality KPIs, stewardship) with measurable, sustained adoption.
MDM / data catalog: Experience delivering programs on an MDM or data catalog platform (Informatica, Collibra, or Ataccama).
SAP & Ariba: Hands-on familiarity with procurement data in SAP S/4HANA (or ECC) and SAP Ariba.
Data & analytics foundations: Working knowledge of SQL, Snowflake, and Power BI or Tableau, plus data lineage, cross-system mapping, data dictionaries, and business glossaries.
AI / agentic data: Experience defining data requirements for production AI/ML, automation, or agentic workflows — including data readiness, quality thresholds, and validation or feedback rules.
Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to influence IT, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority on enterprise-scale, multi-region initiatives.
Ways of working: Able to collaborate across US and Asia time zones, including regular overlap with US-based team members and stakeholders.
▍ Preferred Requirements
Experience reimagining a data governance operating model with AI or agents embedded, including agentic patterns such as data quality agents, lineage agents, maintenance agents, and steward copilots.
Hands-on implementation experience (not just usage) with Informatica (MDM/IDQ/Axon), Collibra, or Ataccama in production.
Depth in Source-to-Pay, Procure-to-Pay, or Supply Chain data domains (Vendor Master, Material Master, Spend, Category Taxonomy, Contracts).
Familiarity with ERP migration data readiness, machine-readable policies, and data loss prevention and sensitivity-label impacts on AI connector access.
Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) or an equivalent data-management certification; additional AI/analytics or procurement transformation certifications.

Position Title: Electrical Shift Technician – Facilities Operations
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
Department: Engineering & Facilities Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Electrical Shift Technician to support 24x7 Facilities Operations and ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation of critical electrical infrastructure and utility systems. The role involves operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and first-line response activities for high-voltage electrical distribution systems supporting manufacturing and facility operations.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in 220 kV GIS Substations, 33 kV Distribution Systems, 6.6 kV Networks, HT/LT Power Systems, Transformers, UPS, DG Sets, and Facility Utility Systems.
Key Responsibilities
Electrical Operations
Operate and monitor 220 kV GIS, 33 kV, and 6.6 kV electrical distribution systems.
Perform routine electrical switching, isolation, energization, and shutdown activities as per approved procedures.
Monitor power system parameters, load distribution, and electrical equipment health.
Support uninterrupted power supply to manufacturing and facility operations.
Respond to alarms, trips, and electrical system abnormalities during shift operations.
GIS & Substation Support
Assist in operation and routine inspection of GIS substations and switchgear.
Monitor GIS breakers, disconnectors, protection systems, and SF₆ gas parameters.
Perform equipment inspection, housekeeping, and condition monitoring activities.
Support preventive and corrective maintenance of substations and electrical systems.
Maintenance & Troubleshooting
Execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities.
Troubleshoot electrical equipment faults and support quick restoration of systems.
Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective action implementation.
Support reliability improvement and continuous improvement initiatives.
Utilize Gen AI tools, Copilot, Copilot Library, and Agent Bots for troubleshooting and operational support.
Critical Utility Support
Support operations and maintenance of:
HVAC Systems
Chillers
Air Compressors
Water & Wastewater Systems
Gas Systems
Cleanroom Utilities
Building Infrastructure
Safety & Compliance
Follow Electrical Safety, LOTO, PTW, Arc Flash, and EHS requirements.
Participate in emergency response and incident management activities.
Ensure compliance with company standards and statutory regulations.
Support audits, inspections, and safety programs.
Documentation & Reporting
Maintain shift logbooks and operational records.
Record equipment alarms, incidents, and corrective actions.
Update maintenance records in CMMS/SAP.
Support preparation of shift and maintenance reports.
Required Qualifications
Education
ITI / Diploma in Electrical Engineering or equivalent technical qualification.
Experience
3-8 years of experience in:
Semiconductor Facilities
Electronics Manufacturing
Data Centers
Pharmaceutical Facilities
Industrial Utilities
Process Manufacturing Plants
Required Technical Skills
220 kV GIS Substation Operations
33 kV Distribution Systems
6.6 kV Electrical Networks
HT/LT Power Distribution Systems
Transformers and Switchgear
Protection Relays and Electrical Panels
RMU, PCC, MCC Systems
UPS Systems and Battery Banks
DG Sets and Synchronization Systems
Electrical Fault Finding & Troubleshooting
Thermography and Condition Monitoring

jobs.title: NAND Custom Test Circuit Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, integrate, and optimize custom test circuit architectures for NAND flash memory designs, including transistor-level digital, analog, mixed-signal, monitoring, control, and memory-array interface circuits.
Interpret product specifications and test requirements; define circuit functionality, interfaces, operating limits, controllability, observability, and validation criteria.
Create, review, and optimize schematics, device sizing, bias structures, sensing and monitoring paths, multiplexers relevant to test circuits.
Analyze circuit testability and robustness to ensure compliance with quality, coverage, manufacturability, power, area, and reliability requirements.
Validate custom test circuits using XA simulations, Verilog simulations, and mixed-signal validation environments.
Collaborate closely with layout teams on matching, parasitic sensitivity, shielding, routing, guard rings, device placement, and layout-dependent effects; review post-layout results and drive closure.
Evaluate circuit risks including leakage, contention, floating nodes, device overstress, power sequencing, current density, EM/IR, and long-duration stress conditions.
Create and debug test sequences and test modes required to control, observe, characterize, and validate custom test circuits at wafer and package levels.
Work with Product Engineering during first-silicon bring-up, debug and characterization, failure isolation, simulation-to-silicon correlation, and ramp to high-volume production.
Use laboratory measurements and silicon data to identify root cause and recommend circuit, test-mode, characterization, or screening improvements.
Apply a Design + AI approach as a core responsibility by using AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows to accelerate circuit review, simulation triage, waveform analysis, root-cause investigation, automation, documentation, and knowledge retrieval while maintaining engineering rigor and sign-off discipline.
Develop Python or scripting-based automation and AI-enabled solutions that improve design quality, reduce turnaround time, and increase engineering productivity.
Document test-circuit methodologies, specifications, design decisions, validation results, silicon correlation, and clear technical recommendations.
Required Qualifications and Skills:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 2+ years of experience
Relevant hands-on experience in custom/analog circuit design, mixed-signal design, memory peripheral circuit design, or Product Engineering with strong transistor-level circuit and silicon-debug exposure.
Strong understanding of CMOS device operation, transistor-level circuit design, leakage mechanisms, parasitics, PVT sensitivity, timing, loading, noise margin, power, and reliability principles.
Hands-on proficiency with circuit build entry, waveform debug and post-layout verification.
Proficiency in XA or equivalent fast transistor-level simulation, Verilog, and mixed-signal validation methodologies.
Preferred (not must) solid understanding of NAND flash memory architecture, test modes, peripheral circuits, internal signal access, and wafer/package test considerations.
Proficiency in Python and scripting for simulation automation, regression analysis, result extraction, waveform processing, and engineering efficiency.
Ability to identify workflows that can be improved through AI, develop or adapt AI-enabled engineering solutions, and apply appropriate technical review, data protection, and engineering judgment.
Excellent problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail, and effective interpersonal skills for multi-functional, global collaboration.
Nice to have: Laboratory skills using oscilloscope, logic or signal analyzer, source-measure equipment, function generator, and hands-on testing of silicon at wafer and package levels.

Job description
Function: Mechanical
Location: Sanand
Experience: 12 to 15 Years
Qualification: Mechanical Engineering, Bachelor of Engineering degree
Industry Preference: Semiconductor Plant
The role requires an experienced engineer to lead the composition coordination, quality implementation, and installation oversight for all utility hook-up systems connected to semiconductor manufacturing tools. The candidate should be capable of handling cross-functional coordination for mechanical, electrical, network, water, and gas systems while ensuring conformity with engineering standards, cleanroom requirements, Working on AI-Enabled tools (such as Copilot and Power BI), safety rules, and project timelines.
Role purpose
This position is responsible for end-to-end coordination of tool hook-up works, from building review through installation, inspection, testing, and handover. In semiconductor projects, tool hook-up is a critical integration stage because each production tool must be accurately connected to utilities such as electrical power, process gases, chilled or process water, DIW, drain system, exhaust, and communication/data systems before startup and qualification can begin.
Key responsibilities
Review tool utility requirements and coordinate hook-up development for mechanical, electrical, network, water, and gas systems.
Verify layouts, installation drawings, hook-up packages, utility routing, and interface points with tool suppliers, facility teams, and project collaborators.
Manage field implementation of tool hook-up operations and verify adherence to approved drawings, quality plans, and safety guidelines.
Coordinate installation activities related to power supply, earthing, cables, data/network connectivity, water lines, gas lines, mechanical supports, and associated utility connections.
Ensure cleanroom protocols, contamination control practices, and semiconductor installation standards are maintained during execution.
Support QA/QC activities including inspections, punch listing, leak testing, pressure testing, continuity checks, flushing, and utility verification.
Work with OEMs, construction teams, quality teams, and facility engineers during startup, commissioning support, interlock verification, and handover.
Prepare and maintain engineering documentation such as checklists, as-built drawings, progress reports, inspection records, deviation logs, and turnover dossiers.
Apply industrial engineering methods to improve workflow, resource planning, installation sequencing, productivity, and execution efficiency.
Identify execution risks, resolve field issues, and drive corrective and preventive actions to maintain schedule and quality targets.
Required qualifications
Mechanical Engineering degree
12–15 years of experience in managing projects, facilities engineering, tool installation, or tool hook-up activities is required.
Strong knowledge of building review, field execution, quality assurance, and coordination across multidisciplinary utility systems is required.
Proficiency with AI tools (such as Copilot and Power BI) is required.
Preferred experience in semiconductor plants, cleanroom environments, or high-tech manufacturing facilities.
Ability to understand engineering drawings, utility layouts, P&IDs, single-line diagrams, and hook-up documents is preferred.
Working knowledge of testing, commissioning support, turn-on documentation, and vendor coordination is required.
Good communication, planning, team coordination, and problem-solving skills are essential.
Preferred candidate profile
The ideal candidate should have direct experience with semiconductor projects and a solid understanding of facility backbone systems. These include power, water, gas, and mechanical utilities that support fab operations. Candidates with cleanroom tool hookup, OEM coordination, utility interface management, and efficiency improvement experience are especially suited. Join us to be part of an ambitious team driving world-class innovations!

Title and Summary
Analyst, Risk Management
Job Description:
The primary responsibility is to support the CRM team to ensure customer risk is appropriately monitored in accordance with Mastercard’s policies & procedures and risk appetite framework. The role also involves partnering with our Corporate Treasury Central Team and Settlement Operations teams to assist with any CRM data validation or CRM system testing related to CEM (Customer Exposure Management) improvements as well as preparing commercial underwriting documentation before handing it over to senior analysts for completion.
Mastercard has approximately $68B in credit exposure to financial institutions and other counterparties worldwide, placing the CRM role as a key part of its evolving and quickly growing business model. The magnitude and strategic nature of this exposure necessitates periodic engagement with senior management, Mastercard’s sales, franchise, and product organizations as well as our customers (issuers, acquirers, etc. This provides great opportunities to learn and grow your career within Mastercard.
Role:
· Daily read of Factiva/CreditEdge customer related news and regulatory website to scan for customer’s financial distress
· Monitor 24/7 global customer exposures and, based on volume trends and news/regulatory websites, immediately inform risk managers in case of urgencies (bankruptcies, insolvencies, administration etc)
· Monitor 24/7 the company prefunding accounts.
· Follow up with customers and account managers on open settlement positions of customers for small settlement failures, coordinating with Account Managers and Settlement operations, to determine if genuine or if it is a reconciliation issue
· Participate in decision process, including emergency procedures as directed by the Risk Managers
· First assembling of Commercial Underwriting for senior risk analysts, including data points such as volume/exposure trends, recommended CEM thresholds limits and settlement analysis
· CEM (Customer Exposure Monitoring) System testing
· Ad hoc reporting on customer volume, exposure and CEM declines trends
· Report and coordinate with the appropriate teams in case of CEM inaccuracies or process failures
· Maintain Customer Exposure Monitoring Manual
· Participate in various process improvement initiatives and best practices sharing;
· Access/check balances on customer bank account subject to security agreements, as applies
All About You:
• Graduate/Postgraduate degree in business, economics, econometrics or equivalent.
• Experience in credit risk assessment and financial statements analysis (preferably).
• Accuracy, self-drive, accountability and sense of urgency.
• Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills.
• Advanced Excel, Word, and PowerPoint user.
• Positive attitude, strong work-ethic, and good sense of humor.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Job Details | Atlassian
Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Responsible AI
Engineering | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India.
We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team, dedicated to developing innovative solutions to make AI services responsible (Responsible AI).
You will join the Responsible AI (RAI) & AI Safety engineering team. We are responsible for building, operating, and advancing the centralized AI safety, content moderation, and guardrail platforms powering Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo.
Our systems run inline and asynchronously across high-throughput production workloads, detecting and mitigating jailbreaks, prompt injection, harmful content, bias, and policy violations while preserving latency and user experience. We partner closely with Product Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI Gateway, Legal, and Trust teams to deliver safety systems that scale globally.
We have teams in the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and this will be our expansion to India. This team is responsible for building solutions and operating mature platforms to improve the entire company's security and trust & safety posture.If you are passionate about improving security, trust & safety, and combating abuse, this role presents a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact!
At Atlassian, a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) is responsible for building, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models into production systems at scale. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering and data science, requiring production-grade code to turn research prototypes into real-world systems like search ranking, recommendations, and GenAI platforms.
What You’ll Do
Design & Productionize Safety Models: Architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM-based guardrail and moderation models (text, multi-modal, and code) to safeguard user inputs and model outputs across Atlassian products.
Build Robust Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design offline and online evaluation frameworks, adversarial test suites (red-teaming), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to measure precision, recall, false-positive rates, and robustness against model drift.
Optimize for Real-Time Serving: Work at the intersection of model accuracy and low latency (P50/P99 targets) to deliver cost-effective, high-throughput safety filtering integrated with our central AI Gateway and inference layers.
Combat Emerging Threats: Research and build defenses against adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, and unauthorized tool-calling behaviors in agentic systems.
Drive Global Compliance & Governance: Support technical readiness for enterprise standards and emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, ISO 42001 / AIMS, FedRAMP) through verifiable safety controls, audit logging, and watermarking capabilities.
Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with engineering managers, staff engineers, data scientists, and product managers to steer technical strategy; provide code/design reviews and mentor junior engineers across the team.
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
Your background
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with 7+ years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production.
Deep hands-on experience with modern NLP and LLM techniques, transformer architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., PEFT/LoRA), and model alignment.
Proficiency in Python (and familiarity with Kotlin, Java, or Go) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and performant production-grade code.
Proven experience constructing rigorous evaluation pipelines, benchmarking datasets, and managing precision/recall trade-offs for high-consequence classification or safety systems.
Expertise at telling stories with data and familiarity with at least one visualization tool (e.g. Tableau, R-Shiny, Microstrategy, SAP Business Objects, Looker, etc.)
Experience deploying and scaling ML services in cloud environments (AWS / GCP) using containerized platforms (Kubernetes/Docker) and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, SQL).
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to navigate ambiguity, and clear communication skills to articulate ML trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
An agile development mindset focused on constant iteration, solving problems from first principles, and navigating ambiguity.
It's great, but not required, if you have
Experience specifically in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, or AI Red-Teaming / Adversarial Robustness.
Hands-on experience optimizing inference engines (e.g., Triton Inference Server, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) or model quantization techniques for low-latency serving.
Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, content provenance/watermarking, or regulatory compliance standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001).
Experience with large-scale streaming pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) or graph-based entity systems.

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
We are looking for a Technical Team Lead (Engineering Manager) who exhibits a player-coach and servant leadership mentality to lead a highly autonomous, multidisciplinary team of AI software developers. You will act as the defining engineering voice serving as the bridge between ambitious business goals and the technical reality of building scalable, ethical, and high-impact AI solutions within a highly regulated healthcare environment. You will collaborate with AI Product Managers, consultants, subject matter experts, platforms leadership and engineers, Roche Digital Technology (Roche IT) and business stakeholders to define, build and operate various kinds of AI solutions, driven by generative AI, agentic and classical Machine Learning.
In this role, you must successfully balance being on the manager's- and maker's-schedule. You will likely step away from daily feature coding to guide system architecture and perform rigorous code reviews, while simultaneously providing empathetic people management necessary to cultivate a high-performing engineering squad.
Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small agile teams (e.g. ~8 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through applying Agentic SDLC). This team will not only build end-to-end solutions, but also support "buy and integrate" projects while gathering technical feedback to support the ongoing development of RDT AI Platforms.
Job Responsibilities
Team Management
Manage multi-disciplinary team members with different skill sets from your own, injecting stability into the squad within a complex organizational environment.
Cultivate healthy team dynamics, collaboration, psychological safety, and open communication while maintaining a sustainable pace of work.
Set clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, managing sprint goals in partnership with Product Managers while actively removing roadblocks. Engage in continuous product discovery in partnership with Product Managers and UX leads. Be willing and able to step into a Product Owner role when necessary.
Explain the "WHY" and provide necessary context to your team members.
Capability Development & Resource Management:
Encourage team members to self-define and drive their career journey and actively enable development opportunities that align with it.
Manage hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation calibration, succession planning, handling underperformance, and conflict resolution.
Manage the team's budget, including headcount, software/infrastructure operational costs, and vendor contracts, ensuring financial responsibility.
Technical Direction & Architecture:
Enable technical decision-making and design of robust, resilient, and highly available systems that integrate generative AI, multi-agent frameworks, RAG/GraphRAG pipelines, state machines, classical ML, and enterprise data ecosystems.
Establish robust patterns for utilizing LLMs, multimodal foundation models, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, and vector, graph and relational databases.
Ensure newly developed AI applications fit within the context of RDT and Business functions, strictly following architectural patterns, standards, and data strategies established across the functions.
Identify areas of technical debt and perform pragmatic cost/benefit analyses for resolving this debt, ensuring optimal cloud resource and model inference cost-efficiency.
Establish and enforce rigorous enterprise standards for code, systems development, identity management, and authentication mechanisms across the team.
Agentic SDLC & Code Quality:
Ensure the team effectively leverages agentic Software Development Lifecycle workflows and tools daily (e.g., Claude Code, autonomous agents) to safely accelerate development and automated testing cycles.
Act as the technical standards keeper; perform or enable effective, rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code to maintain strict enterprise software engineering standards.
Compliance & Regulatory Alignment:
Oversee compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments, ensuring engineering deliverables are audit-ready and aligned with GxP compliance and Computerized System Validation (CSV)/Software Assurance (CSA) standards.
Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) to preserve validated infrastructure states.
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Bachelor or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, Science, or a related field.
Leadership Experience: 3+ years of experience in team leadership and people leadership in an agile product delivery environment, with a proven track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
Technical Experience: 7+ years of experience working in AI software development teams, with at least 5 years as a hands-on engineer or architect designing cloud-native solutions.
Regulated Domain Experience: Proven experience operating within a highly regulated environment (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical healthcare preferred) delivering validated applications.
Exhibits servant and creative leadership (VACC) behavior.
Possesses deep active listening and mentoring/coaching skills.
Demonstrates a leadership presence, strong business acumen, ability to navigate ambiguity, and manage complexity.
Is a decisive leader, comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Brings an enterprise mindset that can break down silos, focusing on delivery through collaboration across organizational boundaries.
Technical Skills
AI & Orchestration Frameworks: Deep practical expertise in multi-agent system design, state machine logic, and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
Classical Machine Learning: strong hands-on background in building applications driven by classical (pre-generative) Machine Learning and MLOps.
Core Programming: Production-grade mastery in advanced Python for backend/AI workloads and TypeScript for modern frontend interfaces and generative AI and classical ML UX/UI. Strong foundational understanding of modern full-stack development environments.
Data & Cloud Platforms: Strong architectural understanding of enterprise data platforms like Snowflake, vector databases (e.g., AWS OpenSearch), and graph databases (e.g., AWS Neptune).
Cloud Engineering & DevOps: High proficiency overseeing AWS cloud architecture (including serverless workloads, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, etc.), managing fully automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform).
AI Observability: Experience defining monitoring, logging, and telemetry strategies to track model drift, API/MCP health, resource utilization, and anomaly identification.
Additional Qualifications
Excels in communicating in English highly effectively and clearly, at the level of: C1+.
Strong stakeholder management skills to influence non-technical Senior Stakeholders on complex architectural designs.
Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in LLMs, GenAI, agentic, classical ML, cloud computing, and software architectures.
Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative , with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Be an excellent problem solver and analytical thinker, detail-oriented and highly organized.
Be willing to learn and expand their skill set in an environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary.
Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

The Opportunity
Nutanix is looking for a passionate and talented UX Writer/Content Designer. Nutanix, a leader in hybrid multicloud computing, is a diverse organization. More than 6,000 of us work across geographies and time zones to help businesses of the future embrace multicloud solutions.
About Nutanix
Nutanix provides an enterprise cloud platform that gives organizations a single hyperconverged infrastructure combining virtualization, storage, and networking for all their apps and data across clouds.
With Nutanix, organizations can reduce complexity and simplify operations. As a pioneer of hyperconverged infrastructure, Nutanix is trusted worldwide to power hybrid multicloud environments consistently and cost-effectively. Incorporated in 2009, Nutanix is headquartered in San Jose, California. Learn more at www.nutanix.com
About the role
As a UX Writer/Content Designer, you’ll join our Research & Design team and work closely with designers, researchers, and engineers. You’ll help us shape our product experiences by informing content strategy, information architecture, and language.
You are a strong copy editor/writer with experience defining and realizing a content strategy across a sizable product portfolio. You possess a “makers” mentality and are equally comfortable “pitching in” as an individual contributor as you are at developing strategy and pitching to stakeholders.The Content Strategy role at Nutanix is a terrific opportunity to define and build a mission-critical function within a successful, growing, market-leading company. The UX Writer/Content Designer role is a critical component of the Nutanix strategy to leverage design to revolutionize the cloud infrastructure experience. "Design" and "Customer delight" are embedded in every step of our product cycle. Nutanix has a design-first philosophy that combines consumer-grade design with web-scale engineering to create an amazing user experience.We’re looking for a UX Content Designer to shape intuitive, consistent, and user-centered experiences across our products. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Engineers, and subject matter experts to simplify complex concepts, design effective product experiences, and ensure content is an integral part of the product development process. This role goes beyond writing UI copy. It involves understanding user needs, solving content and usability challenges, establishing consistent terminology, and creating scalable content patterns that help users navigate complex products with confidence.
Responsibilities:
Putting our users first, your work will be grounded in empathy, drawing upon user research and feedback.

You’ll remove critical assumptions from our user data, design patterns, and communication style to help improve our product delivery.
You’ll collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure consistency, voice, tone, and brand appeal.
You’ll explore AI-assisted content workflows to improve efficiency while maintaining quality, accuracy, and consistency.

jobs.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
Job Summary:
What do you need to know about the role
This is an incident command role. You'll direct application and infrastructure teams during incidents making work assignments, prioritizing troubleshooting paths, and authorizing critical actions like rollbacks and regional failovers. You need the technical knowledge to rapidly read Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes manifests, and CI/CD configurations to make informed decisions under pressure.
Meet Our Team
The Site Health Engineering (Command Center) team serves as the operational and technical authority during PayPal's most critical incidents. We are a team of experienced infrastructure and reliability professionals who blend deep technical expertise with sound judgment under pressure, directing cross-functional engineering efforts across PayPal's core platforms and family of brands, including Venmo, Xoom, Zettle, and Braintree.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:
Actively monitor and analyze system metrics to ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of digital platforms and applications.
Diagnose and resolve complex system issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes to prevent recurrence.
Create and maintain automation scripts, tools, and processes to streamline operations, reduce manual effort, and enhance reliability.
Configure and improve monitoring and alerting tools to provide actionable insights into system health and performance.
Analyze system usage trends and forecast future resource requirements to ensure scalability and prevent capacity-related issues.
Work with development teams to design and implement reliable, fault-tolerant systems, incorporating best practices for high availability.
Ensure smooth and reliable software releases by managing continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
Perform failure simulations, such as chaos engineering, to identify weaknesses and improve system robustness.
Develop and maintain detailed documentation for system configurations, operational procedures, and incident handling workflows.
Partner with development, operations, and product teams to enhance system architecture for improved performance, reliability, and scalability.

1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Hand-off validated material selections, process guidelines, and design rules to manufacturing teams in a structured and repeatable manner.

Support root cause analysis efforts by combining physical failure analysis with test vehicle data and available simulation insights.

Electrical / signal integrity / power integrity modeling

Experience with cross-functional project coordination and technical collaboration across global teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable integration decisions.
Strong interpersonal, oral, and written English communication skills.

Experience with AI/ML tools for data visualization/automation.
Knowledge of semiconductor fabrication, assembly & test processes.

jobs.title: Hardware Security Analyst - Semiconductor IP
jobs.description:
We Are:
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
You Are:
You are someone who builds trust with product and engineering teams and helps them do security work as part of normal delivery. You listen first, write in clear language, and own your conclusions. You work well with people in different disciplines and locations without needing to be the loudest person in the room.
You are practical when information is incomplete. You explain complex topics in simple terms, stay calm when the design changes, and challenge unclear choices in a respectful way. You care about teamwork, follow-through, and leaving work that others can use.
This is a full-time role.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Lead threat analysis for semiconductor IP and associated firmware: identify assets, access points, threat scenarios, and attack paths, and recommend controls in the IP versus requirements for the integrator.
Run security analysis as part of the cybersecurity lifecycle, from planning through design, implementation, verification, and release.
Advise product teams on cybersecurity requirements, architecture, and verification so security work is built into the existing development flow.
Author customer-facing security integration guidance that describes the threat landscape, implemented controls, and how customers should integrate the IP.
Review RTL, architecture, and verification intent against secure-design principles; judge whether a claimed control is implemented and testable; capture integrator recommendations where needed.
Support in-field cybersecurity activities for the products you cover, including vulnerability assessment, incident analysis, and security advisories, working with product-team architects and corporate vulnerability response as required.
Facilitate working sessions with cybersecurity architects and design and verification leads; keep analysis consistent across similar IP classes.
Deliver analysis incrementally with product teams working in agile sprints: plan security work against the product backlog, adjust scope when the design changes, and keep evidence current at each milestone.
Use Python to automate analysis, transform inventories and threat-model data, and produce repeatable reports other analysts can run and review.
Use agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) to speed research, first drafts, consistency checks, and routine tasks without handing off ownership of findings.
Run the job in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track analysis and incident work, keep project documentation current, and version work products through merge requests and review.
The Impact You Will Have:
Give product teams threat analysis they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
Leave cybersecurity requirements and verification objectives that design and verification teams can execute.
Produce integration guidance that customers can follow without a security specialist in the room.
Strengthen the cybersecurity lifecycle for IP products so security work stays current as the design changes.
Improve consistency of analysis across similar IP classes through shared working sessions and clear written conclusions.
Help the organization respond to in-field issues with clear assessment and practical advisories.
Raise analysis throughput with Python and agentic workflows without lowering the quality of technical conclusions.
What You’ll Need:
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
Typically, 4 or more years in product cybersecurity, embedded security, digital design, digital verification, or a closely related engineering role. Stronger evidence on the required capabilities can offset fewer years. Title (Analyst or Senior Analyst) will match demonstrated depth.
Practical experience performing threat modeling or threat analysis and risk assessment on real products, not only training exercises.
Ability to identify assets, attackers, attack surfaces, and attack paths, and to map each path to a mitigation (in-product control or integration requirement).
Comfort working without a single known end-system: analysis must cover representative integration scenarios and state assumptions clearly.
Experience applying a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, requirements, design, implementation, verification, and release.
Ability to turn threat-analysis results into requirements, design guidance, verification objectives, and release evidence.
Hands-on understanding of embedded systems: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, hardware/software interfaces, memory-mapped registers, boot and debug, and on-chip interconnects.
Ability to reason about hardware-rooted threats and firmware threats, and to read architecture, databooks, and interface specifications with the design team.
Hands-on proficiency as a digital designer or a digital verification engineer. Either path is sufficient.
Ability to read and discuss RTL (Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL), architecture, interfaces, and register maps with designers and verification leads.
Ability to judge whether a claimed cybersecurity control is implemented in the design and whether it is verifiable.
Experience delivering analysis or engineering work inside agile product teams, including re-scoping when product content changes.
Ability to write and maintain Python for analysis and automation. This is not a software-engineering role. Scripts should be readable and usable by other analysts.
Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.
Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions with geographically distributed teams.
Working knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard is helpful, as is analog or mixed-signal background, semiconductor IP product experience, vulnerability handling, or applied embedded cryptography.
Who You Are:
You build trust with design teams and keep working relationships strong when the discussion is difficult.
You own the technical conclusion. You do not hand off judgment to a tool, a template, or the loudest voice in the room.
You write clearly so engineers and customers can use your work without you in the room.
You work well with incomplete information and out-of-context IP, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend improvements teams can actually adopt.
You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as the design changes.
You are comfortable with agile change and re-scope analysis without waiting for a late gate.
The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
You will join the cybersecurity team that supports Synopsys semiconductor IP products. As an analyst, you are assigned to IP product teams and work in their delivery cadence. You collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, and firmware engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to complete analysis, guidance, and evidence through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Your written work products are used by product teams and by customers who integrate the IP.
Rewards and Benefits:
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months.
You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99.5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences.
At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter.
What You'll Be Doing
Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs

jobs.title: Senior Layout Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Layout Design, Sr Engineer
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years translating analog circuit schematics into physical layouts that actually perform, not just pass DRC. You know that a GPIO layout is not just about routing metal, it is about understanding how a 2pF mismatch or a 10-micron shift can break ESD performance or skew I/O timing in ways the schematic never predicted. You think in cross-sections and current density maps, and you have learned to spot a latchup risk or a substrate coupling problem before it ever hits silicon.
You are comfortable sitting with a circuit designer who hands you a half-finished schematic and a set of constraints, and you know which questions to ask to turn that into a layout that meets area, performance, and reliability targets. Matching does not scare you, it is something you have done enough times to have opinions about dummy placement and orientation strategies. You have debugged parasitic extraction results at 2 a.m. and lived to tell the story.
Automation is not a nice-to-have for you, it is how you stay sane. You write scripts to check spacing rules, generate array structures, or pull reports because doing it manually fifteen times is not an option. At Synopsys, you will work on IO and analog IP that ships in real products, with a team that knows the difference between a layout that works and one that just closes.
What You'll Be Doing
Design and own full custom analog layouts for GPIO, specialty IO, and general-purpose analog IP blocks including I2C, I3C, SMBUS, eMMC, SVID, Quad SPI, and JTAG interfaces
Develop high-performance LVDS layouts and crystal oscillator circuits with attention to signal integrity, noise coupling, and parasitic management
Collaborate with circuit designers to translate schematics into physical implementations that meet area, performance, matching, and reliability specifications
Perform layout verification including DRC, LVS, and parasitic extraction analysis, iterating with design teams to close on performance targets
Build and maintain layout automation scripts to improve design efficiency, consistency, and quality across IP families
Provide technical guidance and layout reviews for junior engineers, helping them develop skills in analog matching, IO frame design, and technology-specific layout techniques
Work across global teams in the US, Europe, and Asia to align on design standards, schedules, and deliverables for multi-site IP development programs
The Impact You Will Have
Your layouts will directly enable GPIO and specialty IO performance in Synopsys IP that powers AI, automotive, and high-performance computing chips used by leading semiconductor companies
You will help reduce design cycle time and improve first-pass silicon success rates through high-quality layout and proactive parasitic management
The automation scripts and layout methodologies you develop will become reusable assets across multiple IP families and process nodes
Your technical reviews and mentorship will raise the skill level of the layout team and reduce costly respins caused by layout-induced performance issues
You will contribute to IP roadmaps by identifying layout-driven design constraints early, influencing architecture decisions before they become problems
The IO and analog blocks you design will ship in millions of devices, affecting real-world product performance and time to market for Synopsys customers
You will help establish layout best practices and design guidelines that scale across a global engineering organization
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, VLSI Design, or equivalent practical experience
3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in analog or mixed-signal custom IC layout design
Strong understanding of CMOS layout fundamentals including device matching, parasitic effects, electromigration, latchup, and ESD protection strategies
Proficiency with industry-standard layout tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Calibre, or equivalent verification and extraction platforms
Working knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL, or SKILL for layout automation and design checks
Experience with IO frame design, pad ring assembly, or specialty interface IP layout is a strong plus
Familiarity with parasitic extraction tools and the ability to interpret and act on R/C extraction results to meet circuit performance targets
Who You Are
You can sit in a layout review, spot a symmetry issue or a metal density violation in seconds, and explain the fix without needing to pull up the full design
You do not wait for perfect specs, you work with what circuit designers give you, ask clarifying questions about critical matching pairs or bias routing, and move forward
You treat layout as a craft, not a checklist, and you care about the difference between a layout that barely passes LVS and one that is actually manufacturable and reliable
You are comfortable working across time zones with teams in different geographies, coordinating handoffs and reviews without losing momentum
You are the person junior engineers come to when they are stuck on a tricky matching problem or cannot figure out why their extraction numbers are off, and you enjoy that role
You know when to escalate a layout-driven performance issue to the circuit designer and when to solve it yourself with a smarter floorplan or routing strategy
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will be part of a strong development team focused on GPIO, specialty IO, and general-purpose analog IP development. The team works on a range of interface IP including I2C, I3C, SMBUS, eMMC, SVID, Quad SPI, JTAG, high-performance LVDS, and crystal oscillators. You will collaborate closely with experienced engineers locally in Bangalore and across global sites, contributing to multi-site IP programs that serve customers worldwide.
