jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Job Summary
The Planner will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and controlling integrated project schedules in line with approved planning methodologies. The role involves critical path analysis, progress monitoring, variance and delay analysis, and preparation of insightful planning reports to support management decision-making. The Planner will closely coordinate with project teams, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure schedule integrity, identify risks, and propose recovery strategies to achieve project milestones.
Roles and Responsibilities
1. Develop and maintain project schedules based on defined planning methodology, including schedule basis, assumptions, exclusions, and coding structures.
2. Establish and manage schedule baselines in alignment with contract requirements and project controls standards.
3. Perform Critical Path Method (CPM) analysis and continuously monitor critical and near-critical activities.
4. Conduct delay analysis, impact assessments, and evaluate schedule changes and claims.
5. Propose schedule crashing, fast-tracking, and recovery strategies to mitigate delays and support milestone achievement.
6. Perform schedule variance analysis against baseline and previous updates, identifying root causes and trends.
7. Prepare and present weekly and monthly planning reports highlighting progress, risks, critical path movement, productivity, and recovery recommendations.
8. Lead and facilitate schedule review workshops with internal teams and external stakeholders.
9. Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams to ensure realistic and achievable schedules.
10. Validate contractor schedules, progress updates, and reports, identifying discrepancies and non-compliances.
11. Support management with planning insights, scenario analysis, and forecast completion assessments.
12. Ensure compliance with project planning standards, contractual requirements, and reporting protocols.
13. Prepare executive level presentations and dashboards
14. Should have good working knowledge of using AI agents like Copilot, Claude, etc. and should demonstrate application of the same in day-to-day job

Educational Qualification
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical / Civil / Electrical / Industrial or relevant discipline).
• Certification in Project Planning / Project Management (Primavera P6, PMP, PSP, or equivalent) is preferred.
• Certification in Power BI/ Tableau preferred
Experience
• 7+ years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling within EPC, industrial construction, semiconductor fabs, infrastructure, or large-scale projects.
Technical Skills & Proficiency
• Strong proficiency in Primavera P6 (mandatory).
• Working knowledge of MS Project, Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables, dashboards), and PowerPoint.
• Experience in developing schedule basis documents, WBS, and coding structures.
• Expertise in Critical Path Analysis (CPM), delay analysis, and recovery planning techniques.
• Understanding of productivity measurement, progress curves (S-curves), and forecasting.
• Familiarity with contract scheduling requirements and claim support documentation.
• Experience in developing BI Dashboards (preferred)
• Working knowledge of using AI tools like Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.

ARP evaluates whether internal platforms are “agentic-ready” for end-to-end AI agent development. Collaborating with the accounting team to ensure compliance and accuracy in financial reporting.
Driving process improvements, including the creation of standard and ad-hoc reports and Excel dashboards.
Supporting ad-hoc business analysis and reporting requirements for various business units.
Ensuring high data accuracy and attention to detail in all financial analyses.
Designing and implementing reporting tools to enhance transparency and flexibility in financial analysis.
The Impact You Will Have:
Empowering leadership with reliable financial insights to make informed strategic decisions.
Enhancing operational efficiency through cost reduction and optimization initiatives.
Strengthening financial discipline and accountability across the organization.
Driving process improvements that streamline reporting and increase transparency.
Supporting business units with accurate and actionable financial analysis, fostering growth and profitability.
Promoting a culture of continuous improvement in financial planning and execution.
Facilitating compliance and accuracy in financial reporting, safeguarding Synopsys’ reputation and integrity.
Enabling Synopsys to respond proactively to risks and opportunities in a fast-evolving industry.
What You’ll Need:
CA (Chartered Accountant), ICWA (Management Accountant), US CPA, or MBA (Finance specialization).
10+ years’ experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, MIS, and analytics, preferably in a leading high-tech company.
Strong background in accounting, expense accruals, analysis, and capital expenditure analysis.
Advanced analytical and numeric skills; adept at handling complex data and translating it into actionable insights.
Working knowledge of Anaplan, SAP, and advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and visualization tools; hands-on experience with Oracle is a plus.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective interaction with Corporate FP&A partners and functional teams.
Willingness to work in shifts to enable collaboration with global teams across different time zones.
Who You Are:
Collaborative team player who communicates effectively across functions and geographies.
Self-starter with a curious mindset and a drive for continuous learning and improvement.
Detail-oriented with a high standard for data accuracy and integrity.
Relationship builder who cultivates trust and credibility with business partners.
Adaptable and resilient in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
Proactive problem solver who takes initiative to deliver results.

You’ll join a high-performing finance team that partners closely with cross-functional business units and leadership. The team is focused on delivering strategic financial insights, driving operational excellence, and supporting Synopsys’ mission to lead in innovation and technology. Collaboration, transparency, and a commitment to continuous improvement are core values, and you’ll have opportunities to contribute to impactful projects while growing your expertise in a supportive, global environment.

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings.

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
ROLE
Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and validation of advanced 3D NAND products. Establish whether silicon meets design intent and datasheet requirements, correlate simulation with measurements, and resolve issues that could affect product qualification, reliability, yield, or SSD/system integration.
This role provides a unique opportunity to develop end-to-end expertise across advanced NAND products, spanning circuit design concepts, mixed-signal simulations, first-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers gain broad exposure to analog, mixed-signal, digital, firmware, memory-array, and system-level behavior while working closely with design, verification, firmware, product, and system teams.
RESPONSIBILITIES
• Own validation strategies, coverage, and test plans for assigned NAND circuits and functions; define expected behavior, operating corners, and pass/fail criteria from product specifications and design intent.
• Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and simulation-to-silicon correlation across voltage, temperature, process, timing, and workload conditions.
• Characterize and debug NAND subsystems including reference and bias generation circuits, bandgap references, oscillators, voltage regulators, charge pumps, sensing and page-buffer paths, high-voltage program/erase circuitry, memory-core drivers, control and timing logic, interface circuitry, trim and calibration functions, and firmware-controlled mixed-signal features.
• Investigate silicon failures with Design, Verification, Firmware, Test, Reliability, Product Engineering, and SSD/System teams. Form evidence-based hypotheses, design targeted experiments, identify root causes, and drive issues to verified closure through hardware, firmware, test-flow, trim, or workaround solutions.
• Convert silicon observations into engineering insight and product decisions by explaining deviations from expected behavior, assessing risk, recommending next actions, reviewing validation evidence, mentoring engineers, and improving reusable validation and debug methodologies.
Proven ability to leverage AI‑assisted (vibe) coding techniques to improve efficiency or automate design and analysis methodologies
Leverage AI tools to automate the tools and workflowApplying Artificial Intelligence in workflows to improve build efficiency
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with experience appropriate to the approved Senior Staff/Principal level.
• Strong analog and mixed-signal fundamentals with substantial experience in at least one of the following:
Mixed-signal verification
Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design
Post-silicon validation and characterization
Memory validation
• Experience with mixed-signal simulation environments, including full-chip, block-level, pre-layout, or post-layout simulations.
• Familiarity with Verilog/System-Verilog-based simulation and debug environments.
• Ability to derive tests from specifications, assess coverage, debug complex circuit behavior, and explain differences between expected and observed results.
• Experience with validation, characterization, data analysis, scripting, or automation using tools such as Python.
• Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• NAND Flash, SSD, DRAM, or other memory technology experience, including program/read/erase operations, sensing architectures, bias generation, charge pumps, timing/control circuits, reliability characterization, or system-level integration.
• Experience with System-Verilog, Verilog-AMS, real-number modeling, SPICE, assertions, functional coverage, or simulation-to-silicon correlation methodologies.
• Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, probe stations, source measurement units (SMUs), semiconductor parameter analyzers, automated test equipment (ATE), or similar silicon characterization platforms.

As an Electrical Design Engineer in the Systems Integration Group (SIG) of Micron Technology, Inc, you will design load boards that support semiconductor memory manufacturing, as well as resolve issues with and develop improvements to deployed automated test equipment (ATE) products.
Load boards, used for testing memory devices after they are manufactured & packaged, are the contact interface between ATE and pins of the device under test (DUT). Load boards contain the necessary components to:
setup the DUT for correct testing by the ATE;
route power, test, and response signals between the DUT and the ATE;
provide additional test capabilities that the ATE may not be able to provide; and,
alternately, testing or calibrate the ATE itself.
Load board design considerations, like other PCB assemblies, include DC power supply distribution, clock & digital routing, and high-speed signal integrity. You will apply circuit theory to design load board solutions working closely with other team members located around the world that include other engineering disciplines, technicians, procurement, planning, and external contract manufacturers.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
As an AI Reimagination Engineer in Micron's Generative AI Center of Excellence (GenAI COE), you have an outstanding chance to transform how businesses function. You will partner with different business areas to break down large, manual, multi-step processes and redesign them into effective, autonomous systems. This position combines process reimagination with AI systems engineering, making you a key part of the transformation journey. You will collaborate closely with the GenAI COE, IT architecture, security, and project teams. You will lead projects from the initial redesign to the final build, delivering solutions that business teams can adopt and scale.
Responsibilities:
Decompose end-to-end processes: Map current-state flows, quantify effort and risk, and lead eliminate/simplify/agentify analysis before automation.
Architect the agentic solution: Build future-state flows and AI architecture, including task and agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool and data access, memory and context strategy, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Translate inventions into buildable solutions by developing agent workflows, composing prompt and context strategies, MCP/connector and integration requirements, and evaluation criteria. Follow Micron's “Secure by Design” and data-classification standards.
Prototype and build: Construct working agentic solutions, or direct their build with platform engineers, validating fit and value prior to full delivery.
Engineer trust and control: Define testable human-in-the-loop controls and least-privilege permissions for each process step.
Drive multi-functional delivery: Collaborate across the client function, IT architecture, security, platform engineers, and the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) through first production release.
Measure value and codify patterns: Capture value baselines during discovery, support 30/90-day post-release measurement, and turn findings into reference flows, decomposition patterns, and playbooks. Mentor engineers and grow the network of agentic champions.
Minimum Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, AI/ML, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience blending technical delivery with business process work.
Hybrid Experience: Proven track record in both decomposing complex business processes and crafting or building technical solutions.
Agentic Delivery: 8+ years of overall experience and 3+ years in AI/ML. Recently, hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-based systems.
Preferred Qualifications:
Process Redesign: Experience leading workshop-based process redesign and translating findings into requirements. Familiar with AI governance, responsible-AI, security fundamentals, and validation/testing strategies for autonomous behavior.
Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with enterprise AI and automation platforms, and proficiency across Python, .NET/C#, SQL, and APIs. Depth in agent orchestration and multi-agent development, context management, and long-horizon tasks.
Communication: Excellent facilitation, written, and executive interpersonal skills. Proficient in running discovery with business leaders and driving alignment across business, engineering, and risk teams.

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
As the EHS Engineer, you will be responsible to Develop and implement EHS policies and procedures: Create and enforce EHS policies, programs, and practices in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards. Identify and Manage risk for environmental, health, and safety hazards in the workplace.
Job Description
Job Summary
The Safety & Health Engineer is responsible for leading the implementation of occupational health, process safety, and industrial safety programs within semiconductor manufacturing operations. The role ensures compliance with regulatory, corporate EHS standards and SEMI guidelines, while driving risk-based safety performance across fab construction, installation, and operations.
Semiconductor fabs operate with complex hazards including toxic chemicals, high-voltage systems, radiation, and cleanroom operations, requiring strong technical safety expertise
Safety & Health:
Site ISO14001/ISO45001/ Work safety standardization /RBA certification efforts and maintain continuous compliance against EHSMS standards, as well as continual improvement.
Act as the primary contact at the site for matters concerning EHS audit e.g., site internal audit, Global EHS audit, Registrar audit, and Customer audit, including planning for audit logistics.
Plan and execute regular site EHS management system and compliance audit, and report non-conformance, track CAPAs for all EHS related NCs and ensure they are closed effectively.
Report audit results and continual improvement opportunities to Site leadership.
Coordinate with team to prepare and conduct regular management system review.
Establish and maintain a process to monitor, measure, analyze and evaluate EHS performance and objective.
Establish and maintain process to manage the nonconformity from EHS audits/ inspections.
Incident investigation and corrective / preventive actions.
Risk elimination, improvising engineering, and administrative controls.
Establish and maintain EHS training, communication, and document control process/ program.
Write technical reports based on the interpretation of EHS data, observations, and current regulations regarding inspection findings and recommend corrective actions.
Driving the organization towards best-known/best-in-class EHS practices.
Oversee immediate program implementation for Emergency response preparedness (ERP) and Business Continuity Plan preparedness (BCP), Equipment Safety Buyoff, Mock drills, In House clinic Management, Good Catch, PPE Management, Confined Space Management, Work at Height Management, Live Safe Coordinator, Off the Job Safety, Traffic Control Management, HIRARC and Contractor Safety Management
Statutory Approvals as per Local Laws
EHS Department Budget Preparation & Tracking.
Coordinate and arrange Staff, Contractual Employee Health Checkup as per Local Laws.
Technical Skills
Strong Knowledge of
Equipment safety and Semiconductor/clean room standards/utilities
ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 systems/RBA compliance
Process safety, LOTO, PTW systems
Industrial hygiene and exposure monitoring
Using Artificial Intelligence for safety initiatives.
Core Competencies
Risk-based decision making
Strong stakeholder coordination (Construction, Operations, Facilities, Contractors)
Incident investigation and problem-solving
Leadership in safety culture development
Strong problem-solving skills, good analytical skills & experience in writing reports &
Excellent communication skills and good team working skills, Self-motivated.
Strong ability in English speaking and writing, be able to communicate with English speaking engineers both verbally and by writing.
Education Required:
Bachelor’s degree in safety & health engineering or any related field of study.
Experience Required:
Minimum 8 –12 years’ experience in Safety, Health and Environment.
Experience in fab environment, cleanroom protocols, facilities systems or complex industrial systems is a strong advantage

jobs.title: Revenue Analyst 3-Fin
jobs.description:
Oracle’s Global Finance Information Center (GFIC) in Bangalore is a strategic shared-services finance center supporting Oracle Finance. Within GFIC, the Accounts Receivables Center of Excellence manages global invoice-delivery operations and supports Oracle’s response to the evolving global e-invoicing and e-reporting landscape.
Job Summary
The Global E-Invoicing Business Analyst – IC3 will support the design, implementation, and rollout of e-invoicing and e-reporting capabilities across multiple countries.
This role serves as a bridge between country-specific regulatory requirements and the teams responsible for delivering scalable global solutions, including Tax, Finance, IT, Legal/Compliance, local teams, and external e-invoicing service providers.
The Business Analyst will take end-to-end ownership of assigned country requirements—from regulatory discovery and requirements definition through data mapping, testing, go-live, and stabilization—while promoting reuse of global standards and solution components.
Location: Bangalore, India
Level: IC3
Key Responsibilities
Analyze country-specific e-invoicing and e-reporting requirements, including invoice formats, mandatory data elements, validation rules, and submission, clearance, or reporting models.
Translate regulatory and business requirements into clear functional and system requirements, documenting assumptions, decisions, gaps, dependencies, and required outcomes.
Map e-invoice requirements to ERP, billing, tax, customer, vendor, and other relevant source-system data; identify gaps and coordinate their resolution.
Partner with Tax, Finance, Legal/Compliance, IT, local teams, and external service providers to support solution design, integration, and implementation.
Coordinate end-to-end country rollout activities spanning discovery, design, mapping, testing, readiness assessment, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live stabilization.
Develop and support test scenarios, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), invoice-data validation, defect resolution, and end-to-end testing across standard and exception scenarios.
Track implementation milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and open issues; provide timely stakeholder updates and escalate blockers appropriately.
Maintain standardized implementation documentation and promote reuse of global requirements, templates, mappings, and solution components while accommodating legitimate country-specific requirements.
Qualifications & Skills
Mandatory
Experience analyzing and translating business and/or regulatory requirements into functional and system requirements.
Experience with data analysis and field mapping across enterprise systems or data sources.
Experience supporting end-to-end implementations or rollouts, including requirements, testing, readiness, go-live, and stabilization activities.
Experience developing or supporting test scenarios, UAT, data validation, and defect resolution.
Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple stakeholders, including business, Finance/Tax, technology teams, local teams, and/or external providers.
Ability to manage implementation risks, dependencies, milestones, open issues, and documentation.
Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, communication, and documentation capabilities.
Good-to-Have
Prior exposure to e-invoicing and/or e-reporting implementations.
Understanding of country-specific electronic invoicing models such as submission, clearance, and reporting.
Experience working across ERP, billing, tax, customer, or vendor data environments.
Experience supporting multi-country or global implementations.
Exposure to Finance, Accounts Receivable, invoice-delivery, tax compliance, or related processes.
Experience working with external e-invoicing or technology service providers.

Do I have hands-on experience translating complex business or regulatory requirements into clear functional or system requirements?

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Regulatory AI and Content Specialist
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
Location : Hyderabad
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.
Mission
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
As part of Roche’s Product Development (PD), Product Development Regulatory (PDR) strengthens regulatory capabilities through scalable models and sustainable solutions that support evolving regulatory requirements, global drug development priorities, and continuous innovation, leveraging automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and emerging technologies.
The Position
As a Regulatory AI & Content Specialist, you will serve as the bridge between Pharma Development Regulatory (PDR) , content management, and AI-enabled technology, driving the digital transformation of regulatory content within the PDR organization. In this role, you will leverage your understanding of regulatory documents, content structures, and submission requirements to design, standardize, and optimize reusable regulatory content for AI-powered authoring and automation. You will play a key role in setting up, configuring and managing content use cases and templates within the in house GenAI powered platform enabling efficient, consistent, and compliant regulatory document generation for a global regulatory organization.
You will also work directly alongside document authors supporting, and where needed leading, the drafting of regulatory documents using AI-enabled authoring capabilities ensuring that what the platform produces is genuinely usable, high quality, and submission-ready.
Key Responsibilities
Regulatory Content & AI Expertise
Have a strong understanding of regulatory/ Clinical documents across the drug development lifecycle and CTD-based submissions.
Apply knowledge of Generative AI, structured content, and regulatory authoring principles to support AI-enabled content creation and document standardization.
Stay current with evolving regulatory requirements, AI capabilities, and industry best practices.
Regulatory Template/ Content Management
Analyze regulatory documents and convert them into standardized templates, reusable content components, and structured content models within the in house GenAI powered platform.
Configure and maintain templates, metadata, and content library assets to enable efficient, compliant, and AI-assisted regulatory authoring.
Support content governance through template lifecycle management, version control, and content quality.
Platform Enablement & Collaboration
Serve as a super user for the GenAI powered platform, providing business support, user enablement, and contribute towards continuous improvement initiatives to enhance platform adoption and operational efficiency.
Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), business validation, and release readiness activities for new platform capabilities.
Collaborate with stakeholders across PDR, PD, PT (Pharma Technical) and RDT (Roche Digital Technology) colleagues to align regulatory content with business and platform requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve regulatory content development through AI, automation, and low-code/no-code capabilities.
Who You Are
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
4–6 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Operations, Regulatory Medical Writing, Medical Writing, or a related pharmaceutical role.
Experience in leading/ supporting clinical or marketing authorization submissions, with a good understanding of the drug development lifecycle, ICH guidelines, CTD/eCTD structure, and regulatory expectations of major health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, or Health Canada).
Ability to critically review and interpret regulatory, clinical, and safety documents, and translate them into standardized, structured content for AI-enabled authoring.
Knowledge of Generative AI, AI-enabled content authoring, and digital technologies, with an interest in applying them to regulatory processes.
Experience with structured content authoring, document templating, content management, Regulatory Information Management (RIM), or AI-enabled authoring platforms; familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms is desirable.
Experience in leading/ supporting digital platform implementation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), or business validation activities is preferred.
Excellent analytical, written communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with a continuous learning mindset and attention to detail.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

As an IT Project Manager at the P3 level, you will own medium-to-complex projects end-to-end: shaping the business case, driving planning and execution, and delivering measurable outcomes on time and within budget. You will operate with real independence, determining the best path to the objective while partnering closely with business sponsors, technical teams, vendors, and Micron leadership.
This role is positioned for a project manager who has moved beyond executing defined tasks and is trusted to lead through ambiguity, influence stakeholders without formal authority, mentor less experienced team members, and build the independent judgment needed for driving project outcomes
Responsibilities:
Project Initiation
Develop project charters that clearly define objectives, scope, benefits, and success criteria.
Identify stakeholders and build RACI matrices that establish clear decision rights from day one.
Define high-level scope, milestones, and timelines aligned to the business case and Micron’s strategic roadmap.
Identify cross-domain dependencies early and connect the problem to project and PMO outcomes, not just deliverables.
Support vendor selection and partner engagement through scoping conversations and early commercial input.
Project Planning
Establish project governance, including sponsors, core team, and extended project team, and drive effective kickoff activities.
Facilitate business and technical requirements gathering across functional and technical stakeholder groups.
Establish and maintain project management artifacts, ensuring a well-governed and transparent tracking of project progress, risks, and dependencies
Forecast project spend, SOWs, and POs, and support financial planning and budget tracking throughout the lifecycle.
Support executive reviews and stage-gate approvals with decision-ready materials, not just status updates.
Project Execution & Closure
Manage project scope, quality, schedule, and deliverables, adapting the plan as new information emerges.
Track development, SOE, and UAT milestones, and translate progress into clear, decision-ready status for leadership.
Proactively manage risks, issues, and escalations by bringing recommendations and options, not just problems.
Provide consistent and accurate status reporting to PMO and leadership teams.
Facilitate lessons learned and drive formal project closure and approval.
Leadership and PMO Excellence
Lead cross-functional project teams and build shared alignment around the project vision.
Resolve conflicts constructively and manage resource allocation across the project team.
Provide mentorship to less experienced team members and contribute to continuous improvement in PMO process efficiency.
Actively adopt AI-enabled tools and workflows to improve planning, reporting, and delivery efficiency.
Qualifications & Skills:
5+ years of Project Management experience, including ownership of medium-to-complex, cross-functional projects.
Demonstrated ability to work independently under project or sub-function objectives, determining the best method to deliver rather than requiring step-by-step direction.
Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies, applied to fit the project context.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce decision-ready updates for sponsors and leadership.
Strong change management capabilities and experience facilitating stakeholder alignment without formal authority.
Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity, reporting, or analytics tools applied to project or portfolio management.
Experience mentoring junior project team members
Inclusive, collaborative, and comfortable engaging with technical, non-technical, vendor, and leadership teams.
Preferred Qualifications:
PMP certification.
Experience managing enterprise-wide, cross-functional programs spanning multiple sites or geographies.
Education and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Project Management, or equivalent certifications/professional experience. Related disciplines considered.
Minimum of 5 years of project management experience in enterprise technology, infrastructure, security, digital workplace, platform migration, application delivery or related programs

Success in this role is measured through strong delivery against P3 expectations, including independent decision-making, governance leadership, stakeholder influence, analytical rigor, AI-enabled PMO excellence, coaching, integrity, and measurable project outcomes.
Career Growth:
Strong, sustained performance against the P3 competency bar, particularly independent decision-making, governance leadership, and coaching, is the primary pathway to expanded scope and future progression.

Leadership & Soft Skills: Recognized technical authority with strong executive‑level interpersonal skills. Ability to make and defend data‑driven architectural trade‑offs. Lead complex customer issue investigations, including issue replication, Level 1 debugging, root cause analysis, and failure analysis, and manage issues from escalation through resolution using Jira or an equivalent issue-tracking system.
Drive customer issue prioritization, turnaround-time tracking, technical reviews, and escalation management while coordinating engineering, validation, quality, product management, field organizations, and ecosystem partners.
Support customer qualification, platform integration, deployment, production ramp, sustaining activities, Level 1 performance testing, workload characterization, performance analysis, interoperability testing, validation, and technical troubleshooting for assigned SSD products and solutions.
Communicate product capabilities, limitations, technical requirements, qualification criteria, deployment considerations, and technical findings through clear, accurate, actionable, and customer-appropriate communications.
Own firmware release management, including release planning, deployment readiness, firmware change-list development, release documentation, approval coordination, customer communications, and technical input for customer-specific firmware requirements.
Develop and maintain customer-facing technical documentation, including standard and custom datasheets, application notes, errata, firmware release communications, troubleshooting guides, and related technical collateral, and review Product Change Requests (PCRs) for impacts on documentation and customer deliverables.
Deliver technical training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing for Field Application Engineers (FAEs), Customer Quality Engineers (CQEs), Technical Customer Managers (TCMs), and support organizations, and align technical execution with qualification schedules, customer priorities, identified risks, and business commitments.
Provide technical ownership and support for SSD management and diagnostic tools, including MSECLI, SuperDM, and Storage Executive, and coordinate tool-related issue resolution and enablement needs.
Drive Design-for-Debug initiatives, incorporate customer and field feedback into Market Requirements Documents (MRDs), product readiness activities, and roadmap planning, and analyze recurring issues to improve product quality, reliability, usability, support readiness, and customer experience.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, with 13 or more years of relevant experience in SSD technologies, storage systems, firmware engineering, hardware engineering, applications engineering, product engineering, validation engineering, technical support, or a related technical field.
Deep expertise in SSD architecture, NAND Flash technologies, storage controllers, firmware interactions, enterprise or data center storage systems, and storage technologies and protocols, including NVMe, PCIe, SATA, and SAS.
Proven experience leading customer escalations, issue replication, debugging, root cause analysis, failure analysis, and complex technical problem resolution.
Experience supporting product qualification, deployment, production ramp, sustaining activities, and post-deployment customer support, including firmware release management, technical documentation, and customer or field enablement.
Experience coordinating cross-functional technical investigations and managing issues through resolution using Jira or an equivalent issue-tracking system.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, accurate, actionable, and audience-appropriate communications.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making skills, with excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, influence decisions, and lead strategic initiatives across global and matrixed organizations. Equivalent combinations of education, training, certifications, and experience may be considered in accordance with company policy and applicable requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
Experience supporting SSD products across qualification, validation, deployment, production ramp, firmware release, sustaining support, and post-deployment customer support in enterprise, data center, hyperscale, cloud, OEM, or other large-scale storage environments.
Expertise in SSD performance characterization, workload analysis, reliability engineering, product qualification, validation methodologies, interoperability testing, firmware release management, change control processes, Product Change Requests (PCRs), and Market Requirements Documents (MRDs).
Familiarity with SSD management and diagnostic tools, automation frameworks, validation environments, technical data analysis, and customer qualification workflows, with proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Perl, Shell scripting, or comparable automation technologies.
Experience working with customers, OEMs, hyperscalers, cloud service providers, ecosystem partners, or global engineering organizations and collaborating with Technical Customer Managers, Field Application Engineers, Customer Quality Engineers, product teams, and other customer-facing organizations.
Experience translating field feedback and customer requirements into product improvements, technical requirements, readiness plans, and roadmap recommendations; developing technical documentation and delivering training; and applying or leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to improve engineering workflows, technical analysis, issue triage, automation, knowledge management, documentation, or customer support.

SSD Applications Engineering, SSD Architecture, Solid State Drives (SSD), NAND Flash, NVMe, PCIe, SATA, SAS, Firmware Engineering, Storage Controllers, Enterprise Storage, Data Center Storage, Hyperscale Storage, Cloud Storage, Product

jobs.title: SR, Engineer - AMS Verification
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Roles and Responsibilities
· Plan and execute verification of analog and mixed-signal circuits at block, subsystem, and full-chip levels.
· Develop and maintain full-chip mixed-signal simulation environments in which analog circuitry, digital logic, and firmware coexist.
· Create schematic and behavioral models for selected blocks to make full-chip simulations feasible, efficient, and sufficiently accurate for the intended verification objective.
· Develop verification plans from design data sheets, new feature requests, requirements, interface definitions, and identified risk areas.
· Run static and dynamic simulations to identify leakage paths, power-sequencing issues, and unintended circuit interactions.
· Perform device-level electrical rule checks, including SOA, snapback, SFB, and related reliability checks.
· Perform SPF extraction analysis and fanout, connectivity, and coupling checks.
· Execute power-cycling simulations, including power-loss and brownout events.
· Run chip-level user-mode simulations that correlate analog subsystems, logic behavior, and firmware algorithms.
· Debug complex AMS failures with a system-level outlook, identify root causes, and work with design, firmware, and verification partners to drive closure.
· Develop scripts and reusable automation for regression setup, simulation execution, log processing, waveform analysis, result comparison, and report generation.
· Develop AI-assisted engineering flows and agent-based tools that automate or accelerate repetitive AMS verification activities.
· Prototype engineering agents for use cases such as requirement-to-test extraction, verification-plan assistance, regression triage, log summarization, failure clustering, waveform-analysis guidance, coverage-gap identification, and technical report generation.
· Integrate approved engineering data, scripts, simulation results, and documentation into reusable AI workflows with clear validation checks and human review.
· Define success criteria, evaluate the accuracy and usefulness of AI-generated outputs, document limitations, and ensure that final verification decisions remain grounded in simulations, specifications, and engineering judgment.
· Collaborate with Product Engineering, Test, Probe, Process Integration, Assembly, and other partner teams to improve product quality, root-cause analysis, reliability, cost, and time-to-market.
Minimum Qualifications
· Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline with 3+ years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree in Engineering with relevant experience.
· Understanding of MOS device physics, including important second-order effects.
· Working knowledge of analog and mixed-signal circuits such as current mirrors, bandgap references, operational amplifiers, regulators, ADCs, DACs, and charge pumps.
· Hands-on experience with AMS verification, including testbench development, simulation setup, regression execution, waveform analysis, and debug.
· Familiarity with Virtuoso, HSPICE, XA or FastSPICE-class simulators, and co-simulation environments.
· Familiarity with hardware description languages such as Verilog/SystemVerilog and Verilog-A/Verilog-AMS.
· Working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and scripting using Python, Perl, shell, or an equivalent language.
· Exposure to AI development concepts or workflows, such as large language models, prompt-based automation, retrieval-augmented generation, AI-assisted coding, or agent-based systems.
· Ability to use AI-assisted development responsibly, validate generated outputs, and convert a verification pain point into a practical automation prototype.
· Strong debugging mindset, ability to understand complex workflows, and a consistent drive to innovate and improve verification efficiency.
· Good communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
· Deep knowledge of NAND memory architecture and periphery circuits.
· Experience with analog and digital simulators such as HSPICE, FastSPICE, XA, and Verilog-based simulation flows.
· Experience building or maintaining chip-level analog and mixed-signal co-simulation environments.
· Familiarity with Cadence design environments and LVS/DRC tools.
· Proficiency in Python and experience working with APIs, structured data, version control, and maintainable software-development practices.
· Experience prototyping an AI agent or multi-step AI workflow using requirements, data sheets, simulation logs, waveform-derived data, verification results, or engineering documentation.
· Familiarity with tool-calling, retrieval, evaluation methods, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review for reliable engineering AI applications.
· Experience measuring the benefit of an automation or AI flow using indicators such as reduced manual effort, faster debug, improved traceability, or better verification completeness.
· Ability to collaborate across AMS design, circuit verification, firmware, CAD, data engineering, and software teams.

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
Contributing to the development of new product opportunities by assisting with the overall design, layout, and optimization of Memory/Logic/Analog circuits
Parasitic modeling and assisting in design validation, reticle experiments and required tape-out revisions
Leading all aspects of and managing the layout process including floor-planning, placement, and routing
Performing verification processes with modeling and simulation using industry standard simulators
Contributing to cross group communication to work towards standardization and group success
Working with Marketing, Probe, Assembly, Test, Process Integration, and Product Engineering groups to ensure accurate manufacturability of product
Proactively solicit mentorship from Standards, CAD, modeling, and verification groups to improve the design quality
Driving innovation into the future Memory generations within a dynamic work environment
Design Planning & Top-Level Integration
Perform top-level virtual flat placement to explore partitioning options and validate hierarchy quality before commit.
Implement top-level global routing to derive congestion, timing, and pin-feasibility signals that drive planning decisions.
Own partition creation: block shaping, abutment, channel/keep-out definition, and power-domain planning.
Drive pin optimization / pin cutting — pin placement, alignment, and count reduction guided by top-level routing.
Plan and implement repeater / feedthrough insertion: budget top-level nets, place repeaters, and manage crossings across partition boundaries.
Generate block-level constraints (timing budgets, boundary SDC, ILM/ETM models, physical constraints) directly from the design planning tool and hand them off to block owners.
Perform top-level assembly: integrate block-related work (LEF/DEF/GDS/ETM/ILM), close top-level timing, DRC, LVS, and EM/IR, and iterate ECOs to convergence.
Block-Level APR
Implement full APR flow (init → floorplan → place → CTS → route → ECO → sign-off) on digital blocks; own block-level STA sign-off across corners alongside DRC, LVS, EM/IR, and antenna closure.
Set up new project and revision environments — collateral (SDC, netlist, LEF, QTM), stdlib migrations, and constraint authoring.
Debug and correlate synthesis vs. APR vs. STA (PPA regressions, DRV, size_only/don't_touch strategy, scan chain stitching).
Methodology & Automation/AI
Automate flows in Tcl / SKILL / Python; extend internal make-based flow and contribute to shared analysis tooling and dashboards.
Improve the processes efficiency and quality leveraging AI flows
Partner with STA, DFT, CAD, and custom-layout teams; document methodology and provide mentorship to engineers gaining experience.

The SME team is looking for a Senior Software Integration Engineer who can contribute independently in complex situations while supporting quality, engineering, and delivery goals. This position is responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining tests that validate interactions across integrated components, systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies. The candidate will help establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, optimize performance, improve customer satisfaction, and support compliance.
The role also requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can guide others informally and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions.

• Perform QE activities across assigned projects, including test planning, strategy, validation, automation, and release readiness.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to enhance testing processes and strengthen quality practices.
• Contribute to SME QE teams focused on test validation and automation within assigned projects.

• Establish and maintain QA processes and standards that prevent defects, improve quality, optimize performance, and support customer expectations.

• Analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to ensure work moves smoothly from one stage to the next.
• Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices by supporting automated test execution, version control, and integration of test automation into delivery pipelines.
• Provide technical guidance to team members, support proof-of-concepts, coach others informally, and help teams adopt scalable and maintainable test automation practices.
• Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
• Promote agile ways of working, continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team.

• Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and software validation across complex technology programs.

• Experience designing and maintaining integration tests that validate data flows, interfaces, dependencies, web services, and system interactions.
• Experience with API performance testing and exposure to performance testing tools such as Gatling and BlazeMeter.
• Strong understanding of requirements management, including documenting, analyzing, tracing, prioritizing, agreeing on, and communicating requirements and changes to stakeholders.
• Strong understanding of software development life cycle practices, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
• Experience with systems integration, including validating communication and interoperability across applications, services, technologies, and processes.
• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues across systems, applications, services, test environments, and networks.
• Experience with web services and standardized protocols that enable communication, data exchange, interoperability, scalability, and integration across diverse systems.
• Ability to analyze workflows, identify bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, allocate resources, and adapt processes to achieve outcomes.
• Working knowledge of version control tools such as Git.
• Experience with API testing tools such as Insomnia.
• Experience with test case management tools such as XRay.
• Experience with project management tools such as Jira.
• Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
• Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering and quality practices, including GitHub Copilot, Playwright MCP servers, and automation accelerators.
• Ability to work on proof-of-concepts.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present quality insights clearly.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer Analog Design
jobs.description:
Analog Design, Sr Engineer
We Are:
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
You Are
You are a passionate Analog Design Engineer with strong expertise in the design and development of analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits. You have hands-on experience designing high-performance analog IPs including High-Speed I/O (HSTIO), LVDS interfaces, Crystal Oscillators, Bias Generators, Bandgap References, LDO Regulators, Supply Monitoring Circuits, and related analog building blocks.
You enjoy solving complex circuit design challenges and have a deep understanding of transistor-level design, circuit optimization, and silicon validation. You are comfortable working across the entire product lifecycle from architecture definition and circuit implementation to layout review, silicon bring-up, and characterization.
You thrive in collaborative environments, partnering with layout, digital, verification, product engineering, and validation teams to deliver robust and production-quality designs. You are detail-oriented, technically curious, and motivated to develop high-performance analog solutions for next-generation semiconductor products.
What You'll Be Doing
Design, develop, and validate analog and mixed-signal IP blocks including High-Speed I/O (HSTIO), LVDS interfaces, Crystal Oscillators, Bandgap References, Bias Generators, LDO Regulators, Supply Detectors, and other analog building blocks.
Perform transistor-level circuit design, simulation, and optimization across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) conditions.
Execute comprehensive pre-layout and post-layout verification including corner, Monte Carlo, mismatch, noise, reliability, and performance analysis.
Work closely with layout teams to implement high-performance analog layout methodologies including matching, shielding, isolation, and parasitic optimization.
Participate in architecture definition, design reviews, documentation, and technical discussions.
Collaborate with digital, verification, validation, and product engineering teams to ensure successful integration and product execution.
Support silicon bring-up, characterization, debugging, and correlation of silicon results with simulation data.
Contribute to design methodologies that improve performance, robustness, power efficiency, and product quality.
Apply analog design best practices, including awareness of ESD protection and reliability requirements.
What You'll Need
Strong experience in analog and mixed-signal circuit design.
Proven expertise in one or more of the following areas: High-Speed I/O (HSTIO), LVDS, Crystal Oscillators, Bandgap References, Bias Circuits, LDO Regulators, Supply Detection Circuits, or related analog IPs.
Solid understanding of transistor-level analog design fundamentals including gain, bandwidth, noise, stability, matching, and power optimization.
Experience with industry-standard analog design and simulation tools.
Strong knowledge of pre-layout and post-layout verification methodologies, including PVT, Monte Carlo, reliability, and corner simulations.
Experience working closely with layout engineers on analog layout reviews and parasitic-aware design optimization.
Exposure to silicon bring-up, characterization, debugging, and lab validation.
Understanding of ESD protection concepts and analog reliability considerations is preferred.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Who You Are:
An analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and keen attention to detail.
A collaborative team player who values diversity, inclusion, and open communication.
A proactive learner who stays current with industry trends and emerging technologies.
An effective communicator, able to translate complex technical information to diverse audiences.
A results-driven individual who is adaptable, resilient, and comfortable with fast-paced, high-impact work.
The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
You’ll join a passionate, multidisciplinary team of analog and mixed-signal engineers dedicated to advancing Synopsys’ interface IP portfolio. The team is focused on delivering robust, innovative, and high-quality solutions that meet the rigorous demands of a global customer base. Collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical mentorship are at the core of our culture, ensuring you’ll have the support and opportunities needed to thrive and grow.
Rewards and Benefits:
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Job Description
As a Global Quality Front-End Central Quality Assurance Remote Operation Control (GQ FECTQA ROC) Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will be part of a global organization responsible for centralized quality operations supporting Micron wafer fabrication sites across Asia and the United States. You will play a critical role in safeguarding product quality through automated quality screening, lot disposition, statistical risk assessment, and operational excellence initiatives.
In this role, you will leverage advanced statistical analysis, semiconductor process knowledge, automation, and data-driven decision-making to identify quality and reliability risks, recommend appropriate product dispositions, and drive network-wide quality improvements. You will collaborate closely with Site QA, Product Engineering, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Global Quality teams to ensure consistent execution of quality control strategies and defect containment actions across the Micron network.
You Will:
Design and Develop Quality Screening and Disposition Systems
Develop quality screening strategies, business rules, and disposition plans for deployment in Micron's centralized quality systems.
Configure and maintain automated lot hold, disposition, and containment workflows.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to establish risk-based quality control methodologies.
Support implementation and validation of quality system enhancements and screening improvements.
Ensure robust controls and interlocks are implemented to minimize quality escapes and operational risks.
Execute Wafer Lot Disposition and Quality Risk Assessment
Evaluate wafer lots impacted by planned or unplanned manufacturing deviations.
Assess quality and reliability risks using electrical test data, physical characterization results, process history, and statistical analysis.
Interpret outlier signals, defect signatures, and excursion indicators to determine appropriate disposition actions.
Support disposition activities related to Fab Conversions, Quality Deviations, Special Work Requests, and Manufacturing Excursions.
Document disposition decisions and provide technical justification to stakeholders.
Perform Advanced Data Analytics and Statistical Monitoring
Analyze large manufacturing datasets to identify abnormal signatures, trends, and potential quality risks.
Develop statistical models and methodologies for outlier detection, screening optimization, and excursion monitoring.
Perform distribution analysis, SPC review, baseline trending, and risk assessment activities.
Create dashboards, metrics, and reporting solutions to improve operational visibility and decision-making.

jobs.title: SR, Engineer - AMS Verification
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Roles and Responsibilities
· Plan and execute verification of analog and mixed-signal circuits at block, subsystem, and full-chip levels.
· Develop and maintain full-chip mixed-signal simulation environments in which analog circuitry, digital logic, and firmware coexist.
· Create schematic and behavioral models for selected blocks to make full-chip simulations feasible, efficient, and sufficiently accurate for the intended verification objective.
· Develop verification plans from design data sheets, new feature requests, requirements, interface definitions, and identified risk areas.
· Run static and dynamic simulations to identify leakage paths, power-sequencing issues, and unintended circuit interactions.
· Perform device-level electrical rule checks, including SOA, snapback, SFB, and related reliability checks.
· Perform SPF extraction analysis and fanout, connectivity, and coupling checks.
· Execute power-cycling simulations, including power-loss and brownout events.
· Run chip-level user-mode simulations that correlate analog subsystems, logic behavior, and firmware algorithms.
· Debug complex AMS failures with a system-level outlook, identify root causes, and work with design, firmware, and verification partners to drive closure.
· Develop scripts and reusable automation for regression setup, simulation execution, log processing, waveform analysis, result comparison, and report generation.
· Develop AI-assisted engineering flows and agent-based tools that automate or accelerate repetitive AMS verification activities.
· Prototype engineering agents for use cases such as requirement-to-test extraction, verification-plan assistance, regression triage, log summarization, failure clustering, waveform-analysis guidance, coverage-gap identification, and technical report generation.
· Integrate approved engineering data, scripts, simulation results, and documentation into reusable AI workflows with clear validation checks and human review.
· Define success criteria, evaluate the accuracy and usefulness of AI-generated outputs, document limitations, and ensure that final verification decisions remain grounded in simulations, specifications, and engineering judgment.
· Collaborate with Product Engineering, Test, Probe, Process Integration, Assembly, and other partner teams to improve product quality, root-cause analysis, reliability, cost, and time-to-market.
Minimum Qualifications
· Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline with 3+ years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree in Engineering with relevant experience.
· Understanding of MOS device physics, including important second-order effects.
· Working knowledge of analog and mixed-signal circuits such as current mirrors, bandgap references, operational amplifiers, regulators, ADCs, DACs, and charge pumps.
· Hands-on experience with AMS verification, including testbench development, simulation setup, regression execution, waveform analysis, and debug.
· Familiarity with Virtuoso, HSPICE, XA or FastSPICE-class simulators, and co-simulation environments.
· Familiarity with hardware description languages such as Verilog/SystemVerilog and Verilog-A/Verilog-AMS.
· Working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and scripting using Python, Perl, shell, or an equivalent language.
· Exposure to AI development concepts or workflows, such as large language models, prompt-based automation, retrieval-augmented generation, AI-assisted coding, or agent-based systems.
· Ability to use AI-assisted development responsibly, validate generated outputs, and convert a verification pain point into a practical automation prototype.
· Strong debugging mindset, ability to understand complex workflows, and a consistent drive to innovate and improve verification efficiency.
· Good communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
· Deep knowledge of NAND memory architecture and periphery circuits.
· Experience with analog and digital simulators such as HSPICE, FastSPICE, XA, and Verilog-based simulation flows.
· Experience building or maintaining chip-level analog and mixed-signal co-simulation environments.
· Familiarity with Cadence design environments and LVS/DRC tools.
· Proficiency in Python and experience working with APIs, structured data, version control, and maintainable software-development practices.
· Experience prototyping an AI agent or multi-step AI workflow using requirements, data sheets, simulation logs, waveform-derived data, verification results, or engineering documentation.
· Familiarity with tool-calling, retrieval, evaluation methods, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review for reliable engineering AI applications.
· Experience measuring the benefit of an automation or AI flow using indicators such as reduced manual effort, faster debug, improved traceability, or better verification completeness.
· Ability to collaborate across AMS design, circuit verification, firmware, CAD, data engineering, and software teams.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager- TDP Insights and Data Resiliency
jobs.description:
Job Details | Atlassian
Senior Engineering Manager- TDP Insights and Data Resiliency
Engineering | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote | Full-Time
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India. You will work closely with engineering teams in India and Australia and coordinate strategy, priorities, and execution with leadership in the United States.
Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. It helps those teams manage persistent customer data while meeting complex enterprise requirements, including data residency, encryption, regulatory compliance, backup and recovery, and operation across multiple cloud environments.
TDP Insights provides the intelligence layer for the Trusted Data Platform. It helps teams understand where data lives, how it moves, what it costs, how reliably it operates, and how customers use TDP services. By transforming high-volume platform telemetry into actionable insights, it supports better decisions about reliability, capacity, cost, compliance, recovery readiness, and developer experience.
Atlassian Data Resiliency (ADR) strengthens end-to-end recovery across TDP. It provides common backup and restore capabilities, recovery assurance, RPO and RTO evidence, validation, restore exercises, and consistent resiliency standards across TDP data platforms.
We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the TDP Insights and ADR engineering team. This leader will be accountable for the team’s people, strategy, execution, and operational outcomes. They will partner with senior engineers, product and program leaders, storage and streaming teams, infrastructure teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations to improve how Atlassian understands, protects, and recovers its data.
Success in this role means building a strong engineering organization, delivering trusted platform insights and recovery capabilities, and translating complex customer, reliability, and infrastructure requirements into a clear and executable roadmap.
Team and organizational leadership
Lead, coach, and develop engineers and senior technical leaders, establishing clear expectations and accountability.
Build an inclusive, high-performing team through effective hiring, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
Develop senior technical and leadership talent by delegating meaningful ownership to senior engineers and emerging leaders.
Establish operating practices that support good decisions, predictable execution, and continuous improvement.
Manage capacity across strategic investments, customer commitments, operational work, and technical debt.
Build an effective distributed-team operating model across India and Australia, with clear alignment and communication with leadership in the United States.
Strategy and execution
Define and execute the TDP Insights and ADR strategy and roadmap in alignment with Atlassian’s broader data-platform and cloud-infrastructure goals.
Translate enterprise, product, platform, and recovery requirements into measurable outcomes, milestones, and engineering plans.
Surface delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, capacity constraints, and required trade-offs early.
Establish clear ownership and decision-making responsibilities across TDP Insights, ADR, TDP data platforms, and partner teams.
Deliver actionable insights into platform health, customer adoption, cost, data movement, compliance, and recovery readiness.
Improve recovery confidence through common capabilities, clear standards, validation, and repeatable restore exercises.
Reliability and customer trust
Own the operational health of TDP Insights and ADR capabilities, including availability, data quality, performance, security, compliance, and recoverability.
Establish service-level objectives, operational indicators, review mechanisms, and sustainable on-call practices.
Establish trustworthy measures for backup coverage, restore validation, RPO and RTO performance, and recovery readiness.
Lead the response to material incidents and ensure that lessons produce durable technical and organizational improvements.
Ensure that TDP Insights and ADR support enterprise needs such as data residency, encryption, disaster recovery, regulated environments, and multi-cloud operation.
Maintain clear visibility into customer and recovery commitments and intervene when delivery, reliability, or data-integrity risks threaten those outcomes.
Technical and platform leadership
Partner with senior technical leaders to establish architectural direction and make high-quality technical decisions.
Guide the evolution of large-scale telemetry, analytics, backup, restore, and recovery capabilities across multiple cloud providers and specialized operating environments.
Ensure designs account for scalability, data locality, security, compliance, data quality, migration safety, operability, and reversibility.
Establish technical and operational standards for data collection, processing, analytics, recovery validation, and integration with TDP data platforms.
Balance near-term delivery with platform simplification, lifecycle management, cloud portability, and reduction of operational burden.
Establish clear technical and operational contracts with storage, streaming, control-plane, infrastructure, and customer teams.
Cross-functional leadership and economics
Build trusted partnerships across product, engineering, security, compliance, reliability, infrastructure, FinOps, and customer-facing teams.
Coordinate effectively across engineering teams in India and Australia and leadership stakeholders in the United States.
Resolve cross-organizational dependencies through explicit owners, acceptance criteria, and delivery dates.
Represent TDP Insights and ADR in engineering reviews, leadership forums, operational reviews, architecture discussions, and portfolio planning.
Use platform telemetry and operational evidence to inform investment, reliability, capacity, and customer-adoption decisions.
Own the cost posture of the team’s capabilities, including infrastructure efficiency, demand forecasting, unit economics, and cost attribution.
Make investment decisions that prioritize customer trust, strategic platform value, and sustainable cost efficiency.
Minimum qualifications:
Significant engineering leadership experience.
Demonstrated success building or operating a business-critical distributed system, data platform, analytics platform, storage service, resiliency platform, or comparable infrastructure product.
Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, organizational design, hiring, and succession planning.
Experience converting ambiguous strategies and customer requirements into clear roadmaps, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, reliability engineering, security, and operational risk.
Experience operating large-scale production systems with clear service-level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and sustainable operational practices.
Experience delivering enterprise capabilities such as data residency, encryption, compliance, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, or tenant isolation.
Proven ability to lead incident response and convert operational learning into lasting improvements.
Strong cross-functional influence and experience resolving dependencies between organizations with different priorities.
Experience leading teams and programs across multiple geographies and time zones.
Sound judgment when balancing reliability, strategic alignment, delivery speed, cost, and technical sustainability.
Clear communication skills appropriate for engineers, executives, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders.
Experience with high-scale telemetry and analytics systems, streaming and data-processing technologies such as Kafka or Flink, analytical query platforms, distributed storage, backup and restore systems, multi-cloud infrastructure, or internal developer platforms is beneficial but not required.
Benefits & Perks
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.
