jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
About the Team
The Digital Employee Experience Collaboration team, part of Business Technology (BT) at Workday, delivers innovative, engaging digital experiences for our global workforce. Operating at the intersection of technology, artificial intelligence and employee experience, our goal is to eliminate friction and elevate productivity across a fast-paced, distributed workforce.
We partner closely with teams across Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, HR, Employee Communications, and other functions to deliver seamless, integrated experiences that support business operations and help Workmates do their best work. We are a collaborative, dynamic team that values creativity, innovation, customer empathy, and continuous improvement.
About the Role
In this role you will deliver outstanding Collaboration service to the enterprise demonstrating our SaaS product suite which comprises of Slack, Google Workspace, O365 (Microsoft Teams) and other applications like Miro, Asana and Smartsheet. Join a team of hardworking, multifaceted, and hard-working engineers who take personal pride in the service they provide to our workmates and external clients.
The ideal candidate should have a passion for operational excellence, automation, AI engineering solutions, and developing modern collaborative workflows. This person must be driven with a strong capacity to quickly adapt to a meaningful pace of work and an interest in learning new technologies. You will possess the ability to balance multiple tasks while operating across a large range of technologies simultaneously, ensuring daily operational responsibilities are met alongside customer SLAs. The successful candidate will be willing to take on tasks outside of their immediate knowledge base, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and communicate effectively—both written and verbally—in technical and non-technical language across multi-functional teams.
About You
Basic Qualifications:
Professional Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience in IT engineering, platform administration, or enterprise systems engineering.
AI Platform Readiness: Hands-on experience or interest in integrating enterprise AI tools and third-party SaaS products with enterprise collaboration stacks.
Enterprise Platform Expertise: Deep administrative expertise across core collaboration platforms, specifically Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Vault), Slack Enterprise Grid, and Microsoft 365 / MS Teams.
Automation & Scripting: Demonstrated proficiency in architecting automated workflows and scripts using Python, PowerShell, Google Apps Script, REST APIs, and command-line administration tools such as GAM and Google Admin SDK.
Technical Operations (L3/L4): Proven experience operating as an escalation point for complex L3/L4 technical issues, incident management, root cause analysis, and ticketing systems (ServiceNow or Jira).
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
Other Qualifications:
Global Support & Coordination: Ability to coordinate across global operations and maintain seamless daily handoffs across time zones (PST / IST) to ensure 24x5 coverage.
Shift-Left Operational Strategy: Strong drive to implement operational automation that empowers Tier 1 and Tier 2 support teams, reducing ongoing engineering maintenance overhead.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical business partners and leadership.
Agility & Problem Solving: History of balancing multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced technology environment while adhering to customer SLAs.
Our Approach to Flexible Work
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Job Description
As a Non-Volatile Memory QRA (NVMQRA) Solid State Drive (SSD) Quality and Reliability Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will you will be responsible for managing quality and reliability of Micron SSD products as these products enter into high volume production phase of product lifecycle.
You will perform reliability testing and data analysis on material associated with sustaining qualifications through change requests, product proliferations, special work requests and conversions. You will also take part in the management of product deviation events, through participation in product containment activities and providing quality and reliability evaluation plans for risk assessment.
You will also manage the outgoing quality and reliability (OQRM) metrics. You are expected to conduct failure analysis from qualification, evaluation and OQRM failures and report the resulting data. You can expect to conduct global meetings to determine product priorities or product dispositions.
In this role you will work with various Engineering and Quality Reliability Assurance Groups to provide technical support, expertise, consultation and training. You should expect to support customers both internal and external to Micron on an on-going basis.
Responsibilities And Tasks
Manage Reliability evaluations for deviation management
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Identify deviated material within Material Review Board (MRB)
Take part in containment activities
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Determine disposition of materials
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Manage and coordinate various inputs from various stakeholders in Quality Reliability
Collaborate with discrete component product quality and reliability team for product reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Collaborate with package quality and reliability team for package-related reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Manage Product Outgoing Quality and Reliability Monitoring
Provide the plan for operations to execute for SSD product OQRM data collection
Analyze the data from Micron Manufacturing Execution System (MES) such as MAM
Use statistical analysis tools to provide conclusions and verify results
Summarize the reult of analyzed data through a regular OQRM metrics report
Digital & AI Tool Usage
Leverage AI-powered tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, agentic AI platforms, and other generative AI solutions) to enhance engineering effectiveness, automate routine tasks, analyze large datasets, and improve decision quality.
Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows to increase productivity, reduce cycle time, and improve knowledge sharing within the organization.
Provide Expertise, Consultation and Training
Communicate Globally with NAND, Firmware, BUs and Engineering Groups for priority management
Provide training to engineers and technicians within and outside of the group
Maintain knowledge base (lessons learned) within the group for each SSD market segment
Stay abreast of Quality and Reliability issues of Micron NAND components
Provide consultation for audits, RMA, and customer issues
Education
Required: Master's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field
Desired: PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field
Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree and strong academic performance, relevant internships, research projects, or semiconductor-related experience may also be considered.
Experience
Exposure through coursework, academic research, internships, co-op programs, or project work in one or more of the following areas is preferred: Solid State Drive (SSD) products and storage technologies, Non-Volatile Memory (NAND, NOR, UFS, eMMC, SSD) technologies, Semiconductor device engineering, Semiconductor process integration engineering, Semiconductor quality and reliability engineering
Experience applying engineering principles to solve complex technical problems through academic, research, or internship projects.
Demonstrated ability to effectively utilize Generative AI and Agentic AI platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent tools) to improve productivity, automate routine tasks, accelerate data analysis, and enhance technical documentation.
Comfortable leveraging AI-assisted tools in daily engineering activities while exercising sound technical judgment, critical thinking, and responsible data handling practices.
Strong willingness to learn, adapt, and work in a fast-paced semiconductor product development environment.
Qualifications
Fundamental knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing and wafer fabrication processes
Fundamental understanding of semiconductor device physics
Basic understanding of NAND flash memory architecture and operation
Basic understanding of Solid State Drive (SSD) architecture and operation
Familiarity with storage interface standards such as SATA, PCIe, and NVMe through coursework, projects, or internships
Understanding of engineering statistics and reliability concepts
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to learn new technologies quickly and collaborate effectively in a cross-functional global team environment

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. As a Photolithography Engineer at Micron, you will be responsible to tackle critical lithography scribe challenges for memory devices. In this position, you will be responsible for supporting work for the photolithography team. This includes modeling to support optical simulation related to scribe mark, provide mark design recommendations, identifying root causes for sophisticated problems, and providing simulation training for other photolithography engineers. You will also define and lead projects to address photolithography performance gaps on current and future memory and storage nodes.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Understand the technology challenges with respect to overlay and establish project plans to address them for the N, N+1, and N+2 nodes.
Work with vendor applications teams to find areas for overlay scribe improvement.
Drive technical innovation in your area of expertise as a recognized Micron expert in your field.
Standardize methods and procedures across area, department and/or FABs.
Define and lead sophisticated, multi-disciplinary projects that are essential to Micron’s photolithography roadmap. Help to craft strategic decisions.
Work with process development engineers on issues and projects related to photolithography.
Summarize plans, progress to experimental work, and conclusions in the form of written reports.
Provide advice and counsel to senior management on technical issues related to overlay scribe.
Build strong customer relationships to understand customer expectations.
Integrates AI-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, or effectiveness, exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements.
Contributes to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI-enabled enhancements within one’s scope of work.
Qualifications for this position include:
Strong understanding of photolithography. Familiarity with semiconductor process integration is a plus.
Understanding of optics. Understanding of the principals of photolithography and optical metrology.
Understanding of how lens aberrations, scanner chuck differences, and process variations can affect overlay.
Understand various alignment and overlay marks. Understand how mark type and design can impact overlay errors. Experience with overlay mark simulation software is a plus.
Ability to develop and maintain relationships with multi-functional teams and suppliers.
Strong curiosity about research and development and ability to build production-worthy technologies.
Strong communication skills (written, verbal and presentation).

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
jobs.description:
Job Details | Atlassian
Principal Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
Engineering | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote | Full-Time
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian India
Atlassian's mission "to unleash the potential of every team" is the guiding light behind what we do. Our products, including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, help teams everywhere work better together, from NASA to Cochlear.
Our office is in Bengaluru, but eligible candidates can work remotely across India: from home, from an office, or somewhere in between. We call this TEAM Anywhere.
Your future team: KubePlat Team
The KubePlat group in Core Engineering owns Atlassian's entire Kubernetes ecosystem. Every Atlassian cloud product, including Jira, Confluence, Loom and Rovo, runs on the clusters, platform services and deployment systems we build and operate. Our mission is to provide Atlassian a secure, reliable, cost-efficient and globally distributed compute platform, as the foundation for building great products.
What we own:
Kubernetes infrastructure: hundreds of production clusters (EKS and GKE) across AWS, GCP and regulated cloud environments.
Fleet management: automated, cloud-agnostic lifecycle management for clusters and platform components, with safe progressive rollouts.
Kubernetes Platform-as-a-Service: an opinionated, multi-tenant platform for running Atlassian's microservices.
Cloud resource management: self-serve, Kubernetes-driven provisioning of the cloud resources that services depend on.
Secure sandboxed compute: strongly isolated environments for running untrusted code and AI-agent workloads.
Software delivery: artifact management, deployment orchestration and automated verification for thousands of deployments every day.
AI/ML infrastructure: the GPU compute, high-bandwidth networking and parallel filesystem ecosystem on Kubernetes that powers model training and AI inference behind Atlassian's AI features.
We are in the middle of a major transformation: moving to a multi-cloud, cell-based architecture, meeting FedRAMP and data-residency requirements, and building a reliable, cloud-native foundation for AI training and inference at scale.
As a Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for Atlassian's Kubernetes, compute and AI/ML infrastructure platform. You will lead engineers across several teams on our hardest problems, and take large, cross-team initiatives from design to launch.
What you'll do
Define the architecture and multi-year roadmap for a multi-cloud, cell-based Kubernetes fleet that scales to thousands of clusters.
Design Kubernetes-native control planes (controllers, operators, CRDs and policy) that give engineers self-serve compute, networking and cloud resources.
Raise platform reliability and security: reduce blast radius, build safe progressive rollouts, define SLOs, isolate workloads and support compliance (for example FedRAMP).
Lead compute efficiency through autoscaling, bin packing, capacity planning and cost optimisation.
Build the AI/ML infrastructure ecosystem on Kubernetes: GPU compute at scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency networking, and high-performance parallel filesystems for training and inference.
Influence engineering and product leaders globally, set architectural standards, and mentor senior engineers.
10+ years building and operating large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform-as-a-service systems.
Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise from running it in production at scale: internals, networking, multi-tenancy, and building operators and CRDs.
Strong experience with AWS and/or GCP (EKS/GKE) and distributed systems design.
Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java or similar.
Platform engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps/CD (for example Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD) and observability.
A track record of leading technical direction across teams, with excellent communication and mentoring skills.
Nice to have
Experience with Kubernetes fleet management, cell-based architectures, sandboxing (gVisor, Firecracker) or regulated environments.
Experience providing AI/ML infrastructure: GPU clusters, high-bandwidth networking (for example RDMA, InfiniBand, AWS EFA, GPUDirect) or parallel filesystems (for example Lustre, Amazon FSx for Lustre, GCP Parallelstore).
Contributions to CNCF open-source projects.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Development [CPaaS, Data Platform, Database Internals,12 -16 years experience]
jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a world-class systems architect to join the Nutanix Cloud-PaaS (CPaaS) data services team as a Staff Software Engineer. This is a high-visibility technical leadership role designed for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of deep database internals and scalable distributed systems. If you are ready to lead the design of platform foundations while championing an "Open Source First" philosophy, this is your next challenge.
About Team
At Cloud Platform as a Service, our core mission is to architect, develop, and maintain a robust, enterprise-grade data and compute platform. This platform is meticulously crafted using cutting-edge open-source technologies, providing the foundational infrastructure upon which numerous product engineering teams at Nutanix build and deliver their exceptional solutions to our valued customers.
Your Role
Architect & Innovate: Lead the design, implementation and optimization of core data platform components for on-prem, hybrid-cloud enterprise & service provider environments. You will ensure our systems are resilient, performant, scalable and easily "day-2 manageable" across diverse customer data centers, including air-gapped and highly regulated environments.
Performance Engineering: Dive deep into I/O stacks, memory management, DB engines, distributed messaging stack, and data models to squeeze every ounce of performance out of the hardware.
Technical Leadership: Be a force multiplier, influence the technical roadmap, conduct high-stakes design reviews, and mentor engineers across the CPaaS team.
Customer-Led Engineering: Develop a deep intuition for user challenges to build high-impact solutions that deliver immediate value. By collaborating with cross-functional leads, you will ensure our data platform remains a pragmatic, reliable foundation that solves real-world problems without compromising on long-term architectural excellence.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a critical escalation point for cross-functional teams, providing the deep architectural insights and hands-on debugging necessary to resolve complex technical blockers and accelerate delivery cycles across the organization.
Open Source Leadership: Identify internal data platform technologies & contributions suitable for open-sourcing to establish Nutanix as a thought leader.
Planning & Prioritization: Collaborate with engineering leads to define the high impact initiatives and quarterly priorities. You will ensure the CPaaS data services roadmap balances immediate customer needs with long-term architectural sustainability and technical debt reduction.
Work in a geographically distributed team setup.
What will you bring?
Deep Systems Expertise: 12+ years of experience building and scaling large-scale software, with a specialized focus on distributed systems and database internals. You should have a proven track record of solving complex problems at the infrastructure layer.
Polyglot Programming: Expert-level proficiency in Go, C++, or Rust. You are also comfortable using Python to automate, prototype, and bridge services within a cloud-native ecosystem.
Data Engine Mastery: A deep, internal understanding (indexing, storage engines, data models, query optimization) of diverse data architectures:
Analytical & Time-Series: ClickHouse, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics.
Relational: PostgreSQL, MySQL.
Graph: Neo4j, Dgraph.
Messaging: NATS, Apache Kafka.
Cloud-Native Foundations: A solid architectural understanding of Kubernetes and container orchestration, specifically regarding stateful workloads and high-availability data services.
Operational Excellence: Experience operating distributed "Big Data" systems in a resource constrained on-prem or hybrid cloud environment. You understand the nuances of observability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and zero-downtime migrations.
AI-Augmented Engineering: A forward-thinking passion for integrating AI tools into the SDLC. You have experience using AI for code generation, automated design reviews, and accelerating the path from "concept to commit."
The "Nutanix" Mindset: A self-starter who can think big (architecting for the future), start small (delivering iterative value), and make it happen (driving projects to completion).
Work Arrangement
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer - Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP)
jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
The Opportunity
Founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Jose, California, Nutanix is a global leader in cloud software and a pioneer in hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) solutions. With a passionate team of over 6,000 employees worldwide (affectionately known as "Nutants"), we make computing invisible anywhere. Companies around the world rely on Nutanix software to manage any app, at any location, and at any scale across private, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. We value intellectual curiosity, a bias for action, customer obsession, and an entrepreneurial spirit. Nutanix welcomes builders who thrive on tackling seemingly impossible challenges while celebrating what makes each of us unique.
As a senior staff engineer, you will serve as a key technical leader and architect for the NKP team. This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role where you will look beyond single-cluster management to solve "fleet-scale" problems—designing systems that manage tens of thousands of clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. You will bridge the gap between Nutanix’s core infrastructure and the evolving CNCF ecosystem.
About the Team
The Nutanix Cloud Native team is at the forefront of building the next generation of enterprise infrastructure. Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), a complete, enterprise-grade solution that simplifies Kubernetes operations across hybrid, edge, and multi-cloud environments.
Our mission is to make NKP the foundational layer for all modern workloads. We are solving complex distributed systems challenges in fleet management, multi-tenancy, and edge computing to deliver a robust, scalable control plane.
You will report to the engineering leader at Nutanix. The work setup is hybrid, allowing for flexibility and a healthy work-life balance. As a new hire, you will be expected to work from the office three days a week, ensuring face-to-face interactions with your team members and promoting a sense of camaraderie and community within the team.
Your Role
Architectural Strategy: Lead the design of critical NKP components with a focus on multi-tenancy, resilience, and "Fleet Management". You will ensure NKP operates reliably at the Edge and in resource-constrained environments.
Force Multiplier: Act as a technical "bar-raiser". " You will lead and mentor a distributed team of 15–20 engineers, driving excellence through design reviews, coding standards, and a culture of technical curiosity.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product Management, the Data Services (NDK) team, and Core Hybrid Cloud teams to translate high-level business goals into technical roadmaps for stateful workloads and disaster recovery.
Community & Innovation: Represent Nutanix in the open-source community. Contribute to upstream CNCF projects (Cluster API, Kappa, etc.), file patents, and author white papers that define the future of hybrid cloud.
Operational Excellence: Engage with customers and support teams to resolve complex production issues, ensuring our platform meets the highest standards of scale and user experience.
What You Will Bring
Experience: 15-20+ years of software development experience within product-led companies, with a significant tenure architecting and shipping large-scale distributed systems. Technical: Rock-solid proficiency in Go, Python, or Java. While deep K8s internals (controllers, API machinery) are a plus, we value "systems thinkers" who can master new stacks quickly.
Domain Expertise: A proven track record in cloud-native systems, Docker/containers, and large-scale control plane management is a great plus. Leadership: You can navigate ambiguity, drive consensus across multiple teams, and balance long-term innovation with short-term risk/reward trade-offs.
Education: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Overview
Join the Central Engineering - Software team as a Senior System QA Engineer, helping to validate complex Linux server and SoC platforms. You will develop automated tests and investigate system-level issues across hardware, firmware and software, contributing to reliable platform bring-up, performance and long-duration stability. This role offers the opportunity to work across processor, memory, I/O, networking, storage, power and thermal technologies, collaborating with engineering teams to turn challenging failures into clear, actionable findings.
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain functional, performance, stress and stability tests for Linux server and SoC platforms.
Create test automation, log-analysis tools and regression coverage using C/C++, Python and shell scripting.
Validate and debug interactions across firmware, Linux kernel and device drivers, system management, networking, storage and hardware bring-up.
Investigate failures found during system-level workloads and long-duration testing; gather evidence, identify likely root causes and communicate findings clearly to partner engineering teams.
Exercise platform reliability, availability and serviceability features, telemetry, power and thermal behaviour, and reset and boot flows.
Contribute to validation of memory, high-speed I/O, PCIe, NVMe, Ethernet, RDMA and accelerator-related workloads where relevant to the platform.
Required Skills and Experience
Practical experience programming in C or C++ and using Python and shell scripting to develop test automation, analyse logs and support regression testing.
Ability to validate and debug Linux-based server or SoC platforms across firmware, kernel, device drivers, system management and hardware bring-up; equivalent practical experience is welcome.
Experience designing and running system-level functional, performance, stress or long-duration stability tests, with effective failure detection and root-cause analysis.
Understanding of system architecture and behaviour across areas such as CPU and memory, cache coherency, DMA, NUMA, IOMMU/SMMU, PCIe, networking, storage, power or thermal management.
Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience
Experience with BMC-based server management, secure boot, firmware authentication, boot-stage sequencing, watchdogs, reset flows, inter-processor communication or mailbox mechanisms.
Knowledge of RAS validation across memory, interconnect, PCIe or accelerator subsystems, including use of telemetry such as performance counters, sensors and activity monitors.
Experience with PCIe or NVMe validation, including raw block-device testing, storage performance testing or long-duration storage stress testing.
Knowledge of high-speed Ethernet, RDMA, RoCEv2, MPI/CCL-style communication stacks, collective operations, or scale-up and scale-out communication architectures.
Familiarity with AI/ML or accelerator validation, including PyTorch workloads, model execution, numerical-result comparison, benchmarking, workload automation or concurrent compute, memory, networking and I/O testing.
In Return
You will work on meaningful system validation challenges at the intersection of hardware and software, helping improve the reliability and performance of complex server and SoC platforms. The role provides broad technical exposure across Linux, firmware, platform management, networking, storage and accelerator technologies, alongside opportunities to deepen your debugging, automation and system-level validation expertise. You will collaborate with engineers across disciplines and see your work inform product quality and platform readiness.

Job Overview:

Key Responsibilities:
Invoice Processing & Vendor Management
Review, code, and enter vendor invoices, purchase orders (POs), and contracts into the accounting/ERP software 
Perform 3-way matching (Invoice vs. Purchase Order vs. SOD) to ensure payment accuracy
Handle vendor onboarding, verify bank details, and maintain active, compliant vendor master records
Address vendor payment inquiries and resolve billing/discrepancy issues in a timely, professional manner
Statutory Compliance & Tax Deductions (India)
Ensure accurate deduction and filing support for TDS (Tax Deductions at Source) on qualifying vendor payments under relevant Sections (e.g., 194C, 194J, 194Q).

Process employee expense reports and reimbursements via corporate tools in line with company travel and expense policy.
Maintain digital repository for all receipts, tax invoices, contracts, and payment vouchers for easy retrieval.
Support internal, statutory, and tax audit processes by pulling required document samples and schedules.
Qualifications & Skills:
Accounts Payable professional with 1-2 years work experience 
In-depth knowledge of accounting principles, TDS, GST
Strong Excel skills; Working knowledge of SAP
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under pressure to meet deadlines.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and with external stakeholders.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Agentic Systems (Quality Engineering)
jobs.description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
Who We Are
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
Job Summary
As a Staff Software Engineer in IT Quality Engineering Automation, you will be the technical anchor and visionary for our automated testing and next-generation SDLC ecosystem, operating directly from our Bangalore office. At Palo Alto Networks, we are transitioning from traditional QA to an AI-First engineering culture.
We are looking for an early-in-career AI Engineer to build and ship custom Agentic AI. Applications across an Enterprise IT landscape spanning Salesforce, SAP, custom. Licensing and Entitlement management applications, and AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM platforms. You will work with modern generative AI — LLM orchestration, autonomous agent loops, tool calling and RAG — against real enterprise infrastructure, building agents that carry out multi-step business workflows, act on data across these systems through their APIs, and hand back to a human when they should.
At Palo Alto Networks we are moving towards an AI-First engineering culture, and you will not be starting from a blank page. You will build on our own internal AI platform tools for test generation, automation scripting, execution and quality reporting.
Agentic Systems & Enterprise Integration
Build agentic features: Develop and maintain agent workflows using LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, AutoGen or CrewAI, including planner/executor loops, state handling and failure recovery.
Enable cross-system integration and tool calling: Connect agents across enterprise applications, including: Salesforce: REST/SOAP APIs, Webhooks, Platform Events, Apex Invocable Methods, SOQL and Flows. SAP: OData/BAPI services and business-object events. Custom applications: Licensing, Entitlement, AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM through REST APIs, webhooks and message queues.
Build context grounding and RAG pipelines: Use vector stores such as pgvector, Pinecone and Weaviate to provide LLMs with accurate, current enterprise context.
Define tools and schemas: Create well-specified tool definitions and JSON function schemas, including MCP tools, to support deterministic tool calls and traceability back to Jira.
Agent Quality, Safety & Observability
Build evaluation suites: Develop and run golden-set evaluations to validate improvements to agents and prompts before release.
Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop workflows: Establish safety controls, rate limiting, fallbacks and clear approval handoffs, especially when agents write to systems of record.
Enable observability: Instrument agents with tracing and metrics covering execution paths, latency, context usage and token costs, and use findings to improve performance.
Apply responsible AI practices: Follow company policies on intellectual property and data privacy, keep secrets in managed stores and require explicit opt-in for steps that send content to external services.
Collaboration & Growth
Collaborate across functions: Partner with Salesforce, SAP and platform architects, QE leads, product managers and security teams to deliver reliable AI features that meet business, quality and enterprise compliance requirements.
Learn the enterprise landscape: Build an understanding of transaction flows from AI Custom Quoting and order capture through licensing, entitlement, provisioning and service management. Prior knowledge is not required, but proactive learning is expected.

jobs.description:

1. OPEX Budgeting (Annual & Quarterly)
Lead preparation of the annual OPEX budget for Construction & Facilities, covering utilities, O&M contracts, AMCs, repairs and maintenance, consumables, services, manpower contracts and other operating cost elements.
Prepare quarterly budget refreshes and rolling forecasts; incorporate operational changes, ramp-up plans, contract renewals, escalations and inflation assumptions.
Build cost models and bottom-up estimates with cost owners; maintain clear basis-of-estimate documentation and assumptions.
Align budgets to cost centers, GL accounts and WBS elements as per Micron Finance structure; support budget reviews and approvals with the Program Lead and Finance.
Identify cost-saving and cost-avoidance opportunities and incorporate them into budget plans.
2. OPEX QVS Performance Tracking
Track and report OPEX performance against QVS targets on a monthly and quarterly basis, including actuals, commitments, accruals and forecast-to-complete.
Perform variance analysis (budget vs. actual vs. forecast), identify root causes and drive corrective actions with cost owners.
Prepare dashboards and management reports for the Program Lead and site leadership; highlight risks, opportunities and spend trends.
Support month-end and quarter-end close, and respond to Finance and corporate queries on OPEX performance.
3. SAP Transactions – PR Issuance, GRN Adjustments & Accruals
Create, modify and track Purchase Requisitions (PRs) in SAP with correct account assignment (cost center, GL, WBS), and follow up through approval workflow to PO conversion.
Coordinate Goods/Service Receipts (GRN/SES) with requestors and perform GRN adjustments, reversals and corrections as required.
Estimate and post monthly accruals for services rendered but not invoiced; reverse and true-up accruals in line with corporate accounting policies and close calendars.
Monitor open POs, aged commitments and unutilized balances; drive PO closure and de-obligation of residual values.
Ensure all SAP transactions are accurate, timely, auditable and compliant with internal controls (SOX / delegation of authority).
4. OPEX P2P Tracking (PR to Payment)
Own end-to-end tracking of the Procure-to-Pay cycle: PR → PO → GRN/SES → Invoice → Payment for all Construction & Facilities OPEX spend.
Validate vendor invoices against PO terms, contract rates, GRN/SES quantities and service evidence (3-way match); resolve price/quantity mismatches and blocked invoices.
Verify statutory requirements on invoices, including GST compliance, TDS applicability and e-invoicing details, in coordination with Accounts Payable and Tax teams.
Maintain a P2P tracker with status, ageing and bottlenecks; follow up with Procurement, AP and vendors to ensure on-time payment and minimize vendor escalations.
Reconcile vendor statements and support vendor ledger clean-up and resolution of disputes.
5. Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement
Ensure adherence to Micron procurement, finance and audit policies; support internal and external audits with complete documentation.
Standardize OPEX processes, templates and reporting; drive automation of trackers and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Excel/VBA, SAP reports).
Partner with Procurement on contract scope, rate validation, escalation clauses and renewals to ensure commercial accuracy.
6. AI-Enabled Ways of Working
Use approved AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, enterprise GenAI assistants) to speed up budget preparation, draft variance commentary, summarize contracts and SOWs, and prepare management reports, while checking all AI outputs for accuracy.
Use AI and advanced analytics for OPEX forecasting and spend trend analysis, such as predicting utility, maintenance and contract costs from historical consumption and operating data.
Apply AI and automation to P2P processes, including invoice data extraction, automated 3-way match exception flagging, duplicate or anomalous invoice detection, and accrual estimation support.
Find repetitive OPEX and SAP tasks that can be automated (AI agents, RPA, Power Automate, Power BI) and work with Finance, IT and digital teams to build and scale these solutions.
Keep financial data clean, structured and well governed so it can be used reliably by AI and analytics tools.
Follow Micron’s Responsible AI, data privacy, information security and confidentiality policies; never put confidential vendor, pricing or financial data into unapproved tools.
Share AI use cases and good practices with the Construction & Facilities team and support colleagues in adopting AI-enabled ways of working.

Your future team
As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Atlassian, you’ll be at the forefront of applied AI, working directly with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, AI-powered solutions. The FDE team partners with top organizations across industries, helping them leverage Atlassian’s AI capabilities to solve complex, real-world problems. You’ll collaborate with product, engineering, and design, rapidly growing your technical and domain expertise while making a tangible impact on business outcomes. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for those who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are passionate about shaping the future of AI-powered teamwork.
To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/fdeatlassian.

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML-powered solutions tailored to customer needs.
Architect and implement robust application integrations using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, with a focus on APIs, microservices, and enterprise-scale systems.
Drive data-driven solution development by analyzing complex datasets to extract insights and inform product direction.
Champion the adoption of AI-augmented workflow automation within customer environments, maximizing business value and operational efficiency.
Oversee the end-to-end deployment of AI solutions into production, ensuring continuous evaluation, monitoring, and improvement.
Navigate risk and compliance requirements, including AI risk assessment, data privacy (GDPR), and regulatory frameworks.
Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, creating concise artifacts for peers, partners, and leadership.
Align technical solutions with business objectives, setting a clear vision for technological progress and measurable results.

10+ years of experience in backend software development.

Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, and experience with APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration.
Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems and thrive in rapidly changing environments.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority.
Experience with AI risk assessment, data privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR).
Strategic and innovative thinking, with a track record of aligning technical solutions to business goals.

Experience with Atlassian Intelligence, Rovo AI, or AI-powered Atlassian features.
Familiarity with regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare).

Prior experience mentoring or leading engineering teams.

jobs.description: Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work â whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team, dedicated to developing innovative solutions to make AI services responsible (Responsible AI). You will join the Responsible AI (RAI) & AI Safety engineering team. We are responsible for building, operating, and advancing the centralized AI safety, content moderation, and guardrail platforms powering Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo. Our systems run inline and asynchronously across high-throughput production workloads, detecting and mitigating jailbreaks, prompt injection, harmful content, bias, and policy violations while preserving latency and user experience. We partner closely with Product Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI Gateway, Legal, and Trust teams to deliver safety systems that scale globally. We have teams in the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and this will be our expansion to India. This team is responsible for building solutions and operating mature platforms to improve the entire company's security and trust & safety posture. If you are passionate about improving security, trust & safety, and combating abuse, this role presents a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact! At Atlassian, a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) is responsible for building, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models into production systems at scale. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering and data science, requiring production-grade code to turn research prototypes into real-world systems like search ranking, recommendations, and GenAI platforms. What Youâll Do Design & Productionize Safety Models: Architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM-based guardrail and moderation models (text, multi-modal, and code) to safeguard user inputs and model outputs across Atlassian products. Build Robust Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design offline and online evaluation frameworks, adversarial test suites (red-teaming), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to measure precision, recall, false-positive rates, and robustness against model drift. Optimize for Real-Time Serving: Work at the intersection of model accuracy and low latency (P50/P99 targets) to deliver cost-effective, high-throughput safety filtering integrated with our central AI Gateway and inference layers. Combat Emerging Threats: Research and build defenses against adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, and unauthorized tool-calling behaviors in agentic systems. Drive Global Compliance & Governance: Support technical readiness for enterprise standards and emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, ISO 42001 / AIMS, FedRAMP) through verifiable safety controls, audit logging, and watermarking capabilities. Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with engineering managers, staff engineers, data scientists, and product managers to steer technical strategy; provide code/design reviews and mentor junior engineers across the team. Your background Bachelorâs or Masterâs degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with 7+ years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production. Deep hands-on experience with modern NLP and LLM techniques, transformer architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., PEFT/LoRA), and model alignment. Proficiency in Python (and familiarity with Kotlin, Java, or Go) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and performant production-grade code. Proven experience constructing rigorous evaluation pipelines, benchmarking datasets, and managing precision/recall trade-offs for high-consequence classification or safety systems. Expertise at telling stories with data and familiarity with at least one visualization tool (e.g. Tableau, R-Shiny, Microstrategy, SAP Business Objects, Looker, etc.) Experience deploying and scaling ML services in cloud environments (AWS / GCP) using containerized platforms (Kubernetes/Docker) and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, SQL). Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to navigate ambiguity, and clear communication skills to articulate ML trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. An agile development mindset focused on constant iteration, solving problems from first principles, and navigating ambiguity. It's great, but not required, if you have Experience specifically in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, or AI Red-Teaming / Adversarial Robustness. Hands-on experience optimizing inference engines (e.g., Triton Inference Server, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) or model quantization techniques for low-latency serving. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, content provenance/watermarking, or regulatory compliance standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001). Experience with large-scale streaming pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) or graph-based entity systems. jobs.description: The Opportunity We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead LLM‑powered application development—from prototype to production—on AWS. Own the ML lifecycle: Data curation, feature engineering, training/fine‑tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), A/B testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of models and prompts. Productionize on AWS: Ship scalable services on EKS/ECS/Lambda; leverage SageMaker, Bedrock, EMR, MSK, Step Functions; apply observability (CloudWatch/OpenTelemetry) and cost controls. (Duties aligned to modern AWS ML roles.) Scale training & inference: Use distributed training (FSDP/DeepSpeed), quantization, caching, vector databases, and GPU/Inferentia for performance and efficiency. MLOps & governance: Establish CI/CD for models (MLflow/Kedro/SageMaker Pipelines), model/version registries, data and prompt lineage, evaluation gates, and responsible‑AI controls. (Aligned with contemporary MLOps templates.) Partner across Brightly: Translate asset‑management use cases into ML/LLM solutions; collaborate with product managers and UX to ship customer‑visible features that measurably improve reliability, safety, and sustainability. Mentor & lead: Provide technical leadership, review designs/PRs, and raise the bar on ML engineering excellence across the team. (Common senior ML expectations.) Perform Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on structured, semi‑structured, and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, correlations, feature importance, and data quality issues. (Consistent with ML engineer responsibilities to analyze data before model development.) Conduct deep research on asset-related, operational, and domain-specific datasets to understand root causes, trends, and predictive signals. What you’ll bring Required experience 5–7 years total software/ML engineering experience, with 3+ years building and operating ML systems in production. 1+ years hands‑on LLM application development (e.g., RAG, fine‑tuning, prompt engineering, evaluators/guardrails, agentic workflows) using packages such as Langchain and Langgraph. AWS proficiency (3+ years): Strong with core services (EKS/ECS, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB/RDS, Step Functions, IAM) and ML stack (SageMaker, Bedrock or HF on AWS). (Representative AWS ML role skills.) Modeling & frameworks: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem; vector stores (e.g., OpenSearch, PGVector, Pinecone), embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation metrics for NLP/LLMs. (In line with senior LLM roles.) MLOps: CI/CD for ML, model registries, experiment tracking, telemetry/monitoring, automated retraining; Docker/Kubernetes, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI. (Current MLOps expectations.) Data engineering fluency: ETL/ELT, streaming/batch (Spark/Flink), data quality and governance controls for ML. Nice to have Experience with distributed training (FSDP, DeepSpeed), RLHF, or Inferentia/Trainium optimization. Exposure to sustainability/asset/intelligent operations domains. Familiarity with security & compliance for ML systems in enterprise environments. (Frequently included in senior ML roles.) How you’ll work Pragmatic and product‑oriented: You bias to measurable outcomes and iterate quickly with stakeholders. (Modern senior ML role framing.) Engineering excellence: You write production‑quality Python, design reliable APIs/services, and uphold testing/observability standards. (Common duties in senior templates.) Collaborative leadership: You mentor peers and influence architecture across teams. (Industry‑standard senior expectations.) Qualifications Bachelor’s in CS/EE/Math or related field (Master’s preferred) or equivalent practical experience. (Typical for senior ML roles.) Join a mission‑driven team building technology that keeps communities running—safer, greener, and more resilient—at global scale. You’ll pair startup‑speed product work with the reach and rigor of Siemens. #AMS

jobs.description: Job Purpose : As Enterprise AI’s delivery portfolio grows and GenAI and agentic solutions move from pilot to production, the platform must scale reliably and safely. The AI Platform Engineer owns significant areas of that platform — ensuring they operate at SLO, building automation against routine operations work, embedding security and responsible AI controls into the platform layer, and contributing to the vendor and standards conversations that shape the platform’s direction. Owns significant platform areas with genuine accountability for reliability, security, performance, and cost efficiency of AI services — not just task execution. Makes AI consumable at enterprise scale by operating the gateways, model endpoints, and context services through which every team reaches models, tools, and data. Builds platform leverage through automation, self-service, and reusable components that reduce manual operations work across the team. Embeds governance by design so that AI security, data protection, and responsible AI controls are enforced by the platform rather than negotiated project by project. Develops the next generation by mentoring junior and mid-level platform engineers, building team capability over time. Responsibilities : At least 6 years of experience running SaaS, cloud, or platform-engineering services in a production setting, including at least 2 years operating AI/ML or GenAI workloads or services. Strong proficiency in Python; working proficiency in at least one additional language (for example, Go, TypeScript, or Java). Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform; Bicep a plus), GitOps, and modern CI/CD. Hands-on experience operating API gateways or AI/LLM gateways, including routing, rate limiting, authentication, and policy enforcement for AI traffic. Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic patterns — tool calling, orchestration, and agent frameworks — and of how context is retrieved, managed, and governed for LLM applications. Experience operating production services with defined SLOs, observability, and incident management. Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as a primary development mode. Solid understanding of identity and access management, secrets management, and data protection for cloud and AI services. Required skills: Platform & Cloud: Kubernetes, containers, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, DevSecOps, platform reliability engineering, and at least one major cloud (Azure preferred) with multi-cloud and hybrid architecture awareness. AI Gateway & API Management: API gateway patterns, AI/LLM gateway architecture and operations, traffic management, and policy enforcement. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI/ML
jobs.description: Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Position Overview We are seeking a talented and versatile AI / Machine Learning Engineer with 3–10 years of experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered capabilities across our electronic design and verification tools. In this hands-on engineering role, you will contribute to the design and implementation of AI/ML pipelines and Agentic AI systems, bridge modern GenAI architectures with robust software engineering, and integrate intelligent capabilities directly into engineering workflows. Collaborating closely with domain experts, software architects, and product teams, you will translate cutting-edge AI concepts—such as intelligent copilots, multi-step reasoning agents, and automated EDA verification assistants—into reliable, scalable, and high-impact solutions. Key Responsibilities • Design, implement, and deploy end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions integrated into EDA software workflows and developer environments. • Build and enhance intelligent agent systems capable of automated reasoning, planning, multi-step execution, and tool usage using modern frameworks (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol / MCP, etc.). • Develop and optimize production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, and semantic reranking. • Build robust data preprocessing, feature extraction, model inference, and evaluation pipelines adhering to clean code, testability, and CI/CD practices. • Work closely with domain experts (chip design, verification), product managers, and core software engineering teams to formulate AI use cases, prototype solutions rapidly, and harden them into production. • Ensure robust model safety, evaluation against hallucinations, prompt injection defenses, IP protection, and compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. Qualifications • 3 to 10 years of professional software engineering and AI/ML experience, with proven hands-on involvement in taking AI/ML or LLM-based solutions from concept to production. • Strong proficiency in Python with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modular architecture, and automated testing (pytest, CI/CD). • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs/GNNs), feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics. • Practical experience building applications with foundational LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, etc.), prompt engineering best practices, and Agentic design patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, tool calling). • Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies. • Proficiency with modern ML and AI development libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LangGraph. • Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows. • Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations. Preferred & Good-to-Have Skills • Hands-on experience with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, dataset preparation/curation, or domain-specific model adaptation using Hugging Face TRL or Axolotl. • Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Apache AGE) and knowledge graph-augmented retrieval. • Familiarity with C/C++, compiler concepts, or GPU profiling/acceleration (CUDA). • Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases). jobs.title: Scaled AI & Solution Architect
jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY The Scaled AI & Solution Architect is the senior technical design authority for the Digital Quality (DQ) organisation, which delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer. The role is a global individual contributor position accountable for setting and driving the AI and solution architecture direction across the entire DQ product portfolio, rather than for the delivery of any single product. The incumbent defines the target architecture, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering standards that every DQ solution is built against, so that capability is built once and reused many times rather than rebuilt product by product. The role leads the scaled adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and agentic AI across the portfolio, translating enterprise AI platforms and emerging technology into GxP-compliant, validated, production-grade capability that measurably improves quality, safety and environmental outcomes at site level. Recognised as an expert within and beyond Digital Quality, the incumbent influences the strategic technology direction of the QSEO business, and partners with Solution Leads, the Platform and Solution Engineering team, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security to ensure architectural coherence, compliance and pace across a complex global portfolio. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Cross-Product Solution Architecture Own the target-state solution architecture for the Digital Quality portfolio, spanning quality management, laboratory, manufacturing quality, and safety, environment and occupational health solutions. Define how products, platforms, data and integrations fit together, and drive convergence of point solutions onto common architecture, avoiding duplicated capability and unmanaged technical debt across the portfolio. Architecture Standards, Patterns and Reusable Components Establish, publish and maintain the architecture standards, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering guardrails that DQ solutions are designed and built against, covering integration, data, identity, AI, validation and cyber security. Make reuse the path of least resistance for delivery teams, and measure adoption, reuse and the resulting delivery efficiency. Scaled AI Enablement Define and drive the AI and agentic AI architecture for the DQ portfolio, including use case patterns such as deviation and incident triage, leading-indicator prediction, automated document and content generation, and conversational access to standards and procedures. Determine where AI capability should be built once as a shared service versus configured per product, and ensure AI is delivered on enterprise platforms with appropriate human oversight, evaluation, model monitoring and lifecycle management. Design Authority and Technical Governance Act as design authority for significant DQ investments, reviewing and approving solution designs at key lifecycle gates and providing architectural assurance on build-versus-buy, platform selection and vendor technical fit. Identify multiple viable options for highly complex problems, set out the trade-offs in cost, risk, compliance and time to value, and make clear recommendations to Digital and business leadership and relevant governance forums. Technical Leadership and Capability Building Provide hands-on architectural leadership to Solution Leads, Product Managers, engineers and vendor teams across the portfolio without direct reporting authority, influencing through expertise, credibility and evidence. Mentor and raise the technical capability of architects and engineers across Digital Quality, and lead architecture and AI Communities of Practice that spread good practice across DQ and the wider Digital organisation. Compliance, Data Integrity and Security by Design Ensure architectural decisions embed GxP computerised system compliance, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements from the outset, in partnership with Quality, Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Cyber Security. Define validation-efficient architecture patterns that allow AI and cloud capability to be deployed at pace while remaining inspection-ready. Innovation and Emerging Technology Exercise foresight in evaluating emerging AI, data and platform technologies, and act independently on self-initiated proofs of concept and technical experiments that challenge the status quo and shape the multi-year DQ technology roadmap. Take appropriate, well-governed technical risk, and translate proven experiments into scaled, supportable production capability with a defined adoption path. QUALIFICATIONS Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree required in Information Technology, Engineering, Environmental or Occupational Health Sciences, Life Sciences or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in in solution architecture, technical leadership or enterprise software delivery (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including demonstrable accountability for architecture across a portfolio of products rather than a single application. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI or machine learning capability into production, including an understanding of large language model and agentic architecture patterns, retrieval, evaluation and model lifecycle management. Strong experience with cloud, integration and data architecture, and with modern software engineering and Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. Experience setting and driving adoption of technical standards across teams that do not report to the incumbent, influencing senior stakeholders through technical credibility. Experience across all stages of the system and application lifecycle, from value analysis and business case through deployment to value realisation and technical debt management. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical senior leaders. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation and data integrity expectations (e.g. GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11). Working knowledge of quality, or EHS business processes and the platforms that support them (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority). Experience deploying AI in a regulated context, including responsible AI governance, model risk assessment and human-in-the-loop design. Recognised architecture certification (e.g. TOGAF) or equivalent cloud architecture certification. Track record of external technical contribution — industry forums, working groups, publications or conference speaking. PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Occasional travel up to 20% Ability to work with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare. ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms – Digital Quality Lead. Key internal relationships include Enterprise Architecture, the enterprise AI and Data organization, Cyber Security, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation, Legal and Privacy, and senior business stakeholders across Quality and EHS in Pfizer Global Supply. External: strategic software and AI vendors, cloud and platform providers, implementation and managed service partners, and relevant industry and regulatory technical forums. RESOURCES MANAGED Financial Accountability No direct budget ownership. Influences the architecture and technology decisions underpinning the Digital Quality portfolio representing approximately $10M of annual software, services and transformation investment, and is accountable for identifying reuse and rationalization opportunities that improve return on that investment Supervision Individual contributor with no direct reports. Provides technical direction and design authority to matrixed teams of product, engineering, data, validation and vendor resources across the Digital Quality portfolio, and mentors architects and senior engineers across the organization. Work Location Assignment: Hybrid Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers . Information & Business Tech

jobs.description: About the Role Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide. In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. Train large models efficiently on GPU infrastructure using mixed-precision training, gradient accumulation/checkpointing, efficient attention, and distributed strategies (DDP, FSDP, or equivalent). Build and optimize feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw behavioral events into high-quality model inputs. Translate prototypes into production ML systems — scalable, reliable, and observable — and drive inference performance through architectural and serving-side optimization. Contribute to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring. ML Algorithm Implementation: Partner deeply with Data Scientists to translate complex, theoretical ML models and algorithms into high-performance, production-grade code. High-Performance Service Delivery: Design, develop, and deploy highly extensible ML API services rigorously optimized for low latency and massive scalability. Operational Intelligence & Observability: Devise and build advanced monitoring capabilities to track both engineering system health and ML model performance metrics (drift, accuracy, etc.) over the long term. Strategic Innovation & Architecture: Architect solutions from scratch, leading Proof of Concept (POC) initiatives across various tech stacks to validate optimal solutions for complex business challenges. Technical Leadership & Execution: Own the full lifecycle of feature delivery autonomously—from requirement gathering with product stakeholders to final deployment—while collaborating with cross-product architects to drive platform adoption. Production Excellence: A proven, demonstrable track record of successfully architecting, building, and productionizing complex Machine Learning solutions at an enterprise scale. MLOps Mastery: Deep, practical experience with modern MLOps practices, ensuring seamless, automated, and secure model transitions from development and training into production environments. Education: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. ML & Deep Learning Frameworks: Mastery of industry-standard ML libraries and Deep Learning frameworks, including PyTorch, Keras, TensorFlow, and TFServing. Foundational Engineering: Deep, advanced understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms (DSA), and complex, distributed System Design. Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on knowledge and proficiency with Cloud infrastructure and services (AWS highly preferred) for large-scale data processing and ML model hosting. Analytical Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical and debugging skills with a relentless focus on algorithmic optimization, resource efficiency, and resolving bottlenecks in distributed systems. jobs.description: Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! ㅤ Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth & ML), Hyderabad Meet our Team Our Data & Audience Platform organization builds advanced AI/ML solutions that power identity, audience intelligence, advertising, and personalization at scale. Our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad develops foundational AI/ML capabilities that transform first-party data signals into production-ready machine learning systems. These solutions help expand addressable audiences, improve targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, user engagement, and retention. Our Machine Learning Engineers combine strong data science expertise with hands-on engineering capabilities to take models from development to production. This includes building production-grade ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and scalable ML infrastructure such as feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps frameworks. We primarily leverage Databricks, along with Snowflake and AWS, and actively embrace emerging technologies, including agentic AI development workflows, to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent machine learning solutions . About the Role As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across our global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring. Roles & Responsibilities: ML System Design & Ownership Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models. Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs. Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM). Modeling & Experimentation Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching. Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case. Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs. Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR). The position requires close collaboration with customers, control system suppliers, engineering disciplines, product development, procurement, project management, electrical/generator teams, and execution teams throughout the proposal lifecycle. The department collaborates closely with engineering, product development, proposal teams, and other functions across multiple international locations to deliver competitive and technically robust control and instrumentation solutions for customers worldwide. Analyze customer requirements and define technically compliant and competitive Control System solutions for Large Gas and Steam Turbine applications. Prepare technical offer documentation, including offer texts, technical specifications, assumptions, clarifications, deviations, and exceptions. Lead and support technical clarification meetings and discussions with customers during the proposal phase and drive closure of open technical topics. Experience in designing of turbine control and protection systems Review and define field instrumentation requirements, including measuring points, instrument specifications, electrical requirements, and interfaces with turbine and auxiliary systems. Define customer Control & Instrumentation interfaces, including Signal Exchange Lists, customer interface requirements, and required technical clarifications. Coordinate project-specific Control & Instrumentation requirements with interfacing disciplines including Generator, Electrical, Mechanical, Process, Package Engineering, and other turbine engineering functions. Strong understanding of Gas Turbine and/or Steam Turbine Control & Instrumentation systems. Good understanding of SPPA-T3000, PCS7, or comparable industrial control/DCS platforms.
