jobs.title: Director - Automation Engineer / Product Manager
jobs.description: GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Job Purpose The Engineer, Product Manager leads the design, build and adoption of AI and agentic solutions in the Automation Acceleration Hub, combining hands-on AI engineering with product management to turn high-value opportunities into solutions that change how GSK runs technology. It identifies, shapes and prioritises AI and automation opportunities across DPTF, owns the AI product roadmap and backlog, and stays hands-on in design and delivery where that is what moves the work forward. Reliability and responsible-AI guardrails are built into solutions from the start, with explicit service levels for AI services. The role is deliberately dual: engineering depth and product ownership sit together rather than being split across two people. AI platform architecture sits with the Director, AI Platform Architect, hands-on AI and agent engineering also sits with the Principal AI Engineer / Architect and the Principal AI / Prompt / Agent Engineer, process design sits with the Principal AI Process Architect, and adoption enablement sits with the Principal AI Enablement Lead. Solutions transition to the owning domain as they mature rather than remaining in the Hub indefinitely. Key Responsibilities • Identify, shape and prioritise high-value AI and automation opportunities across DPTF, linking each to strategy and to a measurable outcome rather than to a technology. • Lead the design and delivery of AI and agentic solutions that accelerate delivery and operations, staying hands-on where that is what moves the work forward. • Own the AI product roadmap and backlog, steering with OKRs and value metrics under lean portfolio principles. • Build reliability and responsible-AI guardrails into solutions from the start, with clear service levels for AI services rather than best-effort operation. • Partner with the platform domains to embed solutions in their operations, and transition ownership to them as solutions mature. • Champion AI-native ways of working across DPTF, and treat adoption rather than deployment as the point at which a solution has landed. • Measure and report the value and efficiency delivered by AI solutions, including where a solution did not deliver and has been stopped. • Work with AI platform suppliers and model providers, holding them to performance and safety standards rather than accepting vendor assurance. • Maintain a visible pipeline of assessed opportunities, so that Hub capacity is directed by value rather than by whoever asked most recently. • Assess where agentic approaches are appropriate and where they are not, and record the reasoning so the judgement is reusable. • Work within GSK information security, data and quality requirements, including GxP where a solution touches regulated activity, engaging those functions during design rather than at approval. • Hold the boundaries with the Director, AI Platform Architect on AI platform architecture, the Principal AI Process Architect on process design, and the Principal AI Enablement Lead on adoption enablement. Professional Qualifications • Degree in a technology, engineering, mathematics or computer science discipline, or equivalent practical experience. • AI, machine learning or cloud certifications desirable, together with product or agile credentials. Area of Specialisation • AI and agentic solution engineering, covering large language model and agent frameworks, and machine learning operations. • Product management for AI capability, covering opportunity assessment, roadmap and backlog ownership and value measurement. Experience Required • Overall 18 years and typically 8-10 years in engineering or technology delivery, including at least three years building AI, machine learning or automation solutions in production rather than in pilots. • Strong hands-on experience with AI and agentic solutions, including large language model and agent frameworks. • Product management experience, covering opportunity assessment, roadmap and backlog ownership and value measurement. • Track record taking an opportunity through to delivered and adopted value, not to proof of concept. • Practical responsible-AI awareness, including where a use case should not proceed. • Experience with machine learning operations, or an automation or robotic process automation background. • Experience holding technology suppliers and model providers to performance and safety standards. • Practical awareness of AI patterns and judgment for where AI adds genuine value Skills/Background • Combination of engineering credibility and product judgement, since the role needs both at once. • Discipline to stop a solution that is not delivering value rather than continuing to invest. • Judgement about where agentic approaches genuinely fit and where a simpler method is better. • Ability to transition ownership to domains rather than retaining solutions in the Hub. • Comfort engaging security, data and quality functions during design rather than at approval. • Scepticism toward vendor and model provider claims, with the means to test them. #AGTech Skills AI Adoption, Asset Life Cycle Management, Cyber Security Architecture, Data Integrity, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Problem Solving, Product Management, Product Portfolios, Risk Awareness, Service Portfolio, Standards Compliance Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. Inclusion at GSK: As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs. Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. jobs.description: Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future? How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise? How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design? How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments? How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality? How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies? That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production. Responsibilities Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions. Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions. Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation. Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables. Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies. Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments. Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis. Requirements BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields. Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers. Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows. Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains: Analog and custom IC design Standard cell design and optimization Physical implementation Design migration and design reuse Semiconductor design automation Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption. Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills. Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams. Preferred Experience Analog and custom IC design workflows. Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows. DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification. OpenAccess-based design environments. Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso. Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows. Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration. We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions. Why us? Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday #LI-Hybrid #LI-EDA

We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role The Role: As a Technical Consultant (Migration Engineer) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will execute high‑volume tenant‑to‑tenant migration tasks for SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business. You will run migration jobs, monitor progress, resolve common errors using playbooks, complete validation checks and produce clean evidence for every migration wave. You will operate in a strict runbook environment across a 24x7 shift pattern and will be measured on throughput, accuracy and disciplined ticket/evidence practices. Key Responsibilities: - Execute SharePoint/OneDrive migration runbooks for assigned scope: set up jobs, run pre‑checks, perform migrations and complete post‑validation. - Monitor migration queues and long‑running jobs; detect and respond to throttling, failures and repeatable exception patterns. - Remediate common issues (blocked files, permissions mapping errors, large items, metadata anomalies) using standard playbooks. - Perform validation tasks: permissions sampling, metadata/version checks, link/sharing checks and user experience spot checks. - Maintain excellent ticket hygiene: status updates, migration IDs/job references, time stamps and evidence attachments. - Produce wave evidence packs aligned to programme governance (reports, exception lists, remediation notes). - Escalate complex issues with complete context and diagnostics; follow escalation etiquette and templates. - Contribute to shift handover packs so that work is continued seamlessly by the next shift. - Support periodic reporting activities: job completion counts, exceptions categories, throughput metrics. Who You Are Must‑Have (or equivalent experience): - Delivered production tenant‑to‑tenant SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive migration execution work (hands‑on), not only planning. - Strong working knowledge of SharePoint/OneDrive constructs relevant to migration (sites, libraries, permissions, sharing, metadata). - Experience using a recognised SharePoint/OneDrive migration toolset (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent). - Comfort operating in a runbook‑driven, high‑volume factory model with strict execution discipline. - Evidence capture discipline: able to produce repeatable proof packs and clear closure notes. - Able to work shift patterns with mandatory handovers and queue/backlog execution. Good‑to‑Have: - Experience with Teams‑related shared content dependencies and basic awareness of sequencing constraints. - PowerShell/Graph scripting for inventories, bulk checks and reporting. - Microsoft 365 administration certification (e.g., MS‑102) or equivalent. - Exposure to information governance considerations (retention, sensitivity labelling behaviour, access governance patterns). Interpersonal & Consulting Skills: - Reliable execution under process: follows standards, flags deviation and avoids undocumented shortcuts. - Clear communicator in tickets and handovers; writes notes that another engineer can action. - Collaborative approach: supports peers, shares patterns and learns quickly from shift leads. - Operates with professional judgement in client environments (security, access, confidentiality). - Comfortable with rapid delivery tempo and handling multiple work items concurrently. - Proactive in raising risks early, with evidence and suggested options. Typical Deliverables / KPIs: - Throughput: migrations completed per shift vs target. - Rework: reduction in retry/re‑run volumes; fewer preventable errors. - MTTR: time to remediate common exception types. - Evidence: completeness and accuracy of reports/logs attached to tickets. - SLA: adherence to wave schedules and timely escalation of blockers. Shift / Working Pattern Notes: - This role operates within a three‑shift 24x7 Factory model . The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 11 Role: Lead Platform Engineer – Enterprise Developer Platform and Toolchain The Team The Enterprise Developer Platform & Toolchain team owns the developer platforms, tools and capabilities used by software engineers across S&P Global. By architecting integrated solutions across source control, CI/CD, cloud, identity and security tooling, and by scaling self-service capabilities, you will accelerate engineering productivity while keeping the platform secure, governed and reliable. You will have the opportunity to lead CI/CD migrations and platform adoption strategies, build and grow a team, and collaborate with security, SRE and engineering leaders. We support your growth through innovation projects, training, cloud certifications and knowledge sharing. Responsibilities Own the platform engineering roadmap, architecture and delivery from design through production. Lead, mentor and grow a team of engineers; set technical standards and review designs. Plan and track delivery across multiple workstreams, managing dependencies, risks and stakeholder communication. Define platform metrics and use them to prioritise investment and demonstrate value. Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling across GitHub Enterprise Cloud, Azure DevOps (ADO) and GitHub Actions hosted runners to ensure reliable, fast and secure software delivery. Administer and evolve GitHub Enterprise Cloud, including repository governance, branch policies, access controls and enterprise-level configuration. Manage the repository lifecycle (creation, ownership, archival) and enforce version control standards (Conventional Commits, semantic versioning, branching and PR standards). Drive the internal developer portal and self-service strategy, including service catalogues, templates and self-service workflows. Provision, secure and optimise the AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudFormation/CDK) that underpin the developer platform. Integrate security, quality and artefact management tools into developer workflows with minimal friction. Own and operate AI-assisted development tooling, including GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE, developer agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, driving adoption, measuring productivity impact and scaling usage across engineering teams. Build automation frameworks and developer agents that eliminate toil across identity and access provisioning, onboarding, environment setup, compliance checks and routine platform operations, in partnership with security and IT teams. Partner with engineering, security, SRE and architecture teams, divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and BISOs to enforce guardrails and keep the platform governed, reliable and operationally ready. Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Enterprise Cloud (administration, Actions, hosted runners, GHAS) and Azure DevOps. Deep expertise in CI/CD pipeline design and automation at enterprise scale. Strong understanding of the repository lifecycle, Git workflows and branching strategies (Conventional Commits, semantic versioning, trunk-based/GitFlow, PR workflows). Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) and configuration management tools. Solid experience with AWS services, including compute, networking, storage, IAM and container orchestration (ECS/EKS). Understanding of CMDB and ITIL-aligned change management (change requests, approvals, audit trails). Experience building or extending internal developer portals (Backstage, Port or similar). Familiarity with ServiceNow (workflow and catalogue configuration) and data platforms (Databricks or equivalent). Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, TypeScript/Node.js). Strong communication skills with the ability to influence adoption across engineering teams. Nice to Have Experience leading CI/CD migrations across platforms. Experience working in regulated environments. Experience with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE) and developer agents/MCP integrations. Hands-on experience building developer productivity metrics and dashboards (DORA, SPACE frameworks). Contributions to open-source Backstage plugins or IDP ecosystems. Experience with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimisation for platform infrastructure. Familiarity with compliance-as-code and policy engines (OPA, Sentinel). Certifications in AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD). jobs.description: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Join a fast-moving Credit Risk Technology team where modern engineering, data, and AI come together to drive real-world financial impact. We operate with a startup mindset—ownership, speed, and experimentation—within the rigor and responsibility of a global financial institution. You’ll help design and deliver mission-critical platforms that support credit risk assessment, analytics, and decisioning across the firm. You will lead application design and development while partnering closely with risk, data, and platform teams to deliver systems that are performant, resilient, and compliant. This role blends hands-on development, system architecture, technical leadership, and AI-enabled innovation, with a strong emphasis on microservices, cloud-native design, and enterprise-grade governance. Partner with risk, product, and technology leadership to integrate platforms, identify enhancements, and enable new products and process improvements. Resolve high-impact, complex initiatives through deep analysis of business processes, system flows, and industry standards. Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, data, security, and infrastructure blueprints. Establish and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, CI/CD, debugging, and production readiness. Design and evolve microservices-based architectures, ensuring scalability, resiliency, observability, and maintainability. Apply AI and GenAI capabilities to modernize workflows, automate analysis, and unlock new insights in credit risk. Serve as technical leader and mentor, coaching mid-level engineers and analysts and allocating work as needed. Apply sound risk and control judgment, ensuring compliance with laws, regulations, and policies while safeguarding clients, data, and the firm. Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL , with strong software engineering fundamentals. Hands-on experience building API-driven services using FastAPI, Pydantic, and/or Django. Proven expertise designing and implementing microservices architectures, including service decomposition, inter-service communication, resiliency patterns, and observability. Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes , deploying and operating containerized services in production. Deep understanding of system architecture, data flows, and distributed systems. Experience working in Linux environments, including shell scripting and operational troubleshooting. Strong track record implementing unit testing, TDD, and automated quality controls. Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one application, platform, or service domain. Familiarity with prompt engineering, model integration patterns, and AI governance considerations in enterprise environments. Exposure to modern “vibe coding” practices—leveraging AI-assisted tooling to accelerate development, experimentation, and problem solving while maintaining engineering rigor. Experience modernizing or decomposing legacy monolithic systems in large enterprises. Proven delivery of GenAI / AI-driven solutions in regulated or large-scale environments. jobs.description: Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Position Overview We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced software engineer with a strong background in C/C++, Data Structures, Algorithms, and Qt to join the QuestaSim (Simulation) R&D team at Siemens EDA. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize high-performance C/C++ software for simulation debug and visualization workflows, solving complex, open-ended problems in collaboration with a senior group of engineers in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact: As a GPU Software Development Engineer, you will focus on enabling and optimizing Intel's GPUs by developing, backporting, and validating software solutions that span the stack-from firmware and device drivers to APIs and the application layer. You will play a critical role in designing, debugging, and improving GPU kernel drivers and graphics software on Linux platforms across diverse kernel environments and enterprise distributions, ensuring seamless integration and performance. Your contributions will directly support Intel's innovations in graphics and data center technologies. Business Group: The Data Center Group (DCG) drives Intel's leadership in computing innovation, with a focus on delivering high-performance solutions for data-centric markets. This group develops technologies that power advanced workloads in cloud computing, AI, and graphics acceleration. By joining DCG, you'll collaborate with experts dedicated to enabling cutting-edge GPU solutions that advance Intel's broader mission to shape the future of technology. Key Responsibilities: Develop and validate GPU kernel drivers and graphics software solutions, contributing to the full development lifecycle from design and implementation to testing and release across Linux platforms, including contributions to the open-source graphics software community where applicable. Debug, optimize, and enable Linux DRM/KMD drivers - including root cause analysis of kernel panics, regressions, deadlocks, race conditions, and memory corruption across diverse hardware and software environments. Design and implement new driver features, enhancements, and optimizations within the Linux DRM/KMD subsystem, collaborating closely with hardware and firmware teams to enable new GPU capabilities. Adapt and backport upstream Intel GPU drivers (DRM/KMD) to LTS, enterprise, and customized customer kernel environments, designing and maintaining compatibility layers and out-of-tree packaging solutions such as DKMS. Collaborate with cross-functional teams - spanning firmware, KMD, user-space runtime, and compute/graphics stacks - to ensure robust integration, compatibility, and stability across the full GPU software stack. Partner with validation and DevOps teams to expand multi-kernel test matrices, regression suites, and automated build pipelines that catch compatibility breaks early. Ensure high code quality and adherence to Linux kernel coding standards through active participation in design and code reviews, spanning both upstream driver development and backported driver deliverables. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electronics/Electrical Engineering. 5+ years of hands-on experience in large-scale software product development with deep focus on Linux kernel and system software engineering. Expert-level C programming with deep understanding of Linux kernel internals, driver architecture, memory management, concurrency, locking primitives, and interrupt handling. Proven experience developing and debugging Linux DRM/KMD drivers and device driver debugging mechanisms. Hands-on experience backporting Linux kernel patches and drivers across kernel versions, with practical understanding of kernel API/ABI drift and compatibility wrapper construction. Proficiency in Linux kernel debugging tools such as ftrace, perf, kdump/crash, kgdb, GDB, dynamic debug, and interpreting stack traces and lockdep reports. Preferred Qualifications: Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electronics/Electrical Engineering. Deep experience with Linux DRM/KMS subsystem, GPU memory management (TTM, GEM), DMA-BUF, and modern graphics/compute software stacks. Experience with out-of-tree module frameworks (DKMS, Kbuild backport frameworks) and multi-kernel distribution packaging (RPM, DEB). Experience triaging and resolving kernel regressions caused by upstream changes in core subsystems such as schedulers, memory allocators, power management, and PCIe buses. Experience supporting customer-specific or enterprise Linux distributions such as RHEL, SLES, or Ubuntu LTS, including kernel validation and issue resolution in production environments. Active patch submissions or contributions to the open-source Linux kernel or DRM/graphics community. This role focuses on building LLM-powered, agent-driven architectures that can reason, collaborate, and execute complex workflows across enterprise systems. You will work on cutting-edge Agentic AI frameworks, enabling systems that go beyond prediction to decision-making, orchestration, and autonomous execution. Roles & Responsibilities: Design and build multi-agent AI systems capable of planning, reasoning, and task execution Develop applications using LLMs (GPT, Claude, Llama, etc.) with advanced prompt engineering and orchestration Implement Agentic workflows (planner - executor - critic - memory loops) Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector databases for enterprise knowledge grounding Develop tool-using agents that integrate with APIs, databases, and enterprise systems Architect and deploy AI copilots and autonomous assistants for business workflows Optimize LLM performance using fine-tuning, prompt chaining, and caching strategies Implement short-term and long-term memory mechanisms (vector stores, knowledge graphs) Design multi-agent collaboration protocols (hierarchical, swarm, role-based agents) Deploy scalable solutions using MLOps & LLMOps practices (monitoring, evaluation, guardrails) Ensure AI safety, governance, and responsible AI practices Professional & Technical Skills: Experience building multi-agent orchestration systems with role-based coordination Exposure to agent planning algorithms (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tree of Thought) Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, TruLens, Promptfoo) Knowledge of graph-based reasoning, knowledge graphs Building autonomous systems or copilots in enterprise environments Domain experience in industrial, energy, or IoT environments Systems thinking for designing autonomous AI architectures Strong problem decomposition for agent task design Ability to balance latency, cost, and accuracy in LLM systems Communication with business stakeholders to translate workflows into agent pipelines Innovation mindset with focus on applying agentic AI in production 3 8 years'' experience in AI/ML with strong focus on Generative AI Strong Python development skills Hands-on experience with: - LLMs & GenAI frameworks - OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers - Agent frameworks: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel - RAG pipelines & vector DBs- FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate Experience building API-driven, tool-integrated AI agents Strong understanding of - - Prompt engineering & prompt optimization - Chain-of-thought reasoning and tool augmentation - Context management and token optimization Experience with cloud platforms (Azure OpenAI preferred, AWS/GCP acceptable) Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Generative AI. This position is based at our Pune office. A 15 years full time education is required. Qualification 15 years full time education

Passion for networking technologies and high-performance systems.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Experience range: 3-8 Yrs
We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging - but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for youConstant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. Data and Applied Science The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready. Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As a Data and Applied Scientist at SAP, you'll help build the context engine grounded in SAP's Business Ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants. This is an early-career role for engineers and scientists who are sharp, curious, and ready to do real work on hard problems from day one. What you'll build You'll contribute to the semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You'll work alongside senior scientists and engineers to build and scale the layer that makes that possible. Support the design and maintenance of enterprise ontologies and semantic models that give AI agents accurate, grounded understanding of SAP and connected business landscapes - learning how data from SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external providers gets harmonized into unified semantic layers. Contribute to AI capabilities including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge grounding that make SAP's agents accurate and reliable in production. Develop and iterate on AI solutions - including generative AI and LLM-based approaches - using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and structured and unstructured data assets. Learn SAP's deep data and process context - data models, metadata structures, and business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce - and apply that context to ground AI solutions in real enterprise reality. Work with modern cloud and data platforms including Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, and GCP, gaining hands-on experience with scalable AI workflows. Collaborate across product, engineering, and business teams to understand how ambiguous business challenges get translated into concrete AI solutions, and contribute meaningfully to that process from early stages through deployment. Apply machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling to build and evaluate AI solutions using real-world enterprise datasets. What you'll bring Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field recent graduates welcome. 3+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience work Foundational understanding of knowledge representation, semantic data systems, or graph databases (through coursework, research, or personal projects). Familiarity with at least one graph query language (SPARQL, Cypher, or GQL) or a willingness to learn quickly; some exposure to the trade-offs between RDF triple stores and property graph databases is a plus. Exposure to modern GenAI concepts - RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval - through coursework, research, or hands-on experimentation. Solid Python and SQL skills; some experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn (academic projects, research work, and personal projects all count). Eagerness to learn production-grade development practices and grow into operating AI/ML solutions end-to-end. Clear, collaborative communication style - you ask good questions, explain your thinking, and work well with others. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience - through internships, research, or projects - with ontology design, semantic modeling, or knowledge graphs. Any exposure to enterprise software ecosystems (SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, or similar) is a real accelerator here. Familiarity with the W3C stack (OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, SHACL) or property graph query languages (Cypher, GQL). Academic or project experience in machine learning and deep learning, including training, evaluating, and improving models on real datasets. Curiosity about agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, multi-agent architectures, or planning and orchestration. Experience contributing to shared or reusable codebases - open-source projects, research codebases, or team projects. Where you belong Join SAP SuccessFactors at a pivotal point in the evolution of enterprise AI, where we are moving beyond traditional applications and analytics toward intelligent, autonomous agents that can understand HCM context, reason over trusted business data, and help customers make better workforce decisions. As part of the SuccessFactors Line-of-Business, you will work at the intersection of HCM domain expertise, enterprise data, applied AI, and agentic technologies-helping shape how employees, managers, HR leaders, and businesses interact with SAP through intelligent experiences. You will collaborate with product, engineering, data, and research teams to ground autonomous agents in SuccessFactors business processes, semantics, policies, and data, while building solutions that are accurate, responsible, secure, and scalable. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact problems across the employee lifecycle, from recruiting and talent to workforce planning, analytics, and people intelligence, and to play a foundational role in defining the next generation of AI-powered HCM at SAP. #dlhiring

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Create and maintain functional specifications, configuration documentation, process flows, test scripts, and knowledge-transfer materials. Collaboration: Work closely with SAP functional consultants, technical teams, business stakeholders, and project teams to deliver integrated solutions within agreed timelines. Project Management Support: Assist project managers with defining scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and risks related to SAP FICO implementations in a cloud environment. Required Skills 8–10 years of SAP FICO experience , preferably with SAP S/4HANA. Strong experience in SAP FI and CO processes and configuration. Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud is preferred. Good understanding of integration with MM, SD, and other SAP modules . Strong client-facing, analytical, and communication skills. Total Experience Expected: 08-10 years

Key Responsibilities - Define and own the overall SoC verification strategy, architecture, and closure plan for image sensor-based SoC programs. - Drive verification planning across IP, subsystem, and full-chip levels, ensuring coherent coverage and sign-off criteria. - Provide technical leadership across multiple verification teams, setting direction on methodology, tooling, and reuse strategy (UVM, formal, emulation/FPGA prototyping as applicable). - Review and approve verification plans, testbench architectures, and coverage models for critical IPs and subsystems (eg, image sensor interface, ISP pipeline, MIPI/I3C connectivity, security/crypto blocks). - Drive SoC-level integration verification - power-up sequences, clocking/reset, interconnect, low-power modes, and cross-IP interactions. - Champion the use of formal verification for control-logic, FSM, and connectivity verification, and identify where formal can accelerate closure or replace simulation effort. - Own escalation and resolution of critical verification issues, including specification ambiguities, cross-team dependencies, and schedule-critical bugs. - Represent verification in program-level reviews, providing risk assessment, closure confidence, and sign-off readiness to senior management and stakeholders. - Drive root-cause analysis for any post-silicon issues traced to verification gaps, and feed learnings back into methodology and coverage models. - Mentor and develop senior and mid-level verification engineers; build technical depth and succession within the team. - Evaluate and drive adoption of new verification tools, flows, and AI-assisted verification techniques to improve productivity and quality. - Collaborate with external IP/VIP vendors and EDA partners to resolve tool and methodology issues. Required Skills - Bachelors/masters degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (VLSI specialization preferred). - 15+ years of experience in digital design/SoC verification, including demonstrated ownership of full-chip or SoC-level verification sign-off. - Deep expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM methodology, including testbench architecture at IP and SoC level. - Strong background in functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification (SVA), with the ability to define SoC-level coverage and closure criteria. - Hands-on and architectural experience with formal verification tools and methodology (eg, JasperGold) for FSM, connectivity, and control-path verification. - Strong understanding of image sensor interfaces and imaging SoC architecture (eg, MIPI CSI, sensor control protocols such as I3C/I2C, ISP pipelines). - Proven experience driving SoC-level integration verification: clocking, reset, power domains, low-power verification, and interconnect/fabric verification. - Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Perl, or TCL) and experience with regression/CI infrastructure at scale. - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technical discussions and drive alignment across design, architecture, DFT, and software teams. - Expertise in Gate-Level Simulation with timing annotation (SDF) , including efficient debugging of timing-related failures. - Exposure to AI/ML-assisted verification techniques (eg, test generation, debug automation, coverage analysis) to improve verification productivity and efficiency. Preferred / Good to Have - Experience with emulation or FPGA-based prototyping for SoC-level verification. - Familiarity with security/crypto IP verification in an SoC context. - Experience with low-power verification (UPF/CPF) at SoC level. - Prior experience defining or contributing to verification methodology standards/guidelines across an organization. - Experience working directly with EDA vendors (eg, Cadence, Synopsys) on tool evaluation and escalations. - Experience in an automotive-qualified or safety-critical (ISO 26262) SoC verification environment. Soft Skills - Strong technical leadership with the ability to set direction and influence without direct authority across teams. - Excellent judgment in balancing schedule, risk, and verification thoroughness for sign-off decisions. - Strong communication skills - able to translate technical risk into clear, actionable input for senior management. - Structured, logical approach to problem decomposition and root-cause analysis on complex, ambiguous issues. - Passion for mentoring and building technical capability within the team. - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional, globally distributed program environment. - Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive closure under deadlines. - Collaborative approach to working with design, architecture, and cross-functional teams. - Exposure to AI/ML assisted verification techniques to improve verification productivity and efficiency. What We Offer - A high-impact technical leadership role shaping verification strategy for next-generation image sensor SoCs. - Direct influence over methodology, tooling, and technical direction across the verification organization. - Opportunity to work at the intersection of imaging, connectivity, and security IP verification. - Mentorship and people-development opportunities as a manager - Collaborative environment with global design, architecture, and EDA partner teams. - A technical leadership track with visibility into IP-level and subsystem-level verification strategy. - Opportunity to shape verification methodology, including formal and protocol verification practices. - Exposure to advanced verification domains including formal verification and next-generation Security IP and systems. jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Onboarding
jobs.description:
Experience range: 1-6 Yrs
Job Description Role Objective The objective of this team is to identify, onboard, and grow premium, high-CFT and trending outlets on Dineout, with a strong focus on being the first mover in acquiring high-potential restaurants before competitors such as District. The team will initially focus on premium outlet acquisition and onboarding, with a long-term mandate to also own account management, GOV growth, market share, and exclusive campaigns/events for these strategic accounts. Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) 1. Identify Premium & High-Potential Outlets Identify premium restaurants and high-CFT outlets across priority markets. Track trending, upcoming, and high-demand restaurants that have strong customer pull. Build a pipeline of strategically important outlets based on brand value, CFT potential, customer demand, and market relevance. Proactively identify new restaurant launches and emerging premium brands. 2. Close Comp-Gaps for Premium Outlets Identify premium outlets that are already live on Z but are missing from Dineout. Prioritize and close these Comp-Gaps to ensure strong outlet coverage. Develop a systematic approach to track, prioritize, and convert high-value Z-Gap opportunities. 3. First-Mover Advantage Ensure Dineout is the first mover in onboarding high-value premium outlets, wherever possible. Track upcoming launches, competitor movements, and market trends to identify opportunities before other competitors. Build strong relationships with restaurant owners, management teams, and key decision-makers to secure early partnerships. Create a culture of proactive acquisition rather than reactive competitor-led onboarding. Long-Term Scope of the Team The role is expected to evolve beyond acquisition into end-to-end ownership of strategic premium accounts. 1. Account Management Build account management capabilities within the team for outlets onboarded by them. Maintain strong relationships with premium restaurant partners. Drive partner engagement, retention, and business growth after onboarding. Identify opportunities to deepen the relationship and increase business contribution. 2. Drive GOV Growth & Market Share Own and drive GOV growth from the premium outlet portfolio. Increase Dineouts market share within premium restaurant segments. Identify opportunities to improve outlet performance, customer transactions, and overall business contribution. 3. Exclusive Campaigns & Events Identify premium partners suitable for exclusive campaigns, partnerships, and events. Work closely with internal teams to conceptualize and execute differentiated campaigns. Leverage Scenes to create visibility and demand for premium restaurant partners. Build exclusive restaurant-led experiences and campaigns that strengthen Dineouts proposition for both consumers and restaurant partners. Key Success Metrics The performance of the team can be evaluated through: Number and quality of premium/high-CFT outlets identified. Premium outlet onboarding rate. Reduction in Z-Gaps. First-mover onboarding rate versus competitors. GOV generated from newly onboarded premium outlets. GOV growth from managed accounts. Dineout market share within the premium outlet segment. Number and quality of exclusive campaigns/events launched. Qualifications Strong business development and sales orientation. Ability to identify and pursue high-value opportunities proactively. Strong understanding of the premium restaurant/F&B ecosystem. Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills. Ability to work with data and identify business opportunities. Ability to transition from pure acquisition into strategic account management This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. jobs.title: Manager - National Accounts
jobs.description:
Experience range: 3-5 Yrs
Role Purpose The Profile owns the day-to-day execution of event planning, monthly promotion planning, and CRM and social activity for National and Gourmet brands. The role drives visibility and OPD growth, turns marketing plans into executed properties, and tracks their performance. The Manager works closely with the Director on strategy and with Ads, Merchandising, Storefront, and brand teams on delivery. Key Responsibilities 1. Event Planning Drive visibility and growth for NATs and Gourmet brands around events, and plan event-specific growth initiatives. Build inorganic growth campaigns for events and report on their impact. Build performance reads for events by geography, cuisine, brand, and slot to inform future planning. Recommend event calendar priorities based on past performance and upcoming opportunities. 2. Monthly Promotion Planning Prepare month-level plans that combine all marketing plans and maximise visibility and OPD growth across visibility channels. Close brand-level alignments and own visibility planning, slotting, and execution for Topicals, BOTDs, Cuisine Banners, Brand Cards, and Top Picks. Deliver the monthly topline targets in sync with the Ads point of contact, and make sure committed visibility is delivered for each brand. Run performance analysis on properties across brands, covering funnel metrics and orders for Food Topicals and Brand Cards, and share findings with stakeholders. Coordinate with Merchandising and SF to align on NAT-related execution. 3. CRM and Social Media Align social media promotions for NAT and Gourmet brands, both for organic events and other activity. jobs.title: Assistant Manager - MarTech & AI
jobs.description:
Experience range: 1-11 Yrs
Job Description About the role Swiggy s Growth Marketing team builds technology that improves campaign execution, customer engagement, and partner experiences. This role sits at the intersection of MarTech, applied AI, and product execution. You will identify high-impact problems, prototype solutions, work with Engineering and AI platform teams to productionise them, and drive adoption after launch. What you will do - Build customer-facing conversational experiences across WhatsApp and voice for consumers and restaurant partners. - Work with agent-platform and MCP teams to improve conversation quality, user context, tool selection, and failure recovery. - Diagnose and improve latency across model inference, speech processing, tool calls, and downstream APIs. - Define instrumentation, evaluation frameworks, latency budgets, and release-readiness checks for AI agents. - Work on user profiling and personalisation so agents can use relevant customer or partner context while respecting privacy and access controls. - Build automations for campaign creation, audience segmentation, personalisation, push notifications, WhatsApp workflows, and marketing operations. - Convert business and user problems into PRDs, product flows, acceptance criteria, rollout plans, and GTM plans. - Use data, SQL, experimentation, and production traces to measure quality, adoption, reliability, and business impact. - Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, Security, Infrastructure, and external technology partners to take solutions from discovery to production. - Create operating documentation, monitoring, and support processes so launched products can be adopted and improved over time. What we are looking for - Experience in product execution, MarTech, growth technology, CRM, applied AI, or consumer internet products. - Strong ability to break down ambiguous business or user problems and convert them into a clear execution plan. - Working knowledge of APIs, data systems, SQL, and scripting or prototyping with Python, JavaScript, or similar technologies. - Understanding of LLM-based agents, tool calling, conversation state, user context, evaluations, and latency trade-offs. - Experience writing PRDs and working closely with Engineering teams on delivery. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate failures across multiple systems. - Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills. - Bias towards building and testing solutions, not only documenting requirements. Good to have - Experience with WhatsApp, voice, telephony, ASR, TTS, or conversational AI. - Experience with MCP or similar tool-integration frameworks. - Familiarity with marketing, engagement, attribution, or customer-data platforms. - Experience with cloud infrastructure, observability, deployment workflows, and production operations. - Experience in a high-growth consumer technology or e-commerce company. - Experience using Generative AI to build internal tools or customer-facing workflows. This role is a fit if you - Enjoy solving problems that span product, technology, data, and operations. - Can move from a user problem to a working prototype and then to a production-ready product. - Care about agent response quality and latency, not just whether an agent technically works. - Are comfortable working through ambiguity and coordinating across multiple teams. - Think beyond launch and focus on adoption, reliability, and measurable outcomes. jobs.description:

Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned Responsibilities Account & Partner Relationship Management Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently. Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned. Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights. Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business. Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc. Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner. Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.). Functional Competencies Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV) Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition Desired Skills Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality Effective communication skills Attitude & Aptitude for Sales Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life. Analytical, good Excel skills. The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach. Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns. Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Job Description Senior Manager - Travel Ops Bangalore (On-Site) About CREW: CREW is Swiggys premium travel concierge, built to take the stress out of planning and traveling for busy professionals. Instead of leaving customers to stitch together flights, hotels, visas and on-ground logistics across five different apps, CREW brings it all into one place - backed by real people, powered by AI. What sets CREW apart: Member-only hotel rates: Negotiated prices on domestic and international stays 24 7 on-trip assistance: A concierge that stays live from planning to landing Deep destination expertise: From the best activities to currency exchange to making the most of every day at the destination One stop shop: Hotels, flights, visas, trip planning, forex, cabs and insurance - all in one place, so theres no juggling five platforms for one trip By combining human expertise with seamless service delivery, CREW lets customers focus on the reason theyre traveling - work, family or leisure - while we handle the details before, during and after the trip. About the Role: We are looking for a dynamic and execution-focused Senior Manager - Travel Ops who will lead the Travel Desk: The team of Team Leads and Crew Captains who plan, book and coordinate every trip CREW delivers. This is a delivery-side ops role. Your job is that the trip we promised is the trip the customer actually gets - every time, at premium standards. CREW is early, and much of how the Travel Desk works is still being written. Wed like you to write our next growth chapter: The SOPs, the escalation ladder, the quality bar, the shift model, the way work moves between our AI concierge and our Captains. Youll carry GMV and conversion targets, but youll hit them by building a delivery engine thats consistent and fast. Were looking for someone from a genuine travel background - OTA, travel agency, DMC, or premium concierge - who has planned trips themselves and knows what actually breaks on the ground. Youll be leading Team Leads, holding vendors to a standard, and driving operational excellence in a fast-moving, customer-facing environment. The ideal candidate has a strong ops mindset, a bias for action, and high ownership - someone who thrives in ambiguity and gets things done without waiting for perfect clarity. Key Responsibilities: Ops excellence: Own trip delivery end to end - coordination with hotels, DMCs, transport partners and on-ground vendors so bookings, changes and cancellations land correctly. Team and performance: Lead Team Leads and Crew Captains against GMV, conversion and NPS targets. Team reviews: Run the review cadence that makes performance visible at TL and Captain level, and coach against it. Playbook: Build and continuously refine SOPs across hotels, flights, visa documentation, forex, cabs and insurance, so service quality doesnt depend on who happened to pick up the mission. Floor Ops: Own the shifts, task distribution and load balancing, so the desk is genuinely staffed when customers are traveling - nights, weekends and peak season included. Escalations: Be the final internal escalation point for the desk - resolve on-ground issues in the moment, then close the loop so the same failure doesnt recur next week. Automation and AI-assisted ops: Find the manual work worth removing, specify it, and partner with product and engineering to ship it. Comfort working alongside AI tooling is not optional in this role. Travel craft: Set the creative bar for itineraries and recommendations - the destination knowledge and taste that make a CREW trip feel different from a booking confirmation. Qualifications Required Skills Qualifications: Must be based in Bangalore. Open to rotational shifts (5-day work week including weekends). 5-8 years in travel - OTA, travel agency, DMC, or premium concierge/travel services - with hands-on trip planning experience of your own. 3+ years leading a team in a service or operations setup, ideally including managing team leads. Hands-on vendor and destination partner management: youve held a third party to a service standard when the customer was already waiting. Strong ops mindset with a demonstrated bias for action and high ownership. Excellent interpersonal, communication and leadership skills. Ability to perform under pressure while ensuring a seamless customer experience. Passion for delivering outstanding, personalized experiences for premium users. Job Description Job Title: Senior Manager, Applied Science - Instamart Team: Data Science Years of Exp: 8 - 12 Location: Bangalore, India About the Team The Role The Swiggy Data Science team is a vibrant group of scientists, engineers, and problem-solvers who are passionate about tackling some of the most complex challenges in machine learning at scale. We work on everything from ETA prediction and delivery partner assignment to personalized recommendations, demand forecasting, and fraud detection. We are looking for an experienced and visionary Data Science Senior Manager to lead a team of talented data scientists. In this role, you will be a player-coach, blending deep technical expertise with strategic thinking and people leadership. You will own the roadmap for a critical business area, partner with product and engineering leaders, and guide your team to build and deploy ML models that drive direct business impact. This isnt just a management role; its an opportunity to shape the future of convenience in India. What Youll Do: Lead Mentor: Lead, manage, and mentor a team of 8-10 data scientists and machine learning engineers, fostering their career growth and building a culture of innovation, accountability, and excellence. Strategic Roadmap Vision: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities. You will translate ambiguous business problems into a clear, data-driven strategic roadmap for your team. Technical Leadership Execution: Oversee the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle-from ideation, data exploration, and model prototyping to deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You will ensure the team adheres to the highest standards of statistical rigor and engineering best practices. Problem Solving on latest Generative AI solutions: Guide your team in solving complex problems in personalization support discovery and internal productivity: Logistics Fulfillment: Optimizing the three-way marketplace (ETA prediction, batching, driver assignment, route optimization). Discovery Personalization: Building recommendation engines, personalized search, and discovery journeys for Food, Instamart, and Dineout. Growth Economics: Customer segmentation, LTV prediction, churn modeling, and designing optimal pricing and promotion strategies. Forecasting Supply Chain: Demand forecasting for Instamart, restaurant supply prediction, and inventory management. Stakeholder Management Communication: Effectively communicate complex technical concepts and the business impact of your teams work to a diverse audience, including senior leadership. Hiring Team Building: Be a bar-raiser for talent. Actively participate in the hiring process to attract and retain top-tier data scientists. What Youll Need (Must-Have Skills): Educational Background: A Bachelor s or Master s in a quantitative field like Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, or a related discipline. Experience: 10+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Applied Science or a Machine Learning-focused role. 2+ years of experience in a formal leadership capacity, managing and mentoring data scientists. Technical Proficiency: Expert-level proficiency in Python and its data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib). Deep, hands-on experience with modern machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras. Strong expertise in SQL and experience with large-scale data processing using tools like Spark, Hive, or Presto. A solid understanding of both classical ML and deep learning along with exposure to Generative AI solutions (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, Transformers). Core Competencies: Problem Formulation: A proven track record of converting vague business questions into well-defined machine learning problems. Statistical Rigor: Deep understanding of statistical methods, experimental design (A/B testing), and causal inference. ML Systems Design: Experience in deploying, monitoring, and maintaining machine learning models in production environments. Familiarity with MLOps principles and tools (e.g., Kubeflow, MLflow) is a strong plus. Leadership: Exceptional leadership skills with a passion for developing people and building high-performing teams. Communication: Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional partners. Why Join Swiggy Unprecedented Scale: Work with one of the richest datasets in India, covering user behavior, logistics, geography, and real-time transactions. jobs.title: Captain 2
jobs.description:
Experience range: 1-5 Yrs
Job Description About the Role We are looking for a Captain to join Trip Assist, CREW s on-trip concierge. You ll be the person our travelers are actually talking to while they re on their trip. When they want to know tomorrow s plan, need a dinner spot, or something goes wrong at the hotel, you re the one who answers, quickly, warmly and correctly. You ll be assigned parts of live trips. You ll build and maintain the trip plans, keep travelers informed through the trip, coordinate with hotels, DMCs, guides and vendors, and close every trip properly once it ends. You ll report to the Assistant Manager, Trip Assist, and work alongside Senior Captains who lead trips end to end. This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role. You re measured on how fast and accurately you respond, how smoothly the trip runs, and how the traveler rates the experience at the end. We re looking for someone who has been on the ground (or on the phone) while a trip was actually happening, knows what breaks, and stays calm and quick when it does. Key Responsibilities Build the trip plan: Put together an accurate day-by-day itinerary using our service design. Confirm hotel bookings and research sightseeing, dining and activity options, so every day of the trip is planned and timed. Add thoughtful touches: Go beyond the template where it makes sense, like a local food recommendation, a re-timed slot based on a group preference, or a fun activity that isn t on the standard list. Respond fast and well: Answer traveler queries within minutes, in simple, warm, easy-to-read language. No walls of text. Make information visual: Turn plans into checklists, simple maps and neatly formatted day plans so travelers can take them in at a glance. Flag escalations immediately: When something goes wrong (a room issue, a delayed flight, a no-show vendor), raise it to the right person right away with full context: what happened, photos, and the options you ve already checked. Triage and suggest next steps: Judge how serious an issue is and come to your TL with a possible solution, not just the problem. Coordinate with partners: Work with hotels, DMCs, guides, transport partners and on-ground vendors so the trip runs the way it was promised. Follow every process, every time: Run the full trip process without missing a step, including the end-of-trip NPS message, follow-ups, closing and exporting the chat, and paying the guide. Don t just mark a step as done; make sure it s actually completed. Own the small stuff: Catch timing clashes or gaps in the itinerary and fix them yourself, without waiting to be told. Use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, and flag repetitive work that s worth automating. Be available for rotational shifts, including nights, weekends and peak season, so travelers always have someone on the other end. Qualifications Required Skills Qualifications Open to rotational shifts (5-day work week including weekends). 1-5 years of relevant experience in at least one of the following: A concierge role (hotel, lifestyle or travel concierge) Handling trips for travelers (trip management, tour coordination, travel desk) On-ground travel operations (DMC, tour operator, ground handling, events or group travel) Hands-on vendor coordination: you ve held a hotel, driver or guide to a service standard while the traveler was waiting. Fast, clear and warm written communication, especially over chat. Strong ops mindset, bias for action and high ownership. Attention to detail in itineraries: timings, bookings and logistics that add up. Genuine passion for travel and destination knowledge, with the taste to make a trip feel special. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer III
jobs.description:
Experience range: 8-13 Yrs
Job Description About the role Swiggy s Data Platform enables teams to move, process, and use data reliably at scale. As an SDE III, you will design and build foundational platform capabilities across data ingestion, distributed compute, storage, and serving. You will own problems end to end-from architecture and implementation through rollout, observability, and operations-and help raise the engineering bar for the team. This role is for an engineer who enjoys solving difficult systems problems: keeping data pipelines dependable as volumes and workloads grow, making platform behavior predictable for users, and improving performance and cost without compromising correctness or governance. What you ll do Design, build, and operate scalable data-platform services and distributed systems used by product, analytics, and machine-learning teams. Develop reliable batch and streaming data processing and ingestion capabilities, with clear guarantees around correctness, recovery, and data freshness. Improve the performance, availability, and cost efficiency of data workloads through sound architecture, measurement, and iterative optimization. Build platform abstractions and self-service workflows that make common data tasks easier and safer for engineering and data users. Establish strong operational practices: observability, alerting, capacity planning, incident response, and durable root-cause fixes. Apply access control, data governance, and safe change-management practices to production systems and datasets. Lead technical design reviews, break down ambiguous problems, and make pragmatic decisions that balance speed, reliability, and maintainability. Partner with infrastructure, product, analytics, and machine-learning teams to understand needs and deliver platform capabilities with measurable outcomes. Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, and contribute to a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. What you ll bring 8+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems, including meaningful experience with distributed systems or data infrastructure. Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, Scala, Python, or Go, and the ability to write maintainable, well-tested code. A solid understanding of distributed computing concepts, data structures, concurrency, fault tolerance, and system design. Hands-on experience with large-scale data processing or streaming technologies-for example, Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, or comparable systems. Experience designing reliable data pipelines and working with data storage formats, lakehouse systems, or analytical warehouses. Good SQL skills and an understanding of data modeling, partitioning, performance tuning, and data-quality concerns. Experience operating cloud-based production systems, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and managing service reliability. A strong sense of ownership: you can take a problem from an unclear requirement to a production solution and its ongoing health. Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering and data-focused teams. It s a plus if you have Experience with platforms such as Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake, or similar technologies. Experience building multi-tenant platforms, developer tooling, or self-service infrastructure. Experience with data governance, lineage, access control, or privacy-aware data systems. A track record of improving reliability, performance, or infrastructure cost at significant scale. Experience leading technical initiatives and helping other engineers grow. How success looks Data workloads become more reliable and easier to operate as platform usage and complexity grow. Platform users can onboard and run workloads with less manual intervention and clearer operational feedback. Improvements to performance, cost, freshness, or reliability are measurable and sustained. Technical decisions and production changes are well documented, observable, and safe to evolve. Qualifications 8+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems, including meaningful experience with distributed systems or data infrastructure. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

You mentor the Sales Manager tier and own a portion of the city-wide targets. Job Description: Own a portfolio of multi-outlet restaurants: Manage 30-40 high-value accounts(60 to 80 in case of Indianext cities), each with 2-10 outlets. These accounts represent 40-60% of city revenue Executive relationship management: Build relationships with franchise owners, regional managers, and operational heads. You are often dealing with decision-makers, not individual restaurant managers Consultative strategy: Move beyond product features. Help restaurants think about their growth strategy across, e.g., optimizing delivery times, increasing order frequency, and cross-location consistency Field presence with data: Conduct monthly visits to key accounts to understand operations, gather feedback, troubleshoot adoption barriers, and surface new opportunities Advanced analytics: Build detailed business reviews (QBR) for accounts. You should be able to build a dashboard for each RP, which can help you and the restaurant partner to keep track of their business with us MBAs/PGDMs would be preferred in any discipline Strong Industry Understanding: Since this is a mid-senior account management role, working knowledge of the restaurant ecosystem (unit economics, delivery margins, competitive landscape, aggregator dynamics) should be expected.
