jobs.title: Director of Digital Design Engineering, Memory Interface IP
jobs.description:
Experience range: 15-24 Yrs
Job Title Director of Digital Design Engineering, Memory Interface IP We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You have spent years deep in the world of high-speed memory interfaces, where timing closure is measured in picoseconds and a single protocol violation can sink a tape-out. You know HBM, DDR, and LPDDR not as acronyms but as living systems with tradeoffs you have navigated across multiple generations. Leading a design team is not about holding status meetings. It is about knowing when to step into a critical path issue at 4 p.m. on a Friday and when to let your engineers own the solution. You have built teams that ship, and you know the difference between a group that executes and one that just stays busy. You do not manage from a distance. You review RTL, you ask the hard questions during design reviews, and you push back when a verification plan is too thin or a schedule is built on hope. At the same time, you trust your people, you clear obstacles, and you create space for them to do their best work. You have worked with executive stakeholders and you can translate a technical risk into a business decision without losing the engineering substance. At Synopsys, you will lead a team building memory interface IP that powers the next wave of AI and high-performance compute. What You'll Be Doing Lead a team of ASIC digital design and verification engineers working on HBM, DDR, and LPDDR memory interface IP Own the technical direction and execution of RTL design and verification at both block and chip integration levels Drive design reviews, architecture decisions, and quality checkpoints across the full development cycle from spec to silicon Collaborate with cross-functional teams including analog design, DFT, physical design, and product management to align on specifications, schedules, and deliverables Build and refine design and verification methodologies, incorporating AI-driven tools and automation to improve efficiency and quality Manage project timelines, resource allocation, and risk mitigation to deliver on schedule and within scope Mentor and develop engineers, providing technical guidance and career growth opportunities across the team The Impact You Will Have Deliver memory interface IP that enables the next generation of AI accelerators, data center processors, and high-performance SoCs Raise the bar for design quality and verification coverage across one of the most performance-critical IP domains in the industry Shape the technical roadmap for high-speed memory controllers that will be integrated into products shipping at scale Build a high-performing team culture where engineers grow, ship complex designs, and solve hard problems together Accelerate time to market by driving adoption of advanced methodologies, automation, and AI-assisted design flows Strengthen Synopsys' leadership position in memory interface IP by delivering differentiated, production-proven solutions Influence product strategy and customer engagements through deep technical insight and execution credibility What You'll Need 15 - 20+ years of experience in ASIC digital design and verification, with significant hands-on work in memory interface IP such as HBM, DDR, or LPDDR Proven track record leading engineering teams through full product development cycles from architecture to silicon bring-up Deep expertise in RTL design, verification methodologies, and design closure for high-speed digital interfaces Strong understanding of memory protocols, PHY/controller architecture, signal integrity, and timing closure challenges Experience managing cross-functional collaboration with analog, physical design, and product teams Demonstrated ability to communicate technical risks, tradeoffs, and project status to executive leadership and stakeholders Experience with AI-driven design tools or a strong interest in integrating AI into design and verification flows is a plus Who You Are You can walk into a design review, spot the gap in a verification plan or a timing assumption, and ask the question that changes the outcome You build teams that want to work for you because you clear the path, give honest feedback, and celebrate the wins that matter You are comfortable making hard calls under uncertainty, whether it is a schedule tradeoff, a resource decision, or a technical pivot You do not wait for perfect information to act, you gather what you need, align the right people, and move forward with clarity You care about the details but you do not micromanage, you know when to zoom in and when to let your engineers own the problem You see AI not as a buzzword but as a practical tool to improve design quality, automate repetitive work, and accelerate decision-making The Team You'll Be Part Of You will be joining a highly skilled and motivated team of ASIC Digital Design engineers. Our team is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and delivering groundbreaking solutions. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and we are looking for someone who shares our commitment to excellence. Rewards and Benefits We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Change the world. Love your job. Validation engineers are said to have a break-the-part mentality. This means they spend some of their time working to identify the use-cases in which the device will stop working as intended and understand the impact and cause of those failures. Sometimes, those are acceptable failures, but others we may need to mitigate for quality, safety, or other reasons. Plus, we want to ensure that our parts are consistently performing to the specifications that we set in our data sheet, and even to some more conservative limits or as defined in the VVCM (validation/verification compliance matrix). To do this, they must design PCB boards and develop automation software that will increase coverage and reduce data collection time. Why Multiphase Processor Power (MPP): Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and Autonomous Driving are just a few of the trends driving the need for high current multiphase switching power in the Enterprise, Data Center, Communications and Automotive markets. As a part of this strategy for growth we are investing in resources for AI/ML based accelerations for Product Development, enabling us introduce new product designs with highest quality and efficiency. Our charter is to build AI/ML based acceleration platforms that will enable the silicon design teams to accelerate the development of silicon designs, verification of the design, layout/physical design and accelerate building the test solutions for these designs with higher and better-quality gates. Our goal is to maximize product throughput by synergizing tools, technology, data analytics, EDA, and IT infrastructure. We are seeking a highly motivated NPDE AI/ML Leader to drive this effort. If you are passionate to push the envelope of product (silicon and software) development technology and enjoy leading transformational changes in a fast-paced environment, here is the opportunity to be part of TI s next generation product development journey. What will you be doing in this role(Responsibilities) As an NPDE AI/ML leader, you will be defining, developing and deploying strategic AI solutions by closely working with the domain experts to accelerate new product development. Develop deep awareness of Silicon development processes, EDA tools and translate complex problems into roadmaps of elegant touch free solutions for a design / verification / layout / validation / test engineer. Set the strategic and technical design of AI architectures, and come up with actionable plans for SW experts and EDA engineers aligning with futuristic goals/ trends in semiconductor development. Lead a team of software specialists to define and operationalize forward looking software solutions to centralize operations management for all facets of silicon development i.e. in design, verification, layout, validation and test. Embrace AI-driven software technologies, data science & machine learning techniques to transform current flows and development procedures, enable operational efficiency and cost leadership. Leverage statistical approaches, trend and pattern analysis, linear mixed models for random & fixed effects, nonlinear/combinatorial optimization in finite search space, network models, and machine learning for predictions of design behaviour. Closely collaborate with design / verification / layout / validation / test technologists and engineers in the company and industry to influence architectures and optimize/customize accelerated development EDA solutions. Responsibilities also involve evaluation of technology approaches to solve real-world problems and participate in standards councils. The candidate will manage accelerated development deliverables with a strong quality and productivity mindset and the solutions should enable development of highly customized semiconductor products aligning with large fluctuations in customer demand at speed and scale Minimum Requirements: Bachelor s/Master s degree in Computer Science or Electronics, Electrical Engineering or related field of study 8+ Years of Relevant Experience Preferred Qualifications: Good understanding of the semiconductor development process 8+ years of experience as engineering expert with progressive experience in developing and deploying AI/ML solutions, preferably in EDA space Experience in few of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing and neural deep learning methods Advanced proficiency in system design and architecture, generative AI, machine learning to deliver high-performance software and optimizing of algorithms. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a passion for research, and technology and the ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in across geographical areas in the world. Excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Team-work is imperative in this role

Job responsibilities You will use your skills in incident management processes and tools, application monitoring metrics and tooling to generate reports and take corrective actions. Position Summary... What youll do... Job Summary As a SOC Analyst, you will monitor, detect, analyze, investigate, and support remediation of cybersecurity events in accordance with established standard operating procedures. You will combine hands-on security operations expertise with data-driven investigation, automation, and responsible use of AI/Generative AI to improve analyst effectiveness, detection quality, investigation consistency, and response outcomes. The role requires close collaboration with stakeholders, engineering teams, incident responders, and business units across a global operating environment. About the Team The Information Security organization helps protect Walmart s customers, associates, information assets, and technology environment. SOC Incident Management is a centralized security operations function responsible for monitoring, detecting, analyzing, investigating, escalating, and responding to security threats. Analysts work alongside security engineers, incident responders, threat intelligence teams, and other cybersecurity professionals to protect the organization s information assets and networks. Key Responsibilities Security Monitoring, Investigation Incident Response Monitor, triage, analyze, investigate, and support remediation of cyber events using defined SOC procedures, playbooks, escalation paths, and service expectations. Perform investigation across endpoint, network, email, identity, cloud, Windows, and Linux telemetry; correlate evidence across multiple data sources to determine scope, impact, root cause, and recommended actions. Run approved commands, queries, scripts, and automation for assigned areas of work while maintaining appropriate operational controls and documentation. Identify indicators of compromise, suspicious behaviors, attack patterns, and emerging risks; escalate confirmed or high-risk incidents to the appropriate response teams. Communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders during troubleshooting and security events, providing timely status, findings, risk context, and recommended next steps. Detection Engineering Continuous Improvement Provide actionable input to improve alert logic, correlation rules, detection use cases, thresholds, enrichment, prioritization, and suppression of known false positives. Identify opportunities for new risk detection based on investigation trends, threat intelligence, recurring incidents, control gaps, and observed attacker behavior. Partner with engineering and platform teams to validate and operationalize detection improvements across SIEM, EDR, SOAR, email security, firewall, IPS, and cloud security tooling. Capture investigation learnings, recurring patterns, root causes, and operational gaps; recommend measurable improvements to SOC processes, playbooks, documentation, and analyst workflows. AI / Generative AI Responsibilities Use approved AI/GenAI capabilities (for example, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, or enterprise-approved equivalents) to assist with investigation summarization, evidence correlation, query/script drafting, threat-context synthesis, case documentation, and recommendation generation. Critically validate AI-generated analysis against authoritative telemetry and security evidence before using it for incident decisions, escalation, remediation, or stakeholder communication. Maintain analyst accountability for final conclusions. Assess the quality of AI-assisted investigations by identifying inaccurate conclusions, missed evidence, weak reasoning, hallucinations, incomplete recommendations, or inconsistent outputs, and provide structured feedback for improvement. Help develop and refine prompts, analyst workflows, evaluation criteria, test cases, and feedback loops that improve the accuracy, consistency, explainability, and operational usefulness of AI-assisted SOC analysis. Identify appropriate opportunities to integrate AI/GenAI with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence, case-management, and knowledge-management workflows to reduce repetitive analyst effort and accelerate triage and investigation. Apply responsible-AI and security principles when using AI tools, including data handling, confidentiality, access controls, human oversight, traceability, and compliance with company policies and approved-use requirements. Monitor AI-assisted workflows for quality and operational risk, and escalate cases where AI output could create false assurance, inappropriate remediation, data exposure, or other security impact. Contribute to AI readiness across the SOC by documenting effective practices, sharing lessons learned, and supporting analyst adoption and training for approved AI-enabled capabilities. Build collaborative relationships across functional and organizational boundaries and respond effectively to stakeholder and business-unit requests. Governance, Ethics Compliance Operate in accordance with company policies, security standards, procedures, ethical expectations, and applicable compliance requirements. Protect sensitive information throughout investigations and communications, using approved systems and appropriate data-handling practices. Demonstrate professional judgment, fact-based decision-making, transparency, and appropriate escalation when evidence is incomplete or risk is uncertain. Experience range: 6-8 Yrs
Job Summary The Senior Associate, Record to Report (RTR) for Controllership will support end-to-end RTR accounting and controllership activities for assigned Warner Bros. Discovery entities and business areas. This role will be based in Hyderabad and will report directly to the Manager RTR. The role is responsible for accurate and timely month-end, quarter-end and annual close activities, journal entries, account reconciliations, variance analysis, financial reporting support, SOX documentation, audit support, and compliance with US GAAP and company accounting policies. Responsibilities Perform and support RTR accounting and controllership activities for the assigned scope, ensuring completeness, accuracy and timely delivery. Prepare and post month-end journal entries including accruals, prepaids, amortizations, reclasses and other standard or ad-hoc entries. Prepare balance sheet reconciliations, investigate reconciling items and aging, and support timely resolution of open items. Perform monthly and quarterly balance sheet and income statement variance analysis and provide clear explanations to controllership stakeholders. Support intercompany reconciliations, investigate out-of-balance items and coordinate timely resolution with WBD counterparts. Ensure all assigned close activities are completed in accordance with the close calendar, accounting policies and reporting requirements. Assess accounting implications of routine transactions, apply sound judgment within established policies, and escalate complex matters to the Manager RTR. Prepare and support financial reporting schedules, management reporting requirements and other close deliverables as assigned. Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness Ensure accounting and reconciliation supporting documentation meets SOX standards and internal control requirements. Execute assigned key controls, retain appropriate evidence and promptly escalate control exceptions or financial reporting risks. Support internal and external audits, statutory requirements, walkthroughs, testing and information requests, and help drive timely closure of open items. Transition and Operating Model Buildout Support transition, knowledge transfer, stabilization and documentation of RTR activities moving into the Hyderabad Accounting COE. Help establish and maintain process documentation, SOPs, ownership matrices, close checklists, KPIs and escalation protocols. Participate in training, shadowing, reverse-shadowing, testing and readiness activities to support successful transitions and business continuity. Transformation, Process Excellence and Systems Identify and implement opportunities for process standardization, simplification, automation and continuous improvement across RTR activities. Job Summary Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth ML), Hyderabad As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across WBD s global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams - including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting - while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5-8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring. Responsibilities ML System Design Ownership Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models. Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the WBD feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs. Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM). Modeling Experimentation Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching. Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case. Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs. Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR). MLOps Infrastructure Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks. Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency. Contribute to the team s feature-store strategy - feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs - and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds. Exercise independent judgment and effective challenge when business responses, proposed controls, risk acceptance decisions, or supporting evidence do not adequately address identified exposure or policy expectations. Monitor remediation plans, control gaps, exceptions, and outstanding actions through closure; escalate overdue or material items in accordance with governance and risk-management requirements. Track performance against established metrics and policy requirements, analyze trends and recurring issues, and present clear recommendations to management for strengthening risk governance and business performance. Maintain current knowledge of enterprise third-party risk management policies, standards, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry practices, and apply that knowledge consistently across assigned engagements. Assess third-party technology, cloud, software-as-a-service, and artificial intelligence use cases in coordination with relevant specialists, considering factors such as data handling, access controls, model governance, human oversight, transparency, resilience, subcontractor dependencies, and compliance with technology and vendor-management requirements. Support an accountable, collaborative, and risk-aware culture by managing multiple priorities, meeting committed timelines, maintaining high-quality documentation, and communicating professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

Product Security Engineer Role overview Xerox printers, multifunction devices, software and cloud services are used by enterprises, government agencies and regulated industries around the world. The Product Security team makes sure those products are designed, built and supported securely across their lifecycle, from threat modeling and secure development through vulnerability response and regulatory compliance. As a Product Security Engineer, you will be the main security partner for product and application teams. You will help them design securely, find and fix vulnerabilities, and meet the security requirements our customers and regulators expect. The role spans embedded devices and firmware, desktop and server software, and cloud services, and offers broad exposure to a varied attack surface. What you will do Secure design and development Act as a security consultant and primary point of contact for product and application teams, giving guidance on secure design, security requirements and vulnerability remediation. Perform and review threat models (for example, STRIDE) for devices, firmware, software and cloud services; triage identified threats and recommend mitigations. Conduct product and application security risk assessments, and evaluate remediation alternatives. Promote secure coding practices and help teams integrate security activities and tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA) throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). Support teams in addressing weaknesses aligned with the OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25 and Xerox security standards. Vulnerability management and incident response Participate in the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT): triage internally and externally reported vulnerabilities, analyze impact across product lines, assign CVSS scores, and coordinate fixes and security bulletins under the Xerox Vulnerability Management and Disclosure Policy. Support investigation of product security incidents, identify root causes and recommend measures to prevent recurrence. Track, prioritize and follow up on remediation to ensure timely resolution of security findings. Support Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and third-party component risk management. Standards and compliance Help product teams meet security requirements from regulations and certification programs such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act, FedRAMP, Common Criteria and FIPS 140-3. Develop and maintain product security guidance, standards and best practices. Program and engagement Drive security awareness, office hours, knowledge-sharing sessions and other Product Security engagement activities. Support continuous improvement of the Product Security program through process enhancements, metrics and stakeholder feedback. Build strong relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and influence security adoption without direct authority. Manage multiple priorities across several product teams. Required qualifications 5+ years of information security experience, including at least 4 years of hands-on application or product security work, or equivalent experience gained through work, training, military service or education. Hands-on experience defining security requirements, performing security risk assessments and applying a secure SDLC. Experience performing or reviewing threat models. Strong knowledge of the OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25, and common software vulnerabilities and their remediation. Experience using SAST, DAST and/or SCA tools and validating their findings. Working knowledge of at least one of C/C++, Java, Python or JavaScript, with the ability to read code to confirm and explain issues. Excellent communication, stakeholder management and consulting skills, and strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Preferred qualifications Experience securing embedded, IoT or Linux-based devices, including secure boot, firmware signing and update mechanisms. Experience with PSIRT operations, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, CVE and CVSS. Knowledge of applied cryptography and PKI, including awareness of post-quantum cryptography migration. Familiarity with the EU Cyber Resilience Act, FedRAMP, Common Criteria, FIPS 140-3 or similar programs. Cloud security experience (for example, AWS or Azure). Penetration testing, fuzzing or reverse engineering experience. Relevant certifications such as CSSLP, GIAC (GWEB, GSSP), OSCP or CISSP. Bachelor s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent experience. jobs.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : .Net Full Stack Development Good to have skills : NA Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: Seeking a forward-thinking professional with an AI-first mindset to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade solutions using Generative and Agentic AI frameworks that drive innovation, efficiency, and business transformation. AI Powered Tech Talent Roles & Responsibilities: Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery by applying GenAI and Agentic AI to address complex business challenges, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise workflows for measurable impact. Professional & Technical Skills: Strong grasp of Generative and Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation frameworks. Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization. We are seeking a dynamic Mid-Level Application Architects / Senior Developers with a strong focus on hands-on development and practical solution design. The ideal candidate will have robust experience in .NET Core, MVC, and Python, with working knowledge of front-end technologies like React or Angular, and a foundational understanding of AI integration. This role emphasizes active coding, solution implementation, and collaboration across application development, infrastructure, and integration in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) to deliver scalable, secure enterprise applications. Key Responsibilities: Hands-On Coding: Actively develop, test, and deploy application-heavy solutions, write clean, efficient code in any of the programming languages like .NET Core (C#, ASP.NET), and Python for backend systems, and contributing to front-end development using React or Angular. Solution Design: Partner with senior architects to design scalable, cloud-native application architectures, focusing on performance, maintainability, and integration in multi-cloud environments. Integration Development: Build and maintain integrations using APIs, microservices, and event-driven patterns (e.g., REST, GraphQL, Kafka, or message queues). Multi-Cloud Implementation: Develop and deploy applications across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, ensuring portability and optimization for cost and performance. AI Integration: Implement practical AI features (e.g., automation, basic analytics) using cloud-based AI services or frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch. Infrastructure Support: Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement containerized solutions (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines, with hands-on use of IaC tools like Terraform or BiCep. Performance & Security Optimization: Ensure applications meet performance and security standards through code reviews, testing, and adherence to best practices. Team Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and infrastructure teams to translate requirements into technical implementations, providing hands-on support and mentorship. Continuous Learning: Stay updated on full-stack development trends, cloud technologies, and AI advancements to contribute to innovative solutions. Qualifications & Skills: Experience: 5 to 12 years of hands-on experience in full-stack development, with at least 2 years in a lead developer or junior architect role focusing on application-heavy systems. Demonstrated experience building and deploying solutions in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Strong proficiency in .NET, and Python for backend development. Hands-on experience with front-end frameworks like React, Angular, or similar. Basic exposure to AI/ML integration, such as using cloud AI services (e.g., Azure Open AI, Azure Foundry, AWS SageMaker,) or simple ML frameworks. Practical experience with integration patterns (e.g., REST APIs, message queues) and microservices architecture. Familiarity with infrastructure tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and IaC (e.g., Terraform, BiCep). Experience with cloud-native services (e.g., Azure Functions, LogicApps, ServiceBus etc.). Working knowledge of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and monitoring tools. Understanding of secure coding practices and basic enterprise security standards (e.g., IAM, encryption). Soft Skills: Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with a hands-on mindset. Clear communication to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to juggle hands-on coding with architectural design contributions. Eagerness to learn and adapt to new tools, frameworks, and cloud technologies. Education: Bachelor s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. Certifications like Azure Developer Associate, Azure AI Fundamentals or similar are a plus. 15 years full time education

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon Customer Service (CS) is hiring a Software Development Engineer II to join the Associate Experience team. Our organization is at the forefront of customer experience — seeking to delight our customers in every interaction they have, whether through self-serve technology and tools (e.g., chatbots), or by interacting directly with our Customer Service Associates (CSA). Customer Service works to offer effective, empathetic, and efficient issue resolution when our customers need us, and we are also champions of driving defects out of customer experiences across the entire company, relentlessly advocating on behalf of customers and keeping them at the heart of everything we do. As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will design, develop, and own comprehensive customer engagement services and solutions that anticipate and resolve customer questions at global scale. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive technical strategy and improvements to our technology platform, owning systems that power the ultimate customer service experience. You will also contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior engineers on the team. You should be somebody who thrives on solving difficult technical problems, designing scalable solutions, and feels strongly about building reliable software with a customer-centric mindset. We use Scrum, test-driven development, and continuous deployment to deliver projects by making effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. If you are results-oriented, data-driven, and passionate about creating innovative customer experiences through technology, we would love to connect with you. Key job responsibilities Design, develop, and own software services and tools that solve difficult business and operational problems, delivering with a focus on simplicity and scalability Optimize and enhance existing systems for performance, reliability, and maintainability at Amazon scale Make informed technical decisions on system design, technology selection, and problem-solving approaches with limited guidance Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the development lifecycle, escalating when appropriate Partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to contribute to design reviews, align on technical direction, and drive improvements across team boundaries Make effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to deliver high-quality results within project timelines Track, analyze, and act on key metrics to optimize system performance and drive continuous improvement Identify and implement engineering process improvements, contributing to operational excellence and best practices across the team Mentor junior engineers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of learning and high standards Write clear technical documentation, including design documents and operational runbooks, to support system ownership and team knowledge sharing A day in the life As a Software Development Engineer II on the Associate Experience team, no two days look exactly the same — but each one centers on building technology that makes a real difference for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) and the customers they serve. You might start your morning reviewing metrics from a recent deployment, analyzing how a feature you own is performing at scale and identifying areas for optimization. Then you could be deep in a design review with your team, debating trade-offs between approaches for a new generative AI-powered automation feature. After that, you shift to hands-on coding — writing, testing, and shipping production-quality code using test-driven development and continuous deployment practices. Throughout the day, you collaborate with product managers and other SDEs to shape technical direction and translate customer needs into scalable solutions. You also make time to review pull requests from teammates and mentor junior engineers on best practices. Some days involve investigating and resolving production issues, making quick decisions to mitigate risks and keep systems running reliably. By end of day, you have contributed meaningfully to services that touch millions of customer interactions worldwide. About the team The Associate Experience team develops products to support Amazon's Customer Service Associates (CSAs) in delivering seamless customer service. Our mission is to empower CSAs with intelligent solutions — powered by generative AI, machine learning, and automation — that anticipate customer needs and accelerate issue resolution at global scale. We build AI assistants, contact automation, and real-time insight tools that reduce CSA effort and improve the customer experience with every interaction. Our team values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, and you will have the opportunity to work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about using cutting-edge technology to make a meaningful impact on how millions of customers experience Amazon support. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. null

jobs.title: Senior ServiceNow Platform Engineer
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. ServiceNow Engineer About Lilly At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. About the IT Organization Technology at Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using cutting edge technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Technology at Lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of the enterprise. Digital Core is at the forefront of digitalization to enable and advance the entire company, with increased productivity and best-in-class Customer experiences. This team provides a robust and sustainable infrastructure of hardware, software and services that are critical to enable our global workforce. As leaders in technology, this team defines and leads the overall company technology strategy. About the Team Global Service Management (GSM) team works to enable Lilly to enhance global productivity and protect our Brand. The team manages the industry leading ServiceNow enterprise platform. We enable our 69k global workforce to accelerate how they work, manage critical action plans, and enhance their working methods/environment, and manage key vendor contracts / spending. In addition to maintaining operational excellence for our existing services, we must boldly innovate and enhance capabilities such as generative AI, automation & workflows across the enterprise. This will enable us to enhance our return on investment, improve user efficiency and experience, and help support the broader Company purpose of making life better for people around the world. What You'll Be Doing As a ServiceNow Engineer on the ServiceNow platform, you'll serve as a senior technical SME and strategic leader within our Global Service Management organization. You'll drive platform innovation, lead technical delivery, and ensure seamless integration across enterprise systems. You'll collaborate with architects, developers, vendors, and business stakeholders to shape and evolve our ServiceNow ecosystem. In this role, you will also be expected to leverage and contribute to ServiceNow's rapidly evolving Agentic AI capabilities. This includes working with the ServiceNow Agentic AI Suite — encompassing Now Assist (Otto), ServiceNow's generative AI assistant that powers intelligent search, summarization, and conversational experiences across the platform — as well as Now Assist for Creator, which accelerates development by enabling AI-assisted flow design, code generation, and natural-language-to-configuration capabilities. You will be expected to evaluate, adopt, and operationalize these AI-native features to drive automation, improve developer productivity, and enhance the end-user experience across the enterprise. This is a Dev-Ops role, which means the position operates on a rotational shift basis. You will be required to work either morning shifts or evening shifts to ensure round-the-clock platform support, incident response, and operational continuity across global time zones. How You Will Succeed Platform Leadership: Own the technical roadmap for ServiceNow capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business goals. Solution Delivery: Lead end-to-end technical delivery for new features, including configuration, workflow design, UI customization, reporting, and integrations. Integration Strategy: Architect and implement integrations with LDAP/Active Directory, SSO (SAML, SiteMinder), REST/SOAP APIs, cloud platforms (AWS, VMware), and enterprise systems. Governance & Standards: Conduct impact analysis and code reviews to ensure conformance with architecture, data, and integration standards. Collaboration: Partner with Platform Architects, Technical Leads, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions. Support & Optimization: Provide expert-level troubleshooting and performance tuning across the platform. Documentation & Enablement: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation and mentor junior engineers. Continuous Improvement: Stay current with ServiceNow releases and industry trends to drive platform evolution. What You Will Bring Deep technical expertise in the ServiceNow platform, including administration, scripting, and application development. Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, CMDB, and configuration management principles. Proven experience leading technical delivery across the full software lifecycle. Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive mindset and commitment to excellence. A passion for mentoring, learning, and driving cross-functional success. Basic Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience: Minimum of 8 years of experience in ServiceNow development. Technical Skills: Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and ServiceNow scripting.Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and integration tools.Fluent in English for verbal and written communications, is essential. Additional Skills/Preferences ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is a plus. Applied knowledge of ITIL v3 or ITIL v4. Experience with AWS, VMware, JDBC/ODBC, and enterprise data management. Demonstrated ability to drive platform strategy and cross-functional alignment. A great sense of humor and passion for engaging people. Travel 0-10% Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. jobs.description: Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Position Overview We are seeking a talented and versatile AI / Machine Learning Engineer with 3–10 years of experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered capabilities across our electronic design and verification tools. In this hands-on engineering role, you will contribute to the design and implementation of AI/ML pipelines and Agentic AI systems, bridge modern GenAI architectures with robust software engineering, and integrate intelligent capabilities directly into engineering workflows. Collaborating closely with domain experts, software architects, and product teams, you will translate cutting-edge AI concepts—such as intelligent copilots, multi-step reasoning agents, and automated EDA verification assistants—into reliable, scalable, and high-impact solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and deploy end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions integrated into EDA software workflows and developer environments. Build and enhance intelligent agent systems capable of automated reasoning, planning, multi-step execution, and tool usage using modern frameworks (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol / MCP, etc.). Develop and optimize production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, and semantic reranking. Build robust data preprocessing, feature extraction, model inference, and evaluation pipelines adhering to clean code, testability, and CI/CD practices. Work closely with domain experts (chip design, verification), product managers, and core software engineering teams to formulate AI use cases, prototype solutions rapidly, and harden them into production. Ensure robust model safety, evaluation against hallucinations, prompt injection defenses, IP protection, and compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. Qualifications 3 to 10 years of professional software engineering and AI/ML experience, with proven hands-on involvement in taking AI/ML or LLM-based solutions from concept to production. Strong proficiency in Python with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modular architecture, and automated testing (pytest, CI/CD). Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs/GNNs), feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics. Practical experience building applications with foundational LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, etc.), prompt engineering best practices, and Agentic design patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, tool calling). Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies. Proficiency with modern ML and AI development libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LangGraph. Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows. Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations. Preferred & Good-to-Have Skills Hands-on experience with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, dataset preparation/curation, or domain-specific model adaptation using Hugging Face TRL or Axolotl. Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Apache AGE) and knowledge graph-augmented retrieval. Familiarity with C/C++, compiler concepts, or GPU profiling/acceleration (CUDA). Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases). Why Us We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Diversity & Inclusion We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Deputy Manager - Finance
jobs.description: Overview: Analyst, Cockpit Reporting & AI-Enabled Solutions. Digital Planning Transformation | Global Finance Cockpit Team Why this role exists. Cockpit is the single reporting platform behind the organization's financial planning: 7,000+ users, 175,000+ views every month, with all Operating Units converging onto one standard. The dashboards are largely built. What we're building now is different. We want reporting that maintains itself: dashboards that validate their own numbers, documentation that writes itself, insights that reach people without someone spending a Tuesday assembling them by hand. That's where we intend to be in two years. We are not there yet, and we're hiring the person who helps us get there. Generative AI is already part of how this team works. It isn't a pilot or a side project. But we care far more about someone who can tell when a model is confidently wrong than someone who has collected prompting tricks. What you'll actually do. Build reporting people rely on (the core of the job)Sit with Operating Units and Finance teams to understand what they actually need, which is usually not what they first asked for. Build financial performance dashboards with real drill-down, following our standard frameworks Improve what already exists: faster, clearer, more consistent Watch how people really consume the data, from analysts to senior leaders, and redesign around what you see. Apply our data security and FP&A reporting standards. We'll teach you these, and you'll follow them carefully Make the work smarter (this part grows as you do)Use AI in daily delivery: drafting documentation, writing and debugging calculations and SQL, accelerating requirements analysis Build and refine prompts for the things we do repeatedly (validation, documentation, quality checks) and improve them based on whether the output actually got better Catch AI's mistakes before a business user does: invented logic, results that don't reconcile, errors that fail silently Find the manual, repetitive parts of our reporting cycle and propose how to automate them Grow into shaping our AI validation and quality frameworks alongside the teamwork with people. Partner with S&T so business requirements survive the translation into Cockpit Help train and support Cockpit usersTake on high-priority projects as they come upWhat we need from you Genuinely required0 to 2 years of experience in analytics, reporting, data or engineering. Internships, academic work and personal projects all count. Hands-on with at least one BI or data tool. Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik, or a data-engineering background built on SQL, Python and pipelines. We don't need a Tableau expert. We build them. Most people here are productive in Tableau within a few months. What we need is someone who has already built something real with data and can walk us through the decisions they made and why. You use generative AI for real work, not just chat. Show us one concrete thing you built, automated or solved faster because of it.Basic SQL. You can read a query, understand a join, and trace where a number came from. You check whether a number makes sense before you publish it. This matters more than any tool on this list. Decent English, written and spoken. Comfort with things being unfinished. Our tooling changes every few months. That's the job, not a defect in it.Helpful, but not expected Python, Databricks, or any cloud data platform APIs, automation tools, or anything you've built with AI beyond a chat window. Finance or FP&A background, or familiarity with P&L and performance reporting. Data modeling fundamentals (grain, joins, single source of truth)Not requiredTableau certification. Prior finance work experience. Having done this exact job before. If you're strong on judgment and genuinely fluent with AI, apply. We'll teach you the rest. What you'll be in 18 months. You'll understand how a global company actually plans and measures itself, and you'll have built reporting that thousands of people use to make real decisions. You'll be fluent in Tableau, working well past dashboard-building, and helping define how an AI-enabled reporting function operates. Very few people anywhere have done that yet. This role sits where finance, data and AI meet, and that intersection is where the interesting careers are being built right now. How we'll assess you1. A dashboard you build on your own time. We'll send you a dataset and a short brief. Build something you'd be comfortable putting in front of a finance team. Use whatever tool you're strongest in: Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Qlik, Python, or something else. We are not testing which software you know.2. A conversation about what you built. You'll walk us through your reasoning: the design choices, what the data let you say and what it didn't, and where you weren't sure. Then we'll ask you to make a couple of changes to it live, with us. That's not a trap. It's the closest thing to how this job actually feels when a stakeholder changes their mind mid-review.3. A conversation about AI on real work. How you use it day to day, and how you decide whether to trust what it hands you. Using AI on the exercise is fine and expected. Just be ready to explain what you used it for and how you verified it. Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain interactive Tableau dashboards, reports, and scorecards. Gather and analyze business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into BI solutions. Write complex SQL queries and scripts to extract, transform, and validate data. Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and business insights. Optimize Tableau workbooks and SQL queries for performance and scalability. Develop and maintain data models, data sources, and metadata documentation. Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across reporting solutions. Work closely with business teams, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reporting requirements. Automate recurring reporting processes and improve operational efficiency. Troubleshoot data discrepancies and resolve dashboard-related issues. Participate in testing, deployment, and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience in Tableau dashboard development and SQL programming. Strong expertise in Tableau Desktop, Tableau Server/Cloud, and Tableau Prep. Advanced SQL skills with experience in writing complex queries, joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning. Experience working with large datasets and relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar. Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and data modeling. Experience gathering business requirements and working directly with stakeholders. Knowledge of KPI development, data visualization best practices, and dashboard design principles. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments. Exposure to FP&A, Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, or Operations reporting domains.

jobs.description: DESCRIPTION AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud. AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses. AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries. Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS. Key job responsibilities Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment · In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales A day in the life As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem. The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. jobs.title: QAE II, Amazon Business Operations, Amazon Business Operations
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon. We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches. Key job responsibilities As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will: Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign-off. Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase. Test operator-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response. Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on. Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does. You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role. A day in the life You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign-off is the gate. About the team Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. This is a new engineering team inside it, dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and you are joining at the start. We work in small teams with direct ownership, we measure ourselves on what changed for the customer, and we expect engineers to argue about design in writing. Expect high autonomy, close contact with the operators and customers you build for, and problems that have not been solved anywhere in Amazon yet. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience Experience in automation testing Experience in manual testing Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Experience scripting or coding Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design Experience in penetration testing and exploitability-focused vulnerability assessment Knowledge of overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance in a database environment Experience debugging, diagnosing, and troubleshooting complex, production software issues Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. as the technical expert for the India market You may be a good fit if you have: 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Implement robust batch and near real time data pipelines supporting analytics, reporting, data warehousing, and downstream applications. Build reusable data flows, workflows, and transforms aligned to enterprise data architecture standards. 2) Data Modeling, Transformation & Enrichment Design complex transformation logic using BODS features such as queries, transforms, lookups, hierarchies, and reusable objects. Implement data enrichment, standardization, and harmonization logic across multiple source systems. Apply canonical data modeling practices to reduce duplication and point to point complexity. 3) Data Quality, Profiling & Governance Implement data quality rules for validation, cleansing, matching, deduplication, and standardization. Build profiling and validation pipelines to assess data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. Support governance requirements through lineage-aware jobs, audit trails, and traceable transformations. 4) AI Native Data Engineering (Agentic ETL Layer) Build data engineering agents that can: o Analyze source metadata and recommend transformation logic. o Propose data quality rules based on observed patterns and historical issues. o Auto-generate initial ETL mappings and job scaffolding, validated against enterprise standards. Implement retrieval grounded assistance that uses metadata catalogs, mapping documents, business rules, and historical defects to produce verifiable recommendations. Enable conversational exploration of data pipelines (e.g., why did this record fail , what changed in yesterday s load ) with grounded, auditable outputs. 5) Testing, Validation & Evaluation Loops Design automated validation strategies: schema checks, row counts, reconciliation rules, referential integrity checks, and regression comparisons. Establish evaluation harnesses for AI behaviors: golden datasets for transformations, accuracy checks for generated rules, and drift detection. Gate releases of ETL logic and AI-generated artifacts through measurable quality thresholds. 6) Performance, Scalability & Reliability Optimize ETL jobs for performance and scalability (parallelism, pushdown, efficient transforms, resource tuning). jobs.description: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer Role Overview: As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte’s engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering—together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio—consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence. Key Responsibilities: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability—ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production—gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability—codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks—operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery. Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements—progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement—rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable. Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering—cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering—together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate—and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling.
