jobs.description: We are seeking an innovative and hands-on AI Security Engineer to design, develop, and implement AI-powered solutions that transform traditional cybersecurity processes through intelligent automation, agentic AI, and secure software engineering. This role will primarily focus on developing autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents to identify, analyze, correlate, and prioritize security vulnerabilities; generate remediation recommendations; automate secure code and dependency fixes; validate proposed changes; create GitHub pull requests; and proactively engage application owners through intelligent notification and escalation workflows. jobs.description: Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka Team: Data Science Job Requisition #: R264031 Date posted: Nov. 02, 2026 Job description About this role Build efficient, trusted agentic AI for private-markets intelligence Research, build and scale advanced agentic systems and fit-for-purpose language models that turn complex information into dependable data, research and decision intelligence. Your team You will join a multidisciplinary AI and data science team focused on applying advanced AI to high-value challenges in private markets. The team brings together data science, engineering, product and domain expertise, and works closely with users to develop practical capabilities that improve how information is acquired, researched and managed. You will work in an environment where applied research is expected to become dependable production capability. We value intellectual curiosity, rigorous experimentation, strong engineering and responsible AI, with quality, security and appropriate human oversight designed in from the start. Your role & impact As an Associate, AI Data Scientist, you will be a hands-on technical contributor responsible for researching, building and scaling enterprise-grade agentic AI capabilities. Working directly with users and senior technical leaders, you will translate complex private-markets workflows into well-evaluated systems that move from experimentation to governed production and sustained adoption. Your core mandate is to advance multi-agent LLM systems through effective agent design patterns, rigorous evaluation and disciplined model engineering. You will develop workflows that plan, retrieve, reason, use tools, verify and escalate appropriately, while selecting the simplest architecture and model that can meet the required quality, latency, cost and control objectives. You will also help establish the lifecycle for open-source small language models and LLMs, from model discovery and benchmarking through training, adaptation, fine-tuning, deployment, monitoring and retirement. Your impact will be visible in stronger data quality, faster research, scalable automation and reusable AI capabilities that help BlackRock Preqin remain at the forefront of private-markets data and technology. Your responsibilities Work forward-deployed with researchers, data specialists and product teams to understand workflows, frame ambiguous problems, define measurable outcomes and iterate rapidly from evidence to production. Research, design and deliver agentic workflows spanning planning, retrieval, tool use, structured extraction, reasoning, verification, exception handling and human escalation, using single-agent or multi-agent patterns where each is demonstrably appropriate. Engineer advanced agent patterns, including bounded iterative loops, reflection and critique, planner-executor and evaluator-optimizer patterns, with explicit stop conditions, budgets and safeguards that prevent unproductive or uncontrolled execution. Build agent and model harnesses that standardise tool interfaces, context assembly, state and memory handling, policy enforcement, tracing, replay and failure recovery. Determine when an agentic architecture, retrieval workflow, specialised model or deterministic service is the best fit, and validate the decision against representative tasks and simpler baselines. Design safe caching and reuse across retrieval, prompts, model responses, tool results and intermediate agent state, with clear cache keys, invalidation, freshness, access-control and provenance requirements. Build systematic evaluation harnesses using representative datasets, explicit quality dimensions, adversarial and edge-case testing, regression suites, human feedback and monitored production outcomes. Research and benchmark open-source SLMs and LLMs for task fit, considering quality, inference performance, cost, licensing, security, deployment constraints and operational supportability; apply fit-for-purpose routing and batching where they improve efficiency. Develop model-adaptation strategies using prompt and context optimisation, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning or other suitable techniques, supported by governed dataset creation, experiment tracking, reproducibility and controlled promotion criteria. Operate the lifecycle for trained and fine-tuned open-source models, including data and model versioning, lineage, experiment and artifact management, evaluation gates, registry and release controls, deployment, performance and drift monitoring, rollback, retraining triggers and retirement. Build production-quality Python components that integrate models with enterprise data, retrieval services, APIs, workflow orchestration and human-review experiences. Improve grounding and trust through attribution, provenance, uncertainty handling, validation checks, access controls and clear separation of source evidence from model-generated conclusions. Own delivered reliability across testing, observability, latency, cost and maintainability, and diagnose model, data, prompt and orchestration failures in production. Document findings, reusable patterns and trade-offs; contribute to design reviews; and communicate results clearly to research, product, engineering, risk and senior stakeholders. Partner with engineering, product, risk, privacy, information security, legal and compliance colleagues to support responsible, secure and accountable use of AI. Required experience We are looking for a hands-on applied AI practitioner who combines strong research and modelling skills with production judgment and user-focused problem solving. You should bring: Strong experience building and deploying AI or machine-learning systems in an enterprise, SaaS, data-product or similarly complex environment, with evidence of taking work beyond prototypes. Practical depth in LLM applications and agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, planning, orchestration, memory or state management, structured outputs, verification and evaluation of non-deterministic behaviour. Experience implementing and comparing bounded loops, reflection or critique, planner-executor and evaluator-optimizer patterns against simpler baselines, with measurable treatment of quality, reliability, latency, token usage, cost and failure modes. Experience building agent or model harnesses across tool interfaces, context and state management, orchestration, policy enforcement, testing, tracing, replay, deployment and observability. Hands-on experience evaluating, selecting, training or adapting open-source SLMs or LLMs, including benchmarking, governed dataset preparation, supervised or parameter-efficient fine-tuning and inference optimisation. Practical ModelOps experience for trained or fine-tuned models, including dataset and model lineage, experiment and artifact tracking, registries, evaluation gates, controlled release, performance and drift monitoring, rollback, retraining and retirement. Experience designing model routing, batching and safe caching with appropriate keying, invalidation, freshness, privacy, access-control and provenance safeguards. Strong grounding in modern machine learning, experimentation and statistical evaluation, with disciplined handling of train-test separation, leakage, uncertainty, reproducibility and model comparison. Ability to write production-quality Python and work effectively across data preparation, model development, APIs, orchestration, testing, deployment and observability. Experience with unstructured or multimodal information, semantic retrieval, provenance and data-quality engineering in workflows where domain experts provide ground truth and structured feedback. Experience working directly with users or domain specialists to turn ambiguous needs into usable capabilities and iterate based on observed workflow outcomes. Sound judgment on model and architecture trade-offs across efficacy, efficiency, security, licensing, maintainability and operational risk. Clear communication and collaborative delivery skills, with the ability to explain experiments, limitations and production trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences. Why this role This is an opportunity to work on consequential AI problems, real user workflows and high standards for trust. jobs.title: Staff, AI Product Management (Global Functions)
jobs.description: About the Role: GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and digital workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes. We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager (Director level equivalent role) to own a major slice of our Global Functions portfolio and act as the strategic counterpart to the engineers and digital workers in your pod, setting the forward deployed strategy they execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can identify and shape high-value AI opportunities across the key areas of Global Functions - HR, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, or Finance, build the case to fund and deploy against them, and ensure FDEs are working on what matters most. You will not manage engineers; you will shape what they build in your domain and how we measure whether it worked. Why This Role Exists: Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things. In this role you will be the person who: Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio. Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain. Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end. Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale. How This Differs from Traditional Product Management: This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you: Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform. Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements. Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off. Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime. Key Responsibilities: Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing: Hunt for high-value AI opportunities within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value. Quantify value rigorously. Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained. Develop deep domain pattern recognition so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated. Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping: Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain. Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio. Make trade-off recommendations. When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go. Protect engineering focus. Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes. Engineering Partnership & Enablement Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain. Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against. Shape engagements end-to-end. Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute. Surface re-use and platform leverage when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability. Design the human–digital split. Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe. Stakeholder Alignment & Communication Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders. Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements. Build sponsor coalitions that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements. Communicate impact clearly in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes. Measurement, Learning & Iteration Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn. Run honest post-mortems and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities. Required Functional Experience: 18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations. Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery. Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it. Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices. Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount. A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software. Skills AI Platforms, AI Product Management, Generative AI, Machine Learning (ML), Production Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmap, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior AI Engineer Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, you'll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to Roles & Responsibilities Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions. Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs. Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations. Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions. Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale. Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production. Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring. Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models. Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists. Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards. Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program. All About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability. Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably. Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency. Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models. A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains. Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome). Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value. Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents. Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability. Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock. Coming from a backend background? We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. If you've built high-throughput systems and started applying those skills to LLM-powered products, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't worked with every tool listed here Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Title and Summary AI Principal Architect Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you. Roles & Responsibilities Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale. Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks). Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context. Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond. Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention. Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models. Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency. Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards. Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness. Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program. Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point. All About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure. Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM. Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail. Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency. Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry. jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - STA
jobs.description: Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Position Overview We are seeking a talented Product Engineer – STA to join our team in Bangalore and Noida. In this role, you will work on cutting-edge 7nm and 5nm designs with various customers for the deployment of Aprisa place and route tools. You will be an expert in solving critical design challenges to achieve desired performance, area, and power targets. You will develop flows and methodologies for placement, CTS, and routing while providing training and technical support to customers using Aprisa tools. This is a hybrid role offering flexibility while enabling you to travel across India and globally to support our customers and teams shaping the future of semiconductor design. Key Responsibilities Develop and optimize placement, CTS, and routing flows and methodologies for complex block and full-chip designs using Aprisa tools. Provide expert technical support and training to customers deploying Aprisa place and route tools for 7nm and 5nm designs. Solve critical design problems to achieve desired performance, area, and power targets for complex semiconductor designs. Identify and resolve timing, power, and area trade-offs using deep domain expertise and optimization techniques. Collaborate with R&D teams to develop signoff-ready ECO flows and drive correlation improvements. Proactively triage and resolve customer issues and JIRAs, driving solutions through to completion with ownership mentality. Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, AI-assisted scripting) to optimize workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and accelerate debugging. Provide clear cross-functional communication between customers, R&D, and internal teams to ensure project success. Qualifications 4–8 years of hands-on experience in Physical Design (floorplan, placement, CTS, routing) and timing closure of complex blocks and/or full-chip designs. Proven experience with commercial place and route tools such as Synopsys-ICC2, Cadence-Innovus, or Aprisa. Tapeout experience on 2 or more projects. Strong understanding of timing, power, and area trade-offs in semiconductor design. Highly skilled in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Copilot, AI-assisted scripting) to optimize workflows, debug, and automate repetitive tasks. Excellent verbal and written communication abilities with strong presentation and problem-solving skills. Experience with Static Timing Analysis (STA) tools such as PrimeTime and Tempus is preferred. Additional Preferred Qualifications Experience with multiple voltage islands and top-level floor-planning and chip-assembly. BE/B.Tech in Electronics and Communication (E&C), Electrical, or Telecom Engineering; ME/M.Tech in VLSI or Microelectronics is a plus. Ability to pick up new flows, learn on the job, and drive quality of results improvements. Why Us We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Diversity & Inclusion We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday #LI-Hybrid #LI-EDA

jobs.description: Job Description: CCaaS Voice Senior Manager (with Dialer Experience) – Responsible for managing and optimizing cloud contact center and voice platforms, including inbound, outbound, and predictive dialer solutions. The role oversees CCaaS operations, telephony infrastructure, dialer campaigns, SIP/VoIP integrations, vendor management, and service delivery while ensuring platform stability, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate should have experience with cloud contact center technologies, outbound dialing platforms, and customer engagement solutions, along with strong leadership and stakeholder management skills. Responsibilities: Lead the day-to-day management, support, and optimization of CCaaS and voice platforms, ensuring high availability and service performance. Manage inbound, outbound, preview, progressive, and predictive dialer operations to support business and client objectives. Oversee telephony technologies including SIP, VoIP, SBCs, carrier connectivity, IVR, call routing, and voice infrastructure integrations. Drive implementation, migration, and transformation initiatives involving cloud contact center platforms and dialer solutions. Collaborate with Operations, Business, Clients, and Vendors to define requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver technology enhancements. Monitor platform health, performance, capacity, and service levels; proactively identify and mitigate operational risks. Lead incident, problem, change, and release management activities for voice and contact center technologies. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, dialing regulations, security standards, and organizational policies. Manage integrations with CRM, workforce management, recording, analytics, AI, and customer engagement platforms. Analyze contact center metrics and dialer performance to improve productivity, contact rates, customer experience, and operational efficiency. Develop and maintain operational procedures, technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and governance processes. Manage vendor relationships, service providers, and technology partners to ensure effective support and delivery. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of CCaaS, voice, and dialer engineers, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and resiliency planning for contact center and telephony environments. Provide technical leadership and strategic recommendations for future contact center and customer experience technology roadmaps. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. Minimum of 8–10 years of experience in contact center technologies, telephony, CCaaS platforms, and voice infrastructure. Minimum of 3–5 years of leadership or people management experience leading technical teams and service delivery functions. Strong hands-on experience with one or more CCaaS platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, Five9, Webex Contact Center, NICE CXone , or equivalent. Proven experience managing outbound dialing solutions including predictive, progressive, preview, and manual dialer campaigns . Solid understanding of SIP, VoIP, SBCs, carrier connectivity, IVR, call routing, and telephony architectures . Experience integrating contact center platforms with CRM, Workforce Management (WFM), Quality Management (QM), Recording, Analytics, and AI solutions . Strong knowledge of contact center operations, KPIs, service levels, customer experience, and workforce optimization practices. Experience supporting large-scale, multi-site, or global contact center environments. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage complex technical incidents and escalations. Knowledge of compliance requirements related to outbound dialing, telecommunications, security, and data privacy regulations. Experience managing technology vendors, carriers, and third-party service providers. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and client-facing skills. Ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage multiple priorities, and drive technology transformation initiatives. Relevant certifications in cloud, contact center, telephony, or networking technologies are preferred (e.g., AWS, Genesys, Cisco, Microsoft, Avaya, Five9, etc.). Preferred Qualifications Experience within BPO, Customer Experience (CX), Contact Center, Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, or Telecommunications industries. Exposure to AI-enabled contact center technologies, conversational AI, speech analytics, workforce engagement management, and automation platforms. Experience leading CCaaS migrations, cloud transformation programs, and telephony modernization initiatives.

jobs.description: At Siemens, we help organizations transform maintenance and operations through connected insights, AI-powered technology, and intelligent asset management solutions. Our software enables customers to handle the full lifecycle of assets, facilities, and infrastructure while improving efficiency, reducing risk, and optimizing long-term investments. Description: Siemens continues to grow and needs exceptional engineers. This is an excellent opportunity for versatile software professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You will work alongside our world-class engineering and product teams to design, implement, deliver, and support highly ambitious SaaS products and integrations. We are building a team that treats AI not as a novelty but as a core part of the engineering workflow — from AI-assisted coding and automated code review to agentic pipelines that amplify what individual engineers can deliver. You will bring your curiosity about these emerging practices and your passion for the craft of software engineering. You will make and impact by: Build innovative, performant features into our next-generation SaaS applications, applying core computer science principles — data structures, algorithms, and design patterns — to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. Design, implement, test, and document services and components that scale across multiple projects as common services or shared modules, within scope, cost, time, and quality constraints. Embed quality throughout the full agile product lifecycle: requirements, design, code, testing, delivery, and production support — including owning root-cause resolution of production defects. Write clean, maintainable code; uphold and continuously improve engineering standards in a professional environment (source control, CI/CD, shortened release cycles, automated testing). Partner with product owners and senior engineers to translate user requirements into technical specifications, offering pragmatic feasibility guidance and data-driven decision making. Leverage AI-assisted developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) to accelerate coding, code review, test generation, and debugging — and actively share practices and learnings with the team. Participate in agentic development workflows where AI agents assist with or autonomously handle defined stages of the SDLC — such as story enrichment, scaffolding, test generation, and PR summarization — reviewing agent output critically and ensuring quality before merge. This is how you will win us over: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related team, or equivalent professional experience. 1–3 years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining web-based or service-oriented applications. Solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, SQL/databases, REST API design, and SOLID principles. Experience with unit testing, mocking frameworks, and test automation — with a quality-first mindset across the full development lifecycle. DevOps mindset: familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, exception handling, logging, monitoring, and operational metrics in a mature SDLC environment. Strong communication, partnership, and teamwork skills; experience working in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, or equivalent). You will thrive even more if you also bring: Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants and prompt engineering — using tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar to accelerate code generation, test scaffolding, documentation, and code review. Exposure to agentic development patterns: understanding how LLM-powered agents can be chained or orchestrated to automate multi-step engineering tasks (e.g., requirement analysis code generation test writing PR creation), and experience evaluating or integrating such pipelines into a team workflow. Familiarity with LLM tool-use, function calling, or structured output techniques that enable AI agents to interact with APIs, codebases, and external systems in a controlled, verifiable way. Cloud platform exposure — AWS, Azure, or GCP — including containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). Experience with event-driven or messaging architectures (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ, or similar). Open-source contributions, personal projects, hackathon participation, or active involvement in developer communities — especially AI/ML or developer-tooling focused. Certifications in cloud platforms, AI/ML fundamentals, technology, or agile methodologies. Prior experience in agile at scale across globally distributed teams. At Siemens, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career while helping organizations operate smarter, safer, and more sustainably. We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, where employees are empowered to make a difference every day. If you're excited about solving real-world challenges, building AI-augmented software, and shaping the future of asset management, we encourage you to apply. #AMS

full lifecycle of at least one non-trivial AI capability: problem framing, evaluation strategy, prompt/context engineering, orchestration, deployment, and post-launch tuning Build deterministic guardrails around probabilistic components — retries, validation, fallback paths, human-in-the-loop checkpoints where confidence is low Design evaluation harnesses and offline/online eval pipelines that actually catch regressions, not vanity metrics Make real architectural tradeoffs on latency, cost, and reliability — token economics is a design constraint you think about upfront, not an afterthought Integrate AI systems into existing production infrastructure (APIs, data pipelines, orchestration layers) without breaking what already works Push back on bad ideas — including ours — systems fundamentals: APIs, event-driven design, queuing, observability, CI/CD Able to reason clearly about cost, latency, and failure modes at design time, not just after something breaks in jobs.title: Senior Researcher - Security & AI
jobs.description: Overview Lab Overview Microsoft Research India, based in Bengaluru, is home to a vibrant concentration of talent, pursuing important questions across AI and Machine Learning, systems, security and cryptography, and AI for healthcare. The lab combines the freedom to pursue deep, long-term research with a strong culture of building and experimentation, interdisciplinary collaboration, and opportunities to translate research advances into real-world impact. Researchers publish openly, engage with the global research community, and collaborate with teams across Microsoft, creating an environment where fundamental ideas and practical impact can reinforce each other. Learn more about the people, research, and projects at Microsoft Research India. Role Overview AI is rapidly changing both the systems we need to secure and the way security itself is practiced. AI systems increasingly interact with sensitive data, execute code, invoke tools, and take actions across complex environments, creating new security challenges. At the same time, advances in AI create opportunities to fundamentally rethink how we detect vulnerabilities, understand attacks, and build defences. Our team is pursuing a forward-looking research agenda at the intersection of security and AI , spanning both securing AI systems and using AI to advance security . Our research includes protecting sensitive data throughout AI pipelines, securing agentic and autonomous systems against new classes of attacks, developing principled defences for AI-enabled systems, and using AI to discover vulnerabilities, understand complex attack surfaces, and develop new security defences. Role Description As a Senior Researcher – Security and AI , you will push the state of the art in security for emerging AI systems. You will pursue significant, long-term research problems while also having opportunities to translate research advances into systems deployed at Microsoft scale. You will work with researchers and engineers across MSR India, Microsoft Research worldwide, and Microsoft product groups, enabling your work to have impact both in the research community and on systems used by millions of users. We are looking for candidates who: Are passionate about advancing the state of the art in security, privacy, cryptography, systems, and AI Have a strong research track record, demonstrated through publications at top venues such as IEEE S&P, USENIX Security, ACM CCS, NDSS , or other leading security, systems, cryptography, or machine learning venues Are excited about tackling emerging security problems created by AI and agentic systems Combine scientific rigor with strong systems thinking and the ability to turn research ideas into working prototypes Thrive in a highly collaborative, interdisciplinary research environment Take end-to-end ownership of complex, open-ended research problems Responsibilities Lead research at the intersection of security and AI, spanning both securing AI systems and applying AI to security problems. Develop new techniques to protect sensitive and proprietary data in AI systems and pipelines, including training, post-training, reinforcement learning, inference, and agentic workflows. Investigate the security of AI agents and autonomous systems, including attacks arising from tool use, code execution, memory, external data, multi-agent interaction, and long-running autonomous behavior, and develop principled defenses against them. Explore how AI can help address critical security problems, including discovering vulnerabilities and attack paths, understanding complex security environments, detecting attacks and anomalous behavior, and developing effective defenses. Investigate new attacks enabled or amplified by advances in AI and develop robust defenses against them. Design rigorous threat models, benchmarks, evaluations, and experimental methodologies for emerging AI security problems. Form hypotheses, build prototypes, design experiments, and evaluate new security mechanisms in realistic environments. Pursue significant, long-term research while identifying opportunities to translate promising ideas into practical security mechanisms. Publish at top-tier security, systems, cryptography, and machine learning venues, release research artifacts where appropriate, and help shape the research agenda in security and AI. Collaborate with research and product teams across Microsoft to translate research advances into stronger security for real-world Microsoft systems. Mentor interns and early-career researchers and contribute to MSR India's broader academic and research engagement. Embody our culture and values. Qualifications Required PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. 1+ years of software engineering or research experience. Strong background in one or more areas of computer security, privacy, cryptography, computer systems, or machine learning. Strong research track record in security, cryptography, systems, machine learning, or a closely related area. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and communicate results through publications, prototypes, open-source artifacts, or other impactful outcomes. Ability to identify and formulate important research problems, develop novel technical approaches, and evaluate them rigorously. Ability to work effectively across disciplinary boundaries and collaborate with diverse research and engineering teams. Preferred Research experience in AI security, security of LLMs, or security of agentic systems. Experience with security and privacy techniques for AI training, post-training, inference, or data pipelines. Experience in areas such as systems security, applied cryptography, privacy-enhancing technologies, confidential computing, access control, or secure machine learning. Experience studying adversarial behavior, software vulnerabilities, attack surfaces, or security of large-scale systems. Experience applying LLMs or other AI techniques to security problems such as vulnerability discovery, security analysis, attack detection, or defense generation. Experience building and evaluating large-scale security or AI systems. Experience designing threat models, security benchmarks, adversarial evaluations, or red-team methodologies for emerging systems. Experience working across the research-to-production boundary and translating research ideas into real-world systems. How to Apply Please apply using the link above. In addition, please send an email to the Hiring Committee at seas-hiring-msri@microsoft.com. Interested in other research opportunities? Explore current opportunities at Microsoft Research India. GitOps & Automation: Practical experience configuring and debugging GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux) and CI platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). Observability: Strong working knowledge of Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry collectors, and centralized log aggregation tools. You will shape the platform capabilities, technical strategy, and engineering practices that enable Jira to become the system of record and control plane for the next generation of human and agent teamwork. Our work is guided by three forces that will power the Jira Platform flywheel: AI TRANSFORMATION: Make Jira the agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork, designing systems that enable people and AI agents to work together effectively. ENTERPRISE READINESS: Build the security, scale, resilience, and administrative capabilities required to earn the trust of the world’s largest and most demanding enterprises as they move to the Cloud. EFFICIENCY: Create a platform with sound unit economics that accelerates developer productivity, supports a growing agentic workload, and delivers world-class reliability for Jira Cloud customers. Your future team API extensibility addresses two major gaps for Jira Platform preventing future agentic and cloud growth. First, reactive gaps : customers are hitting real blockers today driven by company-wide initiatives in motion, including DC to Cloud migration, Connect to Forge migration, and rate limiting rollout. Legacy API gaps that were once tolerable have become migration-critical. Second, proactive structural gaps : Establish Governance as the foundation, Enterprise Readiness to close the immediate gaps, and Agent-first Jira as the strategic bet. As a senior leader, you will work closely with multiple principal engineers, mentor and coach engineers. You will not only drive impactful business outcomes but also take part actively in driving the technical architecture. As a seasoned leader, you will bring in world-class engineering excellence and operational excellence. Application Security AnalystJob SummaryThe Application Security Analyst is responsible for supporting the organization's Application Security Program by identifying, assessing, tracking, and coordinating remediation of security vulnerabilities and technical issues within applications, APIs, and supporting platforms. The role works closely with development teams, OEM vendors, security teams, and operational stakeholders to ensure applications comply with organizational security requirements and industry best practices.The analyst will coordinate with OEM vendors to resolve security-related bugs, software defects, and technical issues, enforce security policies defined by the Account Security Team, and generate security and operational reports to support governance, risk management, and compliance activities.Key ResponsibilitiesApplication Security Assessment RemediationReview application security findings from SAST, DAST, SCA, API security, and penetration testing activities. Track application security vulnerabilities through the remediation lifecycle until closure. Coordinate with development, infrastructure, cloud, and application support teams to implement remediation recommendations. Validate remediation activities and perform retesting where applicable. Support secure application deployment and release processes. OEM Vendor CoordinationCoordinate with OEM vendors and third-party software providers to resolve security vulnerabilities, software bugs, patching issues, and technical defects affecting business applications. Review vendor security advisories and assess application impact. Track vendor remediation timelines and escalate critical security issues when necessary. Participate in technical discussions with OEM support teams regarding application security concerns. Ensure vendor-provided fixes are properly tested and implemented. Security Policy EnforcementEnforce application security policies, standards, and secure coding requirements as requested by the Account Security Team. Support implementation of security controls throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). Verify compliance with secure coding standards such as OWASP Top 10, CWE, and organizational security baselines. Monitor application compliance with established security requirements. Support risk exception and remediation governance processes. Security Testing ValidationSupport and coordinate: Static Application Security Testing (SAST) Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) Software Composition Analysis (SCA) API Security Assessments Penetration Testing activities Analyze findings and prioritize remediation activities based on risk and business impact. Review security testing results and provide remediation guidance to development teams. Reporting Metrics Generate security and operational reports mutually agreed with the Account Security Team. Produce dashboards and metrics related to: Open application vulnerabilities Critical and high-risk findings Remediation SLA compliance Application security testing coverage Secure SDLC compliance Present application security posture and remediation status to stakeholders and management. Security Governance Compliance Support compliance initiatives involving: OWASP ASVS OWASP Top 10 PCI DSS NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) ISO 27001 SOC Controls Assist with internal and external audits related to application security. Maintain application security documentation, risk registers, and remediation tracking records. Continuous ImprovementIdentify opportunities to improve application security processes and controls. Recommend enhancements to security testing methodologies and tooling. Assist in integrating security requirements into DevSecOps pipelines. Support Application Security Program maturity initiatives. Contribute to development of secure coding awareness and training materials. Required QualificationsEducationBachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related field. Equivalent professional experience may be considered. ExperienceMid-Level Analyst3–5 years of experience in Application Security, Security Operations, Software Development, Vulnerability Management, or related cybersecurity functions. Senior Analyst5–8 years of experience supporting enterprise application security programs. Technical SkillsApplication Security ToolsExperience with one or more: SASTCheckmarx Fortify Veracode SonarQube DASTBurp Suite OWASP ZAP Acunetix SCASnyk Black Duck Mend (WhiteSource) API SecurityPostman Security Testing Burp Suite API Testing Salt Security Security KnowledgeOWASP Top 10 CWE/SANS Top 25 Secure SDLC DevSecOps Threat Modeling Secure Coding Practices PlatformsWeb Applications APIs Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure) Containers and Kubernetes CI/CD Pipelines Preferred CertificationsCompTIA Security+ CSSLP GWAPT GWEB CEH CISSP Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500) AWS Security Specialty Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP) Desired CompetenciesStrong application security assessment skills Ability to work effectively with development teams Vendor management and coordination experience Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills Strong reporting and documentation capabilities Risk-based decision-making and prioritization Analytical problem-solving mindset Sample Day-to-Day ActivitiesReview application security scan findings. Coordinate remediation with development teams and OEM vendors. Validate security fixes and perform retesting. Track remediation SLA compliance. Enforce application security standards and policies. Generate weekly and monthly application security reports. Participate in vulnerability review meetings. Support secure SDLC and DevSecOps initiatives. Assist with audit and compliance activities. Interview Questions for This Role Application Security What is the difference between SAST, DAST, and SCA? How would you prioritize application security vulnerabilities? Explain the OWASP Top 10 and its importance. OEM Coordination Describe a situation where you worked with a vendor to resolve a security issue. How would you handle a critical vulnerability when a vendor patch is unavailable? Security Governance How do you enforce secure coding policies across development teams? What would you do if an application owner refuses to remediate a critical vulnerability? Technical How do you validate that a security finding has been fixed? What are common API security risks? How would you secure a CI/CD pipeline? Reporting Metrics What application security KPIs would you track? How would you present application security risk to leadership? We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth. At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference? About the Role As a Tech Lead/Architect (M) – AI and ML Tech Stack , you will drive impactful contributions and focus on enabling and delivering AI-driven solutions that create measurable business outcomes. You will be a key member of the AI and Engineering organization, collaborating with process leaders, architects, product teams, data engineers, software developers, and business stakeholders. You will have the autonomy to lead, innovate, and improve workflows while upholding our commitment to quality, operational excellence, and continuous learning. In this Role, You Will: Lead the end-to-end design, development, deployment, and operationalization of scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions that drive business value. Define and implement AI development standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and solution architecture guidelines across projects. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product management, data engineering, software development, and business stakeholders to align AI initiatives with organizational goals. Drive innovation by researching and adopting emerging technologies in machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and reinforcement learning. Mentor and guide AI engineers, developers, and data scientists while communicating complex AI concepts and actionable insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. What You Must Have to Be Considered 12+ years of hands-on experience in application design and engineering. Strong expertise in Python programming for AI and Machine Learning applications. Deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning techniques. Extensive experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, and related AI/ML frameworks. Strong knowledge of neural networks, model development, model optimization, and AI solution deployment. Experience in data analysis, data cleansing, feature engineering, and data visualization. Strong understanding of Natural Language Processing (NLP) concepts and applications. Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Knowledge of Big Data technologies and scalable AI solution implementation. Expertise in AI infrastructure, model deployment, MLOps, and DevOps practices. Understanding of AI security risks, governance, and mitigation strategies. Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills. M.Sc., M.Tech., or B.Tech. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Experience in a similar leadership role within the industry. A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for impactful work. The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, and Own It. These Will Help You Succeed Relevant certifications in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Experience implementing enterprise-scale AI transformation programs. Expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI enablement initiatives. Strong experience with AI governance, responsible AI practices, and model lifecycle management. Proven ability to deliver innovative AI solutions that solve complex business challenges. Experience leading large, distributed teams in global delivery environments. Work Model We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring work from a Cognizant office in Bangalore or Chennai as needed by business and project requirements. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting and may change based on project, business, or client requirements.

Posted On 15 Oct 2026 End Date 13 Apr 2027 Required Experience10 - 20 years Skills Knowledge & Posting Location Artificial Intelligence Minimum Qualification Bachelor of Engineering (BE) Job Description Job Title: Applied Research Engineer, AI (EPC & Manufacturing) Focus areas : Edge AI, Agentic AI Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu Job Summary: You'll lead applied research in creating and optimizing small language models (SLMs) and derived models for range of use cases cutting across both structured and unstructured data – for edge AI deployment, powering agentic systems, digital threads, and highly contextual knowledge graphs. Focus on real-world EPC/manufacturing scenarios like autonomous workflow orchestration, connected operations, and aimed at taking digital transformation in these sectors to the next generation of technologies and with breakthrough impact. Key Responsibilities: • Design, train, and distill SLMs or derived models (e.g., from Llama/Mistral) for domain-specific tasks in EPC/manufacturing, with deeper context engineering and mature agentic AI workflows, optimizing for low-latency inference on edge devices for site level intelligence and predictability. • Architect agentic AI frameworks that leverage SLMs for autonomous decision-making, such as multi-agent orchestration for construction sequencing or factory floor optimization. • Build and integrate digital threads—end-to-end data pipelines linking design, procurement, construction, and operations—using SLMs for natural language querying and automation. • Develop complex knowledge graphs to model intricate relationships in EPC ecosystems (e.g., asset hierarchies, supplier networks, regulatory compliance), enhanced by SLM-driven reasoning and graph RAG. • Deploy edge AI solutions for real-time applications, including IoT sensor fusion, on-device anomaly detection, and federated learning in harsh manufacturing environments. • Prototype and benchmark systems for scalability, collaborating on MLOps pipelines with tools like Kubernetes, TensorRT, and ONNX for edge-cloud hybrid deployments. • Conduct research on SLM fine-tuning, quantization, and agentic behaviors, documenting findings for internal adoption or publications. Preferred Skills: • Experience in EPC/manufacturing domains: procurement-to-pay automation, digital twins, or supply chain graph analytics. • Knowledge of federated learning, secure multi-party computation, or quantum-safe edge crypto. • Contributions to open-source SLM/edge AI projects or relevant publications (e.g., ICML, NeurIPS workshops). Sensitivity: LNT Construction Internal Use

jobs.title: Threat Detection Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 11 The Team The Cyber Fusion Center protects the business by combining threat intelligence, monitoring, detection engineering, incident response, and security automation into one proactive, intelligence-led defense capability. By breaking down silos, the team reduces risk and strengthens security across the enterprise. The team prioritizes collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation, with shared ownership of outcomes and a supportive learning mindset during high-pressure situations. This is a hands-on, build-driven environment where team members work with real-world use cases, rapidly develop new capabilities, and continuously improve the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to emerging threats. Responsibilities and Impact Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality detections for threats including malware, ransomware, identity attacks, insider threats, cloud threats, network, AI, and advanced persistent threats. Develop detection logic across SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud, network, identity, and application security platforms using tools such as Splunk SPL, Microsoft Sentinel KQL, Elastic Query DSL, Sigma, and YARA. Apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science techniques to identify anomalous behavior, emerging threats, attack patterns, and indicators of compromise. Build and maintain security analytics and data pipelines using Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and Databricks. Perform feature engineering, statistical analysis, model development, testing, tuning, and performance monitoring for security use cases. Conduct threat hunting and hypothesis-driven investigations to identify gaps in existing detection coverage. Map detections to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and improve coverage of priority attack techniques. Analyze false positives, false negatives, alert quality, and detection performance, implementing improvements based on measurable results. Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, SOAR, Cloud Security, and Vulnerability Management teams to develop effective detection capabilities. Implement detection-as-code practices using version control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and controlled deployment. Support purple-team exercises, adversary simulations, attack replay, and detection validation activities. Explore the use of Generative AI, Large Language Models, and Agentic AI to improve threat research, detection development, alert analysis, and investigations. Develop Power BI dashboards and reports to communicate detection coverage, alert trends, model performance, data quality, and operational metrics. Document detection logic, data sources, analytical methods, model limitations, investigation procedures, and response recommendations. Strong knowledge of security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, attack techniques, and enterprise security technologies. jobs.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)
jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) About the Team: Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We are currently looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role exists at the boundary between customer and product - /ou embed with clients before a single line of production code is written, validate whether an AI solution actually solves the business problem, and hand a scoped, evidence-backed brief to the product and engineering teams that build it. You are a builder first, but your deliverable is clarity, not code. Roles and Responsibilities: Embed directly with issuer and acquirer clients to understand their operational workflows, surface pain points, and identify where AI-driven automation or intelligence creates measurable business value. - Design and build rapid proof-of-concept prototypes - agentic pipelines, conversational interfaces, analytical tools - scoped deliberately to test a specific business hypothesis, not to be production-ready. Translate ambiguous client requirements into concrete, testable problem statements; push back on requirements that are too broad to validate or too narrow to generalize. Run structured validation sessions with customers using working prototypes, gather qualitative and quantitative signal on whether the PoC addresses the stated need, and document what it does not. Synthesize field observations into product briefs: scoped requirements, edge cases discovered in the wild, constraints the platform team would not have known from a desk, and a clear go/no-go recommendation. - Partner with product managers to ensure PoC findings directly inform roadmap decisions - requirements that survive validation become backlog items; those that do not get killed before investment is made. Maintain a working knowledge of the AI capability landscape (LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, structured data reasoning) broad enough to know what is feasible in a six-week PoC versus what requires a platform build. - Identify patterns across client engagements that suggest platform-level investment - repeatable needs that should become product features rather than one-off prototypes. Represent technical feasibility in pre-sales and discovery conversations; give customers and internal stakeholders an honest read on what AI can and cannot do for their specific workflow today. - Mentor engineers and analysts on the team on customer discovery craft - how to ask questions that reveal unstated requirements, how to scope a PoC to answer one question well, and how to present findings without overselling. All About You: Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience delivering AI or data solutions to enterprise clients. - Proven track record building working AI prototypes that directly influenced product or investment decisions - you can point to cases where your PoC changed what got built. Strong engineering foundation: you can write clean, working code quickly without over-engineering for production concerns that are irrelevant at the PoC stage. Fluent in Python and comfortable with SQL; experience with large-scale structured data and cloud data platforms is a strong plus. - Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic patterns - you understand the tradeoffs between what you can prompt, what you need to engineer, and what requires fine-tuning. Exceptional customer-facing communication: you can run a discovery session with a non-technical reconciliation analyst in the morning and write a technical scoping document in the afternoon. Strong product instinct: you can distinguish a business requirement from a solution assumption, and you know when a client is describing a symptom rather than a root cause. - Comfort operating in ambiguity - you thrive when the problem statement is unclear and see scoping it as part of the job, not a blocker. Experience working in regulated industries (financial services, payments, healthcare) where data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and customer trust shape what can and cannot be prototyped. Track record of handing off well-scoped, evidence-backed briefs to product and engineering teams; you measure success by what gets built from your findings, not by the prototype itself. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The team brings together product, design, engineering, and digital expertise to create connected, personalized experiences that help clients discover, understand, and engage with BlackRock. Role and Impact: As more clients hold iShares and engage with BlackRock digitally, the quality of our client experiences matters more than ever. We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our global Digital Experiences team and help ensure that the experiences we build—guiding users through the purchase funnel, personalizing to their needs, and encouraging ongoing engagement—are reliable, accurate, and release-ready. The successful candidate will own quality across the delivery lifecycle, from test planning and preparation through execution, automation, and CI/CD integration. They will bring a development-minded approach to testing and help evolve our QA practice toward an AI-assisted model that increases coverage and speed while reducing manual effort. Prepare test data and manually execute test cases to understand application flows. Use AI-assisted tools to generate and refine test scenarios, test cases, and synthetic test data, applying human review to validate accuracy and completeness. Test Execution Execute new functional test cases for the current release, as well as manual and automated regression packs. Log defects and retest fixed defects. Apply AI to triage test failures, cluster related defects, and draft clear, reproducible defect reports. Leverage AI-enabled visual, accessibility, and content checks to catch regressions across pages, markets, and devices. Test Scripting & Integration Develop test scripts according to the BlackRock framework and perform dry runs of automation scripts. Integrate automation with the CI/CD pipeline and complete a full run of automated scripts. Use AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test script development, refactoring, and maintenance, including self-healing of brittle locators. Help build reusable prompts, agent workflows, and standards that scale AI-assisted QA across the team, and measure their impact on coverage, cycle time, and defect leakage. User Documentation Create and update user manuals. Core Skills: Quality mindset with a development background. Analytical mindset with the ability to grasp complex concepts easily. Comfortable working in an agile environment, fluent in English. Interested in continuously extending testing know-how. Curious and pragmatic about AI—applies it to improve quality and speed, while exercising sound judgment on AI-generated output. Experience with Jira/Azure Boards, Confluence, and Git. Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) in testing or development workflows. Desirable Skills and Experience Practical knowledge of designing and developing test automation solutions. Experience with Azure DevOps. Strong hands-on knowledge of TypeScript and Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development. Familiarity with AI-native testing tools, Playwright MCP, or agent-based test generation and execution. Experience testing AI-powered features (e.g., chatbots or generative content), including evaluation of output accuracy and consistency.
