jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer – Generative AI Model Serving (Go / Rust / GPU)
jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. Power the Platform Behind Enterprise Generative AI At Teradata, we’re not just managing data; we’re unleashing its full potential. Our ClearScape Analytics™ platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world’s largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale. As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation. Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust . Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use. Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama.cpp, and ONNX Runtime ; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense. Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments. Own the full delivery path : CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing. Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve. Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation. Drive reliability, security, and cost efficiency: SLOs, load and chaos testing, capacity planning, GPU cost attribution, and secure model and tenant isolation. Who You’ll Work With You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You’ll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions. What Makes You a Qualified Candidate 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure. Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning). Hands-on experience with GPU computing for ML: CUDA fundamentals, GPU profiling (Nsight, nvidia-smi/DCGM), memory and bandwidth tradeoffs, and multi-GPU or multi-node inference. Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above. Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling. Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes. Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform). Full-stack engineering experience : comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration. Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads. You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed. You code daily, own systems end to end, and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them. What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale. Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating. Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus. Bonus Points Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines. Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama.cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment. Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings , and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents). Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices. Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust. Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters. #LI-VB1

As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE ABOUT THE TEAM & YOUR ROLE Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST’s growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don’t want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI. As a member of this team, you won’t be working in a silo. You will be at the intersection of human capital and advanced technology, leveraging AI and data science to solve complex organizational challenges and expected to be a foundational builder. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products. You won't just be using technology—you will be architecting the roadmap, selecting the tools, and establishing the frameworks that will define how ST manages its global talent for years to come. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you’ve found the right place. Responsibilities: End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment. Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e.g., orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing). LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management. Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e.g., Streamlit, Next.js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams. Code Hygiene & Handoff Documentation: Maintain code transparency, track version changes, and collaborate efficiently using GitHub. Author structured "Industrialization Blueprints" (JSON payloads, API mappings, and logic flows) to seamlessly hand over for full scale production Required Background & Skills: AI Orchestration Frameworks: Expert-level workflow creation using tools like n8n (advanced JavaScript/Python execution nodes, webhooks, and sub-workflows) or equivalent orchestration frameworks AI & LLM Mastery: Practical experience implementing conversational APIs, embedding architectures, vector stores, and advanced prompt engineering constraints. Full-Stack Core Development: Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js. Comfort writing clean API connectors, handling RESTful requests, parsing JSON, and maintaining code via GitHub. Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystems: Prior familiarity or structural understanding of building integration layers, bots, or webhooks for the Microsoft 365 / MS Teams ecosystem is highly desirable. Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch). Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent Understanding of HCM systems like Oracle is an added advantage Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

jobs.description: Overview The primary responsibility of this role is to act as a GCP Agentic Product Engineer for medium-to-large AI transformation opportunities, supporting mid-sized clients in designing reusable AI-enabled assets, engineering cloud-native AI products, developing agentic workflows, and establishing scalable deployment frameworks on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role focuses on creating reusable, commercially viable AI solutions that accelerate time-to-value, improve business outcomes, and can be rapidly deployed across multiple client engagements. The ideal candidate will leverage strong product engineering, cloud development, and AI expertise to build scalable agentic AI assets, collaborate with architects and business stakeholders, establish engineering standards, and ensure high-quality product delivery. Working closely with Sales, Architecture, Engineering, Delivery, and Product teams, the engineer will combine software engineering, cloud infrastructure, automation, testing, and AI innovation to deliver differentiated AI-native solutions. Key Responsibilities Translate business and technical requirements into reusable AI-enabled products using Google Cloud services and modern engineering practices. Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architects, Engineering, and Delivery teams to develop scalable and repeatable AI offerings. Design and build reusable agentic AI assets that accelerate deployment and adoption across client engagements. Define product architecture standards, engineering frameworks, reusable design patterns, and deployment approaches. Develop proof-of-concepts, pilot solutions, packaged AI assets, and reusable accelerators. Ensure solutions meet scalability, security, reliability, maintainability, and operational excellence standards. GCP Architecture & Cloud Engineering Design reusable agent configurations using Vertex AI Agent Builder, orchestration frameworks, and AI workflow architectures. Develop Infrastructure-as-Code templates, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment accelerators using Google Cloud services. Create reference architectures supporting agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-native applications. Integrate AI products with enterprise systems, APIs, cloud services, and data platforms. Optimize architectures for reusability, maintainability, performance, and deployment efficiency. Engineering Excellence & Quality Develop testing, validation, evaluation, monitoring, and quality assurance frameworks for AI-enabled products. Implement automated testing and deployment practices to ensure product reliability and consistency. Establish engineering standards, coding guidelines, governance frameworks, version control, release management, and continuous improvement processes. Improve engineering productivity through automation and reusable development assets. Client Engagement & Collaboration Partner with architects, product owners, delivery teams, and business stakeholders to align solutions with business objectives. Drive AI product innovation, reusable asset development, and engineering best practices. Mentor engineering teams on GCP engineering, AI product development, and agentic architecture. Contribute to reusable frameworks, accelerators, thought leadership, and continuous capability development. Qualifications Experience 5–8 years of experience in Product Engineering, Software Engineering, Cloud Engineering, AI Engineering, or related fields. Experience designing cloud-native applications and reusable software assets on Google Cloud Platform. Hands-on experience with AI, machine learning, automation, intelligent workflows, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automated deployment frameworks. Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable product architectures and develop proof-of-concepts, reusable accelerators, testing frameworks, and productized assets. Experience supporting enterprise AI transformation and cloud modernization initiatives. Bonus Points Proven track record building reusable AI products and cloud native engineering assets. Experience developing agentic AI frameworks, evaluation accelerators, and deployment templates. Experience with Agile, DevOps, MLOps, and modern engineering operating models. Knowledge of Vertex AI, intelligent agents, automation frameworks, and AI orchestration platforms. Contributions to reusable frameworks, patents, publications, innovation programs, or thought leadership initiatives.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Senior Developer
jobs.description: Job Description What you'll bring You have advanced software engineering skills and solid hands-on experience with AI and ML techniques in cloud-native environments. Advanced Python proficiency and hands-on experience in at least one cloud-native development environment. Strong experience with large language models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, agent-based workflows, and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn. Hands-on experience with data pipelines, machine learning operations (MLOps), or integrating AI/ML models into application contexts. Solid awareness of cloud platforms — AWS, Azure, or GCP — and tools such as Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Awareness with SAP AI technologies such as SAP AI Core or SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is a plus. We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face. In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools — including agentic AI — in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks, to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and facilitating adoption of AI practices within their teams. What you'll build You'll lead and contribute to the design, development, and operation of AI-native enterprise applications within customer-embedded delivery teams. Lead development of cloud-native applications integrating LLMs, RAG pipelines, and agent-based components. Work within customer projects and cross-functional teams, building deep awareness of business processes and customer needs. Implement features and integrations individually, guide other engineers when needed, and maintain code quality and engineering standards. Lead prototyping and iteration of AI solutions in customer environments, adapting to feedback and evolving requirements. Lead code reviews, technical discussions, and design sessions to raise engineering quality across the team. Own monitoring, troubleshooting, and improvement of deployed solutions to ensure reliability and stability. Where you belong You will be part of a growing AI and industry expert team serving customers across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. We invest in the growth of our people at every level — and this role is built for you if you want to create measurable customer impact. You will be surrounded by skilled engineers and AI practitioners and collaborate with cross-functional partners. You will thrive here if you are curious, collaborative, and motivated to build real AI solutions for real enterprise customers — from day one. #SAPAICareers Additional Information About SAP With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives. As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience. We win with inclusion SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone, regardless of background, feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or complete your application, please send an email with your request to the Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com. For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Are you passionate about working with Amazon-scale data, advanced analytics, and data science? Do you love bringing data together from diverse systems and sources and working on innovative advanced analytics problems for creating deep understanding of customer behavior and generating actionable business insights? Does the idea of working closely with a team of highly experience machine-learning scientists and engineers excite you? We looking for an experienced, self-driven Data Scientist to help us synthesise data into knowledge for our Kindle Direct Publishing business. If you like working with data and want to harness the power of it to develop a deeper understanding of customer behaviour, identify opportunities, impact publishing workflow and influence the business strategy to develop products and features that have a direct impact on the creator and reader experience, this is the role for you! Key job responsibilities As Data Scientist, you will connect with world leaders in your field working on similar problems. You will be working with massive-scale data and providing analytic leadership to scientists, product managers, engineers using these data. You will leverage your knowledge in machine learning, advanced analytics, metrics, reporting, and analytic tooling/languages to analyze and translate the data into meaningful insights. You will closely collaborate with business, scientists, and engineers. You will have end-to-end ownership of operational and technical aspects of the insights you are building for the business, and will play an integral role in strategic decision-making. We also use science to optimize manufacturing, fulfillment, and quality processes. jobs.description: Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! ㅤ Your New Role : As an App Developer - AI/ML at one of the largest global Media & Entertainment companies, you will play a crucial role in building and optimizing cutting-edge applications powered by Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. In this exciting and dynamic environment, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the creation of innovative solutions that transform content delivery, user experiences, and engagement. Your work will empower millions of users around the world and support the business in staying at the forefront of technological advancements. You will be part of a talented, forward-thinking team working with the latest tools and technologies to develop scalable, high-performance AI/ML-powered applications. If you are passionate about AI and ML, have a strong app development background, and are eager to create impactful applications, this is the perfect opportunity for you to join an industry-leading organization that thrives on innovation. 1. AI/ML Application Development Design, develop, and maintain AI/ML-powered applications that enhance the company's core services and customer-facing products. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI/ML models into mobile and web applications seamlessly. Ensure that AI/ML features in applications are scalable, high-performing, and reliable, meeting the demands of millions of users. Build and optimize mobile and web interfaces for AI-powered functionalities, such as personalized content recommendations, intelligent search, and dynamic content creation. Implement end-to-end app solutions by incorporating data pipelines, machine learning models, and real-time data processing. 2. AI/ML Model Integration & Optimization Collaborate with data scientists and AI/ML engineers to integrate machine learning models into mobile/web platforms and ensure they work seamlessly across multiple devices. Conduct optimization of AI/ML models for high-performance deployment, reducing latency and enhancing the user experience. Implement techniques like transfer learning, deep learning, and reinforcement learning to improve model performance and overall system efficiency. Monitor and troubleshoot deployed AI models within applications to ensure continuous improvement and enhancement. Contribute to model versioning, model rollback strategies, and performance tuning in production environments. 3. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management Work closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, and business teams to ensure AI features align with customer needs and business objectives. Partner with software engineers, data scientists, and AI architects to align on the architecture, design, and functionality of AI-driven features. Translate business requirements into technical solutions by applying a deep understanding of AI/ML technologies. Communicate technical challenges and solutions effectively to non-technical stakeholders and business leaders. Contribute to brainstorming and ideation sessions for new features or apps that leverage AI/ML technologies. 4. Continuous Improvement & Innovation Stay up-to-date with the latest AI/ML trends, tools, and technologies to ensure the app development process is innovative and competitive. Experiment with new frameworks, technologies, and AI methods to enhance the functionality and performance of applications. Regularly evaluate the performance of AI-powered applications and contribute ideas for optimization and future improvements. Collaborate with the team to resolve any application issues and refine features based on user feedback and testing results. Contribute to the continuous improvement of development practices by introducing new approaches or optimizing current processes. 5. Quality Assurance & Testing Ensure that all AI/ML applications are tested thoroughly and function as intended across all supported platforms (mobile, web, etc.). Develop unit tests, integration tests, and other quality assurance measures for AI-powered app features. Debug and resolve issues related to performance, scalability, and security in applications. Ensure compliance with industry standards and internal guidelines for coding practices, security, and data privacy. Take ownership of the deployment process, ensuring smooth application launches and versioning management. Qualifications & Experiences: Academic Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Specialized certifications in AI/ML or app development technologies are a plus. Professional Experience: 3+ years of experience in app development with a strong focus on integrating AI/ML technologies. Hands-on experience with AI/ML application development, including model integration, real-time inference, and deployment. Proficient in developing mobile and web applications using modern development frameworks (e.g., React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Django, Flask). Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and integrating AI models within cloud-native applications. Experience with AI/ML libraries and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and Scikit-learn, with the ability to optimize and scale models in production. Technical Skills: AI & Machine Learning Expertise Deep Learning Frameworks – Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or JAX for training and fine-tuning models. Generative Models – Knowledge of transformers (GPT, BERT, LLaMA), diffusion models (Stable Diffusion, DALL·E), and VAEs. Prompt Engineering – Ability to craft effective prompts and optimize LLM responses. Model Fine-Tuning & Optimization – Experience in LoRA, PEFT (Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning), RLHF (Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback). NLP & Computer Vision – Depending on the application (text, images, or multimodal AI). Full-Stack Development Frontend Technologies – React, Next.js, Vue.js for web apps; Swift/Kotlin for mobile apps. Backend Development – Node.js, Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django), or Go for API development. Database Management – NoSQL (MongoDB, Firebase), SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL). API Integration – Experience with OpenAI API, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Google Gemini, etc. Cloud & DevOps Cloud Platforms – AWS (SageMaker, Lambda), Google Cloud (Vertex AI), Azure (OpenAI services). Containerization & Deployment – Docker, Kubernetes for scalable AI services. MLOps & CI/CD – GitHub Actions, MLflow, Kubeflow for continuous model integration and monitoring. Other Skills: Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle complex technical challenges. Experience with Agile development methodologies and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for app development. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders. A collaborative mindset with a focus on working in teams and driving projects forward in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Passion for AI and its transformative role in the Media & Entertainment industry. About Skydance Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. jobs.title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: Location: India Development Center (IDC) The Unbreakable Enterprise Kernel (UEK) team develops and maintains the Linux kernel at the heart of Oracle Linux. We build performance, reliability, and security improvements for demanding enterprise and cloud workloads. Our engineers tackle complex kernel challenges across hardware platforms, partnering with teams across software, firmware, and infrastructure. Join us to solve deep systems problems and help deliver a dependable foundation for Cloud Infrastructure at scale. We are seeking a Linux Kernel Engineer to help develop, maintain, and secure the kernel software that supports our infrastructure. In this role, you will investigate complex systems issues, review and deliver kernel changes, and collaborate with engineers across regions to improve reliability, performance, and security. Key responsibilities Develop, debug, test, and maintain Linux kernel code and patches. Review kernel changes for correctness, maintainability, performance, and regression risk. Assess security vulnerabilities, including CVEs, and backport, validate, and deliver fixes. Investigate kernel crashes, performance bottlenecks, and production issues using debugging and tracing tools. Collaborate with engineering, security, and operations teams to prioritize issues and deliver timely resolutions. Contribute to follow-the-sun operational support through clear documentation and effective handoffs across regions. Improve testing, automation, and engineering workflows to support a growing kernel workload. Required qualifications Strong proficiency in C and practical experience developing or maintaining Linux kernel software. Solid understanding of operating system fundamentals, including memory management, concurrency, synchronization, and process scheduling. Experience diagnosing complex systems issues using crash dumps, logs, tracing, and debugging tools. Familiarity with kernel patch review, backporting, testing, and regression analysis. Experience using Git and collaborating on large codebases. Ability to independently own engineering tasks, communicate technical findings clearly, and work effectively with distributed teams. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience of 6+ years. Preferred qualifications Contributions to the upstream Linux kernel or other systems software projects. Experience with enterprise Linux distributions and kernel maintenance across multiple versions. Experience assessing and remediating kernel CVEs. Knowledge of virtualization, networking, storage, or device drivers. Experience supporting production infrastructure and building automated kernel validation tools. What success looks like You deliver well-tested kernel changes, resolve complex issues, and help maintain timely security patching. Your work strengthens kernel reliability and supports effective collaboration and operational coverage across regions. Key Responsibilities Owns complex system modules and fleet automation workflows; defines integration contracts across software, firmware, and hardware. Leads deep-dive investigations into incidents and hard faults; creates durable fixes and preventive controls. Designs performance, reliability, and fault-tolerance improvements for drivers, services, and provisioning pipelines at scale. Elevates code quality through reviews, patterns, and tooling; sets standards for observability, security, and compliance. Guides platform bring-up and diagnostics; collaborates with silicon, board, and firmware partners to validate end-to-end behavior. Designs and implements firmware components integrating diverse interfaces and protocols. Diagnoses cross-domain issues spanning firmware, hardware, operating systems, and bootloaders using logic analyzers, JTAG, and emulators. Participates in schematic and board reviews; leads initial board and device bring-up. Develops and debugs advanced features—including RAS, high-speed I/O, and chipset/SoC services—across ARM, AMD, Intel, and custom ASIC/FPGA platforms. Systems Software Development: Design, develop, and maintain complex system software modules for managing, monitoring, and provisioning kernel and operating system software for computer servers, storage, networking, and GPU subsystems in hyperscale environment. Utilizes advanced knowledge to design, develop, and deploy software layers and tooling to automate hardware provisioning and onboarding of servers to large-scale fleet. Play a significant role in platform bring-up, firmware updates, platform-level diagnostics, and complex cross-layer debugging. Diagnose and resolve complex issues across software, firmware, and hardware layers, working in DevOps and incident response paradigms to maintain reliability and availability. Software Development and Coding: Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion. Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements. Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code. Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements. Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. Implements comprehensive software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion. Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes. Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope. Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture. Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture. Implements complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. Occasionally conducts technology research and evaluation for potential architectural changes that may have an impact on results for the team. Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: Collaborates with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions. May provide advanced technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues. Advocates for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. Provides input to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. Identifies and implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes. Investigates and troubleshoots complex and broad reaching/scoped maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements). Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: Collaborates with the team and externally to follow development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members. Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, independently. Demonstrates and shares advanced knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. Implements complex secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. Development Operations - System Maintenance: Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities), sharing results with manager upon completion. Drives improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. Core Responsibilities Planning & Execution: Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. Collaboration & Partnership: Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. Problem Solving: Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. Continuous Learning: Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. Continuous Improvement: Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. Performance and Development: Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

jobs.description: DESCRIPTION If you want to apply machine learning and generative AI to a problem where accuracy has a dollar value, this is the role for you. Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) builds the technology that records, reconciles and posts the accounting for Amazon's transportation invoices and payments across 16+ transportation modes. Today, month-end close depends on people tracing breaks across ten or more systems, one case at a time. The Accounting Insights team replaces that with software. We detect anomalies in financial data with machine learning, find the root cause of a break with generative AI, produce explanations and insights for controllers and accountants, and automate the standard operating procedures (SOPs) that run the close. You will lead a team of engineers, own the roadmap with product management and Accounting partners. Key job responsibilities What will you own? You will manage a team of engineers and grow them through long-term technical problems their team solves. You will own the technical roadmap for your area with TFS Product Management, Accounting and Controllership partners. You will own operational excellence for your services: operational load, security, resiliency and compliance at Amazon scale. You will set the bar for taking AI into a controlled financial process, with audit evidence, approval steps and separation of duties built in. What interesting engineering problem will you solve? You will build machine learning models that detect anomalies in reconciliation, balance and posting data before close, with precision you can measure. You will build generative AI agents that trace a break to its owning system and team and propose a permanent fix, with human confirmation before it is submitted. You will build a generative AI assistant that answers balance and variance questions from reconciled figures and attaches the supporting evidence. You will automate close SOPs as versioned, auditable procedures that AI helps author and run, replacing spreadsheets and individual knowledge. What large scale program opportunities will you have? You will own the partner relationship with Accounting, Controllership and Audit, and influence their roadmap as well as yours. You will work with principal product managers and business leaders to prioritize work and deliver it with quality. You will make sure open issues and debated topics reach the right forums, so your team's roadmap stays protected. What Think Big exists for you? You can move month-end close from a monthly investigation to a continuous, automated certification. You can turn each one-off root-cause investigation into a permanent fix, so the same class of break stops recurring. jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Title and Summary Lead Data Scientist Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Overview The Security Solutions Data Science team develops AI and machine learning capabilities that help protect the global payments ecosystem from fraud and cyber threats. Supporting Mastercard’s fraud and risk product, the team builds and enhances models that analyze billions of transactions and enable real-time detection of fraudulent activity. We are looking for a highly motivated Lead Data Scientist to drive the next generation of AI-powered fraud detection systems. This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines deep individual contribution with technical leadership across predictive modeling, AI agents, LLM-based solutions, real-time decisioning systems, and large-scale data engineering while contributing directly to Mastercard's mission of enabling secure and trusted commerce worldwide. Role As a Lead Data Scientist, you will be expected to be highly hands-on while providing technical leadership in designing, developing, coding, testing, and deploying enterprise-scale AI solutions that enhance fraud detection and risk intelligence capabilities across Mastercard's Security Solutions portfolio. This is not just a model development role; it is a strong fit for someone who enjoys working closely with complex data, exploring patterns, understanding the business and technical problem deeply, experimenting through R&D, and bringing interdisciplinary research ideas—such as advances in NLP, deep learning architectures, graph learning, or agentic systems —into the fraud and security space. The role is also about identifying practical solutions and implementing them in scalable production systems. You will lead complex AI engineering initiatives while directly contributing to model development, experimentation, system design, and production implementation. Key responsibilities include: Lead and directly contribute to the design, development, deployment, and optimization of machine learning models for fraud detection, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and related security applications. Define, build, and guide scalable AI and ML pipeline architecture supporting model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement. Hands-on design and implementation of Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), reasoning and planning workflows, Chain-of-Thought-style prompting techniques, tool/function calling, LLM-based modular systems, and multi-agent orchestration. Work with large-scale transactional datasets using distributed computing technologies such as Spark and Databricks. Implement MLOps best practices, including CI/CD, model governance, observability, experimentation frameworks, and performance monitoring. Drive the design of reusable AI platforms, libraries, and engineering frameworks that accelerate AI development, improve quality, and establish best practices across teams. Set technical direction by evaluating emerging AI technologies, defining adoption patterns, and identifying opportunities to apply them to fraud prevention and security challenges. Contribute to Mastercard's innovation efforts by publishing top-tier research papers, filing patents, and translating applied AI research into scalable fraud and security solutions. Ensure solutions meet Mastercard standards for scalability, reliability, explainability, security, responsible AI, and long-term maintainability. All About You Demonstrated experience leading AI Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Data Science, or applied research initiatives from concept through production deployment. Expert-level hands-on programming skills in Python and strong experience building production-quality software, reusable frameworks, and scalable AI systems. Deep understanding of machine learning fundamentals and practical application of supervised learning, ensemble methods, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and production model risk controls. Proven track record as a hands-on practitioner developing, deploying, debugging, and improving machine learning solutions in production environments with measurable business impact. Strong hands-on experience writing, reviewing, testing, and maintaining production-grade code for AI/ML applications. Experience working with LLMs, prompt engineering, reasoning and planning frameworks, RAG architectures, vector databases, AI agents, and Generative AI application development. Experience with distributed computing platforms such as Spark, Databricks, or similar big data technologies. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and associated AI/ML services. Strong understanding of MLOps principles, including model deployment, model monitoring, CI/CD, ML lifecycle management, governance, observability, and operational reliability. Experience working with SQL and large-scale structured and unstructured datasets. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a passion for solving complex real-world challenges. Excellent communication, technical leadership, and collaboration skills with the ability to influence architecture decisions and work effectively across cross-functional teams. Ability to mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and bring strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and thought leadership in AI and machine learning. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing fraud detection, risk management, trust & safety, cybersecurity, or financial crime solutions. Hands-on experience with Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, MLflow, Agentic AI frameworks, reasoning and planning frameworks, LangChain, or similar AI engineering technologies. Experience building Agentic AI solutions and multi-agent systems. Exposure to graph learning, anomaly detection, network intelligence, or real-time decisioning systems. Publications, patents, open-source contributions, Kaggle achievements, or demonstrated research experience in AI/ML. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

GSC Digital & Tech brings together experts in supply chain technology, smart manufacturing, engineering and EHS, sustainability, quality and architecture to build and run platforms that are secure, compliant and scalable. By joining this team, you’ll shape the digital capabilities that power GSK’s global supply network—supporting thousands of colleagues in our sites and networks, and driving innovation, reliability and continuous improvement in how medicines reach patients around the world. Job Purpose The Principal Tech Engineer – Site Serialisation Systems provides technical leadership for site serialisation systems within PIMMS (the Manufacturing Track & Trace product), across the broader product family, technology platform or programme. The role leads solution design, validation, implementation and troubleshooting and ensures technical outputs align with approved architecture, product strategy, engineering standards and GxP requirements. The role is hands-on and embedded close to business problems. The job holder personally investigates complex failures, interrogates data, logs and interfaces, challenges vendor and partner designs and resolves integration problems, rather than primarily coordinating or escalating them. The role works across the site serialisation estate rather than being tied to a single site and retains technical judgement and engineering integrity where strategic partners deliver routine build, test, deployment and support. The job holder applies AI-assisted methods to development, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, knowledge management, monitoring and automation, while retaining full human accountability for technical decisions and GxP, Responsible AI, cyber security and architecture compliance. The role also develops engineering capability by coaching engineers and super users and converting lessons learned into reusable designs, standards, training and knowledge. Key Responsibilities Implement technical solution designs and configurations in accordance with approved architecture and product strategy. Own technical quality for the assigned scope, including specifications, design documentation, configuration records and technical validation evidence. Perform troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, with timely escalation where manufacturing batches, product quality, patient supply or data integrity may be affected. Design or configure interfaces, workflows, recipes, data models and environments, including site serialisation system integrations, and write or review related specifications and test scripts. Hold configurations, interface mappings and scripts under version control, subject changes to peer review, and verify them through repeatable automated or scripted tests, retaining traceable test evidence under approved change and GxP validation controls. Own the technical reliability of site serialisation systems, including monitoring, recoverability, obsolescence and technical debt, addressing root causes so that incidents do not recur rather than closing individual tickets Actively extract and codify existing serialisation knowledge into runbooks, integration patterns, troubleshooting guides and technical documentation, building capability across the wider engineering teams rather than creating a single point of dependency. Lead technical design and implementation across multiple projects, releases or sites. Review and approve key technical specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and validation evidence. Lead diagnosis and resolution of complex incidents, integration failures and data-integrity issues, and act as the technical authority over strategic partner output – accepting or rejecting designs, configurations and test evidence against GSK engineering, architecture and regulatory standards. Assess technical risks and ensure mitigation addresses security, compliance, resilience, data integrity and supportability. Maintain technical standards and reusable engineering assets for the assigned product family or platform. Support formal technical assurance, GxP validation, audits and inspections for regulated site systems and ensure corrective actions are evidence based. Identify repetitive serialisation engineering and support activities suitable for automation, reduce manual diagnosis, testing, deployment and support effort, and reuse automation across sites rather than resolving the same problem repeatedly. Apply AI-assisted methods to development, troubleshooting, testing, documentation and automation within Responsible AI, data privacy, cyber security and GxP controls, validating all output before use and retaining human accountability for technical decisions. Direct and coordinate external vendors, system integrators and managed service partners across design, build, release and stabilisation; set technical direction and acceptance criteria for their work, review and formally accept or reject their designs, configurations and test evidence, and hold them to GSK engineering, architecture, security and GxP standards. Experience in leading technical design and implementation for a product family, platform, programme or multiple sites. Experience maintaining configurations, interface mappings and scripts under version control, conducting peer reviews, and developing and executing repeatable automated or scripted tests, with traceable evidence. Experience reviewing and approving specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and technical validation evidence. Clear technical writing and disciplined maintenance of specifications, designs, test evidence and configuration records. Understanding of interfaces, workflows, data, environments, monitoring and operational support. Awareness of security, quality, validation, data integrity, resilience and change controls. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview What happens when AI agents can rewrite millions of lines of code orders of magnitude faster than humans can review them? That question drives the Future of Scalable Software Engineering (FoSSE) team in Microsoft's CoreAI division. We build AI agents that transform some of the world's largest codebases, including Windows and Azure. Generating code is becoming the easy part; knowing whether to trust it is the real challenge. We combine AI agents with static analysis, testing, and formal verification to make large-scale software transformation practical and trustworthy, and we design tools that spend scarce human attention where it matters most. The team began in Microsoft Research and moved to CoreAI in 2025, and we continue to collaborate closely with Microsoft Research, so research depth meets production stakes every day. Here are the main problems we are currently working on: Migration at scale: We work on migrating hundreds of millions of lines of code, across Windows, Azure, Office, and other products, to work with new versions of dependent packages, new compilers and new platforms. Examples include increasing language-standards conformance of code, remediating CodeQL and other static analysis findings, and retargeting services from x86 to ARM. Language modernization: We move legacy C/C++ (and C#) codebases to Rust, with validation gates at every step. Differential testing against the original, held-out tests, and specification extraction with formal verification (such as Verus proofs) mean each migration is backed by evidence, not optimism. Specification-driven development: We help brownfield codebases adopt specification-driven development by inferring formal specifications for existing code. The specifications are grounded using execution traces and then used to generate concurrency and fault-tolerance tests, find subtle bugs, and ultimately create a validation guardrail for future AI-driven code changes. We are working with formal tools such as TLA+, F*, Lean and Verus in this work. You will be onsite at least three days a week and learn and grow through working with talented colleagues. Responsibilities Design, build, and ship agentic tools and infrastructure for one or more of our problem areas (such as migration at scale, language modernization, or specification-driven development). Build the tool layers agents depend on (context, analysis, and validation) and the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether they work. Integrate static analysis, testing, and verification into agent loops so every change arrives with evidence. Work directly with engineering teams across Microsoft, such as Windows and Azure, to land changes at production quality. Instrument and measure quality, including acceptance rate and correctness, and iterate from user feedback. Contribute to design reviews and mentor other engineers. Qualifications Required qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science or related areas and 6+ years of experience. Or a Master’s degree with 4+ years of experience. Or a PhD in computer science or related areas. Experience coding in languages such as C, C++, C#, or Rust. Experience building developer tools using LLM-based agents. Experience with compilers and program analysis. Excellent technical design, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Strong communication and collaboration skills, customer obsession, and a passion for shipping high-quality products. Preferred qualifications Experience with Rust and C/C++ interop and memory safety. Experience testing at scale, such as differential testing, property-based testing, or fuzzing. Experience with formal methods such as TLA+, model checking, F*, Lean, Verus, Dafny, or similar. Experience working with very large codebases and build systems. Interest or experience in human-AI interaction and developer experience design. Publications or open-source contributions are a plus. Why join us Work on the hardest problems in agentic software engineering, at real scale. Join a small team with outsized leverage, where a handful of experts steer changes across hundreds of millions of lines of code. Blend research and engineering: ideas here ship to tools used by Windows, Azure, and other large teams. Build on, and contribute back to, the research community around TLA+, F*, Lean, Verus, etc. Company, Culture, Candidate Value Proposition: Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and we’re dedicated to this mission across every aspect of our company. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. Join us and help shape the future of the world. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. About Lilly At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. The Digital Engagement Tech@Lilly team builds solutions and capabilities for Marketing, Corporate Affairs and Medical organizations globally, and owns the consumer platforms and the governance around them. This role exists because the hardest problems in our space are not solved from a ticket queue. As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will sit with business, medical and marketing teams, understand how they actually work, and build working AI-enabled software with them, fast. You will go from a vague problem to a live product in weeks, then take what you learned and turn it into reusable patterns for the rest of the organization. Role Overview A forward deployed engineer is a senior, hands-on builder who works at the point where technology meets the business problem. You will be embedded with stakeholder teams, own outcomes end to end (discovery, design, build, deploy, adoption), and stay close enough to users to see what works and what does not. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will spend most of your time building, across the front end, back end and AI layer, while working directly with product owners, system custodians, architects and compliance partners. You will operate with minimal supervision, set patterns and standards for others to follow, and mentor developers and engineers around you. Success means shipping reliable, well-governed solutions that people use, and that move a business metric. What You Will Build Customer-facing and internal web applications in React, Nuxt or Vue, backed by Node.js APIs, built directly with business teams and shipped on short cycles. Agentic and LLM-powered workflows for content, engagement and medical use cases: multi-agent orchestration, tool use and intelligent automation of manual work. RAG and semantic search solutions over enterprise content and data, including embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking and Text2SQL where it fits. Production AI services and APIs that integrate with enterprise data platforms, content systems and downstream product workflows. Reusable patterns, templates, and accelerators that turn a one-off solution into something other teams can adopt. Key Responsibilities Embed and discover Embed with business, medical and marketing teams to understand their workflows, pain points and constraints first-hand. Frame ambiguous problems, decide what is worth building, and be direct about what is not feasible. Prototype quickly, put working software in front of users early, and iterate on their feedback. Build and deliver end to end Design and build full-stack solutions: responsive front ends, API integrations, Node.js services and the data layer behind them. Integrate LLMs, RAG, agents and AI services into products, with evaluation, guardrails and monitoring for quality, latency and cost. Own the delivery lifecycle: scoping and estimation, development, automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and support handover. Work with the technical lead and system custodian to keep what you ship maintainable, observable, and secure. Architecture and standards Make architectural decisions that improve efficiency and maintain compliance in a regulated space. Turn what you learn in the field into reusable components, templates, and reference implementations for cross-functional teams. Set and uphold coding standards, review practices and engineering patterns across teams. Responsible AI, security and governance Apply secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles, and build in traceability, grounding, auditability and human oversight. Work with quality, compliance and risk partners, so solutions meet regulatory and enterprise requirements, including content review processes. Maintain clear architecture, design, and support documentation for everything you put into production. Mentoring and influence Provide hands-on technical guidance to developers and engineers, review designs and code, and raise the bar through practical examples. Communicate trade-offs, risks and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders. Bring practical feasibility, scalability, and value considerations into roadmap planning. Required Qualifications 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of building and shipping production systems end to end. 4+ years building customer-facing or business-facing solutions in close partnership with stakeholders, such as forward deployed, solutions engineering, consulting engineering or embedded product engineering roles. Expert in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript and React, with Nuxt or Vue a plus; strong in responsive design and web standards. Strong back-end experience with Node.js (Express, Koa or Hapi) and API design and integration (REST, GraphQL). 2+ years of hands-on generative AI delivery: LLMs, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, agentic workflows, and evaluation of model outputs. Working proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with frameworks such as LangChain, DSPy or Hugging Face. Strong experience with unit and integration testing frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, Chai or Jasmine. Experience designing, deploying and operating services on a major cloud (AWS preferred), with CI/CD, containers and monitoring. Strong system design and architecture fundamentals: version control (GitHub), code reviews, and secure, maintainable, observable code. Experience working in Agile teams, including scoping, estimation and backlog ownership. Proven ability to turn ambiguous business problems into scalable solutions with measurable value, and to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualifications Pharmaceutical, healthcare or other regulated-industry experience, including working within content review, privacy and compliance processes. Experience with multi-agent systems, tool use, Text2SQL, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and LLM evaluation. Experience with vector databases, lakehouse platforms (such as Databricks), and enterprise AI platforms (such as SageMaker or Azure ML). Experience fine-tuning or adapting models, and optimizing AI systems for quality, latency, throughput and cost. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions and MLflow, or equivalent LLMOps tooling. Experience working across multiple concurrent projects and with stakeholders in different countries and time zones. Experience building developer tooling, internal platforms or accelerators that other teams adopt. Familiarity with web experience platforms, CMS and content operations. Professional Skills and Education Comfortable in ambiguity: you move without a spec, make sound calls with incomplete information, and know when to ask. High ownership and self-direction, with the maturity to work with minimal supervision. Strong communicator, written and verbal, who can earn trust quickly with senior business stakeholders. Pragmatic builder who favors working software and fast feedback over perfect plans. Curious and quick to learn new technologies, with a drive to improve existing business and technical processes. Strong coordination skills and the ability to balance several projects at once. Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and collaboration in a professional setting. Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering or a related technical field. A master's degree is preferred. Equivalent practical experience is considered. jobs.title: FVAL High-Speed Interface Validation Lead
jobs.description: OUR STORY At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. YOUR ROLE Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team that is an integral part of R&D, working on cutting-edge Camera Image Sensor SoC products targeting Automotive, Industrial, Mobile, Security, and Machine Vision applications. As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating high-speed interfaces used in Camera Image Sensor SoCs from FPGA prototyping through silicon bring-up and production qualification. Your mission will be to ensure that interface functionality, performance, compliance, interoperability, and robustness meet product specifications under various operating conditions. In this role, you will be responsible for validating high-speed interfaces across Camera Image Sensor SoCs, focusing on MIPI protocols, DisplayPort , SerDes-based connectivity, protocol compliance, and system-level validation. The role requires a strong understanding of protocol architecture, embedded systems, hardware validation, and automation using Python. Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration. To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs. You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team. Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements. Key Responsibilities Experience: 5 - 10yrs Validate end-to-end functionality of high-speed interfaces implemented in Camera Image Sensor SoCs. Develop comprehensive validation plans and test strategies for: MIPI CSI-2 / D-PHY / C-PHY DisplayPort (DP/eDP) Proprietary SerDes interfaces Verify protocol compliance (CTS) against applicable industry specifications. Validate interface operation across multiple speeds, lane configurations, and low power profiles. Execute interoperability testing with host processors, ISP platforms, FPGA platforms, and validation boards. Perform stress, corner-case, and robustness testing. Validate error handling and recovery mechanisms. Execute compliance and certification activities. Automate test execution, log collection, analysis, and reporting. YOUR SKILLS & EXPERIENCES o Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C) o Version management tools (git, svn) o Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities. Knowledge: o Embedded electronics / computing (real time) o Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, Logic Analyzers, Protocol Analyzers, etc.) o Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP o Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools) o Notions in image processing would be an adding competency. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

jobs.title: Data Modeler - Ontology
jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. Job Description About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Ontology / Knowledge Graph Engineer who understands not just graph databases, but the true semantic foundations behind enterprise knowledge graphs. This role requires experience in building domain ontologies , modeling conceptual semantics, and connecting those models to enterprise data sources. This is not a Cypher-only graph querying role. This is a role for someone who has worked with OWL/RDF , domain modeling, and semantic standards—and can translate complex insurance concepts into a formal ontology that powers AI, LLMs, data governance, and enterprise knowledge systems. Key Responsibilities 1. Ontology Design & Semantic Modeling Design, model, and maintain insurance domain ontologies using OWL/RDF. Build conceptual and logical semantic models for entities such as: Policies, Coverages, Perils, Claims, Loss Events, Parties, Risk Objects, Brokers/Agents. Define canonical data definitions, taxonomies, hierarchical relationships, and semantic constraints. Translate business domain models and regulatory structures into formal semantic structures . 2. Knowledge Graph Architecture Design and extend production-grade knowledge graphs derived from ontologies. Make design decisions on: How the ontology becomes the semantic index for enterprise data. How graph nodes point back to source systems through schema mapping. How the KG will be used in RAG, LLM context grounding, or reasoning pipelines. Implement ontology-driven schemas using RDF stores or labeled-property graph stores. 3. Source System Mapping Parse schemas from policy admin, claims, CRM, billing, and underwriting systems. Map source fields to ontology entities using: Schema parsing Semantic mapping Transformation rules Ensure semantic alignment and consistency across diverse insurance systems. 4. Azure Cloud Integration Deploy and operationalize ontology and KG components using: Azure Data Lake / Storage Azure Purview / Microsoft Fabric Catalog Azure Cognitive Search (for semantic indexing) Azure Kubernetes Services / Azure Functions (for KG pipelines) Azure OpenAI (for semantic enrichment, RAG, and reasoning) Integrate KG metadata into Azure metadata and lineage systems. 5. Collaboration & Governance Work closely with: Underwriting SMEs Claims SMEs Data governance teams Data engineering teams AI/ML product teams Document semantic models, maintain change logs, and drive ontology versioning. Required Skills (Non-Negotiable) Hands-on experience in ontology development , not just graph querying. Strong knowledge of: OWL, RDF, RDFS, SKOS SPARQL , SHACL (preferred) Experience designing conceptual and logical domain models . Demonstrated ability to build a knowledge graph from scratch , not just use one. Strong insurance domain understanding: Policy structures Exposure / risk modeling fundamentals Claims life cycle Product hierarchies Regulatory constraints Ability to map enterprise source schemas to semantic models. Experience with at least one semantic technology stack: Stardog, GraphDB, Neo4j (with RDF frameworks), TopQuadrant, AllegroGraph, etc. Nice-to-Have Skills Experience building LLM-integrated semantic pipelines: Context engineering RAG indexing Metadata grounding Familiarity with Azure OpenAI or similar LLM orchestration frameworks. Understanding of industry data standards such as ACORD . Soft Skills Strong analytical and conceptual modeling skills. Ability to challenge assumptions and define canonical definitions. Ability to communicate with business SMEs and translate domain knowledge into ontology structures. Structured documentation and versioning discipline. Why This Role Matters This role is foundational to: Enterprise LLM adoption Semantic search Knowledge-driven underwriting & claims workflows Data governance AI safety & consistency Eliminating redundant and fragmented data definitions across systems If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
