jobs.description: Job ID JR116676 Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Micron is seeking an experienced Principal SRAM Design Engineer to develop high-performance memory IP and testchip content for advanced semiconductor technologies. The engineer will contribute towards architecture definition, transistor-level circuit design, simulations, and verifications. The role requires strong hands-on knowledge of SRAM and bitcells, sense amplifiers, address decoders, control logic, etc. The successful candidate will work closely with layout, CAD, process integration, testchip, and other partner teams to deliver robust, production-ready memory solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, Develop and verify memory-array subsystems including bitcell arrays, precharge and equalization, sense amplifiers, write drivers, address decoders, wordline drivers, control logic, etc. Evaluate bitcell and peripheral-circuit stability, performance, leakage, dynamic power, and area across process, voltage, temperature, mismatch, and aging conditions. Own transistor-level simulation and signoff using Spectre/FineSim, or comparable tools, including PVT corners, Monte Carlo analysis, parasitic-aware post-layout simulation, and waveform/debug reviews. Partner with layout engineers on floorplanning, bitcell-array composition, matching, critical-net routing, clock and control distribution, parasitic reduction, and layout-dependent effects. Develop or improve automation for simulation setup, corner execution, results extraction, validation, and regression using Python, Tcl, Perl, SKILL, or similar languages. Plan and support SRAM testchips , including memory-instance selection, PPA objectives, test access, measurement structures, characterization plans, and alignment with process-learning goals. Engage process and foundry partners to understand device behavior, variation, layout restrictions, reliability constraints, and technology-specific opportunities affecting SRAM design margins. Create clear circuit specifications , design-review material, verification plans and release documentation with traceable assumptions and decisions. Mentor engineers on memory-circuit fundamentals, simulation discipline, PPA analysis, debug methods, and reusable design practices. Explore AI-assisted engineering workflows for specification extraction, circuit and block partitioning, test-mode enrichment, design-flow automation, regression analysis, and documentation while maintaining human technical review. Technical Scope SRAM and register-file architectures, bitcell arrays, local and global datapaths, sensing, write paths, decoding, control, clocking, test access, and retention behavior. Low-power and high-performance design techniques including assist circuits, biasing, leakage reduction, dynamic-power optimization, robust low-voltage operation, and variation-aware sizing. Memory compilers and configurable macro generation, including architecture templating, legal configuration space, multi-view collateral, validation, and customer or SoC integration support. Circuit verification using spice simulators, PVT analysis, Monte Carlo mismatch, extracted post-layout simulation, and timing/power model correlation. Testchip development, silicon data analysis, debug, model calibration analysis, and process integration collaboration. Minimum Qualifications Demonstrated industry experience of 8+ yars in SRAM, register-file, ROM, DRAM peripheral, or other custom-memory circuit design. BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, VLSI, Microelectronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Strong knowledge of CMOS transistor-level circuit design, memory architecture, static and dynamic timing behavior, power analysis, signal integrity, and process variation. Hands-on experience with Cadence Virtuoso and SPICE-class simulators such as HSPICE, Spectre, or FineSim. Experience performing PVT-corner, Monte Carlo, parasitic-aware post-layout, and power/timing characterization analyses. Ability to translate product or testchip requirements into circuit architecture, measurable design targets, verification plans, and release criteria. Experience collaborating with layout, CAD, process/foundry, verification, product, and silicon characterization teams. Clear technical communication, structured problem solving, and the ability to debug complex circuit or silicon issues using data and waveform evidence. jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to play a key role in building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata’s cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos. You will: Design and build key components of Teradata’s agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service. Design and build agent runtimes and harnesses : tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls. Design, build and secure MCP servers and clients , and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs. Integrate and serve LLMs , both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control. Build ModelOps / LLMOps pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring. Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics. Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries. Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness. Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code. Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata’s vector store. Contribute to technical design reviews and architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions for your area. Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives. Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts across India and Silicon Valley , working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems. You’ll also work cross-functionally with: Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful. Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries. Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads. This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction. Minimum Requirements BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production. Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD. Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering. Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models. Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent. Experience with ModelOps / LLMOps : deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production. Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost. Proficiency in Python (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems. Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling). Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation). Experience implementing AI guardrails , red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense. Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI. Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads. #LI-PG1

jobs.description: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Description Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4–7 years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies, along with a solid understanding of Generative AI and the evolving Large Language Model (LLM) ecosystem. Generative AI & LLMs: Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, LLM architectures, and the differences between various models, including their capabilities, limitations, performance, latency, and cost trade-offs. AI-Powered Application Development: Experience integrating LLMs into applications using APIs, prompt engineering, and techniques such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is highly desirable. AI Coding Tools: Familiarity with AI-powered software development tools such as Claude, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools is an added advantage. Candidates should be interested in leveraging these tools to improve developer productivity, code quality, debugging, and testing. Software Engineering Best Practices: Strong understanding of clean code, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, unit testing, debugging, and performance optimization. Problem-Solving & Ownership: Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical challenges, make sound engineering decisions, and take ownership of features from design through deployment. Collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, agile development environment. Qualifications Hands-on experience building AI-enabled applications, evaluating different LLMs for specific use cases, and using AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate software delivery while maintaining code quality and security. jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. About Tech@Lilly At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly. At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve. Principal Engineer – Operations, Reliability & AI Platforms (R3) About the Role As a Principal Engineer – Operations, Reliability & AI Platforms, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale production systems, cloud platforms, and AI-powered applications. You will drive reliability, operational excellence, observability, automation, and resiliency across multiple products and platforms while serving as a trusted engineering leader for critical business services. This role combines deep technical expertise, architectural leadership, operational ownership, and strategic thinking. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, and Operations teams to establish reliability standards, eliminate operational toil through automation, improve system resilience, and ensure mission-critical services operate securely and efficiently at scale. What You'll Be Doing Technical Leadership & Strategy Define and drive the operational engineering strategy for enterprise applications, cloud-native platforms, and AI-enabled systems. Establish standards for reliability, scalability, availability, performance, security, and operational excellence. Lead architecture reviews with a focus on supportability, observability, resiliency, disaster recovery, and long-term sustainability. Provide technical leadership during major incidents, service disruptions, and high-severity production events. Influence product and engineering roadmaps to proactively address technical debt, operational risks, and reliability improvements. Production Operations & Reliability Engineering Own reliability outcomes through Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), error budgets, and operational health metrics. Drive adoption of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and operational excellence practices across teams. Lead complex root cause investigations involving distributed systems, cloud platforms, integrations, databases, and AI services. Establish operational readiness reviews, production acceptance criteria, release governance, and supportability standards. Define and implement resiliency engineering practices including failover validation, disaster recovery testing, capacity planning, and business continuity programs. Drive continuous improvement through incident trend analysis, reliability metrics, and operational insights. AI Platform & Agent Operations Provide technical leadership for AI-powered applications, copilots, virtual assistants, chatbots, and agent-based systems operating in production environments. Establish operational standards for Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, vector databases, MCP ecosystems, and orchestration platforms. Lead investigations involving AI model failures, retrieval issues, prompt orchestration, tool-calling workflows, agent interactions, and integration failures. Define monitoring strategies for AI quality, token consumption, latency, throughput, reliability, and operational health. Drive AI governance, responsible AI practices, security, compliance, and operational risk management. Automation & Operational Excellence Lead initiatives to eliminate manual operational effort through automation, intelligent workflows, self-healing capabilities, and autonomous remediation. Design and implement operational automation using scripting, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, observability platforms, and AIOps solutions. Establish enterprise runbooks, playbooks, operational standards, and knowledge management frameworks. Drive adoption of platform engineering principles to improve reliability, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. Collaboration & Mentorship Partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, Compliance, and Operations teams to improve service quality and customer outcomes. Mentor engineers and technical leaders in reliability engineering, distributed systems, cloud operations, and AI platform support. Communicate technical risks, operational health, and strategic recommendations to both technical and executive stakeholders. Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve reliability, resilience, supportability, and operational maturity across the organisation. How You Will Succeed Demonstrate exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and systems-thinking capabilities across complex distributed environments. Drive measurable improvements in service reliability, availability, performance, and operational efficiency. Build scalable observability, monitoring, tracing, and automation capabilities that proactively detect and resolve issues. Operate effectively across application, platform, infrastructure, cloud, and AI technology stacks. Influence engineering organisations through technical leadership, collaboration, and data-driven decision making. Balance business priorities, operational risk, engineering investment, and long-term sustainability. Establish measurable operational KPIs, SLOs, SLIs, and reliability programmes. Become the escalation point for the most complex technical and operational challenges. What You Should Bring Experience 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Production Operations, or related disciplines. Proven experience operating and supporting large-scale enterprise production environments. Experience leading reliability, operational excellence, and platform transformation initiatives. Demonstrated success driving operational improvements across multiple products, systems, and teams. Experience operating within regulated industries such as Life Sciences, Healthcare, Financial Services, or similar environments. Technical Expertise Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native platforms. Strong understanding of software architecture, performance engineering, resiliency, security, and operational excellence. Advanced troubleshooting capabilities across applications, integrations, databases, networking, infrastructure, and cloud services. Experience leading major incident management, post-incident reviews, root cause analysis, and corrective action programmes. Strong understanding of governance, compliance, risk management, and secure engineering practices. Cloud & Platform Engineering Skills Expert knowledge of AWS, Azure, and/or GCP cloud platforms. Experience designing and supporting highly available, fault-tolerant, enterprise-scale cloud architectures. Strong expertise with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration technologies. Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or similar platforms. Deep understanding of networking, identity management, security, and cloud governance. Experience implementing platform engineering principles and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs). Strong knowledge of high availability, failover, disaster recovery, backup, and resilience engineering concepts. DevOps, SRE & Automation Skills Expert understanding of SRE principles, reliability engineering, error budgets, SLOs, and SLIs. Strong experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, and modern deployment automation platforms. Proven experience implementing self-healing systems, automated remediation, and operational automation solutions. Deep expertise with observability platforms including OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or equivalent technologies. Experience implementing AIOps, intelligent alerting, event correlation, and operational analytics platforms. Strong automation and scripting capabilities using Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or similar technologies. AI & Emerging Technology Skills Strong understanding of Generative AI ecosystems and enterprise AI architecture patterns. Experience supporting: LLM-based Applications Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems Agentic Workflows Semantic Search Platforms Vector Databases AI Orchestration Frameworks Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Services, or similar AI platforms. Understanding of MCP Server architecture, MCP Clients, Tool Calling, Enterprise AI integrations, and AI platform operations. Experience monitoring AI reliability, latency, throughput, token consumption, usage patterns, and operational health metrics. Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI governance, security, compliance, model evaluation, and operational risk management. Nice to Have Experience leading enterprise-wide operational transformation initiatives. Experience building reliability engineering or operational excellence programmes. Experience supporting Kubernetes-based cloud-native architectures at scale. Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar orchestration frameworks. Experience supporting MCP-based enterprise integrations and AI ecosystems. Experience implementing AIOps capabilities, autonomous operations, and intelligent automation solutions. Cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, or AI/Generative AI certifications. Experience supporting mission-critical, global, 24x7 production environments. Key Competencies Principal Engineering Leadership Production Operations & Support Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Operational Excellence Reliability Engineering Cloud Architecture & Operations Platform Engineering Incident & Problem Management Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Observability & Telemetry Automation & Self-Healing Systems AI Platform Operations MCP & AI Integration Support Generative AI & Agentic Systems Disaster Recovery & Resilience Engineering Security, Risk & Compliance Executive Stakeholder Management Cross-Functional Technical Leadership Continuous Improvement & Innovation Customer-Focused Problem Solving Additional Information Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team will support continuous operations across two shifts and therefore, this role will require non-standard work hours, and some work on weekends and holidays. Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non-standard hours where applicable. Candidate should be open to work on different shifts - 6AM to 2PM and 2PM to 11PM when required. At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. As a Staff Data Engineer & AI Solution Architect you should be able to architect scalable, enterprise-grade data, cloud analytics, AI/ML, and Agentic AI solutions for complex business use cases. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in GCP/Azure, Snowflake, SAP S/4HANA, Python, SQL, and modern engineering practices, along with proven technical leadership, problem-solving, and stakeholder collaboration skills. Roles & Responsibilities Architect and deliver scalable, production-ready cloud data, analytics, AI/ML, and data science solutions to address complex business challenges. Lead enterprise architecture and technical design decisions , establishing robust data models, platform standards, integration patterns, and lifecycle practices while minimizing technical debt. Provide deep technical expertise to troubleshoot critical issues and drive innovative, scalable solutions across multiple projects and technology domains. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, business stakeholders, and technical working groups to define and deliver effective architecture solutions. Provide technical leadership, mentoring, architecture reviews, and solution guidance to Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Engineers, and Product Owners , strengthening overall engineering capability. Strong hands-on experience with GCP and/or Azure , along with enterprise and on-premises technology platforms. Strong experience with Snowflake , including enterprise data architecture, data modeling, performance optimization, and integration with cloud and enterprise platforms. Strong experience with SAP platforms and data integration ; experience with SAP S/4HANA and leveraging SAP data for enterprise analytics solutions is highly desirable. 5+ years of hands-on experience with technologies such as Python, SQL, .NET, and Angular , along with strong software engineering and GitHub-based development practices. Experience with Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions; exposure to distributed technologies such as Kubernetes/OpenShift and Solace is desirable. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across business and technical audiences. jobs.title: Engineering, Sr Engineer
jobs.description: Pune, Maharashtra, India Category Engineering Hire Type Employee Job ID 19532 Date posted 11/02/2026 We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You have spent years building ML systems that work at scale, not just in notebooks but in production, where data pipelines break, training runs fail at hour 47, and someone has to own the fix. The difference between a model that ships and one that stays in research is usually the unglamorous work of versioning datasets, writing tests, and making sure the thing can actually be called from a product workflow. You are the engineer who closes that gap. Scientific simulation data is different. Irregular 3D meshes, physics constraints that matter, and datasets where one bad simulation can poison a training run. You have worked with data like this before, or you are ready to learn why it matters. Either way, you know that the model is only as good as the data it was trained on, and you care about that upstream problem as much as the architecture. Deployment is not someone else's job. You think about what happens after the checkpoint: how it gets packaged, how inference gets served, how a product engineer in a different timezone calls it without breaking their workflow. At Synopsys, you will build the infrastructure that makes Large Physics Foundation Models real for CFD, thermal, and electromagnetics products that customers actually ship. What You'll Be Doing Build and extend dataset factories that produce repeatable, versioned corpora across geometry, mesh, and solver setup using agentic orchestration, shared across CFD, Icepak (electronics cooling), and HFSS (high-frequency electromagnetics) Produce large, quality-gated datasets for training Large Physics Foundation Models, ensuring bad simulations are quarantined and data provenance is tracked end to end Take trained checkpoints through deployment: package models, stand up inference serving, and build integrations that product teams can call inside their workflows for initialization, prediction, or design-loop acceleration Partner with product teams to understand deployment constraints, test in real workflows, and support forward-deployed engineering when models go live Write production-grade Python with testing, versioning, CI, and operability for long-running jobs that span data generation, training, and serving Build data loaders and training pipelines for irregular 3D simulation data using PyTorch, handling distributed training, checkpointing, and physics-based evaluation metrics Own the ambiguous boundary between data engineering, model training, and product deployment, closing gaps instead of waiting for a perfect handoff The Impact You Will Have Enable Synopsys simulation products to shift from "run a solver for every design" to "a model trained on high-fidelity data proposes a physically useful field in seconds," fundamentally changing how customers design cars, aircraft, chips, packages, and RF systems Build the data and deployment infrastructure that competitors cannot replicate from a research paper, giving Synopsys a durable advantage in physics-informed ML Accelerate design loops for customers by orders of magnitude, letting them explore more configurations, fail faster, and use expensive solvers only where fidelity still matters Create reusable dataset factories that scale across multiple physics domains, so campaigns can generate trusted multi-physics corpora without reinventing the pipeline every time Make Large Physics Foundation Models operationally real for product teams, so they can ship models that customers trust and that survive contact with production workflows Establish reproducible training runs and physics-based evaluation standards that ensure models fail gracefully and teams know the bounds of what they can and cannot predict Support product integrations that let downstream engineers call your models without needing to understand the ML stack, just the physics constraints that matter for their workflow What You'll Need Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field (PhD welcome but not required) 2-3+ years building ML systems in production, with meaningful time spent on large scientific datasets, simulation data, HPC environments, or deploying models beyond notebooks Strong Python engineering habits: testing, versioning, CI/CD, API design, and operability of long-running jobs Hands-on deep learning experience with PyTorch or equivalent, including data loaders for irregular 3D data, distributed training, and checkpointing Experience with transformers, vision-language models, neural operators, geometric deep learning, graph networks, or physics surrogates is a strong plus Demonstrated ability to own work across ambiguous boundaries between data engineering, model training, and product deployment Who You Are You close gaps instead of waiting for someone else to define the interface. If the data pipeline does not exist, you build it. If the deployment story is unclear, you figure it out with the product team. Scientific honesty matters to you. You quarantine bad simulations, report what the model does not predict, and own the bounds of failure instead of overselling what works. You defer to specialists on what you do not know and collaborate effectively with product engineers who will live with your deployment long after you hand it off. You can explain a technical tradeoff to a product manager in two sentences without losing the nuance, and you can debug a distributed training failure at 3am when the run is 80% done. You think in systems, not just models. The checkpoint is not the finish line. Packaging, serving, versioning, and supportability are part of the job, and you treat them that way. The Team You'll Be Part Of The team's job is to make Large Physics Foundation Models real for CFD, Icepak, and HFSS. Research defines the architectures and learning objectives. This engineering seat makes the data and the runtime real. You will work with specialists who understand the physics deeply, product teams who know what customers need, and other ML engineers who care about building systems that scale. The core mission has three parts: reuse and scale dataset factories so campaigns produce large, clean, 3D physics corpora; train large models on that data with reproducible runs and physics-based evaluation; and deploy and support those models so product teams can integrate them, operate them, and trust their limits. Rewards and Benefits We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

jobs.description: India T Special Bonus: NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. We are currently seeking a Scrum Master to join our team in Pune, Maharashtra, India. ## Scrum Master ### Role Summary We are looking for an experienced Scrum Master to support Agile delivery across Salesforce and enterprise application programs. The candidate will be responsible for facilitating Agile ceremonies, removing impediments, improving team effectiveness, and ensuring consistent delivery practices across cross-functional teams. The Scrum Master will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, QA teams, Architects, and other stakeholders to enable predictable and high-quality delivery. ### Key Responsibilities Facilitate Agile/Scrum ceremonies including: Daily Stand-ups Sprint Planning Backlog Refinement Sprint Reviews / Demos Sprint Retrospectives Support the Product Owner and team in maintaining a healthy, prioritized, and actionable backlog. Help the team define realistic sprint goals and commitments based on capacity and dependencies. Track sprint progress, delivery commitments, blockers, risks, and dependencies. Identify and remove impediments that affect team productivity or delivery. Promote Agile best practices and help the team continuously improve its ways of working. Coach team members on Scrum principles, Agile practices, ownership, collaboration, and self-organization. Monitor delivery metrics such as: Velocity Burndown / Burnup Sprint predictability Carryover Defect trends Cycle time Support release planning and coordination across development, QA, business, and deployment teams. Facilitate dependency management across multiple teams, applications, and workstreams. Coordinate with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, QA leads, and Technical Leads to resolve delivery issues. Ensure risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies are identified and tracked. Support resolution of team conflicts and encourage effective collaboration. Ensure Agile ceremonies are focused, efficient, and outcome-oriented. Support continuous improvement actions identified during retrospectives. Provide regular delivery status and metrics to project and program leadership. Help ensure appropriate usage of tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or equivalent Agile delivery platforms. ### Required Skills Experience Strong experience working as a Scrum Master in Agile delivery teams. Strong understanding of: Scrum Agile principles Sprint planning Backlog management Estimation Retrospectives Release planning Experience working with cross-functional teams including developers, QA engineers, architects, business analysts, and product owners. Experience managing risks, dependencies, impediments, and delivery commitments. Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to coach teams and improve Agile maturity. Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar tools. Strong understanding of Agile delivery metrics and reporting. Ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams. ### Good to Have Experience supporting Salesforce implementation or transformation programs. Understanding of Salesforce delivery lifecycle, environments, releases, and deployment dependencies. Experience working in large enterprise or multi-vendor programs. Experience coordinating multiple Scrum teams or scaled Agile environments. Familiarity with SAFe or other scaled Agile frameworks. Certifications such as: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) Professional Scrum Master (PSM) SAFe Scrum Master PMI-ACP ### Experience Typically 10+ years of overall IT experience, with at least 3+ years in a Scrum Master or Agile delivery role. jobs.description: Our Company At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. What You'll Do In this role, you will lead product strategy and execution for Teradata's core database engine: the massively parallel query engine behind every workload on the platform. You will shape the roadmap across the optimizer, execution runtime, workload management, and Global Planner, and own how the engine performs on native storage, cloud object storage, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake. This role sits at the intersection of the database engine and AI. AI agents are becoming the dominant consumers of enterprise data, issuing high volumes of exploratory, speculative queries, while GenAI and machine learning can improve the engine from the inside. Every core component needs to be rethought in this light, and you will lead that rethink and turn it into a roadmap engineering can build. Two things anchor the role. Performance: you will spend significant time inside real workloads, query plans, and benchmarks, working with engineering to deliver measurable gains release after release. SQL: you will be the steward of Teradata SQL, the surface customers live in, making its syntax, semantics, and ergonomics simpler, more expressive, and safer for developers, analysts, and AI agents. Strategy: Own the engine vision and multi-year roadmap, co-owning architecture direction with senior engineering leaders and making principled trade-offs across performance, cost, and complexity. AI and agents: Lead the rethink of every core engine component for AI agents as the new dominant workload, and apply GenAI and ML inside the engine to make it faster and more autonomous. Optimizer, execution, and workload management: Agents send many redundant queries. Explore optimizing across queries, sharing intermediate results, and returning early or approximate answers. Apply learned cardinality and cost models and LLM-assisted rewrite, with guardrails that protect plan stability. Define how workload management absorbs bursty machine traffic through agent identity, priorities, and budgets. Performance: Work hands-on with engineering on query plans, regressions, and bottlenecks. Own the benchmark suite and KPIs (latency, concurrency, plan stability, price-performance), including agentic workloads, and build regression gates into releases. Open Table formats: Own the engine side of Iceberg and Delta Lake (scan planning, pruning, pushdown, write paths) so customers never trade performance for openness. Automate statistics, clustering, and compaction with AI. SQL language and query interface: Design features that turn complex problems into simple, readable queries, reduce footguns while keeping power and backward compatibility, and stay aligned with ANSI SQL. Make the dialect something agents can safely generate and execute, and let agents steer with cost estimates, plan explanations, and hints. Who You'll Work With You will work with senior database engineering leaders, performance engineering, AI platform teams, the open table format product team, sales engineering, and executive leadership across the US, Europe, and India. This role starts as an individual contributor, leading through technical depth and influence and mentoring Staff-level PMs. It may grow into managing a team of product managers. jobs.title: AWS DevOps Lead
jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. About the Role We are looking for a AWS DevOps Lead with strong hands-on experience in AWS cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD and production engineering . This role is suited for an engineer with a strong builder mindset who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and creating scalable, reliable and automated platforms. What You'll Do Design, build and maintain highly available, scalable and secure infrastructure on AWS . Build automation to reduce manual operational effort and improve engineering productivity. Design, develop and manage robust CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments. Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation-first engineering practices. Troubleshoot complex production issues across AWS infrastructure, Linux, networking, applications and deployment pipelines . Participate in production support and on-call activities, taking end-to-end ownership of incidents and root-cause analysis. Partner closely with software engineering teams to design and enable cloud-native solutions . Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, security, performance and developer experience . Build reusable automation and self-service capabilities for engineering teams. Evaluate AI-powered engineering solutions that can improve operational efficiency and developer productivity. Create and maintain architecture documentation, operational runbooks and engineering best practices. What We're Looking For 8–12 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, AWS Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, SRE or similar engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) . Experience with AWS services and capabilities such as: EC2 EBS S3 VPC and VPC Endpoints Transit Gateway Security Groups and NACLs AWS CodePipeline AWS CodeBuild Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including process management, memory, file systems, system performance and shell scripting. Solid understanding of networking fundamentals , including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, routing, load balancing, firewalls and VPN concepts. Strong scripting or programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, Java or Bash . Hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines and a good understanding of modern software delivery practices. Experience with GitHub Actions for build and deployment automation. Strong production troubleshooting, debugging and root-cause analysis capabilities. Experience building reusable automation or self-service tooling. Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams. Good to Have Hands-on experience with Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation . Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes and Amazon EKS . Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as AWS CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus or Datadog . Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible . Understanding of AWS cloud security and infrastructure security best practices. AWS certification(s). What Will Make You Successful in This Role You are someone who: Thinks automation first and looks for opportunities to engineer manual work out of the system. Has a strong builder mindset and enjoys solving difficult infrastructure problems. Takes ownership of production systems rather than simply operating them. Has strong debugging instincts and enjoys getting to the root cause of complex problems. Balances reliability, scalability, security and developer experience . Is curious about emerging engineering technologies, including AI-assisted engineering tools. Continuously learns and helps raise the engineering standards of the wider team. Why Fractal? At Fractal, you'll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, cloud and modern engineering , solving challenging problems at scale alongside multidisciplinary engineering and technology teams. If you enjoy building rather than just maintaining , automating rather than manually operating and solving complex cloud infrastructure problems, we'd love to hear from you. If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 10 About the Role: Senior Network Engineer The Team: Global Network Services is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join our dynamic, multi-disciplinary team. You will design, automate, and operate the DNS, edge delivery, and application delivery services that keep S&P Global’s platforms fast, secure, and available. We value continuous learning, excellence, and a proactive mindset. Responsibilities and Impact DDI, Edge Security, and Application Delivery Own the architecture and operation of enterprise DDI services, including Infoblox (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) and cloud DNS (AWS Route 53, Azure DNS/Private DNS, Google Cloud DNS), with hybrid DNS resolution across on-premises and multi-cloud environments. Integrate IPAM/DDI with the CMDB to keep IP, host, and network records accurate and in sync, using discovery data and API-driven reconciliation to detect and correct drift. Design and operate DNS security controls, including DNSSEC, DNS firewall (e.g., Infoblox BloxOne Threat Defense), protection against DNS attacks Design and manage CDN, WAF, bot management, and DDoS protection using Akamai and Cloudflare, including rule tuning, policy management, and traffic analysis. Design and operate load balancing and traffic management, including F5, cloud-native load balancers (AWS ELB/ALB, Azure Application Gateway, GCP Load Balancing), and global server load balancing. Automation and Infrastructure as Code Write, test, and maintain Terraform modules to provision DNS, edge, and load balancing services across AWS, Azure, and GCP, setting shared-module patterns. Build Python tooling and API integrations (e.g., Infoblox WAPI, Akamai ,Cloudflare APIs) to remove repetitive manual tasks and improve consistency. Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for changes, including automated validation, pre-deployment testing, and policy checks. Develop automated configuration and compliance checks to catch deviations from approved standards (e.g., DNS records, WAF policies, IPAM allocations) early. Follow good engineering practice in shared repositories: version control, peer review, modular code, and clear documentation. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement Serve as subject matter expert and third-line escalation point for complex incidents, leading root cause analysis. Collaborate with application, product, engineering, and security teams to deliver changes meeting enterprise standards and compliance requirements. Plan and execute approved changes within agreed maintenance windows, with documented back-out steps, and join out-of-hours change windows as required. Produce and maintain architecture documentation, automation runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Mentor engineers, share knowledge, and identify ways to reduce risk, improve efficiency, and raise standards. What We’re Looking For Basic Required Qualifications 5+ years’ experience in network or infrastructure engineering supporting hybrid, multi-cloud environments. Extensive hands-on experience with Infoblox DDI, including DNS architecture, DHCP, and IPAM design and operations. Proficiency in Python for automation and API integration, following software development best practices (testing, code review). Solid understanding of core networking, DNS, and HTTP protocols, able to read configuration as code and assess a change’s impact before deploying it. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team. Additional Preferred Qualifications Experience querying observability and logging platforms (e.g., Splunk, Grafana , Google Secops etc) to analyze DNS, CDN/WAF, and load balancer telemetry, build dashboards and alerts, and troubleshoot incidents. Active Directory infrastructure knowledge. Experience in a regulated environment with formal change and audit requirements. AI fundamentals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of AI technology and make a significant impact on our organization. As the Senior Manager, you will be responsible for designing and implementing innovative AI solutions, from selecting foundation models to engineering agentic loops. Your expertise will be crucial in translating complex business problems into efficient and scalable AI-powered systems. Responsibilities: Own the end-to-end technical architecture of AI solutions, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance. Select and evaluate foundation models for various AI applications, considering their suitability and potential impact. Design context layers that enhance the performance and adaptability of AI systems in different scenarios. Engineer agentic loops to enable autonomous decision-making and problem-solving capabilities in AI agents. Collaborate closely with product and business teams to understand their needs and translate them into effective AI solutions. Conduct rigorous harness testing to ensure the reliability and robustness of AI systems before deployment. Implement robust production observability practices to monitor and optimize AI systems in real-world environments. Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI (GenAI), and Agentic AI. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of AI engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning. Qualifications: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required, with a master's degree preferred. Minimum 10 years of experience in AI engineering, with a proven track record of designing and implementing large-scale AI systems. Deep expertise in AI architecture, including foundation model selection, context-layer design, and agentic loop engineering. Hands-on experience with harness testing and production observability practices for AI systems. Strong understanding of cloud technologies and their integration with AI solutions. Familiarity with cutting-edge AI technologies such as LLMs, GenAI, and Agentic AI is highly desirable. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex business problems into technical AI solutions. Effective communication and collaboration skills to work closely with cross-functional teams. Ability to lead and mentor a team, fostering a positive and innovative work environment. Passion for staying updated with the latest advancements in AI and a commitment to continuous learning.

jobs.title: AI - Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Company Description About Sopra Steria Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end-to-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5.6 billion. The world is how we shape it. Job Description Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications leveraging LLMs, Agentic AI frameworks, and modern AI engineering tools. The ideal candidate should have practical experience building AI agents, copilots, and RAG-based solutions that solve real business problems and create measurable value. Key Responsibilities Design and develop AI agents, copilots, and autonomous workflows. Build solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Google ADK. Develop RAG solutions, semantic search capabilities, and enterprise knowledge assistants. Integrate AI solutions with business applications, APIs, databases, and enterprise systems. Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Package, deploy, and monitor AI applications in cloud environments. Contribute reusable frameworks, accelerators, and AI engineering best practices. Required Technical Skills Programming & Engineering Strong proficiency in Python. Experience with REST APIs and integrations. FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks. Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals. Agentic AI & LLMs Hands-on experience with one or more: LangChain LangGraph CrewAI AutoGen Google ADK Prompt Engineering Function/Tool Calling Agent Workflows and Memory Concepts Building LLM-powered applications RAG & Knowledge Systems Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Vector Databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, Milvus, etc.) Semantic Search and Embeddings Cloud & Deployment Docker Azure, AWS, or GCP CI/CD fundamentals Preferred Skills Model Context Protocol (MCP) Multi-Agent Systems GraphRAG Semantic Kernel OpenAI Agents SDK PydanticAI AI Evaluation Frameworks (Promptfoo, RAGAS) Knowledge Graphs React or Streamlit-based AI applications Professional Attributes (Mandatory) Strong collaborator capable of working effectively across engineering, product, business, and leadership teams. Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences. Confident, proactive, and self-driven individual who takes ownership and delivers results. Strong networking and relationship-building abilities, with the capability to engage stakeholders across teams and geographies. Comfortable conducting demos, presentations, workshops, and technical discussions. Passionate about continuous learning and staying current with emerging AI technologies. Experience Requirements 3–8 years of overall software engineering experience. Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, or LLM-based application development. Experience building and delivering AI-powered applications, agents, copilots, or automation solutions in enterprise or production environments. Total Experience Expected: 03-04 years Qualifications Bachelor of Technology Additional Information Ideal Candidate Summary A hands-on AI Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals and at least 2 years of experience in Generative AI and Agentic AI . The ideal candidate has experience building AI agents, copilots, and RAG-based solutions using modern agent frameworks and LLM technologies. Beyond technical expertise, they are a confident communicator, strong collaborator, and relationship builder who can effectively influence stakeholders, drive cross-functional collaboration, and help accelerate AI innovation across the organization. At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences. All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad develops foundational AI/ML capabilities that transform first-party data signals into production-ready machine learning systems. These solutions help expand addressable audiences, improve targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, user engagement, and retention. Our Machine Learning Engineers combine strong data science expertise with hands-on engineering capabilities to take models from development to production. This includes building production-grade ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and scalable ML infrastructure such as feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps frameworks. We primarily leverage Databricks, along with Snowflake and AWS, and actively embrace emerging technologies, including agentic AI development workflows, to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent machine learning solutions. About the Role As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across our global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring. Roles & Responsibilities: ML System Design & Ownership Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models. Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs. Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM). Modeling & Experimentation Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching. Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case. Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs. Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR). MLOps & Infrastructure Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks. Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency. Contribute to the team’s feature-store strategy — feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs — and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds. Embed FinOps cost discipline (compute caps, auto-termination, job tagging) into pipeline design. Mentorship & Cross-functional Collaboration Mentor MLE 2s through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing; contribute to team technical standards. Partner with Product, Marketing, and Ad Sales to translate business requirements into ML problem formulations, and with Data Engineering on data contracts and pipeline SLAs. Communicate model performance, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Flagship Projects You’ll Work On Identity Intelligence — foundational, privacy-safe identity across all brands: probabilistic ID resolution that resolves unauthenticated signals to households/persons with calibrated confidence (entity resolution with gradient boosting and embeddings, representation learning, isotonic calibration, candidate blocking, champion/challenger pipelines), expanding addressable audiences beyond deterministic matching. Audience Intelligence — advertising and marketing use cases: lookalike and predictive audiences (LAL across 1,000+ features), ML-driven smart audiences, layered retrieval + propensity, and incrementality/closed-loop optimization, with privacy-safe activation including data clean rooms. ML-based Forecasting — audience growth, demand, and advertising yield/pricing forecasting that powers ad sales and marketing decisions. Content Preferences & Affinity — genre-preference, content-preference, and single-title affinity modeling (two-tower retrieval with semantic content embeddings) that ranks audiences for upcoming titles and powers cross-channel promotion. What You’ll Bring Required 5–8 years of industry experience in ML engineering or applied data science (3+ years with a Ph.D.). Deep Python expertise and production-quality software engineering practices; production experience building and deploying ML at scale (millions+ of users/records). Strong proficiency in Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/DLT, MLflow, Unity Catalog) and solid SQL/Snowflake experience for feature sourcing and model-output delivery. Experience with AWS ML services (SageMaker, S3, Lambda). Strong understanding of ML model evaluation, A/B testing, and statistical inference; knowledge in one or more of recommendations & ranking, identity resolution, embeddings/retrieval, causal/interpretable ML, forecasting, bandits, or optimization. Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions and mentor engineers. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience). Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to advocate technical solutions to engineers, scientists, and product stakeholders. Preferred: Recommendation systems, personalization, identity resolution, or audience modeling in a media / streaming / ad-tech context. Familiarity with Data Clean Room environments (Snowflake DCR, AWS Clean Rooms) and consent-aware activation. Experience with two-tower / retrieval architectures, probabilistic identity resolution (graph-based matching, entity resolution), and probability calibration. Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP), Databricks Genie Space configuration, and Snowflake Cortex. jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! ㅤ As a Principal Data Scientist, you will play a pivotal role in architecting, developing, and deploying high-impact machine learning and data science solutions across Warner Bros. Discovery’s global businesses. This role is ideal for a seasoned technical leader with 14–16 years of total experience, including 10–12 years of deep, hands-on experience in applied data science, machine learning, and statistical modeling. You will translate complex business problems into scalable analytical solutions—leveraging predictive modeling, optimization, experimentation, NLP, computer vision, and modern ML engineering practices. You will lead end-to-end development of ML models, champion scientific rigor, and ensure robust operationalization through modern MLOps practices. Experience in the Media & Entertainment sector—content, streaming, audience behavior, ad intelligence, or metadata systems—is a significant plus. This is a high-impact role requiring strong technical expertise, business acumen, problem-solving skills, and the ability to guide cross functional partners across Product, Engineering, Technology, and Business domains. 1. Core Data Science & Machine Learning Expertise Design, build, and scale advanced machine learning models across predictive analytics, NLP, CV, forecasting, optimization, and recommender systems. Apply strong statistical foundations—hypothesis testing, probability modeling, causal inference, and experiment design—to solve complex business problems. Develop interpretable and explainable ML models, ensuring scientific rigor, reproducibility, and operational robustness. Conduct feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and validation using modern ML frameworks. Translate ambiguous problems into structured analytic approaches with measurable impact. 2. ML Engineering & MLOps Execution Build production-grade ML pipelines integrating with WBD’s data ecosystem (Snowflake, AWS, GCP, Databricks). Implement CI/CD, model monitoring, drift detection, alerting, and model performance governance. Contribute to the design of feature stores, experimentation platforms, and ML observability frameworks. Work closely with data engineering and platform teams to ensure scalable, reliable model deployment. 3. Applied Data Science Delivery for High-Value Business Problems Lead delivery of ML solutions for domains such as: Content performance and ratings prediction Audience segmentation, churn and lifetime value modeling Search ranking, discovery, and personalization systems Metadata enrichment and content understanding using NLP & CV Operational forecasting and automation Convert analytical outcomes into actionable insights—delivering high-ROI recommendations to product and business stakeholders. 4. Stakeholder Partnership & Communication Partner with senior leaders across Streaming, Technology, Product, Content, and Marketing. Present complex modeling results clearly to non-technical audiences, influencing business decisions with data-driven insights. Shape and guide analytical roadmaps aligned to enterprise priorities. 5. Leadership, Collaboration & Mentoring Mentor data scientists and ML engineers, elevating scientific rigor and best practices across the team. Lead project teams in experimentation, modeling, evaluation, and productionization. Promote knowledge sharing, documentation standards, and internal communities of practice. Champion responsible AI, model governance, and ethical data usage across engagements. Qualifications & Experiences: Master’s degree (or Ph.D. preferred) in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or related fields. 14–16 years of total experience, with 10–12 years in Data Science, ML, and advanced analytics. Strong hands-on expertise in: Predictive modeling, optimization, deep learning, NLP, and CV Python, SQL, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, ML frameworks ML Ops, model deployment, monitoring, and observability Statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian methods Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Snowflake) Demonstrated track record of delivering business impact through ML solutions in large-scale environments. Strong communication skills with demonstrable ability to influence cross-functional teams. Preferred: Experience in Media & Entertainment, streaming, digital advertising, metadata, or audience intelligence. Hands-on exposure to foundation models, LLMs, embeddings, or generative AI. Experience with video intelligence, OCR/CV pipelines, or content metadata engines. Publications, patents, or conference-level contributions in ML/AI. About Skydance Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Unified Auth SDK
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION UnifiedAuth is the authentication and authorization backbone for Amazon's service ecosystem. We secure service-to-service communication, ensuring that every call between Amazon services is authenticated and authorized against the right identity and policy. As Amazon's systems evolve toward autonomous agents, we provide agentic authentication and authorization — establishing verifiable identity and scoped, policy-governed access for AI agents acting on behalf of users and services. We also own transaction token management, issuing, propagating, and validating the tokens that carry identity and authorization context across multi-hop request chains. Together, these capabilities let Amazon's services trust who is calling them, what those callers are permitted to do, and on whose behalf they act — protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of every transaction across the fleet. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate components of our authentication SDKs and supporting services. You will own features end-to-end: design through production operations across Java, Python, NodeJS, and Rust client libraries. You will collaborate with security teams, service owners, and business teams to close authentication gaps at scale. This role suits an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, high-impact problems in a domain where correctness and availability are non-negotiable. Key job responsibilities Design and deliver features across Security SDKs, owning them from design document through production launch. Improve the static stability of authentication — ensure services continue operating through service outages via persistent caching, eager token refresh, and bounce-safe recovery. Build and maintain telemetry and compliance mechanisms that measure token propagation and detect gaps across the fleet. Diagnose and resolve production issues as part of the on-call rotation, and drive root-cause analysis and corrections for operational events. This is an AI performance projection/modeling role: your job is to model AI workloads on our GPU architecture, predict their performance with confidence, and use those projections to shape the hardware we build. You'll work across the full modeling spectrum — analytical models for fast architectural what-ifs, and architectural and cycle-accurate simulators for precision — choosing the right level of fidelity for the question at hand. Because these workloads live on the GPU, you'll need real GPU architecture depth to do it. If you think in rooflines, arithmetic intensity, tensor/pipeline/data parallelism, and KV-cache bandwidth budgets — and you want your models to change the microarchitecture, not just describe it — this is the role. What You'll Do Project AI workload performance (your core mission) Build and use models — analytical, architectural, and cycle-accurate — to project the performance of generative AI and LLM workloads (attention, GEMMs, collectives, training and inference, vision models etc) on our GPU architecture. Choose the right fidelity for the question: analytical bounds and rooflines for rapid trade-off exploration, architectural and cycle-accurate simulation for precise answers. Find where performance will be won or lost — compute-engine occupancy, L1/L2 hierarchy, memory bandwidth, SoC fabric — and quantify the impact of each. Characterize workloads & shape the hardware Characterize AI workloads end to end — trace and profile execution, extract structural footprints, and translate them into microarchitectural bottlenecks and performance bounding boxes. Run architecture experiments to evaluate GPU configurations, scaling limits, and trade-offs against real AI workloads, backing every recommendation with sensitivity analysis and data. Extend and maintain the cycle-accurate / cycle-approximate simulators for the GPU subsystems AI workloads depend on — compute engines, cache hierarchies, memory subsystems, interconnects. Prove it on silicon (post-silicon) Run AI workloads on early silicon, capture telemetry, and correlate results back to your pre-silicon models to sharpen fidelity. Root-cause AI performance mismatches on physical silicon using low-level performance counters, register dumps, and Linux tracing. Collaborate across the stack Partner with compiler, runtime, and framework teams to turn model insights into optimizations, and to ground your projections in how workloads actually execute. Act as the bridge between architecture/RTL and software, translating AI workload requirements into concrete architectural constraints. What You'll Bring AI workload expertise: Deep, hands-on understanding of LLM and Transformer performance — scaling techniques, parallel training/inference strategies (tensor, pipeline, data parallelism), kernel execution graphs — and how they map to hardware. Performance modeling breadth: Hands-on experience with analytical performance models and execution-driven / architectural / cycle-accurate simulators, and sound judgment about which to reach for. Track record of turning models into decisions. GPU architecture depth: Strong command of GPU execution pipelines, SIMD/SIMT models, cache hierarchy, memory technologies, and high-bandwidth interconnects (PCIe, custom fabrics). Engineering craft: Expert modern C++ and production-grade Python. Execution: Excellent structured problem-solving; able to turn noisy simulation data into crisp, actionable findings for engineering stakeholders. As an AI Full Stack Engineer, you will design and develop AI-powered applications using Large Language Models, build Agentic AI workflows leveraging tools, reasoning, memory, and orchestration patterns, and develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise knowledge sources. You will work across the full stack — building responsive frontend applications, scalable backend services and APIs, and cloud-native deployments on AWS — while integrating AI services with business applications and ensuring systems are secure, reliable, and production-ready. Build responsive, modern frontend applications and scalable backend services and APIs, using reusable components and clean, maintainable code. Design and manage SQL and NoSQL databases, integrate enterprise systems and third-party services, and ensure secure, compliant handling of data. Collaborate closely with product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, and implement monitoring, logging, and observability best practices. What You Will Bring Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, and Agentic AI concepts, with hands-on experience using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
