jobs.description: About the role and team At Uber, AI agents are increasingly writing, reviewing, testing, and debugging code in production. They deliver high-quality results efficiently, without wasting tokens, only when they understand Uber's codebases. The AI Context Engineering team builds the context foundation that every software-development AI agent at Uber relies on: AI Context Graph: a unified graph of services, ownership, domain entities, and business flows Code Graph: a graph representation of Uber's monorepos built for agents to consume AI-Generated Documentation: documentation that stays fresh as code changes Agentic Memory: a memory layer that lets agents learn across sessions As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own major parts of this platform end to end. You'll take them from prototype to production at monorepo scale, and work with partner teams to integrate foundational context products with the agents running in production for workflows such as root-cause analysis, code authoring, test planning, and library upgrades, etc What will you do Context Graph and Ontology: Enrich the graph with new entity types, such as data streams, metrics, and observability signals, and link them to code so agents can reason across systems. Code Graph Infrastructure: Build and scale code graphs across multiple monorepos and microrepos, covering symbols, call edges, dependencies, and links between code and tests. Add incremental updates, versioned (historical) graphs, and function-level embeddings, and serve the graphs to agents with low latency through local and remote interfaces. AI-Generated Documentation: Extend automated documentation from backend services to mobile (screens, UI components), libraries, and data pipelines. Use refresh strategies that keep context current as code changes. Agentic Memory: Design the memory layer that lets agents persist and reuse decisions, past fixes, and team preferences across sessions. Standards and Governance: Define and roll out standards for agent instruction files (AGENTS.md), including structure, content, and token budget, and generate them systematically across modules. Context Quality Evaluation: Build continuous evals that measure the accuracy and freshness of every context product, and run A/B experiments that prove the impact on agent outcomes. Tooling and Integration: Build MCP servers, skills, and tools that deliver context to agents. Partner with AI Platform, Developer Experience, and product teams to integrate them into production workflows. Technical Leadership: Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, and turn ambiguous problems into well-scoped, measurable projects What will you need Experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience building production systems, with a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Programming: Strong in Go, Java, or Python, writing clean, well-tested, maintainable code. LLMs and Agentic Systems: Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents, including prompt and context design, tool use, and retrieval, and a good sense of what context makes agents succeed or fail. Code Understanding: Experience with static analysis, ASTs, parsers such as tree-sitter, or build and dependency systems in large codebases. Data at Scale: Experience building reliable data pipelines and working with graph or other large-scale data stores. Emerging Protocols: Familiarity with MCP and agent-to-agent protocols and how to apply them. Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and a habit of measuring outcomes, not just shipping features. Success Metrics More agentic workflows use curated context in production, with a measured improvement in each workflow's business metric, such as accuracy, cost, latency, or CI time. Agents provide higher-quality, better-grounded answers while using fewer tokens and tool calls than when they rediscover context from scratch. Context coverage grows across languages, repos, and entity types, with measurable accuracy and freshness. Embeddings and RAG: Experience with embedding generation, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines. Own the lifecycle management for GNI Kubernetes environments, including cluster onboarding, upgrades, capacity, availability, and recovery. Develop production-quality software and automation for cluster provisioning, validation, upgrades, remediation, and safe multi-cluster delivery through GitOps. What We Need to See: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 8+ years of experience building or operating production Kubernetes platforms, network infrastructure, or distributed systems. Deep experience with Kubernetes at scale, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, storage, and recovery. Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Go or Python. Experience with GitOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automated production delivery. Experience deploying and supporting network automation or telemetry services on Kubernetes. Experience with production on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and driving corrective actions to completion. Ways to Stand Out From the Crowd: Strong knowledge of IP routing, data center fabrics, and cloud networking is a great plus. Experience designing and operating large, multi-region Kubernetes fleets, including fleet-wide upgrades and recovery. Hands-on experience with Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3 for bare-metal provisioning, cluster lifecycle, machine remediation, and upgrades. Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators in Go using custom resources and reconciliation patterns. Experience designing or operating network automation and telemetry services on Kubernetes at global scale. Contributions to Cluster API, Metal3, or other open-source Kubernetes infrastructure projects. NVIDIA’s deep learning platforms have made major impact to various fields is broadly used across leading academic institutions, start-ups, and industry, including the world’s largest Internet companies. We need passionate, hard-working and creative people to help us take on more of these unique opportunities in deep learning cloud solutions. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Lead the operational rollout of AI tools through staged governance tiers (development sandbox, supervised review, human-in-the-loop validation, bounded autonomous execution). Drive post-incident analysis on novel outages, utilizing post-mortem telemetry to continuously refine correlation algorithms and suppression policies. Proven track record of shipping production-grade ML models and data pipelines rather than purely experimental or research-focused workflows. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Hello Visionary! We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team. At Siemens, we are scaling the Siemens Data Mesh to power the next generation of industrial AI, smart infrastructure, and digital excellence. Within Data Domain Operations, trusted, high-performance, and real-time data is the foundation of operational excellence. We are looking for a hands-on Data Engineer who is passionate about data in motion – transforming Kafka event streams provisioned by our central data ingestion platform into governed, consumer-ready data products using platforms such as Flink. This person will champion a "shift left" mentality, embedding quality and automation at the source rather than downstream. Move the world with your passion for data and impactful, AI-ready technologies. Rethink how we integrate and process data, and steer the organization toward a future where event-driven insights power every decision. Be bold when others would have given up. In short, play a key role in building the real-time data foundation of Siemens! We are looking for: Data Engineer You’ll break new ground by: As a Data Engineer within Data Domain Operations, you will design, build, and automate streaming data products that transform Kafka event streams – already provisioned by our central data ingestion platform – into trusted, consumer-grade data assets. Operating at the heart of our real-time architecture, you will implement robust pipelines for data in motion using platforms such as Flink, working closely with our data architects to bridge operational source systems and the analytical platforms that depend on them. Build Streaming Data Products: Design, build, and operate real-time and near-real-time data products sourced from Kafka event streams, using stream-processing engines such as Flink. Engineer Event-Driven Pipelines: Develop and automate robust, resilient pipelines for data in motion, covering transformation, enrichment, and delivery of streaming events into our operational and analytical platforms. Champion Shift-Left Data Engineering: Embed data quality checks, schema validation, testing, and monitoring directly into the pipeline development lifecycle, catching issues at the source rather than downstream. Treat Data as a Product: Design streaming data products with clear data contracts, documentation, and SLAs, in line with data-as-a-product principles across the Siemens Data Mesh. Bridge Operational & Analytical Systems: Collaborate with domain architects and analytics engineers to connect Kafka-based event streams with downstream warehouses (such as Snowflake) and reporting layers, supporting real-time operational decision-making. Automate & Operate with DataOps Rigor: Apply CI/CD, automated testing, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code practices to streaming pipelines, ensuring reliable, repeatable deployments. Monitor & Resolve Proactively: Monitor streaming pipeline health, identify and resolve data issues proactively, and contribute to the domain’s data governance and quality framework. Collaborate & Mentor: Work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, and share streaming and event-driven engineering best practices with peers across the domain. You’re excited to build on your existing expertise, including: Education: University degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field. Professional Experience: 3+ years of experience as a data engineer, with a strong focus on data integration, ETL/ELT, and building production data pipelines. Streaming & Event-Driven Processing: Hands-on experience with Kafka (or Confluent Cloud) and stream-processing engines such as Flink or Camel, building event-driven data products that operate on data in motion. Stream Processing & Schema Management: Experience with stateful stream-processing concepts (windowing, joins, exactly-once semantics) and schema registries (e.g., Confluent Schema Registry) for managing evolving event schemas. Cloud & Warehouse Exposure: Hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern cloud warehouses such as Snowflake. Programming & Engineering: Proficiency in Python and expert-level SQL skills, basic working knowledge of Java, along with data engineering best practices such as data versioning, automated testing, and CI/CD for data pipelines. DataOps Mindset: Familiarity with shift-left data quality practices, monitoring, and observability for streaming pipelines. Ways of Working: Experience with agile software development methodologies, and excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proven ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions. Languages: Fluency in English (verbal and written); knowledge of German, Portuguese, or other languages is a plus. Create a better #TomorrowWithUs! This role is based out in Pune or Bangalore and gives you the chance to work with international teams that shape the future of Siemens’ Operations and Data Analytics landscape. We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow. Proficiency with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK) and familiarity with configuration management tools. Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or Bash; familiarity with TypeScript/Node.js. Understanding of configuration management databases (CMDBs) and ITIL-aligned change management, including approvals and audit trails. jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 11 Role: Lead Platform Engineer – Enterprise Developer Platform and Toolchain The Team The Enterprise Developer Platform & Toolchain team owns the developer platforms, tools and capabilities used by software engineers across S&P Global. Our core functions are DevOps, DevSecOps, FinOps, Platform Engineering, SRE and Developer Experience (DevEx). We partner with divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and InfoSec to establish consistent controls and governance across the SDLC, securing developer tools without disrupting the developer experience. We build services and processes that enable DevOps practices company-wide and use DevEx insights to keep our platforms simple, consistent and engineer-friendly. The team is globally distributed. The Impact You will set the technical direction for the enterprise developer platform that engineers rely on every day. By architecting integrated solutions across source control, CI/CD, cloud, identity and security tooling, and by scaling self-service capabilities, you will accelerate engineering productivity while keeping the platform secure, governed and reliable. What’s in It for You You will lead a high-visibility platform engineering function tied directly to company strategy, working with GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, AWS, Terraform and Backstage. You will have the opportunity to lead CI/CD migrations and platform adoption strategies, build and grow a team, and collaborate with security, SRE and engineering leaders. We support your growth through innovation projects, training, cloud certifications and knowledge sharing. Responsibilities Own the platform engineering roadmap, architecture and delivery from design through production. Lead, mentor and grow a team of engineers; set technical standards and review designs. Plan and track delivery across multiple workstreams, managing dependencies, risks and stakeholder communication. Define platform metrics and use them to prioritise investment and demonstrate value. Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling across GitHub Enterprise Cloud, Azure DevOps (ADO) and GitHub Actions hosted runners to ensure reliable, fast and secure software delivery. Administer and evolve GitHub Enterprise Cloud, including repository governance, branch policies, access controls and enterprise-level configuration. Manage the repository lifecycle (creation, ownership, archival) and enforce version control standards (Conventional Commits, semantic versioning, branching and PR standards). Drive the internal developer portal and self-service strategy, including service catalogues, templates and self-service workflows. Provision, secure and optimise the AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudFormation/CDK) that underpin the developer platform. Integrate security, quality and artefact management tools into developer workflows with minimal friction. Own and operate AI-assisted development tooling, including GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE, developer agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, driving adoption, measuring productivity impact and scaling usage across engineering teams. Build automation frameworks and developer agents that eliminate toil across identity and access provisioning, onboarding, environment setup, compliance checks and routine platform operations, in partnership with security and IT teams. Partner with engineering, security, SRE and architecture teams, divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and BISOs to enforce guardrails and keep the platform governed, reliable and operationally ready. Produce clear documentation, runbooks and enablement material to drive self-service adoption and reduce support burden. What We’re Looking For 8+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Enterprise Cloud (administration, Actions, hosted runners, GHAS) and Azure DevOps. Deep expertise in CI/CD pipeline design and automation at enterprise scale. Strong understanding of the repository lifecycle, Git workflows and branching strategies (Conventional Commits, semantic versioning, trunk-based/GitFlow, PR workflows). Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) and configuration management tools. Solid experience with AWS services, including compute, networking, storage, IAM and container orchestration (ECS/EKS). Understanding of CMDB and ITIL-aligned change management (change requests, approvals, audit trails). Experience building or extending internal developer portals (Backstage, Port or similar). Familiarity with ServiceNow (workflow and catalogue configuration) and data platforms (Databricks or equivalent). Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, TypeScript/Node.js). Strong communication skills with the ability to influence adoption across engineering teams. Nice to Have Experience leading CI/CD migrations across platforms. Experience working in regulated environments. Experience with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE) and developer agents/MCP integrations. Hands-on experience building developer productivity metrics and dashboards (DORA, SPACE frameworks). Contributions to open-source Backstage plugins or IDP ecosystems. Experience with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimisation for platform infrastructure. Familiarity with compliance-as-code and policy engines (OPA, Sentinel). Certifications in AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD). jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com. Job Title: Data Engineer Position: Senior Software Engineer Experience: 6 - 12 Years Category: Software Development/ Engineering Shift: Hybrid - (1PM to 10 PM Shift) Main location: Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai Position ID: J1026-2510 Employment Type: Full Time Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 6 years of relevant experience. Position Description: We are seeking a highly experienced and skilled Staff/Senior Data Engineer to join our growing data team. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining our robust data infrastructure, ensuring the availability, reliability, and scalability of our data pipelines. You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and product teams to transform raw data into actionable insights that power our business. If you are passionate about data, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we encourage you to apply. Your future duties and responsibilities Design & Development: Lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable, high-performance, and reliable data pipelines using various ETL/ELT tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, Scala). Data Modeling: Develop and optimize data models (dimensional, relational, columnar) for efficient storage, retrieval, and analysis of large datasets. Infrastructure Management: Build, maintain, and optimize data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks) and data lakes (e.g., S3, ADLS). Performance Optimization: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in data pipelines and queries, ensuring optimal data flow and accessibility. Data Governance & Quality: Implement and enforce data governance best practices, ensuring data quality, integrity, security, and compliance. Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, data analysts, and product managers to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Automation: Automate data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL/ELT) processes, monitoring, and alerting. Mentorship & Leadership: Mentor junior data engineers, provide technical guidance, and contribute to the overall growth and best practices of the data engineering team. Innovation: Stay up-to-date with emerging data technologies and trends, evaluating and recommending new tools and approaches to improve our data platform. Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for data pipelines, models, and processes. Required qualifications to be successful in this role 5+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer, with a strong track record of designing and implementing complex data solutions. Expert proficiency in SQL for data manipulation, analysis, and optimization. Strong programming skills in Python for data engineering tasks. Extensive experience with cloud-based data platforms such as AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, EMR), Azure (Data Lake, Data Factory, Synapse), or GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Storage). Proven experience with data warehousing concepts and technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks). Solid understanding of ETL/ELT processes and tools. Experience with big data technologies like Spark, Hadoop, or Kafka. Familiarity with data modeling techniques (star schema, snowflake schema, 3NF). Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git). Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex data issues. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because… You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction. Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons. That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals. Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform’s core engines—including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules. Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. Experience: 6–13 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, including 3+ years at the Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) or Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) level leading technical projects and distributed engineering teams. AI Tooling & Innovation: Advanced proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery, paired with a strategic vision for integrating AI into technical workflows. Data & Cloud Systems: Strong expertise in relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL/graph databases, distributed data processing, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Regulatory Frameworks: Working knowledge of regulatory standards including NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria). Compliance Engineering: Direct experience building or architecting systems around continuous control monitoring, automated audit trails, or policy engine evaluation (e.g., OPA/Rego). Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem. Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026. About Position: We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team and drive automation, cloud adoption, and continuous delivery initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable CI/CD pipelines, managing containerized environments, automating infrastructure, and ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of enterprise applications. You will work closely with development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to accelerate software delivery and support cloud-native transformation initiatives. Role: DevOps Engineer Location: Hyderabad Experience: 5 to 8 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment What You'll Do: Develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise deployment automation and platform engineering solutions. Design, implement, and support CI/CD pipelines for application build, testing, release management, and deployment. Deploy and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms. Collaborate with development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to streamline software delivery processes. Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment activities using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools. Develop automation scripts and reusable tooling using Shell Scripting, Bash, or Python. Monitor application and platform performance and proactively address reliability and scalability concerns. Troubleshoot deployment, infrastructure, networking, and platform-related issues. Implement DevOps best practices to improve release velocity, system reliability, security, and operational efficiency. Participate in architecture reviews and technical discussions related to cloud-native platforms and modern application deployment strategies. Support cloud migration and modernization initiatives across enterprise environments. Implement and manage monitoring, logging, and observability solutions. Ensure compliance with organizational security, governance, and operational standards. Drive continuous improvement initiatives within DevOps and platform engineering teams. Support production environments and provide technical guidance during critical incidents and deployments. Expertise You'll Bring: 5-8 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or Application Support. Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and OpenShift administration and application deployment. Expertise in Docker and container orchestration technologies. Strong experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, or similar platforms. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and Ansible. Strong Linux/Unix administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning skills. Proficiency in Shell Scripting, Bash, or Python automation. Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK Stack, Splunk, or similar platforms. Good understanding of cloud platforms including Azure, AWS, and GCP. Experience working with cloud-native architectures, microservices, and containerized applications. Understanding of DevSecOps practices, security automation, and infrastructure governance. Experience supporting production environments and resolving complex infrastructure issues. Familiarity with networking concepts, load balancing, DNS, SSL/TLS, and security best practices. Experience working in Agile and Scrum delivery environments. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview The Growth team is seeking engineers to help accelerate the adoption of Copilot and Microsoft 365. Our team is uniquely positioned at the strategic epicenter of Copilot, Agents, and Platform (CAP) for revolutionizing the productivity business by delivering embedded experiences across the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, etc.) that drive the growth of our company’s cutting-edge generative AI solutions across the commercial and consumer spectrum. Our team tackles technical challenges across a diverse tech stack, with the solutions we deliver having a direct impact on the bottom line of the business. This role requires strategic and creative thinking, as well as a passion for building technical solutions that address customer needs. We are a modern engineering organization that embodies industry best practices in Product-Led Growth (PLG). We are data-informed, hypothesis-driven, and rigorous in measuring outcomes to ensure undeniable customer and business impact. We collaborate closely with industry-leading PMs, designers, data scientists, user researchers, and marketers to build deep customer insights that inform the design of experiences used by hundreds of millions of people every day. We partner with teams across the company to deliver world-class services, and we create experiences that connect with customers across Microsoft products. We play a direct role in driving business growth and framing our business value to end users and our vibrant community of fans. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join us. Building a successful team involves creating an inclusive workplace where all people and ideas are welcome. We invest in the health of our team and take "how we work" as seriously as the impact we have on customers and the business. You don’t need to know everything when you join our team; just bring your growth mindset and willingness to learn, and we will provide mentorship and career growth to help you succeed. The team's focus is on following 3 main areas: Client: Deliver high-performance native Android/iOS/Windows/macOS experiences using modern C++, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift and platform-specific frameworks, enabling contextual Product-Led Growth motions within Microsoft 365 apps. Full-Stack: Develop end-to-end features using React/TypeScript frontends paired with C#/.NET REST or GraphQL APIs and scalable data models—built to support millions of daily users. Backend: Design and scale Azure-hosted services in C#/.NET that handle hundreds of millions of requests daily, with opportunities to lead the adoption of event-driven architectures. As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in driving the adoption and monetization of Microsoft 365 Copilot through Product-Led Growth. You will provide technical vision and hands-on leadership, solve complex problems, influence cross-functional teams, and drive architectural and organizational transformation across the stack. You will also help shape how our team works in the age of AI by championing responsible AI-assisted engineering practices that improve developer productivity, accelerate learning and delivery, and strengthen quality. Aligned with Leadership vision, you will foster an AI-first engineering culture that enables the team to innovate, collaborate, and deliver greater customer and business impact. You will build new experiences, lead experimentation, and use data to make informed decisions about release candidates. This role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth area for CAP while helping shape the engineering organization’s technical direction, culture, and values. We are builders, explorers, and connectors and we are looking for a like-minded Software Engineers who thrives on driving big ideas from spark to scale. We are looking for candidates with a growth mindset, and someone who fosters collaboration with teammates and partners. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities Partners with appropriate stakeholders to determine user requirements for a set of scenarios. Leads identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for a product, application, service, or platform. Leads by example and mentors' others to produce extensible and maintainable code used across products. Leverages subject-matter expertise of cross-product features with appropriate stakeholders (e.g., project managers) to drive multiple group's project plans, release plans, and work items. Holds accountability as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI), mentoring engineers across products/solutions, working on-call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions. Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale and shares knowledge with other engineers. Shapes how the team works in the age of AI by championing responsible AI-assisted engineering practices, driving adoption across the development lifecycle, and measuring improvements in developer productivity, quality, learning, and delivery speed. Qualifications Required/Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python. OR equivalent experience. Additional or preferred qualifications Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science. OR related technical field AND 10+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python. OR Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python. Understanding of GitHub Copilot will be an added advantage. Experience with product-led growth, experimentation platforms, product analytics and instrumentation, or activation and adoption funnels for high-scale products; familiarity with Microsoft 365 or Copilot scenarios and GitHub Copilot is a plus. Native Android/iOS/Windows/macOS experiences using modern C++, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift and platform-specific frameworks OR equivalent experience. #CAPIDC #DPG #DPGHiring #Growth #IDCMicrosoft This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. jobs.description: Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. Get to know Okta Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth. At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. Join our team! We're building a world where Identity belongs to you. The Role We seek a technical, research-minded Security Engineering Manager to lead security engineering teams within Auth0 Customer Identity. Your teams' work spans two areas. The first is threat protection: providing general and AI-driven threat intelligence in partnership with Identity Security, and researching how attackers leverage AI, how we build AI-assisted defenses, and how we protect AI workloads across our products, infrastructure, and customer tenants. The second is software development for security: building micro-services and tooling that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including how secrets are generated, stored, distributed, rotated, and retired. This role leads teams embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to deliver proactive threat intelligence, get ahead of emerging attack vectors, and build the security software that protects our platform, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business. We are an engineering-focused organization that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you will set direction for teams that don't just assess our current security posture — they research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, build the software that delivers those protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses and secure-by-default secrets handling into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants. You will lead a globally distributed group of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta's Secure Identity Commitment. You will stay technical enough to challenge designs, evaluate research, review software architecture, and earn the respect of strong engineers, while spending most of your time on leadership: hiring, growing, and retaining your teams and shaping their roadmaps. Responsibilities: Hire, lead, coach, and develop globally distributed teams of security engineers (Senior through Staff), building a culture of research discipline, technical excellence, and ownership workload identity Drive adoption of secure-by-default secrets handling across Auth0 engineering teams, and reduce the risk from hard-coded, long-lived, or over-privileged credentials Research the and protections to get there Direct research and protections against emerging general and AI-driven security threats targeting Auth0 and Auth0's customers — including traditional identity attacks as well as adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP), and data poisoning — as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants Guide the review and hardening of jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to play a key role in building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata’s cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos. You will: Design and build key components of Teradata’s agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service. Design and build agent runtimes and harnesses : tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls. Design, build and secure MCP servers and clients , and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs. Integrate and serve LLMs , both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control. Build ModelOps / LLMOps pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring. Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics. Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries. Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness. Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code. Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata’s vector store. Contribute to technical design reviews and architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions for your area. Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives. Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts across India and Silicon Valley , working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems. You’ll also work cross-functionally with: Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful. Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries. Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads. This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction. Minimum Requirements BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production. Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD. Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering. Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models. Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent. Experience with ModelOps / LLMOps : deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production. Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost. Proficiency in Python (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems. Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling). Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation). Experience implementing AI guardrails , red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense. Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI. Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads. #LI-PG1 Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

jobs.title: Deputy Director - AI Solution and Platforms
jobs.description: Overview: The AI Solution Engineer is a delivery focused engineer who designs, builds, and operates production agentic AI applications, along with the platform services those applications run on. Working within the technical direction set by AI Solutions and Platforms leadership, the AI Solution Engineer translates solution architecture into production grade agents, retrieval pipelines, tool and system integrations, evaluation harnesses, and the guardrails and observability that keep those systems reliable once live. The AI Solution Engineer is a hands on practitioner who codes, integrates, tests, and iterates, owning feature level delivery across one or more solution or platform tracks while building a working understanding of the wider AI platform. The role works daily with modern AI engineering tooling, including agentic frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph, the Model Context Protocol, and coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Codex. This is a technical builder first, with a growing architect mindset Responsibilities: Responsibilities Solution Architecture and Delivery: Architect, build and deploy production agentic AI applications for R&D, taking them from problem definition and prototype through to production use by scientists and engineers. Hands On Engineering: Write production Python and own the difficult parts, including retrieval quality, tool and function design, multi agent orchestration, context management, structured outputs, latency and unit cost. Set the technical bar through design and code review. Agentic Framework Selection: Build with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP and agent to agent patterns. Select the appropriate model across Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI and Google model families, and recognise when a deterministic or classical machine learning approach is the correct answer. Evaluation and Quality: Establish evaluation as a delivery gate, covering golden datasets built with R&D subject matter experts, automated evaluations in CI, regression and grounded Ness testing, red teaming, and human review in the loop. Take solutions from prototype into production and remain accountable for them once live. Platform Ownership: Own the shared AI platform for R&D, including retrieval and vector infrastructure, agent runtime, prompt and model registry, MCP server and connector layer, guardrails, tracing and observability, cost attribution and rate management. Define reference architectures and reusable patterns so that downstream teams ship in weeks rather than quarters. MLOps and LLMOps: Embed CI/CD for models, prompts and agents, infrastructure as code, environment promotion, versioning, monitoring, incident response, model deprecation and migration. Enterprise Integration: Integrate AI solutions with the R&D and enterprise estate, including PLM, LIMS, specification and document management systems, SAP, the Azure data platform and the enterprise Lakehouse. Security and Governance: Own security, privacy and governance for these systems in partnership with Cyber, Legal, Privacy and Responsible AI, covering access control, secrets management, handling of confidential formulation and specification data, and auditability. Contribute to AI governance standards for R&D. People Leadership: Lead, coach and grow a team of AI and platform engineers. Develop technical depth in the team and build AI literacy across the wider R&D community. Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with R&D scientists, category and platform leaders to convert ambiguous scientific problems into scoped, valuable products, and to decline those that will not work. Manage delivery partners and vendors. Communicate credibly with a food scientist and a cloud architect in the same conversation, and with senior leadership on portfolio, risk and value. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science or a related quantitative field. Masters preferred. 10 to 14 years in software, data or machine learning engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years building and running LLM and generative AI solutions in production. 2 or more years leading engineers, formally or as a senior technical lead, with evidence of having developed people. Strong hands-on Python. Code quality will be assessed during the interview process. Deep practical experience with agentic AI, covering tool calling, planning, memory, multi agent and agent to agent patterns, retrieval augmented generation, structured output, guardrails and evaluation. Production experience with LangChain and LangGraph, or an equivalent framework such as LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, Pydantic AI or custom orchestration, with a clear view of the tradeoffs. Daily working use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex or Cursor, including agent configuration and custom tooling rather than inline completion alone. Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals, including context windows, embeddings, tokenization, fine tuning versus adapters versus prompting, and failure modes such as hallucination and prompt injection. Cloud and platform engineering experience. Azure preferred, covering Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry, AKS and Functions, or the equivalent on AWS or GCP. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform or Bicep, CI/CD and API design. Data foundations, including SQL, Spark or Databricks, vector stores, and real experience working with messy unstructured technical documents. Overview (Secondary Language): Prior delivery of technology for an R&D, scientific or laboratory function in CPG, food and beverage, pharma, chemicals, flavors and fragrances, agriculture or materials science. Working familiarity with scientific and product data, including formulations and recipes, technical specifications, bills of materials, ingredient masters, sensory panel data, nutrition and claims data, and stability datasets. Experience with R&D systems of record such as PLM, LIMS or ELN, and with specification and technical document management. Track record of taking agentic systems past pilot into sustained production use, with adoption and reliability data to evidence it. Experience building MCP servers and custom tool layers over enterprise APIs and internal systems. Retrieval engineering depth beyond baseline RAG, including hybrid and semantic search, reranking, chunking strategy for technical documents, and table and figure extraction. Databricks at production scale, including Unity Catalog, Delta and Lakehouse patterns. LLM cost engineering, including token accounting, caching, batching, routing across model tiers and chargeback to business units. Experience building internal developer platforms or shared services consumed by other engineering teams. Exposure to Responsible AI frameworks, AI model risk management, or EU AI Act readiness and comparable emerging regulation. Experience handling commercially sensitive or trade secret data, including how intellectual property is protected when third party models sit in the processing path. Experience in a global capability center delivering for global stakeholders across time zones, where the hub owned outcomes rather than executed tickets. Having hired, levelled and grown AI or platform engineers in the Indian market. A postgraduate qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or Data Science, or in a scientific discipline relevant to food, chemistry, materials or nutrition. Candidates who moved from science into engineering are of particular interest. Recognized AI engineering credentials, for example Anthropic's Claude Certified Developer Foundations or Claude Certified Architect exams, GitHub Copilot certification, or Microsoft, AWS or Google AI engineering certifications. Equivalent demonstrated experience is weighted equally. Open-source contributions to agent or LLM tooling, conference talks, published papers or technical writing.

jobs.title: Scaled AI & Solution Architect
jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY The Scaled AI & Solution Architect is the senior technical design authority for the Digital Quality (DQ) organisation, which delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer. The role is a global individual contributor position accountable for setting and driving the AI and solution architecture direction across the entire DQ product portfolio, rather than for the delivery of any single product. The incumbent defines the target architecture, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering standards that every DQ solution is built against, so that capability is built once and reused many times rather than rebuilt product by product. The role leads the scaled adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and agentic AI across the portfolio, translating enterprise AI platforms and emerging technology into GxP-compliant, validated, production-grade capability that measurably improves quality, safety and environmental outcomes at site level. Recognised as an expert within and beyond Digital Quality, the incumbent influences the strategic technology direction of the QSEO business, and partners with Solution Leads, the Platform and Solution Engineering team, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security to ensure architectural coherence, compliance and pace across a complex global portfolio. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Cross-Product Solution Architecture Own the target-state solution architecture for the Digital Quality portfolio, spanning quality management, laboratory, manufacturing quality, and safety, environment and occupational health solutions. Define how products, platforms, data and integrations fit together, and drive convergence of point solutions onto common architecture, avoiding duplicated capability and unmanaged technical debt across the portfolio. Architecture Standards, Patterns and Reusable Components Establish, publish and maintain the architecture standards, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering guardrails that DQ solutions are designed and built against, covering integration, data, identity, AI, validation and cyber security. Make reuse the path of least resistance for delivery teams, and measure adoption, reuse and the resulting delivery efficiency. Scaled AI Enablement Define and drive the AI and agentic AI architecture for the DQ portfolio, including use case patterns such as deviation and incident triage, leading-indicator prediction, automated document and content generation, and conversational access to standards and procedures. Determine where AI capability should be built once as a shared service versus configured per product, and ensure AI is delivered on enterprise platforms with appropriate human oversight, evaluation, model monitoring and lifecycle management. Design Authority and Technical Governance Act as design authority for significant DQ investments, reviewing and approving solution designs at key lifecycle gates and providing architectural assurance on build-versus-buy, platform selection and vendor technical fit. Identify multiple viable options for highly complex problems, set out the trade-offs in cost, risk, compliance and time to value, and make clear recommendations to Digital and business leadership and relevant governance forums. Technical Leadership and Capability Building Provide hands-on architectural leadership to Solution Leads, Product Managers, engineers and vendor teams across the portfolio without direct reporting authority, influencing through expertise, credibility and evidence. Mentor and raise the technical capability of architects and engineers across Digital Quality, and lead architecture and AI Communities of Practice that spread good practice across DQ and the wider Digital organisation. Compliance, Data Integrity and Security by Design Ensure architectural decisions embed GxP computerised system compliance, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements from the outset, in partnership with Quality, Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Cyber Security. Define validation-efficient architecture patterns that allow AI and cloud capability to be deployed at pace while remaining inspection-ready. Innovation and Emerging Technology Exercise foresight in evaluating emerging AI, data and platform technologies, and act independently on self-initiated proofs of concept and technical experiments that challenge the status quo and shape the multi-year DQ technology roadmap. Take appropriate, well-governed technical risk, and translate proven experiments into scaled, supportable production capability with a defined adoption path. QUALIFICATIONS Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree required in Information Technology, Engineering, Environmental or Occupational Health Sciences, Life Sciences or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in in solution architecture, technical leadership or enterprise software delivery (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including demonstrable accountability for architecture across a portfolio of products rather than a single application. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI or machine learning capability into production, including an understanding of large language model and agentic architecture patterns, retrieval, evaluation and model lifecycle management. Strong experience with cloud, integration and data architecture, and with modern software engineering and Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. Experience setting and driving adoption of technical standards across teams that do not report to the incumbent, influencing senior stakeholders through technical credibility. Experience across all stages of the system and application lifecycle, from value analysis and business case through deployment to value realisation and technical debt management. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical senior leaders. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation and data integrity expectations (e.g. GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11). Working knowledge of quality, or EHS business processes and the platforms that support them (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority). Experience deploying AI in a regulated context, including responsible AI governance, model risk assessment and human-in-the-loop design. Recognised architecture certification (e.g. TOGAF) or equivalent cloud architecture certification. jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)
jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 11 Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems) Role Summary As the Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems), you will help architect and build the organization’s next generation of autonomous AI workflows. This is a multidisciplinary technical role operating at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering . You will move beyond simple "chatbots" to design production-grade Agentic Systems: intelligent applications capable of reasoning, planning, and executing complex tasks autonomously. Responsibilities Agentic Systems Architecture & Core Engineering Architect & Build Multi-Agent Workflows: Lead the hands-on design and coding of stateful, production-grade agentic systems using Python and orchestration frameworks like LangGraph , CrewAI , or AutoGen . Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Communication: Design and implement robust A2A protocols enabling autonomous agents to collaborate, hand off sub-tasks, and negotiate execution paths dynamically within multi-agent environments. State Management & Orchestration: Engineer robust control flows for non-deterministic agents; implement complex message passing, memory persistence, and interruptible state handling to support long-running autonomous tasks. Tool Interface Design (MCP): Implement and standardize the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create universal interfaces between agents, data sources, and operational tools, ensuring modularity and scalability. Model Integration & Optimization: Utilize proxy services ( i.e. LiteLLM ) to manage model routing and fallback strategies; optimize context windows and inference costs across proprietary and open-source models. Production Deployment: Containerize agentic workloads using Docker and orchestrate deployments on Kubernetes; leverage AWS AgentCore or similar cloud-native services for scalable infrastructure. Data Engineering & Operational Real-Time Integration Build Agent Data Pipelines: Write and maintain high-throughput ingestion pipelines (using Databricks or Python-based ETL) that transform raw operational signals into structured context for agents. Real-Time Context Injection: Ensure agents have access to "operational real-time" data (seconds/minutes latency) by optimizing retrieval architectures and vector store performance. Cross-Functional Engineering: Act as the technical bridge between Data Engineering and AI teams; translate complex agent requirements into concrete data schemas and pipeline specifications, while stepping in to resolve hands-on bottlenecks in data availability. Observability, Governance & Human-in-the-Loop LLMOps & Tracing: Implement comprehensive observability using tools like Langfuse to trace agent reasoning steps, monitor token usage, and debug latency issues in production. Safety & Control Frameworks: Design hybrid execution modes ranging from Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) for sensitive operations to fully autonomous execution; build "break-glass" mechanisms and guardrails for automated decision-making. Evaluation & Reliability: Establish technical standards for testing non-deterministic outputs; automate evaluation pipelines to measure agent accuracy, hallucination rates, and drift before deployment. Technical Leadership & Strategy Technical Roadmap Definition: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to scope feasibility for autonomous projects; define the "Agentic Architecture" roadmap. Mentorship & Standards: Define code quality standards, architectural patterns, and PR review processes for the AI engineering team; upskill team members on the latest agentic frameworks and methodologies. Innovation: Proactively prototype with emerging tools (e.g., new reasoning models, graph-based RAG) to solve high-value business problems, moving successful experiments into the production roadmap. Qualifications Required Experience: 7+ years of total technical experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Machine Learning. GenAI Specialization: 2+ years of specific experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or Agentic Systems in production. Database & Lakehouse Mastery: E xperience architecting storage layers for AI, including Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate , Qdrant ), NoSQL/Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB), and modern Data Lakehouses (specifically Databricks or Snowflake). Cloud & Infrastructure: E xpertise in cloud architecture and container orchestration (AWS, GCP, or Azure) using Kubernetes and Docker. You must be comfortable deploying and scaling your own applications. LLM Ecosystem: F amiliarity with common LLM frameworks and orchestration libraries (e.g., LangGraph , LangChain , CrewAI , AutoGen ). You understand the mechanics of RAG, embeddings, and context window management. Hybrid Engineering Skillset: A unique blend of Data Science (understanding model behavior, probability, and prompting) and Software Engineering (CI/CD, API design, asynchronous programming, and system reliability). Language Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python for systems engineering, capable of writing modular, testable, and maintainable production code. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. Preferred Advanced Education: Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field. NLP Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), ranging from foundational techniques (e.g., text processing, embeddings, classification) to modern architectures. Graph Technologies: Experience with Knowledge Graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune), Graph Databases, and GraphML (Graph Machine Learning) to support complex reasoning and relationship modeling. Agentic Tooling: Specific experience with LangGraph , LiteLLM , Langfuse , AWS AgentCore , or implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Advanced Architectures: Proven track record of implementing Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, swarm intelligence, or multi-modal agent workflows. Real-Time Operations: Experience working in environments requiring operational real-time processing (e.g., FinTech, Energy, Logistics). Why This Role Matters You won't just be building chatbots here; you will be architecting the organization’s "central nervous system." As the Lead AI Engineer for Agentic Systems, you are bridging the gap between static data models and active decision-making. The autonomous workflows you design—capable of planning, collaborating (A2A), and executing tasks—will fundamentally change how we operate , moving us from human-dependent processes to self-healing, intelligent systems. This is a rare opportunity to define the standards for Agentic AI in a production environment, working with a stack that represents the absolute cutting edge of the industry. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Position Overview Hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining CI/CD infrastructure, build and release automation, and software deployment solutions supporting SLT, Burn-In, and semiconductor software platforms. The role focuses on GitHub Enterprise Server, GitHub Actions, self-hosted runner infrastructure, cross-platform build and deployment automation, and reliable delivery of on-premises software across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments, with supporting Azure services. This position requires strong technical ownership of automation, infrastructure reliability, release engineering, and deployment troubleshooting across distributed engineering environments. The engineer will work closely with software development, QA, IT, infrastructure, and global engineering teams to establish scalable, secure, and repeatable software delivery practices. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Enterprise Server and GitHub Actions for multiple software products and repositories. Architect and manage self-hosted GitHub Actions runners across Windows, Linux, and macOS, including runner PCs used for hardware-dependent testing, integration, and deployment. Automate software build, unit testing, integration testing, packaging, artifact management, release, installation, and deployment workflows. Develop reusable GitHub Actions workflows, composite actions, scripts, and shared pipeline components to standardize engineering practices across teams. Design and maintain cross-platform deployment automation for on-premises applications, services, tools, and supporting infrastructure. Implement automated deployment, configuration management, environment provisioning, upgrade, rollback, and recovery procedures for customer and internal environments. Manage runner lifecycle, capacity, labels, groups, access controls, service accounts, credentials, connectivity, and job execution reliability. Build and maintain deployment automation using Bash, PowerShell, Python, and other appropriate scripting technologies. Integrate Azure services into software delivery workflows, including identity, secrets management, artifact storage, infrastructure provisioning, and monitoring, as applicable. Implement secure software supply chain practices, including least-privilege access, secret management, dependency and vulnerability scanning, artifact integrity, and controlled release approvals. Establish infrastructure-as-code and configuration-as-code practices using appropriate tools, including Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent technologies where applicable. Design CI/CD pipelines that support automated quality gates, test result publishing, code coverage, static analysis, security checks, and release readiness validation. Monitor pipeline health, runner availability, deployment outcomes, and infrastructure capacity; troubleshoot failures across GitHub, operating systems, networking, permissions, and application dependencies. Establish deployment observability, actionable logging, alerts, operational dashboards, and incident recovery procedures for on-premises environments. Manage release versioning, artifact traceability, environment configuration, release promotion, and deployment auditability across independently evolving software components. Collaborate with software and QA teams to improve build times, test reliability, deployment frequency, and developer productivity. Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, document operational procedures, and drive continuous improvement in DevOps standards and practices. Work directly with global engineering teams during software integration, customer deployments, production issues, and release support. Requirements: 7+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, build and release engineering, or infrastructure automation, with demonstrated technical ownership. Strong hands-on expertise with GitHub Enterprise Server, GitHub Actions, workflow design, reusable workflows, runner management, and GitHub APIs. Proven experience configuring, operating, troubleshooting, and scaling self-hosted CI/CD runners in enterprise environments. Strong experience with Linux administration, command-line tools, Bash scripting, and service management; practical experience supporting macOS build and deployment environments. Experience with Windows environments and PowerShell-based automation for cross-platform software delivery. Proven experience designing CI/CD pipelines covering build, automated testing, packaging, artifact publishing, deployment, and rollback. Experience deploying and supporting on-premises software in enterprise or customer environments, including environments with restricted network access. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, firewalls, ports, and service connectivity. Experience with Azure services and cloud infrastructure integration for enterprise software delivery. Experience with containers and container tooling, such as Docker or Podman, and container-based development or deployment workflows. Strong understanding of identity and access management, secrets handling, permissions, secure automation, and software supply chain security. Ability to troubleshoot complex failures spanning source control, build agents, operating systems, networking, application dependencies, and deployment environments. Experience owning infrastructure and automation solutions from design through implementation, rollout, and operational support.

jobs.description: Job Description: TD Software Test and Support Engineer ACCOUNTABILITIES Within Airbus Customer Services, “Tech Data Support & Services” (SID) is in charge of defining, producing, delivering and supporting the Technical Data (TD) products and services which are necessary for Customers to safely and efficiently operate their aircraft. Technical Documentation is characterized by large amounts of data, configuration management, direct impact on A/L operability, complexity of the processes and associated tools, complexity and diversity of the aircraft design, multiple interfaces to manage and obtain source data from Engineering or Suppliers. And finally, this is combined with the core competence of Maintenance Operations (how aircraft are maintained by operators). In this context, airnav X application is the Airbus solution allowing our Customers (internal & external) to browse and manage Airbus Technical Data. Since its Entry Into Service in 2017, the Online version has been complemented with the Intranet and the Standalone versions and it has been enriched with new features to ease the access to the documentation. Moreover, during the last years, airnav X Ecosystem has been completed with 2 new services: airnav X Full Online and airnav X Editing. With these services, Airbus offers to our Customers advanced features to better manage Airbus documentation: The possibility to attach documents, images or videos in the documentation, to manage more than 2 revisions, to control the access to their documentation by the end users and to add Airline customized data directly in the manuals thanks to the editing function. airnav X Ecosystem helps our Customers to access the Airbus Technical Data they need in an efficient way allowing them to meet their operational requirements and even to improve their operational reliability. airnav X is accessed today by more than 50,000 end users per month from Airlines, MROs and other organizations. More than 400 Customers rely on Airbus to access the technical documentation they need to maintain and operate their aircrafts. Now more than ever they are relying on Airbus expertise and support to ensure the business continuity in their operations in the current challenging context. Within the framework of the TD strategy and policy, the jobholder will be responsible for: The validation of the evolutions and defect management of the airnav X applications in its complete ecosystem (Online, Full Online, Intranet, Standalone, Editing, Offline), and/or GenEWIS application which is the digital solution for the Wiring Data and/or the STDO application which is the platform to access the Supplier data in the frame of the Tech Data deliveries. Support the BAO. He/she would also participate in the support analysis of the above applications. MAIN ACTIVITIES The job holder main activities are described here below: User Acceptance Test (UAT) Managing the test activities in coordination with the Business Application Owners and in case by case with other entities: UAT Coordination team, Project Leaders, Product Leaders, to manage: Dataset availability for tests campaigns execution “Validation environment” test accounts availability when required Tests execution (Functional tests and non-regression tests) Defects opening and tracking during the test campaign Update & maintainability of non-regression test-scripts based application evolution over the time. Participation in the relevant meeting along the test and deployment process. Support the BAO on the activities: Business Requirements Dossier, Features, Users stories, Contribute to M5 maturity and validate RCS (Request Change Sheet), Prepare the test strategy and test cases.
